title: 50 %: Staatlich geprüfte Kosmetikerin in Teilzeit
descriptionHtml:
Ein Haus, in dem Handwerk Zeit hat

Inanna Wellness ist ein privates Haus für Ästhetik und Wohlbefinden in der Charlottenstraße in Berlin-Mitte. Wir arbeiten leise und präzise, mit feinem Handwerk und sorgfältig gewählten Methoden, im Rhythmus unserer Gäste.

Wer hier arbeitet, gestaltet diese Haltung mit: den Menschen vor der Methode, Genauigkeit statt Intensität, Rhythmus statt Beschleunigung.

Diese Haltung wurde mehrfach ausgezeichnet:

  • World Spa Award 2024 und 2025, Best Day Spa Deutschland
  • Gloria Award für Ambiente 2025, 1. Platz
  • Spa Star Award 2025, Publikumspreis
  • Top10 Berlin 2026, Platz 1 in den Kategorien Beauty und Massage
  • CIDESCO-zertifiziert, als einziges Haus in Berlin

Diese Anerkennungen sind nicht das Ziel. Sie sind das Ergebnis einer Arbeitsweise, an der Sie mitwirken können.

Aufgaben

Ihre Arbeit bei Inanna Wellness

Sie begleiten unsere Gäste auf dem Weg zu sichtbarer Verfeinerung von Haut und Haar. Ihre Arbeit verbindet feines Handwerk, das über Generationen weitergegeben wurde, mit sorgfältig gewählten, wissenschaftlich fundierten Methoden der modernen Ästhetik. Technologie verstärkt, was Hände beginnen. Hände geben dem Ergebnis Eleganz.

Sie arbeiten in einem kleinen Team von fünf Menschen, unter der fachlichen Leitung von Chantal Däumig, Meisterin des Hauses.

Bei uns hat jede Behandlung ihre Zeit, in der Regel eine volle Stunde. Wir arbeiten mit wenigen Gästen und der Sorgfalt, die jede Begegnung verdient, nicht mit vielen Terminen am Tag. Was zählt, ist die Genauigkeit der Arbeit und die Aufmerksamkeit für den Menschen vor Ihnen.

Ihre Arbeit hinterlässt mehr als ein sichtbares Ergebnis. Sie gibt den Menschen, die zu uns kommen, Zeit für sich und das Gefühl, in Ruhe gesehen zu werden.

Ihre Schwerpunkte:

  • Sie analysieren Haut und Kopfhaut präzise und geben daraus eine klare, persönliche Empfehlung (Canfield VISIA®, HairMetrix®).
  • Sie gestalten handgeführte Gesichtsrituale (Biologique Recherche®) und beherrschen traditionelle Liftingtechniken (Kobido®, Sculptural Face Lifting™).
  • Sie setzen nicht-invasive Technologie dort ein, wo sie die Arbeit der Hände ergänzt: Ultraschall (LDM® Triple), Radiofrequenz (INDIBA® Elite NS) und LED-Phototherapie (Dermalux® Tri-Wave MD).
  • Sie führen fortgeschrittene Hautbehandlungen mit Genauigkeit und Sorgfalt durch, darunter Microneedling (Candela Exceed™) und chemische Peelings (VI Peel®).
  • Sie übernehmen die dauerhafte Haarentfernung mit Laser (Alma Soprano Titanium®) und Nadelepilation (Apilus®).
  • Mit sanfter Körperarbeit und manueller Lymphdrainage sorgen Sie für Entspannung und Wohlbefinden (Dr. Vodder®, Esalen®).
  • Sie begleiten Menschen in besonderen Lebensphasen mit Würde und Achtsamkeit (MamiSpa®, OncoSpa®).

Ihr Einstieg:

Damit Sie gut ankommen, gestalten wir Ihren Start mit Sorgfalt: ein strukturiertes Onboarding, persönliche Mentorinnen und regelmäßige Entwicklungsgespräche begleiten Sie. Die ersten sechs Monate verstehen wir als gemeinsame Zeit, in der beide Seiten sicher werden.

Qualifikation

Was Sie mitbringen

Sie sind staatlich geprüfte Kosmetikerin, ob am Anfang Ihres Weges oder mit Erfahrung aus dem Spa-, Klinik- oder Hotelumfeld. Präzision, Ästhetik und Achtsamkeit prägen Ihre Arbeit.

Diese Position ist als Teilzeitstelle mit 50 Prozent angelegt. Bei beiderseitigem Wunsch kann sie sich zu Beginn des Jahres 2027 zu einer Vollzeitstelle entwickeln.

NiSV-Zertifikate bringen Sie mit oder erwerben sie zeitnah mit unserer Unterstützung.

Deutsch beherrschen Sie muttersprachlich oder auf vergleichbarem Niveau, Englisch sicher. Weitere Sprachen sind willkommen.

Diskretion ist für Sie selbstverständlich. Sie arbeiten gern in einem kleinen Kreis, begegnen Menschen mit Ruhe und Aufmerksamkeit und entwickeln sich gern weiter.

Benefits

Was Sie bei uns erwartet

Inanna Wellness ist mehr als ein Arbeitsplatz. Entwicklung, Anerkennung und Fürsorge bilden hier eine Kultur, die Sie wachsen lässt.

  • Ein transparentes Bonusmodell mit drei Bausteinen: ein monatlicher Bonus, der Ihren Beitrag widerspiegelt; eine vierteljährliche Prämie für gute Ideen, Zusammenhalt und Gästeerlebnis; und eine Loyalitätsprämie nach fünf Jahren
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit Arbeitgeberzuschuss
  • Fünf Wochen Urlaub im Jahr
  • Geregelte, planbare Arbeitszeiten im Boutique-Rhythmus, mit einem festen Ruhetag in der Woche
  • Regelmäßige Masterclasses und rund zwei Wochen Weiterbildung im Jahr, unter anderem mit Biologique Recherche®, Esalen® und Kobido®
  • Klare Entwicklungswege, von fachlicher Spezialisierung über Verantwortung im Team bis zur Meisterin des Hauses
  • Fürsorge im Alltag: Dienstkleidung gestellt und gereinigt, Mahlzeiten und Getränke während der Arbeitszeit, BVG-Firmenticket, Corporate Benefits sowie Gesundheits- und Präventionsangebote
  • Ein Arbeitsplatz im Herzen Berlin-Mittes, in Räumen, die mit Sorgfalt gestaltet sind

Ihre Zukunft beginnt hier

Würde · Wissen · Wirkung.

Wir suchen Menschen, die Präzision, Tiefe und Aufmerksamkeit verbinden und an einer Kultur der Schönheit und des Wohlbefindens mitwirken möchten.

Der Weg zu uns nimmt sich bewusst Zeit, denn eine gute Entscheidung braucht sie, auf beiden Seiten. Er beginnt mit zwei validierten Stärkenanalysen, die wir für Sie übernehmen. Es folgt ein vergüteter Tag in unserem Haus, an dem Sie unsere Arbeitsweise erleben und das Team kennenlernen, und ein ausführliches persönliches Gespräch mit unserem Geschäftsführer. Über ein Angebot entscheidet das Team gemeinsam.

Wenn Sie heute in einem Anstellungsverhältnis stehen, behandeln wir Ihre Bewerbung selbstverständlich vertraulich.

Wenn Sie diese Haltung teilen, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.

title: Account Director, Data Operations
descriptionHtml:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

3165 - Account Director, Data Operations  - GCS

Role Summary and Impact

The Data Delivery & Project Manager is responsible for the end-to-end coordination, quality assurance, and governance of media data within the Cockpit programme across multiple markets. Acting as the central point of contact between local market teams, global Nestlé stakeholders, and external data partners, this role ensures the timely delivery of accurate, high-quality data that supports MMM modelling and business decision-making. The successful candidate will drive process consistency, manage complex stakeholder relationships, resolve data-related issues, and oversee programme timelines to ensure smooth and efficient execution across all participating markets.

Data Delivery and Project Management

Own and maintain the Cockpit refresh calendar for all participating markets, ensuring alignment with MMM modelling timelines.

  • Coordinate with local market teams, data processing vendors (e.g., Redmill), and global & z-EUR Nestle to ensure timely submission of accurate data to meet cockpit calendar.
  • Manage ad-hoc refresh requests and assess feasibility against resource and process constraints.

Data Quality Assurance

  • Review and validate incoming media plan data for completeness, accuracy, and adherence to agreed formats (e.g., no channels with impressions but zero spend).
  • Perform central QA checks before data is loaded into Cockpit, or oversee local QA when/if decentralised.
  • Investigate and resolve data discrepancies (e.g., spend, impressions, reach) with local teams.

Process Governance & Standardisation

  • Enforce agreed actualisation processes for Cockpit markets
  • Ensure consistent application of data governance rules, including mandatory metrics, cost allocation, and added value treatment.

Stakeholder Management

Act as the central point of contact for the cockpit program between:

  • Local OpenMind (OM) market teams
  • Global Nestlé stakeholders (e.g., Z-EUR, IT)
  • Data processing vendors (e.g., Redmill)
  • Facilitate alignment calls to resolve blockers and ensure all parties are informed of timelines, dependencies, and changes.
  • Communicate clearly on delays, risks, and mitigation plans.

Primary Skills

  • Strong background in media planning, buying, or media operations with a deep understanding of campaign structures, channels, and metrics.
  • Experience managing multi-market data workflows and working with multiple stakeholders across geographies.
  • Proven ability to interpret and troubleshoot media data (spend, impressions, reach, CPM/CPC calculations).
  • Strong project management skills, able to manage multiple deadlines and priorities in a fast-moving environment.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical data issues to non-technical stakeholders.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.

title: Account Executive, Affiliate Marketing
descriptionHtml:
Position: Account Specialist, Affiliate Marketing  

The Account Specialist position is a remote, work-from-home role, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners (a structure central to our culture and vision to change the work/life paradigm). Some travel may be required for client meetings, internal meetings, conferences, and other events. Please note: This role requires fluency in both German and English.

The Role:  

As an Account Specialist, you will be responsible for the day-to-day operations of multiple affiliate programs. The ideal candidate will have 1-2 years of work experience. Affiliate marketing experience is not required. You will manage affiliate communications, reporting, and general account maintenance, including recruitment, newsletters, fraud checks, and data analysis. You’ll work closely with your manager and peers to maximize program effectiveness and create opportunities for growth. Duties are performed across one or more assigned client accounts, which will vary over time.

Top 5 Responsibilities:  

  • Account & Client Communication  
    Build and maintain client and affiliate communications, including creative newsletters and updates about promotions, program developments, and general client information. Develop relationships with clients and partners to understand their goals and objectives, providing clear and proactive communication across channels.  
  • Reporting & Data Management  
    Utilize Excel (pivot tables, v-lookups, etc.) to produce detailed reports, track performance, and analyze data for insights and trends. Summarize findings and provide actionable recommendations to optimize program performance. Proactively track key metrics and report on campaign performance.  
  • Strategy Execution & Task Ownership  
    Own and manage client tasks with minimal supervision, ensuring deadlines are met and tasks are completed accurately. Prioritize tasks effectively, flagging any potential delays and keeping the team informed. Consistently leverage tools and client tracking platforms to support program goals.  
  • Program & Portfolio Management  
    Manage multiple affiliate campaigns, maintaining a balanced focus across each, and organizing tasks by priority. Identify areas for process improvement, and provide proactive support to peers and clients. Manage risks, track fraud, and ensure compliance with program terms and conditions.  
  • Team Collaboration & Growth  
    Collaborate with peers and management to contribute ideas for process improvements and training. Serve as a resource for peers and help drive continuous improvement across the team, sharing best practices and insights.  

What Success Looks Like:  

By 6 Months:  

  • You will be proficient in the day-to-day operations of multiple affiliate programs, including managing reporting, affiliate applications, recruitment, and creative asset deployment.  
  • You will regularly present new campaign ideas to managers and demonstrate a clear understanding of program performance, ensuring regular fraud checks and compliance.  
  • You will have developed strong relationships with clients and affiliates and will be able to execute tasks with minimal guidance.  

By 1 Year:  

  • You will troubleshoot and resolve account and affiliate issues independently, providing valuable insights and actionable recommendations to clients and internal teams.  
  • You will be an integral part of each program, developing new ideas and improving processes to create efficiencies.  
  • You will take on new account responsibilities with support from your manager and serve as a thought leader within the team, contributing to relationship-building and firm development.  

Qualities of the Ideal Candidate  

  • Strong sense of curiosity  
  • Critical thinker  
  • Confident and comfortable being uncomfortable  
  • Flexible, resilient, coachable  
  • Relationship and service oriented  
  • Proactive and outcome oriented  
  • Strong work ethic and personal standards  

Qualifications & Skills:  

  • Fluency in German
  • 1-2 years of experience- background in online marketing, e-commerce, or affiliate marketing beneficial.  
  • Familiarity with affiliate networks and SaaS platforms (e.g., ShareASale, Commission Junction, Impact) is a plus.  
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.  
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel (v-lookups, pivot tables, formatting, etc.).  
  • Knowledge of HTML is a plus.  
  • Ability to travel when necessary for conferences and team meetings.  

WHY ACCELERATION PARTNERS?  

Acceleration Partners is the world’s largest and first-to-market Partnership Marketing Agency creating and nurturing partnerships that drive exceptional measurable outcomes for their clients. Managing clients in 40+ countries, their global team of 300+ focuses on data-driven strategies that help connect brands to the right consumers through performance partnerships, traditional affiliate, influencer, performance PR, content and B2B partnership marketing.   

AP Perks & Benefits - What we offer  

  • 100% remote work for everyone  
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off  
  • Summer & Holiday Wellness Breaks in July and December  
  • Volunteer and Birthday Time Off  
  • Focus Fridays (no internal meetings)  
  • Paid Parental Leave Benefits  
  • Wellness, Technology & Education Allowance  
  • Paid sabbatical leaves, donation matching, and more!!  
  • Target salary range: £27–37K depending on location and experience  

Benefits may vary based on employment status or country location.

descriptionHtml:

Launched in 2023, INFINIT is a fast-growing fintech scale-up operating in multiple countries across Europe and Americas. Our all-in-one operating system has banking at its core, and empowers small business owners and their teams to seamlessly manage and optimize every aspect of their business with AI agents. Join us on the INFINIT journey as we revolutionise the SME economy and drive meaningful impact through innovation 🚀 The Role As a Account Executive at INFINIT, you will own revenue generation within our key account level customer segment, focusing on winning high-value, strategic new-business opportunities. You will engage with senior stakeholders, navigate complex sales cycles, and create tailored value propositions that showcase how INFINIT’s AI-driven fintech platform transforms business operations. We are looking for a high-performing hunter with a strong track record of closing larger deals, managing multi-stakeholder relationships, and driving high-impact commercial outcomes.

descriptionHtml:
Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

Über die Position

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.

We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.

title: Account Executive, Majors
descriptionHtml:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role 

We are looking for an Account Executive Majors Germany to join our team. This is a remote (ideally close to Frankfurt) role, reporting to the Regional Sales Director in the GTM Sales Majors Germany department. You will serve as a Trusted Advisor to complex enterprises, positioning Zscaler’s AI-powered Zero Trust Exchange as the foundation for their digital transformation. You will drive high-impact outcomes through sales process excellence (MEDDPICC) and Value Selling, orchestrating the strategic engagements required to cement Zscaler’s position as a global leader in the AI age.

title: Accuracy Checking Dispenser (ACD)
descriptionHtml:
Looking for something a little different from traditional pharmacy?

At Montu, pharmacy works differently. No retail counter, no walk-in patients and no OTC sales. Instead, you will be part of a busy, growing digital pharmacy focused entirely on getting medication safely and efficiently to our patients.

We are moving into a newly renovated, purpose-built pharmacy at Winnersh Triangle, giving our growing team a modern working environment with free parking on site.

If you are an experienced Accuracy Checking Dispenser who enjoys working at pace, takes pride in getting things right and wants to be part of a pharmacy environment that is continuing to grow and evolve, we would love to hear from you.

What is the role?

hat is the job?As an Accuracy Checking Dispenser at Montu, you will play an important part in making sure every prescription leaving our pharmacy is accurate and ready to reach the patient safely.

You will carry out the final accuracy check on dispensed prescriptions, working alongside our dispensers, pharmacy technicians, ACTs and pharmacists as part of a large and supportive pharmacy team.

This is a busy environment and we operate at significant scale, so you will need to be comfortable working at pace without compromising on accuracy. Attention to detail is incredibly important, as is having the confidence to stop, question something and escalate when it does not look right.

You will be trusted to use your judgement, take ownership of your work and understand the responsibility that comes with being the final check before medication reaches our patients.

Behind every prescription we dispense is a person relying on us to get it right.

What will you be doing?

  • Carrying out final accuracy checks on dispensed prescriptions before medication is supplied to patients.

  • Checking the right patient, medicine, strength, formulation, quantity and directions.

  • Ensuring all labelling is accurate and appropriate.

  • Checking that medicines have been assembled in line with prescriptions, SOPs, legal requirements and our internal processes.

  • Identifying and escalating discrepancies, near misses and potential dispensing errors.

  • Using your professional judgement and knowing when something needs to be referred to the Responsible Pharmacist.

  • Supporting the safe checking of controlled drugs, unlicensed medicines and higher-risk medications in line with relevant procedures.

  • Completing expiry date, batch number and packaging integrity checks where required.

  • Maintaining clear and accurate records of checks completed.

  • Working closely with dispensers, pharmacists and the wider pharmacy team to resolve queries quickly and safely.

  • Supporting quality improvements and helping us continually improve the way we work.

  • Sharing your knowledge and supporting colleagues across the pharmacy.

  • Keeping up to date with SOPs, regulatory requirements and best practice.

What do you need?

We are looking for someone who is confident in their ability, comfortable working in a busy environment and takes real pride in accuracy.

You will need:

  • An accredited Accuracy Checking Dispenser qualification recognised for pharmacy dispensing practice.

  • Previous experience carrying out final accuracy checks within a pharmacy environment.

  • A strong understanding of the dispensing process and the importance of each stage in preventing medication errors.

  • Good knowledge of pharmacy legislation, SOPs, governance and patient safety.

  • Excellent attention to detail and the ability to maintain accuracy when working at pace.

  • Confidence to challenge something when it does not look right and escalate concerns appropriately.

  • The ability to work independently while understanding the boundaries of your role.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work well within a busy pharmacy team.

  • A proactive approach and willingness to take ownership.

  • A genuine focus on the patient and the quality of care they receive.

title: ad/mbo-stage Informatiebeheer, Documenten Ordenen & Kwaliteitszorg
descriptionHtml:
ad/mbo-praktijkstage, vanaf februari 2027

Ben jij iemand die graag orde schept in de chaos?
Krijg je energie van uitzoeken, structureren en dingen overzichtelijk maken?
Werk je graag met digitale systemen?

Dit is jouw uitdaging

We hebben honderden documenten met informatie over ons beleid en genomen besluiten. Deze documenten zijn relevant voor veel collega’s. Om die reden willen we de documenten graag op een overzichtelijke manier aanbieden, zodat alle collega’s snel en makkelijk het document kunnen vinden dat ze zoeken. We hebben al een idee hoe we dit willen gaan doen. Tijdens jouw stage ga je ons idee verder uitwerken en in de praktijk toepassen.

Dit zijn de concrete activiteiten:

  • Je gaat alle beleidsdocumenten verzamelen die nu nog op verschillende plekken zijn opgeslagen.

  • Je maakt een mappenstructuur aan, waarin de documenten op een logische plek komen te staan.

  • Je deelt de documenten in volgens de nieuwe structuur en voorziet ze van labels en metadata voor een optimale vindbaarheid.

  • Je controleert of documenten dubbel voorkomen en verwijdert dubbele, verouderde en niet meer relevante documenten.

  • Je kijkt of de nieuwe structuur in de praktijk goed werkt en of gebruikers de documenten gemakkelijk kunnen terugvinden.

  • Je signaleert knelpunten en doet waar nodig voorstellen voor verbeteringen.

Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Heerlen

Je loopt stage bij het team Staf van Dataverzameling (DVZ) van het CBS in Heerlen. Vanuit deze directie wordt een groot deel van de data verzameld die het CBS nodig heeft voor zijn werk. Je krijgt dus een kijkje achter de schermen bij een organisatie die dagelijks met veel verschillende soorten data werkt.
Jouw stageopdracht gaat over kwaliteitszorg voor alle teams binnen DVZ.

Je staat er tijdens je stage natuurlijk niet alleen voor: je hebt collega’s om je heen bij wie je terechtkunt met vragen en ideeën. De sfeer op de afdeling is informeel en gezellig. Collega’s zijn makkelijk aanspreekbaar en helpen elkaar graag. Natuurlijk wordt er hard gewerkt, maar er is ook tijd voor een praatje bij de koffieautomaat of een gezamenlijke lunch. Als je wilt, kun je tijdens de lunch ook aansluiten bij een lunchwandeling.
Kortom: je krijgt bij ons de ruimte om praktijkervaring op te doen, nieuwe dingen te leren en echt mee te werken in een team.

Dit breng jij mee

Je volgt een ad- of mbo-opleiding informatiebeheer, administratie, business services of management support.

Je hebt kennis van en wellicht ervaring met:

  • Het werken met documenten en informatie en deze op een overzichtelijke manier ordenen.

  • Het werken met digitale programma’s en systemen en het snel wegwijs worden in nieuwe systemen.

  • Nauwkeurig en gestructureerd werken en het leuk vinden om dingen netjes en overzichtelijk te maken.

  • Samenwerken en overleggen met collega’s, vragen stellen en meedenken over hoe iets beter of makkelijker kan.

Je werkt graag netjes en gestructureerd, bent betrouwbaar en vindt het leuk om nieuwe dingen te leren. Je pakt uit jezelf dingen op, denkt mee en stelt vragen als iets niet duidelijk is. Ook vind je het prettig om samen te werken en makkelijk contact te maken met collega’s.

Dit kun je van ons verwachten

Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je:

  • praktijkervaring opdoet met document- en informatiebeheer en leert hoe je informatie overzichtelijk en goed vindbaar maakt;

  • zelfstandig aan de slag gaat, maar ook samenwerkt en overlegt met collega’s;

  • leert hoe je duidelijk communiceert, vragen stelt en goed afstemt met je stagebegeleider;

  • leert om problemen en verbeterpunten op tijd te herkennen en deze samen met je collega’s te bespreken;

  • feedback krijgt en en toepast, zodat je tijdens je stage steeds meer leert en groeit in je werkzaamheden.

Voor jouw inzet ontvang je een stagevergoeding van € 800 bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week).

Dit zijn onze voorwaarden

Het betreft een stageopdracht en geen werkervaringsplek. Voordat je aan de stage begint verwachten we dat je vanuit de onderwijsinstelling een stagebegeleider hebt, waarmee de stage is afgestemd en concrete leerdoelen zijn afgesproken.
Deze stageopdracht is bedoeld voor studenten die momenteel staan ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling; afgestudeerden komen niet in aanmerking.

title: AI Research Engineer, Pre-Training
descriptionHtml:
Hudson River Trading (HRT) is seeking an AI Research Engineer (Pre-training) to join the HAIL team. HAIL (HRT AI Labs) is the team at HRT responsible for developing and maintaining our most powerful models, which are used by our trading teams to drive a significant fraction of our trading. We are building and deploying "foundation models for markets", that ingest and train on vast amounts of market and “alternative” data (such as language) to make predictions about future market state.

As a pre-training research engineer on HAIL, you will have a general mandate to improve all aspects of large-scale model training, including but not limited to kernel development, training data loading, parallelism, networking, and fault-tolerance. You will work closely with our researchers to co-design and improve our models, and shape the research agenda.

We have multiple large, modern, and rapidly growing GPU clusters, and we maintain a very high GPU-to-researcher ratio. We are simultaneously pursuing multiple strategies and developing many model types with different purposes, and we are strongly incentivized to squeeze as much as we can out of our systems. Your work will be directly, clearly, and highly impactful on the business, and it will be challenging: this is a field with no easy or obvious solutions.

Qualifications

  • Strong engineering skills, especially any of: CUDA/Triton/Pallas/CuTe DSL kernel development, lower-level PyTorch/JAX/XLA development, CUDA Graphs, FPGA/ASIC experience
  • Must have two or more years work experience building deep learning systems, for any domain: robotics, biology, chemistry, physics, audio, video, recommendations, etc.
  • Experience translating methods between areas of application is highly valued
  • LLM experience is valuable, but not necessary
  • Finance experience is not required

The estimated base salary range for this position is 250,000 to 300,000 USD per year (or local equivalent). The base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role will also be eligible for discretionary performance-based bonuses and a competitive benefits package.

Culture

Hudson River Trading (HRT) brings a scientific approach to trading financial products. We have built one of the world's most sophisticated computing environments for research and development. Our researchers are at the forefront of innovation in the world of algorithmic trading.

At HRT we welcome a variety of expertise: mathematics and computer science, physics and engineering, media and tech. We’re a community of self-starters who are motivated by the excitement of being at the cutting edge of automation in every part of our organization—from trading, to business operations, to recruiting and beyond. We value openness and transparency, and celebrate great ideas from HRT veterans and new hires alike. At HRT we’re friends and colleagues – whether we are sharing a meal, playing the latest board game, or writing elegant code. We embrace a culture of togetherness that extends far beyond the walls of our office.

Feel like you belong at HRT? Our goal is to find the best people and bring them together to do great work in a place where everyone is valued. HRT is proud of our diverse staff; we have offices all over the globe and benefit from our varied and unique perspectives. HRT is an equal opportunity employer; so whoever you are we’d love to get to know you.

title: Analyst Relations
descriptionHtml:

WHY CONDUCT

We believe the world’s largest companies should move at the speed of their ideas, not the speed of the decade-old systems they run on. Today they don’t.

Every process change and every new product line runs into SAP systems layered with decades of custom code and complexity no human mind can fully comprehend. New requirements take months to ship, system migrations cost $100M+ and years of pain.

We’re building the AI operating system that absorbs this complexity and gives enterprises back their speed and ambition. Major enterprises already trust us with their most critical systems, we’ve closed game-changing SI partnerships, and just raised a $60M Series A.

We’re a small, talent-dense team doing our life’s work out of London and NYC. Extreme ownership, high velocity, low-ego collaboration. What you build here shapes the company and how the world’s largest companies operate. We sponsor visas and are convinced diverse teams build better products, so we especially encourage underrepresented groups in tech to reach out.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Every great enterprise software company has a moment when analysts stop treating it as a vendor to watch and start treating it as the one that defines the category. We’re building toward that moment, and we want you to lead us there.

This is a rare chance to build an analyst relations function from the ground up. There’s no legacy playbook and no inherited programme. You decide what world-class looks like and build it with the full backing of the founders. You’ll have a seat at the table on narrative, product and go-to-market from day one, and your work will show up directly in the deals we win and the category we help define.

You'll be the first dedicated AR hire and the person who shapes how the world's most influential technology analysts see Conduct, and by extension how the CIOs and boards who rely on them see us. title: Analytics Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Analytics Engineer | Tech Ops | Hybrid Working | Hatfield

Introduction:

We are Ocado Group, and we're bringing world-class automation to online grocery. Our Ocado Smart Platform (OSP) combines cutting-edge robotics, AI, and IoT within our advanced CFCs (Customer Fulfilment Centres). We've mastered the single pick, transforming online delivery for our global partners. Join us and be part of a team pushing the boundaries of retail technology.

About the Role:

As an Analytics Engineer for Tech Ops and OMRS, you will bridge the gap between data producers and data consumers, transforming complex data from our robotics and automated systems into trusted, certified data foundations. Focusing on bot, grid, and maintenance telemetry, you will design reporting layers in dbt and implement standardized definitions in the semantic layer to ensure metrics remain consistent across all dashboards, analysts, and AI tools.

In this role, you will act as the key liaison between Data Engineering and business analysts, establishing robust data models and governing metric changes. You will play a pivotal role in enabling self-service analytics, triaging domain requests, and using modern AI-assisted engineering tools to build reliable, high-performing data pipelines that support our global operations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain layered dbt models in BigQuery, balancing query performance with long-term maintainability.
  • Implement and govern standardized business metrics within the dbt semantic layer (MetricFlow).
  • Migrate existing metric logic into the semantic layer while resolving data duplication.
  • Elevate analyst workflows into certified, production-ready reporting marts with full documentation and lineage.
  • Implement automated data quality testing and monitoring, escalating issues to upstream data producers.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact to triage and scope data requests across Tech Ops and OMRS.
  • Translate operational processes into clear data requirements in collaboration with subject matter experts.
  • Enable and coach analysts on dbt best practices, conducting merge request reviews.
  • Maintain metadata to ensure compatibility with AI tools and automated analytics plugins.
  • Utilize AI-assisted development tools (such as Claude Code) to accelerate data modelling and migration.

What We’re Looking For:

Essential

  • Strong hands-on experience with SQL (BigQuery preferred) and dbt, including models, macros, testing, and documentation.
  • Proven background in dimensional data modelling (Kimball or Inmon methodologies) and Git version control workflows.
  • Solid understanding of BI platforms (such as Looker) to align reports with semantic layers.
  • Ability to translate ambiguous business requirements into precise technical data structures.
  • Clear communication skills with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Degree in a numerate discipline or equivalent practical experience.

title: Area Medical Leads, North and South
descriptionHtml:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

You own the clinical bar across the Neko clinics in the North (currently Birmingham and Manchester) or South (currently London) regions of the UK.

That means every consultation in your area meets the same threshold of safety, quality, and member experience across your region. It means the clinical teams working with you are developing, not just performing. It means clinical issues are being seen and addressed before they show up in audits or member complaints. And it means the quality metrics for your region are known, owned and moving in the right direction. And it means clinical judgment shows up at the table when operational decisions are being made.

You'll partner closely with the UK Medical Director, who holds final clinical authority for the UK market, and operate in true dyad partnership with the Area Clinic Manager for your region who owns the operational side. The clinical health of the region is yours.

What You'll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months

  • Hold the clinical standard across every site in your area

  • Manage and develop the clinicians in your region: performance conversations, development plans, coaching, and the honest feedback that turns good clinicians into great ones.

  • Ensure lead clinicians in your market(s) are performing excellently and that the clinical teams have the appropriate clinical escalation pathways in place.

  • Support clinical hiring for your area against defined criteria, and partner with the Training and Education team to close training gaps as they emerge.

  • Own the review and closure of clinical incidents and near-misses in your area, making sure learnings are actually applied, not just documented.

  • Own the quality metrics for your region: accountable for performance against Neko's medical quality goals at area level, including scan quality (perfect scan score), member follow-up quality and timeliness (perfect follow-up score and follow-up SLAs), clinical safety (Northstar Clinical Safety score) and clinician summary quality and timeliness. Review the data with your Area Clinic Manager each week and month, trace variation to root cause by site and clinician, set improvement actions, and report progress and risks to the UK Medical Director.

  • Operate in true dyad partnership with the Area Clinic Manager: co-owning quality, member experience, and business goals, attending and contributing to Weekly and Monthly Business Reviews, and bringing clinical input into operational decisions before they're made.

  • Round your sites regularly to observe, support, and listen, surfacing what's working so it can spread, and what isn't so it can be addressed.

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with the GPs, NHS trusts and private specialist clinicians who receive Neko referrals, monitoring referral quality and addressing breakdowns quickly.

  • Know the UK regulatory landscape: CQC registration and inspection standards, GMC/NMC professional standards and revalidation, NHS and GP referral pathways and obligations, and UK-specific clinical rules, and flag emerging risks before they become problems.

  • Lead or participate in clinical pilots as required - defining success, capturing learnings, and documenting outcomes so the rest of the company can learn from your region.

What We're Hiring For

  • Holds the Bar at Scale. You're the kind of clinical leader who can make sure every consultation feels the same regardless of site or clinician, not by micromanaging, but by setting a clear standard, coaching to it, and noticing when it drifts. You're rigorous without being rigid.

  • Develops the Clinicians You Lead. You take clinician development seriously. You give honest feedback even when it's uncomfortable. You spot what someone needs before they ask. You know the difference between a clinician who needs coaching and one who needs to leave, and you don't avoid either conversation.

  • The Dyad That Actually Works. You bring clinical judgment into operational decisions before they're made and you stay constructive when clinical standards and operational targets pull in different directions. When you escalate, it's because something genuinely needs leadership attention, not because you've stopped trying to resolve it locally.

  • Reads the Pattern, Not Just the Report. You don't just review the data. You see what it's telling you. You round your sites and notice things that don't show up in dashboards. When you spot a pattern you trace it to the root cause and you make sure the right people hear about it.

  • Trusted Outside the Walls. The referral network, the regulators, the specialist clinicians who receive Neko members: these relationships sit with you. You represent Neko credibly because you're a credible clinician yourself. People in the local medical community know your name, and when you flag something, they take it seriously.

Minimum Requirements

  • Full GMC registration with a license to practice, in good standing and with a current revalidation, and right to work in the UK.

  • On the GMC GP Register with qualification (CCT or equivalent) in General Practice.

  • 4+ years of medical leadership experience in the UK health system (NHS and/or private sector), including direct management of clinicians.

  • Demonstrated experience holding clinical standards across multiple sites or a large clinical team.

Preferred

  • Experience in preventive care, tech enabled healthcare or longitudinal care models.

  • Experience operating in a clinical-operational dyad structure.

  • Experience leading clinical pilots or scaling new clinical workflows across multiple sites.

title: Associate, AI & Robotics
descriptionHtml:
About Marble

Marble creates hard tech companies for the New Climate Era, across energy, industry and resilience. Since 2021, we have launched 15 companies backed by some of the best investors across Europe and North America.

About the role

We are hiring an Associate to drive venture creation across multiple opportunity areas in physical AI, robotics, and autonomy in a broad range of sectors (e.g. energy, logistics, construction, manufacturing, mining, etc)

Reporting to Partners, this role gives exposure to every aspect of venture creation: opportunity research, founder recruitment, tech and product development, economic analysis, go-to-market, fundraising, investment decisions, portfolio management.

Because we work at pre-company stage, the job requires to identify what will be relevant and fundable in 2-3 years, not just what is hype today.

Location: Paris, France (occasional travel for events)

Language: Fluent English required. French or German is a plus.

Responsibilities

As part of the Venture Lead team, you will be responsible for driving our venture creation process on the opportunity areas that you own:

  • Opportunity research: build conviction on priority areas where Marble should create new companies, based on deep technical and market analysis.

  • Talent sourcing: identify talent with high founder potential and relevant domain expertise and hire them as Founders in Residence to build with Marble.

  • Building: work with Founders to develop venture ideas, systematically de-risk them, and turn them into new companies with team, funding and a roadmap to seed. You'll ensure robust diligence to support progress / stop decisions.

Alongside these, you will take on supporting work and special projects based on priorities and your profile, such as: external content creation, events, founder resources development, portfolio support, ecosystem relations, etc.

Requirements

This role is ideal for an engineer or computer scientist who can build, reason from first principles, with enough technical foundations to navigate various domains where intelligent systems interact with the physical world:

  • Technical expertise in AI/ML applied to physical systems, robotics and autonomy. You hold a PhD or MS in Computer Science (ML/RL), Robotics, or related (EEng, MechEng), with applied experience in startup or industry.

  • Experience shipping systems in a real-world environment. You understand operational constraints such as safety, uptime and latency, human-in-the-loop workflows, and integrations with other systems.

  • Commercial orientation. Beyond tech alone, you enjoy thinking about product, customers, economics, deployment, manufacturing or supply chains.

  • First principles reasoning. You can break down a problem into its core constituents to understand what needs to be true for things to work.

  • Clear communicator. You can articulate complex ideas and defend a conviction with sharp memos and engaging presentations.

  • Talent intuition. You know a great founder when you meet them, and if you want to work with them, you know how to persuade them.

  • Makes things happen. Team player who moves fast, with high standards for excellence, and high ownership on projects from start to finish.

We would love to hear from you if this sounds like you:

  • You have prior experience working with early stage startups, deep tech commercialisation, applied R&D, or industrial tech development.

  • You are AI native. You can combine frontier tools and human judgment to maximise productivity and leverage in your work.

  • You are relentlessly curious. You stay current in your own field, you enjoy learning about new domains, and you learn very fast.

  • You have a superpower. For example: technical mastery in a field, the ability to see patterns where others cannot, truly original ideas, high EQ and energy level, strong network in a relevant domain, extraordinary writing skills, etc.

  • You are playing to win. You know that venture is competitive and follows a power law, and the challenge motivates you.

  • You are a pragmatic optimist with a driving motivation to solve the hardest problems in physical industries, AI and climate infrastructure.

Your ability to learn on the job matters more than ticking every box.

What We Offer

  • Full-time (CDI) contract, Associate level*

  • €60-70k gross annual base salary + 10% target bonus + stock options

  • Office in Paris. Occasional remote days are possible

  • Health insurance (Alan), meal and mobility vouchers (Swile)

  • Exposure to our network of top founders, investors, and advisors

  • Working with the brightest, most driven individuals you'll meet

  • Rapid learning curve and personal development

  • Enhanced parental support

What is hard to capture just with the above is the unique opportunity this role offers to join Marble in the early days of our journey, and shape the future of what we hope will become a top institution in climate and hard tech in Europe and beyond.

(*) We're opportunistically open to more experienced candidates who could potentially join at the Senior Associate level.

We believe that a diverse group of minds creates an unfair team advantage when building high impact companies. Hence, we actively encourage candidates from all backgrounds, genders and perspective to apply.

Studies have shown that under-represented candidates are less likely to apply unless they feel they meet every single qualification. If you are excited about the opportunity but your experience does not align perfectly - please apply anyway!

You will be accountable for translating client business objectives into best‑in‑class paid social strategies, ensuring excellence in activation across all major social platforms, and embedding WPP Media’s Social Excellence and DPAM ways of working across all activity. The Account Director is also a critical escalation point, senior client contact, and people leader.

Operational Leadership & Escalation

  • Act as the primary escalation point for client or campaign issues, resolving challenges quickly and effectively.

  • Drive continuous improvement across processes, tools, and ways of working to deliver operational excellence.

Skills & Experience

  • Significant experience in paid social media, ideally within an agency environment.

  • Proven experience leading teams and managing senior‑level client relationships.

Life at WPP Media & Benefits 

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.

Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.  

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. title: Associate Relationship Manager - South West
descriptionHtml:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Our vision is to reimagine Relationship Banking for established SMEs, through the very best people, products and digital tools. Allica’s Relationship Management team was formed in 2022 and continues to grow at pace, providing established SME customers with expert human relationships alongside modern banking technology.

The team supports customers with lending, current accounts, savings, asset finance and working capital facilities, while building deep local relationships with SME customers, trusted professional advisers and business communities.

The Associate Relationship Manager role is a newly created position that is a key step in our ambition to build the best Relationship team to support our SME clients. The successful candidate will manage a portfolio of clients and be expected to deliver across a range of commercial, customer service and risk objectives whilst also providing support to the wider relationship team as part of their development.

This is a great opportunity for someone looking to develop their skills and progress a career as an SME Relationship Manager.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Manage a portfolio of SME customers delivering outstanding customer service, building genuine and trusting relationships and develop a deep understanding of your clients’ businesses and their ambitions.

  • Deliver against a range of commercial targets including lending and new customer / deposit acquisition, as well as identifying and meeting a range of client needs through the provision of Allica products and services.

  • Build a trusted external network with SME advisers and the wider business community. Leverage this network to generate new business opportunities for the bank, in addition to signposting your clients to external support and advice as appropriate.

  • Ensure that Risk is managed effectively on your portfolio, with all required risk activities completed on time and to a high standard. Use customer data and internal Allica systems to identify signs of client stress and take proactive action to tackle early.

  • Work closely with a Senior Relationship Manager, contributing to building a bespoke personal development plan which will include supporting them and the wider team as part of your learning.

  • Take an active role in new business campaigns, including attending events, following up on leads, supporting prospect engagement and undertaking some cold calling where appropriate.

  • Support event organisation and follow-up activity, helping the team build strong local relationships with SME customers, prospects, accountants, solicitors and other trusted professional advisers.

  • Maintain accurate CRM records, strong follow-up discipline and good control over customer, prospect and portfolio activity.

  • Build strong, collaborative and productive relationships with your team and wider internal stakeholders to ensure customer needs are meet efficiently and any issues resolved quickly.

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • Some B2B sales, account management and/or SME banking experience, with a clear interest in building a career in SME relationship banking and a passion for supporting SMEs to be more successful.

  • Some experience of commercial lending and understanding / analysing financial accounts would be of benefit.

  • Curious, proactive and keen to learn, with the motivation to develop lending, sales, risk management and portfolio management capability through formal training and on-the-job coaching.

  • Confident engaging with customers, prospects and SME business advisers (including in person, via video call and by phone) asking great questions, following up consistently and building professional relationships.

  • Good organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to manage customer information and requests, portfolio tasks and follow-up actions accurately and at pace.

  • Practical understanding of customer service, sales activity and account management disciplines, ideally gained in a B2B, financial services or relationship-led environment.

  • Confident using systems, CRM tools and data to manage activity, track progress and support strong customer and risk outcomes.

  • Experience using AI tools in a business environment would also be of benefit.

  • An energetic, resilient, hands-on approach, with the confidence to get into the detail, solve problems and take ownership of outcomes.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to build credibility with customers, prospects, advisers, colleagues and stakeholders.

  • Strong alignment to Allica’s values, with the judgement, integrity and energy to lead by example and help contribute to the next phase of the Direct Relationship Management channel.

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

  • Options for flexible working

  • Regular social activities

  • Pension contributions

  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • Private health cover

  • Life assurance

  • Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

Don’t tick every box?

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

title: Backend-Entwickler (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Einleitung

Wir suchen neue Kolleg:innen! Migrando ist ein Legal-Tech-Unternehmen aus Cottbus. Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, den komplizierten und langwierigen Weg zur Einbürgerung effizienter und kundenfreundlicher zu gestalten. Mit unserer Expertise im Ausländerrecht und einem starken Team aus über 60 Kolleg:innen begleiten wir tausende Mandant:innen erfolgreich auf dem Weg zum deutschen Pass. Alle unsere Stellen sind Festanstellungen bei uns vor Ort in Cottbus.

Am besten verschaffst du dir gleich selbst einen Eindruck auf unserer Karriereseite. Denn wir können hier schreiben, was wir wollen, am Ende bleibt es eine langweilige Einleitung.

Wir bieten Dir

Bei uns trägst du echte Verantwortung für die technische Grundlage, auf der alles aufbaut. Kein isoliertes Ticket-Abarbeiten: Du gestaltest von Anfang an aktiv mit, wie unsere Systeme funktionieren und miteinander kommunizieren.

  • Echter Einfluss auf Stack und Architektur
    Docker Desktop, Supabase, n8n, HubSpot-API, WordPress: Du arbeitest mit dem Stack, der den Job erledigt. Du entscheidest mit, welche Technologien wir einsetzen, wie Schnittstellen aufgebaut sind und wie unser technisches Ökosystem langfristig aussieht. Und wenn du ein besseres Tool kennst, wollen wir davon hören.
  • High-End-Hardware nach Wahl
    Egal ob MacBook Pro oder Windows-Tower: Du bekommst die Maschine, auf der du am besten performst, dazu 4K-Monitore, ein hochwertiges Headset, einen höhenverstellbaren Tisch und einen rückenfreundlichen Stuhl.
  • Musik bei der Arbeit
    Bei uns wird nicht mit der Stirn gerunzelt, wenn du dir Kopfhörer aufsetzt. Wenn es dir hilft (und niemanden stört), kannst du auch gern Heavy Metal über eine Soundanlage an deinem Schreibtisch pumpen.
  • Kurze Wege und kleine Teams
    Du arbeitest in überschaubaren Teams, in denen man sich kennt. Du musst dich nicht durch Hierarchien hangeln, um gehört zu werden, sondern sprichst direkt mit Kolleg:innen, Teamleads oder der Geschäftsführung. Entscheidungen fallen schnell, und niemand sitzt „im Elfenbeinturm“.
  • Vertrauensarbeitszeit und flexible Teilzeit
    Keine Kernzeiten, keine vorgeschriebenen Zeitfenster. Ob 4-Tage-Woche, 30 Stunden oder ein individuelles Modell: Dein Job soll zu deinem Leben passen, nicht andersherum.
  • Homeoffice nach der Einarbeitung
    Grundsätzlich arbeiten wir im Büro, weil Zusammenarbeit und Austausch vor Ort für uns wichtig sind. Nach deiner Einarbeitung ist gelegentliches Homeoffice aber kein Problem, auch spontan.
  • Spontan frei, wenn das Leben dazwischenkommt
    Kranke Kinder, Elternabend, kurzfristiger Arzttermin oder einfach mal eine Auszeit: Wir planen unsere Teams so, dass auch spontane freie Tage möglich sind, ganz ohne Stress oder schlechtes Gewissen. Familie und Gesundheit haben bei uns Vorrang.
  • Sinnstiftende Arbeit
    Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf das Leben von Menschen. Du unterstützt sie dabei, in Deutschland anzukommen, Sicherheit zu finden und ein neues Kapitel aufzuschlagen. Das ist keine trockene Büroarbeit, sondern Arbeit mit echter Bedeutung.
  • Modernes Altbau-Büro mit Fitnessraum
    Hohe Decken, viel Tageslicht, Pflanzen und ein Innenhof für die Pause zwischendurch, mitten im Herzen von Cottbus. Unser eigener Fitnessraum im Haus steht dir kostenlos und jederzeit zur Verfügung. Einen Einblick in unsere Räume bekommst du auf unserer Website.
  • Team-Events und Feel-Good-Angebote
    Sommerfest am See, Weihnachtsfeier, Halloween-Sause, gemeinsame Lunches oder Afterwork-Dinner: Wir feiern gern. Erscheinen ist keine Pflicht, und früher gehen ist auch kein Problem. Zwischendurch sorgt unsere Feel-Good-Managerin für kleine Auszeiten, von Nacken- und Schultermassagen bis zu kurzen Entspannungs-Sessions.

Mögliche Aufgabenbereiche

Als Backend-Entwickler (w/m/d) bei Migrando baust du die technischen Grundlagen, auf denen unser gesamtes Ökosystem läuft. Unsere Plattform besteht aus mehreren Portalen, Tools und Automatisierungen, die täglich von tausenden Nutzer:innen verwendet werden. Du arbeitest eng mit Frontend, Design, SEO und Automatisierung zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Systeme stabil, sicher und performant laufen. Ob saubere Logiken in WordPress, Arbeit mit der HubSpot-API, Automatisierungen in n8n oder performante Datenbanken in Supabase: Du entwickelst Lösungen, die langfristig funktionieren und skalieren.

  • API-Integration & Schnittstellenbau
    Du bindest externe Dienste wie CRM-Systeme, Payment-Anbieter oder Marketing-Tools an, baust REST-Endpoints und sorgst für einen sicheren, zuverlässigen Datenaustausch.
  • Entwicklung neuer Features
    Du baust serverseitige Logiken und neue Funktionen, von kleinen Plugins bis zu komplexen Modulen für unsere WordPress-Instanzen.
  • WordPress-Development
    Du programmierst individuelle Funktionen für Produktlogik, Checkout, Bestellprozesse oder Kundenbereiche.
  • Zusammenarbeit mit dem Frontend
    Du stimmst dich eng mit dem Frontend-Team ab, lieferst die passenden Endpunkte, unterstützt beim Deployment und denkst gemeinsam über technische Verbesserungen nach.
  • Datenbank-Management
    Du pflegst und optimierst Datenbanken, strukturierst Tabellen sinnvoll, verbesserst Queries und hältst unsere Datenstrukturen sauber und performant, egal ob unsere Website-Datenbank oder eine Supabase-Datenbank mit internen Daten.
  • Performance-Optimierung
    Du arbeitest an besseren Ladezeiten (Cloud oder lokales Netzwerk), Query-Optimierungen, Caching-Strategien und einer insgesamt schnelleren Serverarchitektur.
  • Automatisierung & Hintergrundprozesse
    Du entwickelst Cronjobs, automatisierte Datenverarbeitungen, n8n- oder HubSpot-Workflows und Hintergrundprozesse, die unsere täglichen Abläufe effizienter machen.
  • HubSpot-Entwicklung
    Du arbeitest mit den Entwickler-Tools in HubSpot und sorgst für eine reibungslose Anbindung an unser bestehendes Ökosystem.
  • Interne Tools weiterentwickeln
    Du arbeitest an kleinen Services, Modulen und Helferprozessen, die unsere Plattform und unser Team technisch voranbringen.
  • Evaluierung neuer Technologien
    Du probierst neue Tools, Frameworks oder moderne WordPress-Architekturen (z. B. Headless-Ansätze) aus und bringst sie ins Team ein.

Dein Profil

Bei uns zählen keine Abschlüsse oder Zertifikate. Wichtig ist, dass du dein Handwerk beherrschst und bereits praktische Erfahrung in der Backend-Entwicklung gesammelt hast, egal auf welchem Weg. Du weißt, wie man Schnittstellen baut, Datenbanken optimiert und Code schreibt, der nicht nur performt, sondern auch von anderen verstanden wird. Wenn du Verantwortung nicht scheust und Lust hast, ein technisches Ökosystem aktiv mitzugestalten, freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

  • Praktische Erfahrung in der Backend-Entwicklung
    Du hast bereits Backend-Projekte umgesetzt, die im Live-Betrieb laufen, und weißt, was es heißt, sie zu betreuen und weiterzuentwickeln. Du entwickelst gern Funktionen, die zuverlässig laufen, sauber strukturiert sind und sich gut erweitern lassen.
  • Festanstellung vor Ort in Cottbus
    Du möchtest fest bei uns angestellt sein und im Team vor Ort in Cottbus arbeiten. Für Freelance-Aufträge oder reine Remote-Stellen sind wir leider nicht die richtige Adresse.
  • PHP-Skills
    Du kennst dich mit moderner PHP-Entwicklung aus, fühlst dich mit OOP und gängigen Patterns wohl und weißt, wo PHP heute steht.
  • Erfahrung mit WordPress
    Du weißt, wie Themes und Plugins aufgebaut sind, arbeitest mit Hooks und fühlst dich im WP-Ökosystem zu Hause.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Datenbanken
    Du kannst Datenbankstrukturen sinnvoll planen und nutzen und kennst die gängigen Best Practices.
  • Erfahrung mit APIs
    Du hast schon mit REST- oder vergleichbaren Schnittstellen gearbeitet, weißt, wie man Services integriert und autorisiert, und hast idealerweise auch eigene Endpunkte gebaut.
  • Sauberer, gut strukturierter Code
    Lesbarkeit und Architektur sind für dich keine Nice-to-haves. Du schreibst Code, den andere in sechs Monaten noch verstehen, inklusive dir selbst.
  • Sicherheitsfokus
    Du kennst typische Schwachstellen und weißt, wie man sich dagegen absichert. In unserem Fall geht es vor allem um Website-Schwachstellen, denn unsere internen Tools sind nur innerhalb des Netzwerks erreichbar.
  • Datenschutz-Verständnis
    Wir arbeiten mit sensiblen Kundendaten. Deshalb erwarten wir ein Bewusstsein für die sichere Speicherung und Verarbeitung dieser Daten.
  • Verantwortungsbewusstsein
    Du denkst bei deiner Arbeit an Skalierbarkeit, Datenintegrität und langfristige Wartbarkeit. „Quick and dirty“ darf auch mal sein, aber das wird vorher abgesprochen.
  • Offenheit für Neues
    Du hast Lust, dich in neue Tools oder Frameworks einzuarbeiten und dich fachlich weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe
    Eigentlich wollen wir hier nichts Generisches schreiben, aber dieser Punkt ist uns wichtig: Gute Zusammenarbeit zählt für uns genauso viel wie Know-how. Jemand, mit dem die Zusammenarbeit angenehm und reibungslos läuft, ist im Alltag oft wertvoller als jemand mit noch mehr Erfahrung, mit dem die Kommunikation aber schleppend ist.
  • Deutsch oder Englisch
    Du sprichst Deutsch oder Englisch, am besten beides (ca. B2-Niveau). Keine Sorge, einen Nachweis brauchen wir nicht.

title: BC Graduate - Fospha
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT BLENHEIM CHALCOT

At Blenheim Chalcot, we invest more than just funds. We invest our knowledge and experience, our ideas and infrastructure.

We are a leading digital venture builder, creating and scaling businesses that transform industries through technology, innovation and entrepreneurship.

Our ventures operate across a wide range of sectors, including FinTech, EdTech, GovTech, Media and Marketing Technology. Businesses we have built include ClearScore, Salary Finance and Modulr.

We provide our portfolio businesses with the expertise, infrastructure and strategic support needed to scale successfully, spanning technology, commercial growth, talent, finance and operations.

For graduates, this creates a unique opportunity to gain exposure to entrepreneurial thinking, innovative technologies and the practical challenges of building successful businesses.

ABOUT FOSPHA

Fospha is a fast-growing marketing measurement technology company transforming how global brands understand and optimise their marketing performance.

In an increasingly complex digital landscape, Fospha helps businesses understand what is driving growth across their marketing channels, enabling smarter investment decisions and more effective commercial strategies.

Combining advanced data science, AI and marketing analytics, Fospha provides a powerful measurement platform that allows brands to understand the full impact of their advertising investments.

Working with leading global brands, Fospha is at the forefront of innovation in marketing technology, helping businesses make data-driven decisions and unlock new opportunities for growth.

With an international team spanning multiple markets, Fospha offers an exciting environment for ambitious graduates who want to develop their skills, challenge conventional thinking and contribute to a rapidly scaling technology business.

Find out more: https://www.fospha.com

THE GRADUATE OPPORTUNITY

Joining Blenheim Chalcot as a Graduate, you will gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment while working directly within Fospha.

You will be embedded within the Fospha team, contributing to meaningful projects across commercial strategy, business operations, analytics, AI and growth initiatives, depending on business priorities and your strengths.

This is not a traditional graduate scheme where you spend months observing. From the outset, you will be encouraged to take ownership, contribute ideas and make a measurable impact.

For you as a graduate, this opportunity involves:

  • Dedicated to Fospha – Although you will be employed by Blenheim Chalcot, your day-to-day responsibilities, projects and objectives will be focused on supporting Fospha's growth and strategic priorities.

  • Commercial & Strategic Exposure – Gain experience working on real business challenges, analysing opportunities, improving processes and supporting initiatives that contribute directly to business performance.

  • AI, Data & Technology – Develop practical experience of how AI, automation and data-driven decision-making can transform business operations, enhance productivity and create commercial value.

  • Training & Development – Access Blenheim Chalcot's learning and development opportunities, designed to strengthen your professional, commercial, analytical and leadership skills.

  • Early Careers Development – Benefit from structured development opportunities, mentoring and exposure to experienced professionals across Fospha and the wider BC portfolio.

  • Graduate Community – Become part of the wider Blenheim Chalcot graduate community, with access to learning sessions, networking opportunities, collaborative projects and social events.

  • Accountability & Ownership – Take responsibility for meaningful projects from an early stage, developing your ability to think independently, solve problems and deliver results.

  • Career Progression – Build a strong foundation for a long-term career within a high-growth technology business, with opportunities to develop as the organisation continues to scale.

WHAT YOU COULD BE WORKING ON

Depending on your interests, capabilities and Fospha's business priorities, you could be involved in:

  • Analysing commercial performance, market opportunities and business growth initiatives.

  • Supporting strategic projects that improve operational efficiency and scalability.

  • Exploring how AI tools and automation can improve existing business processes.

  • Working with stakeholders across commercial, product, operations and analytics teams.

  • Conducting research, preparing business cases and presenting recommendations to senior stakeholders.

  • Identifying opportunities to improve how the business operates, makes decisions and delivers value to customers.

  • Supporting cross-functional initiatives within a fast-growing international technology business.

We are looking for graduates who are excited by the opportunity to get involved in different challenges, learn quickly and contribute wherever they can make the biggest impact.

ARE YOU BC?

We don't expect you to have worked in a start-up before, studied a technology-related degree or have extensive professional experience.

We are more interested in your potential, mindset and ability to learn.

We welcome applications from graduates across all academic disciplines, particularly those who demonstrate strong analytical thinking, intellectual curiosity, commercial awareness and an interest in technology.

We look for some key fundamentals in people joining the BC Group:

  • Curious – You ask questions, challenge assumptions and are always looking for better ways of doing things. You are genuinely interested in emerging technologies, AI and how businesses grow.

  • Analytical & Commercially Minded – You enjoy solving problems, working with information and understanding how decisions translate into business outcomes.

  • Doers – You are proactive, resourceful and willing to take initiative. You don't wait to be told what to do and are motivated by delivering tangible results.

  • Flexible Mindset – You thrive in dynamic environments, adapt quickly to changing priorities and are comfortable navigating ambiguity.

  • Enthusiastic About Technology – You recognise the opportunities AI, data and digital innovation present and are excited to explore how they can be applied in a commercial environment.

  • Humble & Sociable – You are collaborative, approachable and enjoy working with talented people. We value individuals who bring energy to a team and are open to feedback and continuous learning.

Above all, we are looking for ambitious individuals with the drive and potential to grow alongside the business.

If you see yourself in this and would like to work with similarly minded people, we would love to hear from you!

WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU AS A BC EMPLOYEE

  • Be part of one of the UK's leading digital venture builders, with the opportunity to learn from experienced entrepreneurs, technologists and business leaders.

  • Gain meaningful experience within Fospha, an innovative and internationally growing marketing technology company.

  • Access structured graduate learning and development opportunities.

  • Join a collaborative graduate community across the Blenheim Chalcot portfolio.

  • Exposure to AI, data, commercial strategy and business innovation.

  • A fun, entrepreneurial and ambitious working environment.

  • Discretionary bonus.

  • 25 days of annual leave plus your birthday off.

  • Life Assurance and Pension Scheme.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme.

  • Flexible benefits, including Private Medical Insurance, Dental Cover and gym subsidies.

APPLICATION & RECRUITMENT PROCESS

If you are keen to apply, please submit your CV and a member of our Talent Team will be in touch regarding the next steps.

We have a structured recruitment process designed to assess your potential, problem-solving ability, commercial thinking and suitability for a fast-paced entrepreneurial environment.

Our process typically consists of three stages:

Stage 1: Initial HR Screening

An introductory conversation with a member of the BC Talent Team to explore your background, motivations, career aspirations and interest in Fospha.

Stage 2: Case Study Assessment

An opportunity to demonstrate your analytical thinking, commercial judgement, problem-solving ability and approach to using technology and AI to tackle business challenges.

Stage 3: Final Interview

An interview with senior stakeholders from Fospha and Blenheim Chalcot, focusing on your strategic thinking, potential and alignment with the business.

Please note that the recruitment stages and timings may be adjusted depending on business requirements.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES

Blenheim Chalcot is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer. Diversity is one of our core values and is central to our business.

We strive to maximise the diversity of our workforce and welcome applications from everyone.

We encourage diversity of perspective, background, identity and thought, while fostering an environment where everyone can express themselves regardless of race, religion, sex, gender, colour, national origin, disability or any other legally protected characteristic.

We are committed to nurturing an inclusive environment and building a diverse workforce.

By submitting your CV you understand that we have a legitimate interest to use your personal data for the purposes of assessing your eligibility for this role.  This means that we may use your personal data to contact you to discuss your CV or arrange an interview, or transfer your CV to the hiring manager(s) of the role you have applied for.  You can ask us at any time to remove your CV from our database by emailing  here.
