title: Bookkeeper (Boekhouder)
descriptionHtml:
Monumental is automating on-site construction with robotics and software. Our mission is to make construction software-defined and autonomous - a future where beautiful, bespoke buildings go up in a single day, with minimal labour.

We're a growing team of engineers, operators and technicians from diverse backgrounds, including consumer tech, finance and media, and companies like Dyson, Shopify, Meta and Tesla. It's still the early days of building the company, and this is a chance to make an outsized impact on a problem that matters. From day one, you'll be working with an experienced founding team, backed by a $32M Series B led by Khosla Ventures and Plural, alongside other renowned investors.

Monumental is based in the city centre of Amsterdam, in a beautiful facility with a fully equipped workshop and robot testing floor. We build the whole stack in-house, hardware and software. Our work involves building robots in our workshop and houses on real construction sites, so we're onsite five days a week.

Read more on why we believe you should spend your time working on construction, and learn about our vision and company. You might enjoy our YouTube Channel, Based in Europe’s film on how we’re fixing Europe’s housing shortage, or this video by Andreas Klinger of what our office looks like.

About the role

We're looking for a Bookkeeper to bring our day-to-day bookkeeping and month-end close in-house. You'll be our first dedicated bookkeeper, taking over from our external accounting firm and running the books for our growing group: five Dutch BVs today, plus our entities abroad.

Our transaction volume has roughly doubled this year, and 2027 is the first financial year our accounts will be audited. You'll own the reconciliations, records and close process that make our numbers reliable, working closely with our finance lead, purchasing team and external accountants. The external accountants will continue to handle annual accounts and corporate tax, with local advisors handling tax filings abroad.

This is a hands-on bookkeeping role for someone with at least three years of experience running the full cycle through month-end. Our data and processes need cleaning up. If you enjoy turning a messy administration into a tidy one, this is that job. As you settle in, there is room to take on VAT filing and monthly payroll processing.

The role is based at our Amsterdam HQ, on-site five days a week. Salary is up to €50,000 gross a year, including the 8% holiday allowance.

What you'll do

  • Own daily bookkeeping. Code supplier invoices and card spend in Spendesk with the right GL account, VAT code and cost centre, and post them to the general ledger without re-keying. Keep supplier records clean and prepare payment runs. Supplier bank-detail changes are independently verified and approved; payment approval and release sit with the finance lead.

  • Keep accounts reconciled. Reconcile bank accounts, keep payables and receivables current, and investigate outstanding items so every balance is supported or explained.

  • Run the month-end close. Close all entities to a fixed timetable, initially by working day eight and moving towards working day five. Own accruals, prepayments and balance-sheet reconciliations, collect or prepare foreign entities' figures, agree intercompany balances and reconcile group reporting to the ledgers.

  • Maintain fixed assets and inventory records. Keep the fixed-asset register up to date, including capitalisation and depreciation of our robot fleet under agreed accounting policies, and reconcile inventory accounts to month-end stock values.

  • Prepare Dutch VAT returns. Prepare quarterly btw returns with our external accountants reviewing, and take over filing them over time.

  • Keep the books audit-ready. Maintain supporting schedules and an audit file throughout the year. Be a day-to-day contact for our external accountants and support the audit of our 2027 accounts.

  • Improve how we work. Document the close, fix recurring errors and use spreadsheets, software and AI tools to reduce manual work while checking the results carefully. Depending on your experience, take on payroll processing in Loket over time, with payroll tax filings remaining with our external accountants.

What we're looking for

  • Full-cycle bookkeeping experience. You have at least three years of experience running the books through month-end, at an accounting firm (accountantskantoor) or in-house.

  • Hands-on Dutch VAT experience. You've prepared Dutch btw returns and can work through the supporting records.

  • Strong reconciliation skills. You've handled balance-sheet reconciliations, accruals and prepayments, beyond processing invoices. You investigate differences and follow them through to a resolution.

  • Accuracy and ownership. You keep records organised, meet close deadlines and raise missing information or accounting questions early. You'd rather find the €12 difference than book it to suspense.

  • Fluent English and professional working Dutch. English is our working language, and your manager doesn't speak Dutch. You can independently read and process Dutch invoices, tax correspondence and payroll documents.

  • Comfort with systems and confidential information. You work confidently with spreadsheets, learn new accounting tools and handle financial and employee information carefully.

title: Brand Marketing Stagiair(e)
descriptionHtml:
Start: Februari 2027
Beschikbaarheid: 32 uur per week
Periode: 6 maanden

Inner Circle is ontworpen voor mensen die weten wat ze zoeken. Geen eindeloos swipen, maar relevante matches met mensen met dezelfde lifestyle, waar elke dag duizenden dates uit ontstaan.

Doel van de rol

Als Brand Marketing Stagiair(e) help je mee om Inner Circle zichtbaar, relevant en onderscheidend te maken op de socials. Je werkt nauw samen met het marketing- en content team en krijgt veel ruimte om te creëren, te testen, te analyseren en te leren. Van TikTok-trends tot community-interactie en performance-inzichten: jij helpt ons bouwen aan content dat niet alleen entertaint, maar ook iets in beweging zet.

Wat je gaat doen:

  • Content Creation: Je helpt met het creëren en inplannen van content voor Instagram & TikTok. Denk aan Reels, Stories, educatieve posts en leuke trends die mensen laten stoppen met scrollen.

  • Trends spotten: Je houdt trends in de gaten en vertelt ons what’s hot (and what’s not). Jij weet als eerste wat viraal gaat, en kan het direct vertalen naar Reels/ posts voor Inner Circle. Let’s roll! Het hoeft niet perfect, het gaat vandaag nog live!

  • Campagnes analyseren: Je analyseert, rapporteert en evalueert social media content en campagnes.

  • UGC Scouting: Je helpt ons de leukste (UGC) creators te vinden die matchen met onze merkwaarden / wie wij zijn.

  • Copy writing: je vindt het leuk om te schrijven en kan iedereen met jouw woorden overtuigen. Je ondersteunt ons met het schrijven van CRM materiaal: van nieuwsbrieven en blogposts tot pushberichten en in app alerts.

  • Community management: Daarnaast ga je in gesprek met onze volgers, beantwoord je comments en DM’s en help je mee aan het opbouwen van een levendige en loyale dating community.


Wat wij zoeken:

  • Een echte content liefhebber. Of je nu achter de camera staat of verdwaald bent in je FYP, jij weet wat er online speelt!

  • Duidelijk, zelfverzekerd en creatief is met woorden, zowel geschreven als gesproken. En zich comfortabel voelt voor én achter de camera.

  • Ervaring heeft met TikTok, Instagram en tools als Figma, Canva, CapCut etc.

  • Creatief is, maar ook resultaatgericht, analytisch en gestructureerd werkt.

  • Beschikbaar is om te starten vanaf eind februari 2027 (flexibele ingangsdatum).

  • Een HBO- of WO studie volgt en op zoek is naar een fulltime stage, voor een periode van minimaal 6 maanden.

Over Inner Circle

Inner Circle voelt minder als een datingapp en meer als een members club voor dating.

We zijn gebouwd op de overtuiging dat tegenpolen niet aantrekken. Daarom brengen we mensen samen die bewust kiezen met wie ze daten en elkaar herkennen in levensstijl, ritme en intentie. Dat zorgt voor relevantere matches en dates die sneller kloppen.

Inner Circle is een onafhankelijke, bootstrapped techbedrijf. We werden opgenomen in de FT1000 als een van Europa’s snelst groeiende bedrijven en wonnen de Deloitte Technology Fast 50 in Nederland.

Ons team bestaat uit 40 mensen met 16 nationaliteiten en een 60:40 man-vrouwverhouding. Diversiteit zien we niet als beleid, maar als realiteit. Bij Inner Circle is er ruimte om jezelf te zijn in hoe je werkt en wie je bent.

Solliciteren?

Geïnteresseerd in deze kans? Solliciteer snel en eenvoudig, beantwoord een paar korte vragen zodat wij je beter kunnen leren kennen.

Houd er rekening mee dat we kandidaten al tijdens het proces selecteren, dus wacht niet te lang. We kijken uit naar je sollicitatie!

title: Business Associate Intern (Online Business)
descriptionHtml:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

This position is Paris-based.

☎️ Our B2B team

“Nothing stops them from getting the best deals for Joko users. The B2B team’s mission is to develop and grow Joko’s brands network, and available offers.”

The B2B team is divided between our three business lines at Joko: Online, Card-Linked, and Gift Cards.

  • The Online team is responsible for expanding and managing our portfolio of leading e-commerce retailers, both directly and via affiliate marketing platforms

  • The Card-Linked team is responsible for negotiating and signing enterprise partnerships with top-tier physical retailers, and for strengthening these long-term relationships over time

  • The Gift Cards team is responsible for building and managing a broad portfolio of brands and retailers, partnering with providers and brands to drive growth

Led by Nicolas, our CRO, we are a vibrant team full of energy! We work closely with other teams to give the best experience to our partners and build strong long-term relationships. We are a small but unstoppable squad that manages millions of euros in contracts thanks to our outstanding team members and a deep sense of camaraderie. We don't take ourselves too seriously and make sure that the journey is a blast!

🎯 What you will do

As a Business Associate Intern, your mission will be to support the Online B2B team to grow Joko’s e-commerce business in France and abroad: with a strong focus on our upcoming US expansion.

Your responsibilities will revolve around three main pillars:

  • Develop and manage partnerships: Grow your own portfolio of leading brands, negotiate commercial deals and promotional campaigns, and ensure top-quality relationships with our strategic partners.

  • Drive growth through data insights and operations: Act as a trusted advisor for partners by analyzing their performance, extracting actionable insights, understanding their needs and progress, and guiding them on how to maximize results.

  • Contribute across commercial, analytical, and cross-functional projects: Work on strategic initiatives that blend commercial development, customer and data insights, and problem-solving. Collaborate with Marketing, Product, and other transversal teams to analyze performance, identify opportunities, and help shape new initiatives and product launches.

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Education: You are enrolled in a top engineering, business school (or equivalent).

  • Experience: You are looking for an end-of-studies 6-month internship (or a second gap-year internship) and you have at least 6 months of prior experience, ideally gained in a fast-paced environment, tech, or consulting.

  • Problem solver: You are pragmatic and know how to solve problems quickly.

  • Mindset: You have an entrepreneurial mindset, you like challenges and you like getting hands-on.

  • Autonomy: You are fully autonomous and able to manage complex projects from A to Z.

  • Languages: You have to be a fluent French speaker, but also at ease in English both written and spoken, as we are expanding internationally soon.

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

  • 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

  • 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

  • …and much more, check the full list here!

🤝 Our hiring process

  1. Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

  2. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

  3. Step 2 – Role-specific assessments

    • For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).

    • For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

  4. Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.

  5. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

title: Business Development Manager UK
descriptionHtml:
Business Development Manager (UK)

Location: London (hybrid, regular office presence) with UK-wide travel
Reports to: UK Country Director
Type: Full-time, permanent
Compensation: 70-80K Base + 40K OTE + Participation in our warrant program

About Teton

Teton is building the foundational data layer for the point of care, using real‑time, multimodal AI to create a digital twin of both the resident and the care environment, giving care providers clear visibility into what is happening at the bedside. Our technology removes the administrative and observational workload that slows care teams down, allowing them to focus on delivering exceptional care.

Through a combination of in‑room hardware and intuitive desktop and mobile applications, Teton supports a seamless experience for residents, carers and operators. Our solution provides unprecedented access to real‑time data, creating a digital twin of resident states and care delivery that gives care teams actionable intelligence to make faster, safer and better‑informed decisions.

With strong demand and clear product‑market fit, we are scaling rapidly across the UK. This role offers a rare opportunity to drive market expansion in our highest‑potential region.

The Role

The Business Development Manager will hunt and close Teton’s new business with mid‑market care operators: small and mid‑sized residential and nursing care home groups.

This is a hunter role. You will own a defined portfolio of named target groups, generate your own pipeline through high‑volume outbound and events, and move deals quickly from first conversation to signature. Your focus is closing five‑ to six‑figure agreements and building a fast, repeatable win rate across the mid‑market.

Key Responsibilities

New business

  • Prospect relentlessly into your named mid‑market care groups through outbound calling, email, LinkedIn, events and referrals. (Larger groups are covered by our Business Development Directors.)

  • Own the full sales cycle from first meeting to signed contract, keeping deals moving through pilots and contracting with urgency.

  • Consistently close five‑ to six‑figure, multi‑home agreements, converting pilots into paid, group‑wide rollouts.

Senior relationships

  • Engage owners, managing directors, operations leads, registered managers and clinical leads in consultative, outcome‑led conversations.

  • Present clear business cases covering falls reduction, staffing efficiency, regulatory outcomes and ROI.

Pipeline and forecasting

  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified opportunities, with accurate forecasting and disciplined CRM hygiene.

  • Partner closely with Customer Success and Account Management to ensure seamless handover and expansion across signed groups.

  • Represent Teton at regional and national care‑sector events, turning every event into qualified pipeline.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of B2B sales experience, ideally selling SaaS or technology‑enabled solutions into health, social care or another regulated environment.

  • Or a strong track record and deep network in the UK care sector, with the ability to leverage it from the vendor side.

  • A consistent record of exceeding new business quotas, including closing five‑ to six‑figure deals.

  • Experience managing multi‑stakeholder deals to close at pace, from owner‑operators to operational and clinical leads.

  • A true hunter: confident with high‑volume outbound, you build your own pipeline and are driven by closing. You thrive in high‑growth environments and take ownership.

  • Working knowledge of the UK care regulatory landscape (CQC, clinical safety standards such as DCB0129/0160, data protection) or the ability to get there quickly.

  • Highly organised, proactive and comfortable in a fast‑moving environment.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

  • Valid driver’s licence and willingness to travel across the UK.

  • Based in or near London, with regular presence in our London office.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary and uncapped commission.

  • Participation in our warrant programme.

  • The chance to win a large share of the UK mid‑market in a fast‑scaling business.

  • The opportunity to work with state‑of‑the‑art technology in a pioneering field.

  • A vibrant, learning‑focused environment with significant room for growth and impact.

What It’s Like Working at Teton

We are a high‑performing, fast‑moving team of ambitious people who care deeply about our mission. The learning curves are steep, and expanding your skill set is not just encouraged but expected. You will be challenged, supported and surrounded by people who take ownership and move quickly.

We are looking for individuals who believe in our long‑term vision and value entrepreneurship over a traditional nine‑to‑five. If you want a role where your work genuinely shapes the future of care delivery, and you are ready for the ride, we would love to meet you.

title: Business Director
descriptionHtml:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

 A hybrid working model 

We believe the best work happens whenwe'retogether, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection.That'swhywe’veadopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If yourequireaccommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. 

What does a Business Director do at WPP Production? 

By understanding WPP Production's full breadth of services, our Business Directors bring smart solutions to clients, helping them transition and transform their business. You are a hunter and team builder who drives client business, as well as grows WPP Production's opportunities and revenue.

You add value by maintaining and growing client relationships and are valued by senior clients for your partnership and strategic guidance. You are a driver of growth, who identifies new business opportunities and manages new business pitches to grow your portfolio of business. A storyteller who can drive and lead business with the ability to write and present decks with flare and precision.  An exceptional leader of clients, complex teams and individuals, you epitomise our brand values, are passionate about the business and inspire others to continually push to be better.  You partner with the Global Client MD (GCMD) and Global Client Lead (GCL) as well as the wider team helping to deliver the right strategic messaging and expectations for delivery excellence.

Key areas of responsibility

Growth and account planning

  • Support GCMD and GCL in driving agency revenue growth across new business
  • Drive organic strategic business growth through strong relationships, a solid knowledge of your clients’ business, strategic direction and competitive landscape
  • Focus on cross selling our capabilities and services to extend our offering to clients
  • Partner with the Commercial Team and Client Operations Director to formulate plans to manage and leverage opportunities to drive client business and partnership
  • Drive and maintain a client business development plan, comms and contact strategy (per client) and identify specific opportunities and actions
  • Play a key role in new business pitches

Relationship management

  • Build client relationships based on plan agreed with GCMD/ GCL
  • Seen as a trusted advisor on WPP Production's capabilities and provides guidance and counsel to clients to help them achieve their business objectives by developing the right production strategy
  • Responsible for day-to-day management of overall client engagement and relationship health
  • Monitor client satisfaction metrics and associated performance measures. Ensure negative feedback is escalated to GCMD, is addressed directly with clients and corrective action plans are implemented
  • Deep understanding of client dynamics and objectives, manage client expectations for the agency and course correct potential client issues. Briefing GCMD/GCL and agreeing a quarterly plan
  • Working closely with the GCL to understand contractual obligations and commercial arrangement and how these impact our ways of working as well as profitability
  • Provide strategic insights to clients on a monthly/quarterly basis
  • Partner with Client Director and/or Client Operations Director to drive account governance including Quarterly and Annual Business reviews and ensure flawless delivery

Collaboration

  • Work with GCMD/GCL and Client Operations Director to understand who the right capability experts are to bring in to unlock opportunities for growth
  • Partner with Client Delivery to develop and maintain high levels of team effectiveness and satisfaction
  • Maintain high level of trust and respect among department heads in Creative, Production, Operations, Technology, Finance and SMEs
  • Partner with Client Delivery to navigate when there are conflicting priorities
  • Work with Global ExCo and WPP Production Marketing Team to tell the story of WPP Production by delivering compelling case studies and content sound bites

Leadership

  • Create a culture of fresh-thinking, collaboration, respect, equality, diversity and inclusion, with a focus on learning, development and growth
  • Contribute to WPP Production's culture by exhibiting ownership, professionalism, passion and leading by example
  • Regardless of reporting lines and disciplines inspires the wider portfolio team to deliver their best
  • Empower the team to take ownership and find solutions, supporting them by removing any barriers to success
  • In partnership with GCMD and GCL, hire and retain the best talent
  • Understand how data and the use of data can change how we approach content creation and elevate the types of conversations and recommendations we have with clients
  • Have an active interest in sustainability and help drive change within WPP Production to think and act more sustainably

Financials

  • Support GCMD/GCL with P&Ls, budgets and forecasting
  • Ultimately responsible for monthly financial management and agreed contribution margins
  • Partner with the Client Delivery, Finance and Commercial Teams to review revenue and plan against regular revenue analyses provided by the finance team to achieve monthly commitments
  • Knowledge of profit levers and use them to drive profitability across your account portfolio

 Requirements:

  • Experience in a Client Services industry, working in a marketing, integrated campaigns/digital agency and/or consultancy environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to grow revenue through strategic and organic growth and new business with a motivation to meet specific financial targets.
  • Strong business and financial acumen.
  • Expert client relationship skills – multi-stakeholder environment, matrix reporting, industry POV.
  • Experience driving positive and/or turning around Client Satisfaction Scores.
  • Ability to build partnerships across disciplines, networks and teams.
  • Ability to write clear, cohesive and focused client communications including strategic presentations with strong storytelling skills. Also training Sr ADs and ADs to develop these skills.
  • Authentically passionate about great work, teams and business.
  • Curiosity and insatiable need for continual learning that is infectious.
  • AI Proficiency: A strong grasp of the marketing technology landscape, specifically GenAI, Agentic workflows, and how they will disrupt traditional production hierarchies.
  • Proven consultative skills with a proactive and strategic approach to client engagement, serving as a trusted advisor.

Why work here: 
At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

Inclusion and Impact 
WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
Data
We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment. title: C2 Software Engineer

  • Expertise in software development on Linux platforms
  • Solid understanding of networking protocols and communication mechanisms, including TCP/IP, UDP, and inter-process communication (IPC)
  • Experience designing and working with REST APIs
  • Knowledge of low-latency communication systems
  • Fluent in English and German

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with high-availability and fault-tolerant systems
  • Understanding of real-time and deterministic system requirements
  • Experience with sensor integration and multi-modal sensor fusion in event-driven systems
  • Background in geospatial data systems (GIS/geoinformatics) or processing of time-series data

Vous commencez là où débute toute transformation IA : par l’ambition du client, son secteur d’activité et ses processus métier, et non par la technologie. Et vous restez un maker : vous ne vous arrêtez pas au slide. Vous construisez vous-même analyses, business cases et démos fonctionnelles (vibe coding, low-code, no-code) que le client peut toucher, et vous développez un domaine d’expertise solide dans un secteur ou une fonction métier.

Vous travaillez main dans la main avec nos équipes Engineering (qui construisent et livrent des solutions d’IA agentique) et nos équipes AI Adoption (qui favorisent leur adoption) : vous définissez les processus cibles et la roadmap, Engineering les construit et les livre, et AI Adoption accompagne les personnes dans le changement, dès le premier jour.

Activités & Responsabilités

I. Conception de la stratégie et de la transformation IA

Vous définissez la vision IA et la roadmap priorisée des cas d’usage, challengez la pertinence de l’IA et assumez les arbitrages. Lorsque c’est pertinent, vous conduisez des refontes de processus de bout en bout, en pensant lean avant de déployer l’IA et en mobilisant les équipes Engineering et AI Adoption pour les livrer. Vous concevez le modèle opératoire cible et sécurisez ses conditions de succès.

II. Analyses, business cases & prototypage

Vous concevez et pilotez les travaux d’analyse de la mission, business cases inclus, afin de sécuriser des décisions fondées sur les données et sur les faits, et vous revoyez le travail de l’équipe. Vous prototypez rapidement des cas d’usage pour illustrer la valeur par la démo et aider les clients à se projeter dans la solution finale.

III. Delivery, livrables & collaboration

Vous dirigez les missions au quotidien en donnant de la visibilité aux sponsors clients : vous découpez chaque mission en streams, anticipez les risques et challengez le client lorsque c’est pertinent. Vous produisez en autonomie des livrables de niveau C-suite et des synthèses exécutives, structurez la storyline et veillez au respect des standards de qualité Artefact. Vous orchestrez les équipes Engineering pour la faisabilité technique et les équipes AI Adoption pour ancrer l’adoption sur le terrain.

IV. Relation client & développement commercial

Vous êtes l’interlocuteur de confiance des directeurs métiers et des responsables de projets (Comex-1) : vous cartographiez les rapports de force entre les parties prenantes, animez les restitutions pour emporter l’adhésion et maximiser le NPS client, et gérez les tensions et escalades en préservant la confiance. Vous détectez de nouveaux besoins sur le terrain, construisez le plan de développement du compte avec le Directeur ou le Partner et déclenchez de manière proactive des propositions pour développer les comptes existants, en contribuant aux propositions commerciales et aux soutenances.

V. Équipe & connaissances

Vous encadrez et faites grandir les consultants juniors et seniors, êtes counsellor de plusieurs collègues et participez au recrutement des futurs talents. Vous contribuez aussi à la base de connaissances interne par des articles et des retours d’expérience, et animez des formations internes.

Profil recherchéVous vous reconnaissez si… vous aimez piloter des missions exigeantes de bout en bout, faire grandir une équipe et gagner la confiance de dirigeants, et si vous préférez mettre une démo entre leurs mains plutôt que leur décrire une vision.

  • 5 à 8 ans d’expérience au sein d’un cabinet de conseil en stratégie, en management ou en transformation data / IA.
  • Une formation supérieure de niveau licence ou master, issue d’un cursus académique d’excellence.
  • Une expérience de pilotage de missions complexes, de la vision aux résultats, avec des business cases qui résistent à l’examen d’un Comex.
  • Une solide compréhension des enjeux opérationnels de l’IA (IA générative et agentique, gouvernance, cas d’usage métiers), avec la capacité de l’expliquer simplement à des dirigeants.
  • Une expérience de pilotage de projets de refonte de processus métier, avec une maîtrise avérée de certains processus métier.
  • Une expérience du développement commercial (propositions, développement de comptes, relation avec des décideurs de haut niveau).
  • Une expérience d’encadrement d’une équipe de consultants, avec le goût de faire grandir, de déléguer et de tirer l’équipe vers le haut.
  • Un état d’esprit de maker : aisance avec les outils technologiques actuels et capacité à prototyper rapidement des démos fonctionnelles (low-code, no-code, outils agentiques) qui rendent la valeur tangible pour le client.
  • Maîtrise parfaite du français et de l’anglais (oral et écrit).

À propos d’Artefact

Artefact est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en data et en intelligence artificielle, qui accompagne les entreprises pour transformer ces technologies en impact business concret et mesurable. À la croisée du conseil, de la data et de la technologie, nos 2 500 collaborateurs dans 27 pays mettent leurs expertises en commun pour concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions qui répondent aux enjeux de transformation de nos clients.

Notre accompagnement couvre l’intégralité de la chaîne de valeur : AI Strategy (cadrage stratégique, opportunités à fort impact, trajectoires, modèles opératoires), Engineering (industrialisation, architectures agentiques, produits data) et AI Adoption (conduite du changement, montée en compétences, usage quotidien de l’IA).

Pour en savoir plus sur Artefact, nos expertises et notre culture : https://www.artefact.com

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • De la stratégie à la réalisation

Ne pas s’arrêter aux recommandations : participer à la conception et à la concrétisation de solutions IA répondant à de véritables enjeux métiers.

  • Une collaboration entre expertises

Occuper un rôle à la croisée de la stratégie (AI Strategy), de la technologie (Engineering) et de l'humain (AI Adoption).

  • Piloter ce qui compte

Des missions de transformation IA de bout en bout, au cœur des enjeux des grands groupes, avec une vraie autonomie, une équipe à faire grandir et des comptes à développer.

  • Une trajectoire qui accélère

Un parcours clair vers Senior Manager puis Directeur, dans un environnement d’apprentissage continu axé sur la transmission des connaissances et le pragmatisme technologique.

Processus de recrutement

  1. Un entretien de fit RH (45') avec HR / Talent Acquisition
  2. Un business case AI-driven (60') avec un AI Strategist Senior Manager ou Directeur
  3. Un business case de prototypage IA hands-on (60') avec un AI Strategist Senior Manager ou Directeur
  4. Un jeu de rôle AI Strategist Manager (45'-60') avec un AI Strategist Directeur ou Partner
  5. Un entretien de fit final (30') avec un AI Strategist Partner ou Managing Partner

Rémunération : 66 000€ à 75 000€ brut annuel (fixe) + 10 000€ de variable, selon expérience et séniorité

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l’adéquation avec le rôle.

title: Chief of Staff to the CEO
descriptionHtml:
Mozilla Foundationis a non-profit building a better technology future — powered by people, open by design, fueled by imagination.

We deliver people-first alternatives to today’s extractive systems. We build side by side with developers, innovators and advocates, united in the belief that a better technology future is not only possible — it’s ours to create!

Team

Our CEO is increasingly focused outward on the Board, funders, partners, and public conversations that will shape the Foundation’s next chapter. This newly created Chief of Staff role exists to extend the CEO’s reach inside the organization and make that outward focus possible.

Reporting directly to the CEO, you’ll serve as the CEO’s strategic partner, internal proxy and trusted extension of their leadership. You’ll hold the CEO’s strategic agenda, translate the CEO’s priorities into organizational alignment, represent the CEO internally where needed, and make decisions on the CEO’s behalf within clearly delegated authority. You’ll determine what reaches the CEO, prepare the CEO for consequential moments, and escalate only what requires the CEO’s judgment.

As a member of the Executive Leadership Team, you’ll partner strategically with other members of the ELT and work closely with the CEO’s Executive Program Manager to make sure the CEO’s time, priorities, and commitments stay aligned and moving.

You’ll also partner with the Foundation’s Investment Committee and its technical and strategic advisors, keeping their focus on the right questions, their recommendations aligned with the Foundation’s strategic priorities, and decisions moving efficiently from evaluation to funding.

Job responsibilities

Here’s what you’ll likely be focused on for the first 6 months:

  • Building a strong working partnership with the CEO, aligning on priorities, ways of working and clearly defining the scope of your delegated authority.
  • Establishing a trusted partnership with each member of the Executive Leadership Team, learning their priorities, pressures and ways of working.
  • Developing a deep, cross-functional understanding of the Foundation’s work and how each function connects to the CEO’s priorities.
  • Translating the CEO’s priorities into a concise, clear set of strategic outcomes that leaders understand and can use to guide the decisions they own, with a current view of what’s changing and which decisions are approaching.
  • Defining with the CEO what truly requires their attention, and ensuring issues reach them decision-ready, with context, options and a recommendation.
  • Getting up to speed with the Investment Committee and its advisors, and helping keep their focus on the right questions so decisions move efficiently from evaluation to funding.

As the Chief of Staff to Mozilla Foundation’s CEO, you will…

  • Serve as the CEO’s thought partner in developing, pressure-testing and refining strategic priorities, synthesizing executive insight and external developments to anticipate what will need to be known or decided in the next 30, 60 and 90 days.
  • Direct the CEO’s time toward strategy, external relationships, development, Board leadership and the Foundation’s highest-consequence decisions.
  • Filter rather than forward, so significant shifts in strategy, material risks, major budget decisions and Board-level matters reach the CEO early, with context, options and a recommendation.
  • Maintain a current view of the CEO’s top priorities, identify where work is drifting from strategic intent, and surface conflicts in priorities, resources or attention before they become emergencies.
  • Enable the Executive Leadership Team to operate as one team around the CEO’s priorities, so the right issues reach the ELT at the right level and decisions and commitments are followed through.
  • Partner with ELT members on cross-functional issues that need CEO-level alignment but not the CEO’s direct involvement.
  • Represent the CEO’s position in internal discussions and make decisions on the CEO’s behalf within delegated authority, bringing anything beyond it back to the CEO promptly.
  • Ensure the CEO enters every Board meeting, funder and partner conversation, speech and public engagement fully prepared, with concise briefings, organizational context and answers to likely questions.
  • Identify external opportunities that warrant the CEO’s attention, and ensure commitments the CEO makes externally translate into clear internal follow-through.
  • Steward alignment between the Investment Committee’s work and the Foundation’s strategy: keep its technical and strategic advisors focused on the right questions, surface gaps, risks or competing views, and bring forward matters that need the CEO’s judgment.

What this role is not

This is a role of influence. It exists to ensure the CEO can lead effectively through the Executive Leadership Team.

  • The Chief of Staff does not manage the Executive Leadership Team or run the Foundation’s operations. Each executive leader owns execution and decisions within their area.
  • This role does not make decisions beyond the authority the CEO has delegated. Anything outside that authority returns to the CEO.
  • This role does not have any direct reports and also doesn’t manage the CEO’s calendar, scheduling or administrative support.

Your Professional Profile

  • Significant, verifiable experience as a strategic partner at CEO or executive-team level, with a track record of leading high-stakes work and turning ambiguity into structure and action.
  • Experience working across multiple legal entities is a plus, including navigating differences, building influence, and coordinating work across entities where relevant. 
  • A proven record of driving complex, cross-functional priorities from idea to execution by defining outcomes, ownership, milestones and decision points.
  • Exceptional judgment and discretion, including handling confidential information and navigating complex executive dynamics with integrity.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence without formal authority, build trust across functions and at the most senior levels, and give direct feedback with care.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication, with experience distilling complex information into decision-ready briefs, recommendations, presentations and executive communications.
  • Strong analytical and strategic problem-solving skills: you frame the right question, gather the right information, test assumptions and recommend a practical path forward.
  • Disciplined prioritization, with the agility to move between long-term priorities and time-sensitive issues without losing the thread.
  • Direct experience supporting Board governance, fundraising or other high-stakes external relationships at an executive level.
  • A track record of doing high-impact work out of the spotlight, measuring your success by the CEO’s and the team’s, and acting in the best interests of the CEO and the organization.
  • A demonstrated commitment to Mozilla Foundation’s mission and to building an open, accessible and trustworthy internet.
  • The ability to work across time zones and occasionally outside standard working hours for Board meetings, major events or urgent organizational needs.
  • Comfortable traveling for Board meetings, leadership gatherings and major events.

We Are Excited To See Any Additional Experience With:

  • Senior roles in nonprofit, philanthropic, technology or public-interest organizations.
  • Supporting or advising investment, grantmaking or funding committees.

How We Work

A few things that are true about how we work at Mozilla Foundation. Here's a summary along with our expectation of how these should show up in this role:

  • Move toward the hard thing: you surface conflicts in priorities, resources or attention early, and give the CEO and executives direct, actionable input, including what they may not want to hear. You disagree constructively in the room, not afterward, and you don’t wait for someone else to raise it.
  • Stay curious and current: you stay close to what executives are seeing and what’s happening in our fields and communities, and turn it into the context the CEO needs. You pressure-test assumptions, including your own.
  • Work in the open: you document decisions and the reasoning behind them, so executives and teams can follow how and why priorities are set. You favor shared channels over side conversations wherever appropriate.
  • Focus and finish: you keep the CEO’s agenda focused on what matters most, make deliberate choices about what does and doesn’t need the CEO, and make sure decisions and commitments are seen through.
  • Flex with purpose: you move between long-term priorities and time-sensitive issues as context shifts, and adapt how you work with each executive. Flexibility isn’t about being agreeable; it’s staying responsive while holding to the mission and the CEO’s priorities.
  • Lead with care: you hold a high bar for the work while treating people as whole humans. You extend good faith to fellow executives, respect that each owns their area, and talk directly to the person who can solve the problem.

Salary and Benefits Information

Mozilla Foundation is dedicated to fair and equitable compensation for our staff. We aim to pay a competitive and market-based salary based on the responsibilities and requirements of the role. We do not ask for, or take into account, salary histories in our offer process.

The starting salary ranges for this role are listed below. 

  • Germany: €206,448.00 – €232,253.22
  • UK: £181,764.00 – £204,483.81
  • Canada: $356,400.00 – $400,948.65
  • US: $264,000.00 – $296,999.00

We also offer the following benefits:

  • Private Medical Insurance
  • Extended Sick Leave
  • Global Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Retirement Plan contributions
  • Paid Time Off: 20 days annual leave + sick days and your birthday
  • Company Holidays + EOY Shutdown
  • Wellness budget
  • Professional Development budget
  • Top up program for Pregnancy and Parental leaves

Benefits are subject to change at any time at the discretion of Mozilla Foundation.

Mozilla Foundation Hiring Practices

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, and persons of all sexual orientations and gender identities and expressions.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Clinical Associate
descriptionHtml:
We're Heidi.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years.

To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.

If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.

The role

As a Clinical Associate, you sit within Customer Success at the centre of clinician adoption. Your remit is to ensure that clinicians and healthcare organisations derive immediate, tangible value from Heidi by embedding it into day-to-day clinical practice with precision and minimal friction.

This is a deeply operational, clinician-facing role. You will work directly with end users to understand how care is delivered in practice, and then translate those workflows into effective Heidi usage. That includes configuring templates, shaping documentation outputs, and aligning the product to the realities of different specialties, settings, and consultation styles. You will be heavily involved in onboarding and implementation across a range of customer segments, with particular focus on enterprise deployments.

A significant component of the role is in-person delivery. You will regularly travel to customer sites to support rollouts, deliver training, and work directly with clinical teams during critical adoption phases. This on-the-ground presence is essential in driving momentum, resolving friction in real time, and ensuring that Heidi is embedded effectively across organisations.

It’s a perfect role for an enterprising, bright, and gritty current or former clinician looking to break into the health-tech space.

What you’ll do

Implementation & onboarding support

  • Support smooth onboarding of Heidi across new and existing customers, partnering closely with Customer Success Managers and Clinical Template Officers.

  • Contribute to rollout planning by supporting discovery sessions, gathering documentation examples, and clarifying clinician workflows.

  • Deliver and support training sessions for clinicians and operational staff, both live and asynchronously.

  • Provide hands-on support during go-lives and early usage, especially where clinician documentation requirements are the blocker.

Clinical workflow & medical knowledge enablement

  • Develop a strong understanding of Heidi and how clinicians use it across different specialties and care settings.

  • Translate real-world clinical workflows into best-practice guidance that helps clinicians embed Heidi into daily practice.

  • Act as a trusted clinical voice for users, answering questions and helping them understand how to get the best outcomes from Heidi.

Templates: discovery & support

  • Support the template discovery process by collecting examples, understanding documentation needs, and clearly documenting requirements.

  • Triage incoming template-related questions and recommend the right next step (reuse, small edits, or escalation).

  • Make small, high-impact template adjustments (e.g. structure, phrasing, configuration guidance) to unblock onboarding and early adoption.

  • Maintain simple, scalable guidance (how-to notes, examples, do’s and don’ts) that enables Customer Success to self-serve common questions.

Continuous improvement & collaboration

  • Capture and synthesise feedback from clinicians to improve onboarding playbooks, training materials, and template guidance.

  • Partner with Product, Support, and Engineering to share insights from the field and help improve workflows and tooling over time.

  • Contribute to evolving team processes that help Heidi scale implementation and clinical enablement.

What we’re looking for

  • Early-career or recently practicing clinical professionals (medical, nursing, allied health, mental health).

  • Strong interest in healthtech, AI, and improving clinical workflows.

  • Clear, confident communicator with the ability to explain clinical concepts simply and practically.

  • Organised and reliable, able to manage multiple onboarding tasks and support requests.

  • Comfortable learning new tools and working in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.

  • Proactive, curious, and motivated to make clinicians’ working lives easier.

  • Experience with AI tools, CRMs or customer support platforms is helpful but not required. Attitude, clinical insight, and willingness to learn matter most.

What success looks like

  • Clinicians feel confident using Heidi early in their journey.

  • Onboardings run smoothly with fewer workflow or documentation blockers.

  • Customer Success teams are able to self-serve common clinical and template questions.

  • Enablement materials and guidance improve continuously through real-world feedback.

What do we believe in?

Heidi builds for the future of healthcare, not just the next quarter, and our goals are ambitious because the world’s health demands it. We believe in progress built through precision, pace, and ownership.

  • Live Forever - Every release moves care forward: measured, safe, and built to last. Data guides us, but patients define the truth that matters.

  • Practice Ownership - Decisions follow logic and proof, not hierarchy. Exceptional care demands exceptional standards in our work, our thinking, and our character.

  • Small Cuts Heal Faster - Stability earns trust, speed delivers impact. Progress is about learning fast without breaking what people depend on.

  • Make others better - Feedback is direct, kindness is constant, and excellence lifts everyone. Our success is measured by collective growth, not individual output.

Our mission is clear: expand the world’s capacity to care, and do it without losing the humanity that makes care worth delivering.

Why you should Join Heidi

  • Real product momentum. We’re not trying to generate interest, we’re channeling it. This is a rare chance to create a global impact as you immerse yourself in Australia’s fastest growing start-up.

  • Equity from day one. When Heidi wins, you win. You’ll share directly in the success you help create.

  • Unmatched impact. Play a pivotal role at a critical growth moment - all while working on a product that delivers tangible value to clinicians and patients every day.

  • Work alongside world-class talent. Join a team of operators and builders who’ve scaled unicorns.

  • Global reach. Help shape our international expansion as we bring Heidi to key international markets.

  • Growth and balance. Enjoy a personal development budget, dedicated wellness days, subsidised gym membership, and your birthday off to recharge.

  • Flexibility that works. A hybrid environment, with 3 days in the office.

Heidi’s commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

Heidi is dedicated to creating an equitable, inclusive, and supportive work environment that brings people together from diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Our strength is in our differences. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are proud to welcome all applicants as we're committed to promoting a culture of opportunity for all.

Help us reimagine primary care and change the face of healthcare in Australia and then around the world.

title: Compliance Director
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Compliance Director and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one.

You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area.

What You’ll Own

  • Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures.

  • Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite.

  • Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients.

  • Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity.

  • Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments.

  • File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR.

  • Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board.

  • Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest.

  • Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters.

  • Prepare the firm for the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027.

  • Build the compliance and AML team as the business grows.

What We’re Looking For

  • Significant experience in AML/CTF at a regulated EU financial institution. Ideally at an investment firm, neobroker, neobank or e-money institution.

  • Experience with digital onboarding and remote identity verification at scale.

  • Hands-on experience building risk assessments, monitoring scenarios and EDD processes.

  • Experience filing suspicious activity reports and handling regulatory inspections.

  • Knowledge of MiFID II conduct and investment-services compliance, or the ability to learn it fast.

  • Experience selecting and overseeing KYC, screening and monitoring tools.

  • Strong judgment and the confidence to challenge senior colleagues.

  • Clear, concise writing for policies, board reports and regulators.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a key function holder.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania or the FNTT.

  • Knowledge of Lithuanian AML law and Bank of Lithuania instructions.

  • Experience with clients across several EEA countries.

  • CAMS (ACAMS) or ICA certification.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • People who copy policies from templates without fitting them to the business.

  • People who say no without offering a compliant way forward.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised.

descriptionHtml:
About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our Data, AI, Solutions & Engineering practice are looking for an experienced Data Engineer to join the team.

In DAISE, we are focused on delivering value-adding, sustainable data capabilities, aligned to our client’s specific needs. This expertise is applied across clients in all of our industry market sectors (Financial Services, Products & Services, Energy & Resources, Pharmaceutical & Lifesciences and 
Government).

What you will be doing

You will be using your experience to help our clients solve their most important data challenges. You would be also responsible to support the growth of our team, helping them to build the skills they need to solve our client’s challenges. Depending on the level, you can be a part of our leadership 
team, shaping the direction of the practice, growing the business and leading our people.

Typical engagements include:

  • Defining and implementing on premise or cloud architectures, for example, a cloud data warehouse, data lake or a data platform to enable digital transformation.
  • Working with clients in more traditional areas of data engineering such as, data warehousing, building operational ETL/ELT data pipelines across a number of sources, and constructing relational and dimensional data models
  • Performing maturity assessments across clients’ data capabilities and recommending improvements
  • Building technology blueprints and advising clients on the different technology options
  • Translating business requirements (both functional and non-functional) into solutions, ensuring compliance with the organisations strategy, policies and standards and in some cases, help customers to define new policies, principles and standards
  • Helping clients to identify risks and mitigations for their complex data programmes, as well as transition to modern cloud-based infrastructures (AWS, Azure, GCP) by leveraging related architecture patterns (e.g., APIs, events)
  • Working with clients in key areas of data governance, such as in defining principles including, but not limited to Master Data Management, Data Lineage and Data Security

 
Your skills and experience  

We are seeking passionate and dynamic data engineers who are excited by empowering decision making with data, and keen to take an active part in the growth of the company. We’re looking for people who can both advise our clients and, when needed, get hands on in technical delivery to bring 
a solution to life.

  • Passionate individual who is excited by problems with data and can bring a good mix of technical delivery and core consulting skills in client engagements
  • Ability to own and run complex client engagements, interact with leaders across industry, work with senior stakeholders to help them understand and frame their problems, assess their current state, and make impactful recommendations which help shape their thinking
  • Strong hands on expertise in data engineering, delivering data architectures, data pipelines and solutions that are robust and scalable using modern delivery frameworks and tools (e.g. Databricks)
  • Experience in using cloud technologies (Azure, AWS, GCP) as both infrastructure and as a service, as well as big data platforms either on-premise or cloud setup
  • Knowledge of different technology stacks including common legacy and modern stacks, experience of applying DevOps practices to data engineering as well as ability to build CI/CD pipelines
  • Competent in SQL and at least one modern programming language, such as Python
  • Understanding of key core concepts like distributed computing, batch & stream processing, functional and object-orientated programming, how pipelines are built and deployed on cloud, pipeline schedules and SLAs

  • Well-versed with documentation and artefacts that need to go along with the solution design and delivery work

What a career at Baringa will give you 


Putting People First.

Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include: 

  • Generous Annual Leave Policy: We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service. 
  • Flexible Working: We know that the ‘ideal’ work-life balance will vary from person to person and change at different stages of our working lives. To accommodate this, we have implemented a hybrid working policy and introduced more flexibility around taking unpaid leave. 
  • Corporate Responsibility Days: Our world is important to us, so all our employees get 3 every year to help social and environmental causes and increase our impact on the communities that mean the most to us. 
  • Wellbeing Fund: We want to encourage all employees to take charge and prioritise their own wellbeing. We’ve introduced our annual People Fund to support this by offering every individual a fund to support and manage their wellbeing through an activity of their choice. 
  • Profit Share Scheme: All employees participate in the Baringa Group Profit Share Scheme so everyone has a stake in the company’s success. 

Diversity and Inclusion

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people. 

An award-winning workplace

You can be a part of our ‘Great Place to Work’ – with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all. Click here to see some of our recent awards and how we’ve achieved this. 

Using business as a force for good. 

We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve. 

We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Join us

Your application will be considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, nationality, disability, age, faith or social background. title: Core platform growth engineering
descriptionHtml:
Making preventive health the default for every human in Europe

 

The mission

At Lucis, we believe healthcare should be preventive, not reactive. We’re building the OS for human longevity to help people add more healthy years to their lives. You can read more about who we are and how we work here.

 

The role

We've processed 200,000+ clinical tests across 4 countries with a team of 20. We're growing 10% week over week. And we're still early.

We need engineers who build systems, not features, people who own outcomes end-to-end, orchestrate AI to execute, and raise the bar for everyone around them.

You won't spend your days writing boilerplate. You'll write specs that agents execute, review AI-generated code with a critical eye, and make decisions that compound over time. This is what engineering looks like now. If that excites you, keep reading.

We'll shape the exact scope together, mobile, infra, platform, AI, full-stack, based on where you're strongest and where we need it most.

  

What we are looking for:

  • Backend: Membership & payments. A confirmed backend engineer (5+ years) who thrives on designing really reliable data models and services, without over-engineering them. You reach for the simplest model that holds. You'll own the systems membership growth runs on: subscriptions and their lifecycle, checkout and payments, promotions and partner offers.

    We're scaling across the EU, with the complexity that comes with it: new countries, currencies, payment methods, and regulations. This is code where a subtle bug costs real money and real trust. You care that the model is right before the endpoint exists, and that every edge case fails safely.

  • Frontend: Engagement & world-class experience. A confirmed frontend engineer (5+ years) with very good craft and a real sensibility for design. You like things crystal clear for the user, you build neat interfaces, and you don't wait for designs to be ready to propose something delightful.

    You'll own what a first-time visitor meets and what keeps members coming back: the acquisition funnel, onboarding, checkout, the everyday surfaces of the product. Your work has to be delightful and reliable for people who have never heard of us and decide in minutes whether to trust us with their health.

 

About you

You’re passionate about the future of human health and want your work to help people stay healthy for longer. You move quickly from idea to execution, take full ownership of what you build, and work best with talented people who care as much as you do.

 

You thrive in fast‑moving environments, learn by doing, and value feedback as a way to continuously improve. You use AI the way others use a calculator: naturally, to go faster and think bigger.

 

You’ll fit in well if

  • You've shipped at least one product from 0→1 and felt the difference between writing code and building a system

  • You have 2 deep areas of expertise and can operate across the full stack when the situation demands it

  • You write specs before you write code — precise enough that an AI agent executes correctly on the first pass

  • You review AI-generated code with the same rigor you'd apply to a junior engineer's PR: edge cases, security gaps, design smell

  • You bias toward shipping. A good decision today beats a perfect one next week

  • You're genuinely interested in health — maybe you track your own biomarkers, or you're just frustrated that healthcare is still reactive

 

We would not be a fit if

  • You need a clearly scoped role before you can operate

  • You measure output in lines of code written

  • You've only worked in large orgs with dedicated infra, QA, and platform teams

  • You optimize for stability over velocity

 

Our current stack

TypeScript monorepo · Next.js · NestJS · PostgreSQL + Prisma · AWS (Terraform, Qovery) · GitHub Actions · Claude Code + Cursor

 

The process

  • Intro call (20 min): culture & role fit.

  • Technical interview (30 min)

  • At-home case study: hands-on project, delivery in 2 days.

  • Deep dive (90 min) and team chat (on-site)

  • Reference calls

 

How we work

We work together from our Paris hub. We’re passionate about what we’re building and believe the fastest way to create something exceptional is side by side. We’re open to relocation support for the right individuals, and we welcome missionaries who travel to work with us in Paris on a regular basis.

 

  • Rigor without ego: Audits, science, and code all deserve the same high bar.

  • Radical ownership: Feedback loops are short; everyone contributes to building the best version of Lucis.

  • Velocity over perfection: We ship daily and prefer a good decision today over a perfect one next week.

At Lucis, AI isn't just our product, it's our engine. 100% of our teams are equipped with the best AI agents. You have carte blanche to explore and automate everything that can be, so you can focus exclusively on high-value work.

title: Country Executive
descriptionHtml:
Country Executive

The Finance Function Is Broken. Everyone Building For It Is Boring.

Fast-growing multi-entity companies get two options: duct-tape a Frankenstack, or surrender to a corporate ERP and its consultant army. Both are bad. Both are beatable. Beating them market by market is this job.

Light is the AI-native financial platform for modern companies. Fast to implement, intuitive to use, smarter every month. We call it organic software. Legora, Lovable and Fuse Energy run on it. Product ships something worth shouting about every single week.

What we don’t have yet is someone who owns each market as their own. We’re hiring Country Executives across several markets. Tell us which one is yours.

This Is Not A Country Manager Role.

Most first-in-market hires get a quota, a deck and a flight. They repeat the London pitch in a local accent and forward complaints to HQ. This is the opposite. This is a founding hire for someone who wants far more scope than their years of experience would get them anywhere else.

No local playbook. You’ll be the person who owns your market, and within a year you should know its complexity (its rules, its buyers, its excuses) better than anyone else. It’s not a leadership title. It’s the seed of one. Do this right and there’s a real path: stand up an entity, build the team around you, move into product, or run the region as GM.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Sitting across from finance leaders. Real conversations, not discovery calls off a script. You find out what they actually need, the thing behind the thing they asked for, and you come back with it written down clearly enough for engineers to build against.

  • Being the connective tissue. Customer, product, commercial. What you learn in-market changes how Light builds and how Light sells. You are the wire between them, and the wire has to carry current in both directions.

  • Owning the local rulebook. Compliance, regulation, filing, the specific ways finance is done badly in your country. You’re the person in the room who knows this, and you make sure it shows up in the product and in the pitch.

  • Having a public point of view. Ideally you arrive with a finance background and an opinion on what “doing finance right” looks like in your market. Bring it into the market, into the roadmap, and into how every prospect sees Light. Relationships, events, brand presence: built by you.

  • Closing, with London behind you. Our sales team helps you manage and push deals over the line. You bring the market and customer understanding that makes those conversations land. They support you; they don’t carry you, and you don’t carry it alone.

How We’ll Keep Score

This isn’t a pure revenue seat, but growing your country’s ARR is the primary goal and you’re tied directly to that number. We’ll agree a starting point for what you’re measured against on day one, and you’ll build from there.

What We’ll Ask For*

  • The thing you built from nothing. A company, a market, a GTM motion, a product. Something that existed because you hacked through a messy sale with no playbook. First question in the first call.

  • Credibility in front of a CFO. A finance background ideally, or enough substance that a finance leader takes you seriously the moment you walk in. You can’t be the voice of the market without an ear for the buyer.

  • 2+ years as a founder or co-founder. Ex-founder or very early operator. We want the scar tissue.

  • 6+ years somewhere fast. High-growth tech, top-tier strategy consulting, investment banking or similar. Or a body of work that makes the number irrelevant.

  • Structured thinking under mess. Exceptional analytical instincts, applied to markets nobody has mapped for you yet.

  • Fluency in your market’s business language and in English. Both, properly.

Extra credit: exposure to accounting, enterprise software, fintech or SaaS as a user, buyer or advisor; time spent presenting to senior finance stakeholders; an existing finance network in your market, or a demonstrated, unembarrassed intent to build one.

*If the core of the role sounds compelling but you don’t tick every box, we’d still love for you to reach out and convince us you’re the right person.

The Good Stuff

💸 A competitive salary plus potential stock options.
🏝 25 days of annual leave plus public holidays where you’re based.
🚀 A genuine chance to build a market and grow with it.
🥳 Regular socials and two company offsites a year. The last 2 were in Tuscany & Provence!
🌍 Time with the team in London, Copenhagen, Munich, New York, Paris and wherever the action is.

How To Apply

Show us who you are, not just your CV. Tell us which market is yours, what you built and what it did in numbers. Then answer the only question that matters: why this one? Anyone can say they want to work at a startup. A generic AI-written cover letter with no craft behind the prompt will be obvious, and is its own kind of answer.

If this reads as too much scope for one person: it is. That’s the seat.

Light is an equal opportunity employer.
