title: Director, Satellite Business International | Directeur(trice), Développement Commercial International - Satellites
descriptionHtml:
Vast is developing next-generation space stations and space infrastructure using an incremental, hardware-rich, and capital-efficient approach. Vast is rapidly developing its multi-module Haven Station to support a continuous human presence in space for America and its allies, enabling advanced microgravity research and manufacturing, and supporting a growing space economy for government, corporate, and private customers. Haven Demo’s 2025 success made Vast the only operational commercial space station company to design, build, and operate its own spacecraft in orbit. Next, Haven-1 is targeted to become the world’s first commercial space station, with launch anticipated in 2027, followed by additional Haven modules. Additionally, the company recently announced two new offerings leveraging its space station components and the heritage of Haven Demo: Vast Satellite, a high-power satellite product line; and Vast Lunar Systems, power, communications, and habitats for the Moon.

Headquartered in Long Beach, California, and with more than 1,000 employees and over a billion dollars in private capital, Vast has built the facilities capable of manufacturing America’s next space station. The company plans to develop future habitats and systems for Mars, dedicated modules for government partners, and other crewed systems designed to unlock the expanding long-term space economy.

Vast recherche un(e) Directeur(trice), Développement Commercial International - Satellites, sous la responsabilité du SVP, Satellite Business Development & Commercialization, pour diriger le développement commercial axé sur le commerce (communications, observation de la Terre, détection, défense et applications de calcul en orbite) et les gouvernements internationaux pour Vast Satellites. Ce rôle est centré sur les marchés hors États-Unis — notamment l'Europe, le Moyen-Orient et l'Asie — et dirigera l'engagement client, le développement des opportunités, la stratégie de capture, l'engagement gouvernemental/défense et les efforts de partenariat qui font progresser les initiatives de Vast pour développer, fabriquer et exploiter des plateformes de bus satellites avancées.

Il s'agit d'une petite équipe commerciale fondatrice de haut niveau : le rôle exige à la fois des instincts de « hunter » en développement commercial (créer des marchés et de la demande là où il n'en existe pas encore) et des compétences avérées de « closer » (négocier et exécuter des contrats allant de quelques millions à des centaines de millions de dollars).

Ce poste sera à temps plein, exempté, ouvert à un lieu de travail international flexible comme décrit ci-dessus.

Responsabilités :

  • Élaborer et exécuter une stratégie globale de marché commercial et gouvernemental international couvrant l'Europe, le Moyen-Orient et l'Asie, alignée sur les objectifs commerciaux de Vast.
  • Établir et maintenir une veille stratégique sur le marché et la concurrence concernant les clients spatiaux commerciaux et gouvernementaux internationaux, en distinguant le positionnement de Vast de celui de ses concurrents dans chaque région.
  • Piloter la planification interne pour la priorisation des opportunités internationales, la stratégie de capture et le développement du pipeline sur de multiples marchés alliés et partenaires.
  • Diriger l'engagement client à travers l'identification d'opportunités, la définition du périmètre des missions, les présentations de capacités et le développement de concepts précoces avec les opérateurs commerciaux internationaux, les sociétés d'observation de la Terre, les ministères de la défense et les entités gouvernementales.
  • Tirer parti d'un solide réseau préexistant de haut niveau au sein de la chaîne de valeur internationale de l'espace et de la défense pour ouvrir des portes auprès de clients potentiels et identifier précocement les menaces concurrentielles.
  • Diriger l'élaboration des propositions et coordonner les contributions interfonctionnelles des équipes d'ingénierie, de gestion de programme, de finance, juridique et de contrôle des exportations/conformité, avec le soutien de l'analyste BD et de l'ingénieur avant-vente de l'équipe.
  • Assumer la responsabilité du développement du pipeline, des prévisions et des rapports pour tous les comptes commerciaux et gouvernementaux internationaux.
  • Négocier et conclure des contrats pour des missions commerciales et gouvernementales/défense internationales et les services associés, en naviguant à travers divers cadres nationaux de passation de marchés, de contrôle des exportations (ex. ITAR/EAR) et de partenariat.
  • Se coordonner avec l'équipe de sécurité nationale de Vast lorsque les programmes internationaux croisent des parties prenantes ou des enjeux liés au gouvernement américain.
  • Représenter Vast lors d'événements de l'industrie spatiale, aérospatiale et de défense internationale en Europe, au Moyen-Orient et en Asie.
  • Faire des présentations, participer à des panels et fournir des briefings de haut niveau/C-suite communiquant les capacités et la valeur des plateformes satellites de Vast aux audiences commerciales, gouvernementales et de défense internationales.

Qualifications Minimales :

  • Plus de 12 ans d'expérience pertinente dans le développement commercial spatial/aérospatial, les ventes, la gestion de capture ou les contrats gouvernementaux/défense, avec un succès avéré en Europe, au Moyen-Orient et/ou en Asie.
  • Historique avéré d'origination et de conclusion personnelle de contrats, y compris des transactions de plusieurs dizaines de millions de dollars ou plus.
  • Relations établies et vérifiables avec des clients potentiels au niveau cadre et exécutif, et connaissance du paysage concurrentiel sur de multiples marchés spatiaux et de défense internationaux.
  • Expérience dans la chaîne de valeur spatiale/aérospatiale (lancement, bus satellite, charge utile, intégration maître d'œuvre ou opérations), idéalement complémentaire des opérations satellites — par ex. observation de la Terre ou défense internationale.
  • Compréhension approfondie des structures de passation de marchés et de partenariat gouvernementales internationales pertinentes pour les programmes d'espace et de défense.
  • Solides compétences techniques et capacité à communiquer des systèmes complexes à des audiences commerciales, de défense et gouvernementales internationales.
  • Excellentes capacités de communication, d'analyse, de collaboration et de relations interpersonnelles ; à l'aise pour opérer à travers diverses cultures et langues.
  • Capacité à opérer de manière autonome, à hiérarchiser les priorités efficacement et à gérer simultanément plusieurs projets internationaux dans un environnement de petite équipe au rythme soutenu.

Compétences et Expériences Souhaitées :

  • Relations et crédibilité établies en Europe, au Moyen-Orient et en Asie.
  • Maîtrise des langues pertinentes pour les marchés cibles (français, arabe, japonais, etc.).
  • Expérience de travail aux côtés d'équipes d'affaires publiques locales ou coordination avec celles-ci (ex. affaires publiques gouvernementales françaises/UE).
  • Connaissance des régimes de contrôle des exportations (ITAR/EAR) dans les programmes de satellites internationaux.

Exigences Supplémentaires :

  • Capacité à voyager plus de 50 % du temps.

Vast is looking for a Director, Satellite Business Development International, reporting to the SVP, Satellite Business Development & Commercialization, to lead commercial (communications, Earth observation, sensing, defense, and in-orbit compute applications) and international government-focused business development for Vast Satellites. This role is focused on markets outside the United States — including Europe, the Middle East, and Asia — and will lead customer engagement, opportunity development, capture strategy, government/defense engagement, and partnership efforts that advance Vast's initiatives to develop, manufacture, and operate advanced satellite bus platforms.

This is a small, senior founding commercial team: the role demands both business development "hunter" instincts (creating markets and demand where none exist yet) and proven "closer" skills (negotiating and executing contracts from single-digit millions to hundreds of millions of dollars). 

This will be a full-time, exempt position open to a flexible international location as described above.

Responsibilities: 

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive international commercial and government market strategy spanning Europe, the Middle East, and Asia, aligned with Vast's business objectives.
  • Build and maintain a market and competitive intelligence view across international commercial and government space customers, distinguishing Vast's positioning from competitors in each region.
  • Lead internal planning for international opportunity prioritization, capture strategy, and pipeline development across multiple allied and partner markets.
  • Lead customer engagement across opportunity identification, mission scoping, capability briefings, and early concept development with international commercial operators, Earth observation companies, defense ministries, and government entities.
  • Leverage a strong, pre-existing senior-level network across the international space/defense value chain to open doors with potential customers and identify competitive threats early.
  • Lead proposal development and coordinate cross-functional contributions from engineering, program management, finance, legal, and export-control/compliance teams, supported by the team's BD analyst and pre-sales engineer.
  • Own pipeline development, forecasting, and reporting across all international commercial and government accounts.
  • Negotiate and close contracts for international commercial and government/defense missions and associated services, navigating varying national procurement, export-control (e.g., ITAR/EAR), and partnership frameworks.
  • Coordinate with Vast's National Security team where international programs intersect with US Government stakeholders or content.
  • Represent Vast at international space, aerospace, and defense industry events across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.
  • Deliver presentations, participate in panels, and provide senior/C-suite-level briefings that communicate the capabilities and value of Vast's satellite platforms to international commercial, government, and defense audiences.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 12+ years of relevant experience in space/aerospace business development, sales, capture management, or government/defense contracting, with demonstrated success operating in Europe, the Middle East, and/or Asia.
  • Proven track record of personally originating and closing contracts, including deals in the tens of millions of dollars or above.
  • Established, verifiable senior and executive-level relationships with potential customers, and knowledge of the competitive landscape across multiple international space/defense markets.
  • Background in the space/aerospace value chain (launch, satellite bus, payload, prime integration, or operations), ideally complementary to satellite operations — e.g., Earth observation or international defense.
  • Deep understanding of international government procurement and partnership structures relevant to space and defense programs.
  • Strong technical understanding and ability to communicate complex systems to international commercial, defense, and government audiences.
  • Excellent communication, analytical, collaboration, and interpersonal skills; comfortable operating across cultures and languages.
  • Ability to operate independently, prioritize effectively, and manage multiple international efforts simultaneously in a fast-paced, lean-team environment.

Preferred Skills & Experience:

  • Existing relationships and credibility across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.
  • Fluency in languages relevant to target markets (French, Arabic, Japanese, etc.).
  • Experience working alongside or coordinating with in-country government affairs teams (e.g., French/EU government affairs).
  • Familiarity with export-control regimes (ITAR/EAR) in international satellite programs.

Additional Requirements:

  • Ability to travel 50%+ of the time.

We calibrate level and compensation to the selected candidate's experience and demonstrated capability. We welcome applicants across a range of experience levels to apply.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

Base salary will vary depending on job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, business needs, and market demand. Salary is just one component of our comprehensive compensation package. Full-time employees also receive company equity, as well as access to a full suite of compelling benefits and perks, including: medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents, generous paid time off; up to 20+ days of vacation for exempt staff and up to 10+ days of vacation for non-exempt staff with the ability to cash-out unused vacation annually, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, ClassPass credits, personalized mental healthcare through Spring Health, and other discounts and perks. We also take pride in offering exceptional food perks, with snacks, drip coffee & onsite barista, cold drinks, and dinner meals remaining free of charge, and lunch subsidized as part of Vast’s ongoing commitment to providing high-quality meals for employees.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Vast is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Vast is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

title: E-commerce Data Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world's first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences.

Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results.

E-commerce Data Analyst

Location: Weybridge, Surrey, United Kingdom

Established in 2004, Inside Ideas Group is a rapidly growing global agency network that helps clients drive their businesses forward from the inside. We partner with over 300 clients in more than 40 countries, delivering ideas, technology and creativity that make a measurable impact.

As part of The Brandtech Group, we are pioneers in using advanced AI technologies to transform the way we create, optimise and deliver work. Our AI capabilities enhance efficiency, support smart decision making and unlock new levels of creativity for our teams and clients.

We are now looking for a skilled Data Analyst to join our onsite team supporting in London.

About the Role

As the E-commerce Data Analyst, you will be responsible for delivering insight that drives improvements across the full commercial ecosystem spanning customer experience on, retailer investment effectiveness, marketing and sales performance, and the broader post-purchase, onboarding and promotional landscape.

A core part of your remit will be the design, build and ongoing management of a marketing and sales performance dashboard, underpinned by Google BigQuery and delivered in Looker Studio. This will serve as a critical decision-making tool for marketing, e-commerce, retail and CX teams surfacing insight such as campaign uplift, halo effects, retailer investment impact and share performance across products and markets.

Alongside this, you will analyse customer journeys, benchmark competitors, oversee content performance and support the planning and execution of onboarding and e-commerce promotions using platforms like GWI to create digital personas and audience profiles.

You will collaborate closely with CX, marketing, product and e-commerce teams as well as HQ and local market stakeholders to ensure insight informs decisions at every stage.

This role requires strong analytical capability, expertise in data modelling and SQL, and the ability to translate complex commercial questions into dashboard logic and actionable recommendations.

What You Will Be Doing

Marketing & Sales Performance Analytics

  • Design, build and maintain a marketing and sales performance dashboard in Looker Studio, underpinned by BigQuery, combining sell-out sales data, market volume and share data, and campaign activity logs.
  • Define the underlying data model, transform source files and design the reporting layer to support consistent, scalable KPI delivery.
  • Identify and quantify the impact of retailer investment, including uplift in sales and market share during campaign periods.
  • Analyse correlations between campaign activity and commercial performance to determine which marketing levers are most effective.
  • Measure and report on halo effects across products and retailers resulting from promotional and campaign activity.
  • Define and calculate key performance metrics including uplift, baseline, market share, activity intensity and halo effects.
  • Work with GFK or other syndicated market data sources to enrich performance analysis with market volume and share context.

Customer Experience & Digital Analytics

  • Conduct analysis of the current customer experience, including user behaviour, content and campaign performance and conversion pathways.
  • Benchmark key customer journeys against competitor websites to identify gaps and opportunities.
  • Provide regular insight into paid promotions, post-purchase experience and customer satisfaction trends.
  • Support planning, optimisation and operational management of post-purchase and onboarding experience.
  • Analyse content utilisation, engagement and drop-off points, and recommend enhancements.
  • Collaborate with HQ and local teams on onboarding content production and implementation.
  • Support feature management including evaluation, testing performance and monitoring adoption, with ongoing analysis of content effectiveness and customer experience updates.
  • Reporting, Dashboards & Stakeholder Insight
  • Build and maintain dashboards, reports and ad hoc analyses across customer experience, onboarding, e-commerce, retail performance and promotion activity.
  • Translate data into clear insights that guide decision-making within marketing, CX, digital and commercial teams.
  • Present findings clearly to stakeholders at all levels, ensuring insight is embedded in planning and operational processes.
  • Use platforms like GWI to build digital personas and audience profiles that support broader marketing planning.

What You Need to Be Great in This Role

Essential

  • Proven experience as a data or insight analyst within digital, e-commerce, retail, marketing or agency environments.
  • Strong proficiency in Google BigQuery and advanced SQL, including data modelling and reporting layer design.
  • Hands-on experience building dashboards in Looker Studio, with a clear understanding of how to structure underlying data models for robust, scalable dashboard performance.
  • Demonstrable experience combining sell-out sales, market share and campaign activity datasets to generate commercial insight.
  • Ability to define and calculate metrics including uplift, baseline, market share, activity intensity and halo effects.
  • Strong marketing analytics capability, including campaign effectiveness measurement across paid and promotional channels.
  • Good understanding of digital customer journeys, content performance metrics and e-commerce KPIs.
  • Experience with analytics platforms such as Google Analytics GA4, Adobe Analytics or similar.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling ability — capable of translating complex business questions into dashboard logic and presenting findings clearly to non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working with multi-market teams and managing stakeholder expectations across business functions.
  • A passion for data-driven decision-making and an interest in how AI can enhance analytics workflows.

Preferred:

  • Proficiency in Python (pandas) for data transformation, automation and workflow scripting.
  • Broader experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including automating data ingestion and transformation workflows.
  • Experience working in retail, e-commerce or retailer media environments.
  • Familiarity with GfK or other syndicated market data sources.
  • Experience with additional BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI.

  • Piloter le Terrain : Assurer les procédures d'ouverture et de fermeture, en faisant preuve de la polyvalence nécessaire pour assumer tous les rôles sur le site selon les besoins.

Ce dont vous aurez besoin pour réussir

  • Excellente communication : Compétences claires et efficaces à l'oral comme à l'écrit pour assurer la liaison avec les partenaires et les clients.

title: Engineering Lead (m/w/d) TS, React, Next.js & AI 100% Remote
descriptionHtml:
NotarPartner baut die digitale Arbeitsumgebung für das deutsche Notariat – von Notaren für Notare. Statt Copy-Paste aus Word-Mustern: Daten eingeben, Regelung auswählen, unterschriftsreife Urkunde herunterladen. Über 140 Kanzleien arbeiten bereits mit uns, dazu kommen digitale Akten & KI-Assistent.

Wir haben gerade unsere Finanzierungsrunde abgeschlossen. In den nächsten Monaten skalieren wir von rund 120 auf 2.000 angeschlossene Notariate. Dafür bauen wir ein Inhouse-Engineering-Team auf.

Als Engineering Lead führst du unser Entwicklungsteam und schreibst gleichzeitig selbst Code. Du kommst in ein Team aus drei festen Engineers, Product, das in den nächsten Monaten wachsen wird. Kurze Wege, direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung, technische Entscheidungen ohne Gremien.

Aufgaben

  • Du führst unser Engineering-Team fachlich und disziplinarisch: 1:1s, Weiterentwicklung, klare Erwartungen, ehrliches Feedback.
  • Du bleibst hands-on. Ein erheblicher Teil deiner Zeit fließt weiter in Code, Reviews und Architekturarbeit mit React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js und PostgreSQL.
  • Du verantwortest die technische Architektur unserer Multi-Tenant-Plattform und machst sie fit für den Sprung auf 2.000 Notariate – Performance, Datenmodell, Zuverlässigkeit.
  • Du baust das Team mit auf: Du schärfst Profile, führst technische Interviews und entscheidest mit, wer dazukommt.
  • Du machst KI zum Standard – im Produkt (Urkundengenerierung, Dokumentenanalyse, agentische Workflows) und im Entwicklungsprozess selbst.
  • Du sorgst für verlässliche Delivery: Planung, Qualitätsstandards, Deployments, Incident-Handling.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Product, Design und Notaren zusammen und übersetzt zwischen notarieller Praxis und technischer Umsetzung.

Qualifikation

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Softwareentwickler:in und mindestens zwei Jahre Führungserfahrung – du hast ein Team von 3 bis 8 Engineers geführt und weiterentwickelt.

- Du bist technisch voll handlungsfähig: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js und PostgreSQL beherrschst du selbst, nicht nur auf Folien. Du willst diese Rolle ausdrücklich mit Code-Anteil.

- Erfahrung damit, ein SaaS-Produkt durch eine echte Wachstumsphase zu bringen – Architektur, Datenmodell und Betrieb.

- Du hast selbst eingestellt: Interviews geführt, Entscheidungen getroffen, Leute an Bord geholt und gehalten.

- Echte Begeisterung für KI-Tooling (z. B. Claude, Codex) und agentische Workflows – du treibst deren Einsatz im Team aktiv voran.

- Ausgeprägtes Produktverständnis und die Bereitschaft, dich in notarielle Abläufe wirklich einzuarbeiten.

- Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (C2). Unser Produkt lebt von notarieller Fachterminologie – ohne sprachliche Präzision geht es hier nicht.

Nice to have: Erfahrung in Legal Tech oder anderen regulierten Branchen, mit Multi-Tenant-Architekturen, mit der Ablösung externer Dienstleister oder mit verteilt arbeitenden Teams.n Systemen.

Benefits

- Attraktives Fixgehalt, das deiner Erfahrung als Lead entspricht.

- Substanzielle VSOP-Beteiligung: Du profitierst direkt am Unternehmenserfolg – mit klarem Exit-Fokus in den nächsten 3 bis 5 Jahren.

- Die erste Engineering-Führungsrolle im Unternehmen: Du entscheidest über Stackweiterentwicklung, Architektur und Teamaufbau – und wächst mit der Organisation in die nächste Ebene hinein.

- Führung mit Code-Anteil.

- 100 % Remote innerhalb Deutschlands, plus Workation-Phasen (z. B. zwei Wochen Spanien).

- Vertrauensarbeitszeit und 30 Urlaubstage.

- Modernste KI-Tools als fester Bestandteil des Workflows – nicht als Pilotprojekt, sondern als Standard.

- Ein Produkt mit messbarem Nutzen: 11 Minuten Zeitersparnis pro Urkunde im Notariat, spürbar ab dem ersten Tag.

Klingt nach dir? Dann bewirb dich – ein CV oder dein GitHub/LinkedIn-Profil reichen völlig, ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht.

So läuft es ab:

1. Kennenlernen: 20–30 Minuten Video-Call mit unserem CTO – über dich, das Produkt und deinen Blick darauf.

2. Deep Dive: Architektur- und Leadership-Session anhand unserer konkreten Ausgangslage – wie würdest du die ersten sechs Monate aufsetzen?

3. Team-Kennenlernen: Gespräche mit den Engineers und der Geschäftsführung.

Im Anschluss entscheiden wir zügig. Wir suchen zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt.

title: Engineering Manager - Device Platform (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
tonies is the world’s leading interactive audio platform for children, with over 12 million Tonieboxes and 173 million Tonies sold globally. Our intuitive, screen-free system empowers children to learn and play independently in a safe and engaging way.

With a presence in over 100 countries and a diverse portfolio of ~1,500 Tonies across multiple languages, we continue to redefine how children experience storytelling and learning. Since our IPO in 2021, our global team of 630+ colleagues is united by a shared mission: shaping the future of play, learning, and imagination.

 

Engineering Manager - Device Plattform (all genders)

 

Your Role & Impact

At tonies, we are continuously evolving our device and system architecture to strengthen the foundation for future product experiences. As Engineering Manager for the Device Platform team, you define the system architecture (RTOS, Embedded Linux, Android, or alternatives) and deliver a stable, performant firmware platform that ‘Experience teams’ can build against with confidence.

In our JDM setup, the manufacturing partner handles electronics hardware, low-level drivers, BSP, and mechanics, while your team steers platform decisions to ensure a reliable, product-grade system. You will scale our existing core team, primarily through external engineering partners, to drive our platform roadmap.

Our device architecture is feature-rich, battery-powered, and connected—requiring expertise in connectivity, sensors, tight power budgets, and real-time requirements.

 

What you'll do

  • Team Leadership & Build-up: Take ownership of the existing team and scale it — largely through external partners — while building a cohesive engineering culture across internal staff, external engineers, and JDM partner engineers.

  • Platform Selection & Architecture: Drive the programme's most consequential technical decision: choosing and validating the system platform based on product requirements, resource constraints, time-to-market, and long-term extensibility.

  • JDM Steering: Act as the engineering counterpart to the JDM on electronics and firmware — defining deliverables, setting quality standards, reviewing hardware designs and drivers, and ensuring BSP drops integrate cleanly.

  • Interfaces & Delivery: Experience teams specify the APIs they need; your team delivers them reliably. You turn every boundary — JDM below, experience teams above — into a testable contract rather than a coordination bottleneck.

  • Leading Through Ambiguity: Requirements will shift, trade-offs will be sharp (performance vs. battery, flexibility vs. time-to-market). You keep the team productive and aligned through that uncertainty.

  • Technical Credibility: Stay close enough to the firmware to challenge architectural choices, evaluate JDM deliveries with authority, and step in on critical problems yourself.

  • Delivery Excellence: Own milestones, JDM integration gates, and release cadence to the experience teams — keeping the programme plannable and on track.

Your team's responsibilities

  • Evaluating, selecting, and bringing up the system platform (RTOS, embedded Linux, Android, or hybrid)

  • Owning the firmware stack above the BSP: OS configuration, middleware, system services, power management, connectivity, and security

  • Delivering the APIs specified by experience teams, decoupling feature development from platform internals

  • Steering the JDM on electronics and firmware: specifying deliverables, managing BSP integration, holding quality standards

  • Ensuring platform stability through automated testing, integration gates, and systematic validation of JDM deliveries

  • Contributing to the broader tonies® platform strategy where it makes sense

 

What You Bring

  • Leadership: You have led engineering teams and built or significantly grown at least one. You know how to step into a small team, set direction, and scale it — including sourcing, onboarding, and managing a majority of external engineers alongside a smaller internal core.

  • Leading Across Boundaries: You have run a team where external engineers are the planned model, not a temporary supplement. You know how to create shared standards, retain critical knowledge in-house, and keep partner relationships collaborative. JDM/ODM experience is a strong plus.

  • Deep Embedded Platform Expertise: The core of the role. Years of hands-on experience with embedded system platforms — ideally more than one of RTOS, embedded Linux, or Android — and a well-founded opinion on when each is the right choice.

  • Connected-Device Experience: You have worked on resource-constrained, battery-powered, connected devices. Power management, wireless connectivity, sensor integration, and tight hardware budgets are familiar territory.

  • Architectural Vision: Modular, well-layered systems with clean separation between BSP, platform services, and application layer — so experience teams move fast without destabilising the foundation.

  • The Toolbox: C/C++ is your native language. At home in Linux, comfortable with hardware-near debugging (JTAG, logic analysers), Git, GitLab, and CI/CD as daily workflow.

  • Work Style: Pragmatic, technically rigorous, comfortable with ambiguity. You communicate confidently in professional English (German is a plus) and collaborate with your team in a hybrid setup.

  • Last but not least: You are enthusiastic about our product and want to join us on our exciting journey!

 

Why Join Us?

  • Global Teamwork: We collaborate across departmental and country borders. You’ll be part of a truly international community where every voice is heard.

  • Come as you are: This applies to the dress code and everything else. We believe you give your best when you feel truly comfortable being yourself.

  • Competitive Package: We offer a competitive salary and a range of comprehensive benefits tailored to your specific location, which we’ll share during the recruiting process.

  • Collaboration & Community: We’re big on "we." You’ll join a team that values connection and celebrates wins together, no matter the time zone.

  • Continuous Learning: Benefit from internal/external training and an individual learning budget to keep your skills as sharp as a Tonie’s ears.

  • Tonie Discounts: Enjoy attractive discounts on our entire range of products. You’ll quickly become the favorite guest at every birthday party!

  • Rest & Recharge: Great work requires a clear head. You’ll enjoy generous paid time off to ensure you have plenty of time for your own stories.

As part of our principles, we are committed to supporting inclusion and diversity at tonies. We actively celebrate our colleagues’ different abilities, ethnicities, faiths and genders. Everyone is welcome and supported in their development at all stages in their journey with us.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Enterprise Applied AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Why AssemblyAI

AssemblyAI builds the best-in-class Voice AI models powering the next generation of voice applications. We have a lab, and we also power our own models in our own proprietary inference environment. Our models serve 500M+ inference calls monthly, and process nearly 2 million hours of audio daily. The Voice AI space is at an inflection point; we're looking for the best talent we can find to join a rapidly scaling team that's defining the future of the industry.

We are one of the most capital-efficient AI companies on the planet - and are rapidly approaching $1M ARR per employee. We sit among the top 5 most revenue-dense teams within the fastest-growing AI companies today. We have thousands of customers building with us including the top startups and world-renowned enterprises, and are serving at tremendous scale: we process nearly 2 million hours of audio daily and handle more than 15 million API calls every day. This is a rare growth-stage opportunity where the business is proven, the revenue is durable, and the growth trajectory is steep and getting steeper. We have a super flat culture and expect our employees to be deeply intimate with the details at all levels.

If you've ever felt buried under layers of bureaucracy, starved of real ownership, or frustrated watching your work disappear into a slow-moving org, AssemblyAI is built differently. The company operates as a true meritocracy, with no heavy planning or approval processes and no gatekeeping on the tools or information you need. For anyone who genuinely cares about voice AI, not as a trend to chase, but as a technology to build, this is the place where the most interesting problems at the most interesting scale are being solved by a team small enough that you'll actually know everyone's name.

About the role

We're building out our Enterprise go-to-market team, and we're hiring our first Applied AI Engineers dedicated solely to enterprise deals. You'll be the technical counterpart to our Enterprise Account Executives on a focused set of strategic accounts: large companies bringing voice AI into products and operations used by millions of people.

You'll go deep into each customer's technical organization, earn trust from the developers up to the CTO, and run evaluations rigorous enough to stand up to world-class data science teams and developers. Working collaboratively with Enterprise AEs, you'll own the technical path to vendor selection.

What you'll do

  • Hand off cleanly to our post-sale Forward Deployed Engineers once AssemblyAI is selected, and stay close through launch

What you'll need

  • Significant experience in an enterprise customer-facing technical role
  • A strong track record of closing enterprise business as the technical counterpart in the sales cycle
  • Experience leading multi-month technical evaluations with large organizations and many stakeholders
  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or TypeScript/JavaScript, and the ability to read and debug code in other languages
  • Fluency in ML evaluation: metrics, test set design, and what makes a benchmark fair
  • Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure), enterprise security and compliance (SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR), and data residency

Nice to have

  • Experience selling into contact center, healthcare, or other regulated industries

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Was wir machen?

Wir begleiten Menschen beim langfristigen Vermögensaufbau – mit modernen Investmentlösungen wie ETFs und Immobilien.

Neue Partner erhalten ein persönliches 1:1-Coaching und werden Schritt für Schritt ausgebildet.

Du interessierst dich für ETFs? Mach mehr daraus.

Starte dir neben deinem Hauptberuf ein zweites Standbein – mit persönlichem Coaching und modernen Investmentthemen.

Die wenigsten Menschen, die heute mit uns zusammenarbeiten, hatten ursprünglich vor, Unternehmer zu werden.

Sie hatten einen guten Beruf, ein solides Einkommen und oft bereits Verantwortung im Unternehmen.

„War das jetzt schon alles?“ - Nicht, weil der Job schlecht war.

Sondern weil sie gemerkt haben, dass sie ihre persönliche und finanzielle Entwicklung irgendwann nicht mehr selbst bestimmen konnten.

Deshalb begannen viele zunächst ganz einfach:

Mit einem zweiten Standbein.

Neben ihrem Hauptberuf.

Mit wenigen Stunden pro Woche.

Ohne ihren sicheren Arbeitsplatz aufzugeben.

Vielleicht erkennst du dich darin wieder.

Qualifikation

  • Du interessierst dich für ETFs, Vermögensaufbau oder Kapitalanlagen.

  • Du kannst dir vorstellen, dir neben deinem Beruf etwas Eigenes aufzubauen.
  • Menschen vertrauen dir und schätzen deine Meinung.
  • Du arbeitest gerne mit Menschen und bist offen, Neues zu lernen.

Besonders häufig kommen unsere Partner aus Berufen wie:

  • Ingenieurwesen
  • IT
  • Projektmanagement
  • Vertrieb
  • Führung
  • kaufmännischen Berufen

Entscheidend ist für uns jedoch nicht dein Beruf, sondern deine Persönlichkeit.

Benefits

Das erwartet dich?

✔ Persönliche Begleitung durch Johann & Jakob Dick

✔ Über 15 Jahre Erfahrung in den Bereichen ETFs, Immobilien und Vermögensaufbau

✔ Moderner Einstieg in eine spannende Zukunftsbranche

✔ Langfristige Entwicklungs- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten

✔ Du bestimmst selbst, wie groß dein Weg werden soll

Wer wir sind?

Wir sind Johann & Jakob Dick.

Seit über 15 Jahren begleiten wir Menschen beim Vermögensaufbau und entwickeln Unternehmer im Bereich moderner Kapitalanlagen.

Von unserem Standort im Rhein-Sieg-Kreis arbeiten wir gemeinsam mit Partnern in ganz Deutschland.

Unser Ziel ist nicht, möglichst viele Menschen einzustellen.

Unser Ziel ist es, Menschen dabei zu unterstützen, ihr Potenzial zu entfalten und sich langfristig ein erfolgreiches zweites Standbein oder sogar ein eigenes Unternehmen aufzubauen.

Lerne uns persönlich kennen.

Du bist dir noch unsicher, ob dieses Geschäftsmodell zu dir passt?

Genau dafür ist unser unverbindliches Kennenlerngespräch da.

In etwa 20 bis 30 Minuten zeigen wir dir, wie unser Geschäftsmodell funktioniert, beantworten deine Fragen und finden gemeinsam heraus, ob dieser Weg zu deinen persönlichen und beruflichen Zielen passt.

title: Field Marketing Specialist
descriptionHtml:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

This Role

The French market is one of Dust’s most important growth levers, and the Marketing team plays a central role in supporting pipeline generation through events, content and account-based activations.

As field marketing specialist, France, you will be the execution owner for Dust’s local Marketing activities. Working closely with the France Marketing Lead, you will turn defined priorities into high-quality events, localized webinars, social media, content and partner marketing activations that support Sales, BDRs and pipeline generation.

The France Marketing Lead owns the strategy, budget, programme selection and priorities. You will own execution, coordination, content delivery and continuous improvement across the French Marketing motion.

You will be part of a growing Marketing team across the US, UK and France, managed by the Global Head of Marketing.

Key Responsibilities

Own the execution of the French event and webinar programme

  • Execute conferences, Dust-owned events and localized webinars selected and scoped by the France Marketing Lead.

  • Coordinate the preparation, stakeholders, content, landing pages and logistics needed for a smooth delivery.

  • Work closely with Sales and BDRs to prepare target accounts, follow-up plans and event-related content.

  • Collect feedback, measure performance and document learnings after each activity.

Own French social media and content activation

  • Own social media execution for Dust around events, campaigns and key French-market topics.

  • Support AEs with relevant content and messaging for their LinkedIn activity.

  • Coordinate with Global Marketing, Product, Customer Success, Design and external media partners to deliver relevant content for French enterprise audiences.

  • Turn events, customer conversations and market insights into reusable content, including customer stories, blog posts, videos, YouTube content and Sales assets.

Support partner marketing and Growth programmes

  • Provide execution and logistical support for regional partner marketing activities within the strategy, selection and budget defined by the France Marketing Lead.

  • Support Growth with French-market content for ABM, webinars and paid campaigns.

  • Produce or reformat assets such as e-books, landing pages, customer content and campaign materials.

  • Connect event, content and partner marketing activities to target account engagement and pipeline generation.

Coordinate cross-functional Marketing initiatives

  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive Marketing tasks , Build Dust agents and workflows to support research, event preparation, content repurposing, Sales enablement, reporting and follow-up.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in B2B Marketing, ideally across Field Marketing, Event Marketing, Content Marketing or Product Marketing, preferably in SaaS or technology.

  • End-to-end event ownership with the ability to plan and deliver conferences, executive events and Dust-owned events, from preparation through execution and post-event follow-up.

  • Strong content and social media skills with experience creating or repurposing content for enterprise audiences across social media, landing pages, customer stories, YouTube, Sales enablement and executive LinkedIn profiles.

  • Commercial and pipeline mindset with a clear understanding of how events, content and account-based activities support Sales, BDRs, direct pipeline and partner-led growth.

  • Excellent communication skills in French and English, both written and spoken. You can write clearly and accurately, adapt your tone to different audiences and communicate credibly with enterprise executives.

  • Generalist and hands-on approach. You are comfortable moving between event ownership, content creation, Sales preparation, webinars, campaign assets and operational coordination.

  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail. You anticipate needs, manage deadlines reliably and ensure that projects, events and content are properly prepared before launch.

  • Self-starter mentality. You take initiative, make decisions, solve problems and own outcomes rather than waiting to be told what to do.

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills. You know how to find and coordinate the right people across Marketing, Sales, BDRs, Customer Success, Partnerships and external partners.

  • Nice to have: Experience marketing to French enterprise or CAC 40 audiences, working with agencies or media partners, supporting paid campaigns, producing webinars or video content, and working with tools such as HubSpot, Google Workspace and Figma.

  • Location and travel: Based in Paris, comfortable working on-site and willing to travel occasionally for events in France.

What Makes This Role Unique

  • Direct pipeline impact: Your work will directly support Sales and BDRs through events, content and ABM activations.

  • Execution ownership in France: You will turn the priorities defined by the France Marketing Lead into high-quality events, content, social media and partner marketing activations in France.

  • AI-native Marketing: You will use Dust to automate research, preparation, content production, reporting and follow-up.

  • Generalist scope: The role combines events, content, social media, webinars, Sales enablement and ABM.

  • Market-shaping opportunity: Help establish Dust as a leading voice in the French enterprise and agentic AI market.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Our product constitution, a story about our mission

  • Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

We're building genuinely AI-enabled tooling to support this function — so this role is less about arriving with a decade of FIX expertise already committed to memory, and much more about someone sharp, adaptable, and genuinely curious who can use that tooling to go further, faster, and think proactively about how the process itself should keep improving.

What You'll Work On

FIX Onboarding & Integrations:

  • Lead and manage FIX client onboarding projects — from initial requirements gathering through certification and production go-live.

  • Configure, test, and validate FIX sessions, including order routing, execution reporting, and market data flows.

  • Coordinate conformance testing and certification with clients to ensure compliance with platform standards.

  • Document onboarding procedures, client configurations, and integration best practices.

  • Leverage internal AI and automation tools to streamline client onboarding and troubleshooting — including tooling built specifically for this function, giving you a genuine head start on deep process knowledge.

  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to support new FIX workflows, APIs, and client integration initiatives.

Client Services:

  • Serve as frontline technical support for clients in EMEA across FX and equities business lines.

  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, ensuring timely and transparent communication addressing their needs and queries with professionalism and efficiency.

  • Provide ongoing technical and operational support for production trading environments.

  • Manage client inquiries, troubleshoot workflow or configuration issues, and coordinate resolutions across internal teams.

  • Partner with account management, sales and product teams to ensure a positive client experience and successful delivery of platform enhancements.

What We Need

  • 2-5 years of experience in a client onboarding, integration, or technical support role within financial technology, trading, or brokerage.

  • Good working knowledge of the FIX protocol — message structures, session management, and common trading workflows.

  • Genuine comfort troubleshooting FIX connectivity, analysing logs, and resolving integration issues, with the judgement to know when to dig deeper.

  • Familiarity with FX and Equities trading environments, order lifecycle management, and market data connectivity — genuine interest in working across multiple asset classes rather than staying within one.

  • A genuinely proactive, tech-first mindset — someone who treats our AI and automation tooling as a way to go further and faster, not a replacement for good judgement, and who naturally looks for ways to improve a process rather than simply following it.

  • Excellent communication and organisational skills, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple onboarding/client projects in parallel.

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience with OMS/EMS platforms, liquidity aggregators, or trading system integrations.

  • Exposure to other API protocols and architectures (REST, WebSocket) — relevant given the depth of our own API.

  • Scripting or automation experience (e.g. Python) and familiarity with monitoring tools (Splunk, Grafana, or similar).

  • Understanding of financial market structure and post-trade workflows.

What You Get

  • A genuinely rich API to work with — not a thin FIX wrapper bolted onto a legacy system. You'll onboard clients onto an API with real depth across order routing, execution reporting, and market data — the kind of platform where understanding the protocol properly actually matters.

  • Breadth across FX, Equities, and digital assets — most FIX/onboarding roles sit inside a single asset class. Here you'll build knowledge across all three, at a network connecting 40+ liquidity providers — exposure that compounds faster than a single-product environment.

  • Real ownership of the tech-to-business bridge — you're not just configuring sessions, you're the person translating FIX/API detail into client outcomes clients actually care about. That combination — technical credibility plus commercial judgement, is the actual shape of this role.

  • A genuinely tech-first operation — we've built dedicated AI tooling for this function specifically, so your ramp-up is faster and your day-to-day is spent on the client and integration problems that need real judgement, not repetitive configuration work.

  • A small, senior team — you'll work directly alongside Client Services, TechOps, and engineering, with real visibility into how the platform works end to end, not a large layer of process between you and the people who built it.

  • Growth across the business — the skills this role builds (protocol depth, client-facing technical credibility, cross-asset exposure) are the same ones that open doors internally.

  • Competitive package — up to 30 days leave + bank holidays, private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites

Our Hiring Process

We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.

Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition
Format: Video call, ~30-45 minutes

Stage 2: Team Conversation with one or two members of the Client Services team
Format: Video call or In-person, interactive session, ~60 minutes

Stage 3: Leadership Conversation with CRO

Format: Video call or In-person, ~60 minutes

What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you're invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.

*Please note that depending on availability, Stage 2 and 3 may swap around.

How to Apply

Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you'll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.

Right to Work: Candidates must have the existing right to work in the UK. We are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Equal Opportunities: Reactive Markets is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

Reasonable Adjustments: If you need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know — we're happy to accommodate.

Data Protection: By applying, you consent to Reactive Markets processing your personal data for recruitment purposes, in line with our privacy policy.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer - EMEA
descriptionHtml:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to turn n8n’s most strategic enterprise deployments into production-ready success stories by embedding on-site, solving real customer problems, and building reusable automation patterns that shape our product.

To do so, you’ll work directly with customers, Deployment Strategists, and Product to make every engagement high-impact, scalable, and repeatable:

Drive high-impact enterprise deployments

Partner closely with Deployment Strategists to align technical execution with customer priorities, stakeholder needs, and adoption goals.

Build trust with technical and non-technical stakeholders by turning complex customer environments into clear, actionable solutions.

Build production-grade automation solutions

Design and build workflows, integrations, and custom nodes tailored to each customer’s environment and scalable beyond the initial use case.

Extend existing n8n nodes or add missing functionality where needed to unlock high-value enterprise use cases.

Translate ambiguous business problems into concrete automation designs that prioritize real customer value over technical complexity.

Work across industries and tech stacks, getting productive quickly in new environments.

Bridge customer needs with Product and Engineering

Identify when a bespoke customer requirement should become a reusable node improvement, product feature, or platform capability.

Create a clear feedback loop with Product and Engineering by documenting technical gaps, customer context, implementation learnings, and prioritization signals.

Contribute reusable learnings, workflows, custom nodes, and integration patterns to an internal playbook library.

Turn customer learnings into product and playbooks

Identify when a bespoke customer requirement should become a core product feature and document it clearly for Product.

Contribute reusable learnings, workflows, and patterns to an internal playbook library.

Help ensure every engagement makes the next one faster, stronger, and more productized.

Keep engagements focused and scalable

Deliver time-boxed customer engagements with clear outcomes, rather than open-ended professional services work.

Build solutions that customers can own and operate themselves.

Know when to build, when to simplify, and when to push back to avoid unnecessary complexity.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

🧑‍💻 Strong engineering background: You have solid full-stack or backend engineering experience and have built integrations, APIs, or automation pipelines in production environments.

🧩 Integration-building expertise: You can create custom nodes, extend existing integrations, and work confidently with APIs, authentication patterns, data models, and event-driven systems.

🔧 Product-minded technical execution: You can distinguish between a one-off customer workaround, a reusable node improvement, and a product feature worth escalating.

🤝 Customer-facing confidence: You’re comfortable working directly in customer environments and can build trust with engineers, operators, and non-technical stakeholders.

🗺️ Solution design skills: You can take a messy operational problem and turn it into a clean, practical technical design.

⚖️ Strong technical judgment: You know when to build, when to push back, and how to avoid gold-plating solutions that should stay simple.

✈️ Willingness to travel: You’re open to travelling roughly 30-50% of the time for on-site engagements, primarily across Europe.

⚡ Speed to productive: You can quickly understand new industries, tech stacks, and customer environments without needing everything to be neatly defined.

Nice-to-haves

🔁 Workflow automation experience: You have familiarity with n8n or similar workflow automation tools.

🏢 Enterprise deployment experience: You’ve worked with strategic enterprise accounts in complex technical environments.

🧱 Node or connector development: You’ve built custom nodes, connectors, plugins, SDKs, or reusable integration frameworks.

🚀 Forward deployed experience: You’ve worked in a forward deployed, solutions engineering, or similar role at a product-led technical organization.

📣 Product feedback experience: You’ve helped turn customer learnings into clear product feedback, roadmap input, or engineering specifications.

Why join us?

At n8n, you’ll be the founding Forward Deployed Engineer, helping define how we turn our largest enterprise deployments into long-term, referenceable success stories. Your work won’t sit in a demo environment — you’ll build production workflows with real users, influence our product roadmap, and create the playbooks that shape how this function scales.

You’ll join one of Europe’s fastest-growing startups at a moment of huge momentum, working with a remote-first team that values autonomy, speed, experimentation, and direct customer impact.

Sound like a challenge you’re excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Your Impact

Procurement is over 50% of revenue for industrial companies and their biggest lever for profitability. The hard part isn't the software. Every customer's reality is different: a different ERP, a different data model, decades of undocumented process. Generic platforms stall exactly there, and that's where most enterprise AI value quietly dies.

At Tacto, the people who close that gap are Builders who work at the customer edge. You sit inside the customer's environment, build in their production data, and turn what you learn there into product. More than 300 industrial companies already run on Tacto, and every new one teaches us something the platform should do on its own.

 

Your Tasks

  • Prove it with their data. Show a prospect or customer what Tacto finds in their own spend, suppliers and parts, fast enough that the value is obvious.

  • Build in customer environments. Data pipelines, agents and custom logic on top of the Tacto platform, in real production data, until the procurement team can actually work with the result.

  • Be in the room, on site. Run workshops with buyers and key users, debug alongside their IT, and see how a company really buys instead of how the process documentation says it buys.

  • Turn the edge into product. When you solve something twice, ship it into the platform so nobody has to solve it a third time. You're done when it drives revenue, not when the deployment is live.

  • Automate your own job. If a step can be done by an agent, you build the agent and prove it works.

 

Your Profile

  • You've built something people relied on: software, automations, agents, or a technical project that real users used.

  • You build with AI every day. Cursor, Claude, Codex and agents are your default, and you've built with LLMs against real, messy data.

  • You're hands-on with data. SQL and Python at working level, or the drive to get there fast with AI as leverage.

  • You thrive in messy environments. Incomplete requirements, undocumented data and conflicting stakeholders don't stop you.

  • You earn customer trust. You explain technical decisions clearly, handle pushback, and don't over-promise.

  • Early in your career? Good. We bet on people with a steep learning curve, and our senior Builders spend real time making others faster.

  • Native-level German and fluent English, based in Munich, happy to travel across DACH.

 

What This Role Is, and Isn't

We want to be honest about what you are signing up for.

  • This is not an engineering role with customers kept at a safe distance. Customer contact is the job, not a tax on the job. If you want a ticket queue and clean requirements, this is the wrong role.

  • This is not consulting. Nobody here bills days. You are measured on what the customer can do afterwards and on what made it into the platform.

  • It is deliberately broad. If you want to specialise narrowly you will be frustrated here.

  • The deal: prove yourself, deliver real impact, make a strong case for yourself, then we back your next step in every way we can.

How the process works

  1. Say Hello (20 min): get to know each other and the role

  2. Hiring Manager Interview (45 min)

  3. On-site day: a case with three Builders and Pool Leads (1 hour), Meet the Team (30 min)

Our Background

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Why It Matters

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI.

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

What We Offer

The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day. That is demanding and rewarding, but that's where we thrive. Besides that you have:

  • Money: Competitive salary & equity in the company with real upside, so you are invested in our success

  • Workplace: A vibrant in-office culture (> 4 days/week) in a beautiful office in central Munich

  • Development: A development budget and regular exposure to exceptional people, e.g., Lunch & Learns, peer mentoring, external speakers

  • Time off: 26 + 4 vacation days per year (4 fixed “company rest days”) as well as regular off-sites and team events

  • Health: Wellpass membership, of course, a fruit basket (!), and access to Jobrad, for your health

  • Family & Social Security: Voluntary pension contribution, voluntary KITA subsidy for your children

Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

title: Founders Associate – Praktikum
descriptionHtml:

descriptionHtml:

Die Bauindustrie verliert jährlich 1,6 Billionen USD durch Ineffizienzen. Einer der Hauptgründe: Dieselben Fehler wiederholen sich immer wieder, weil entscheidende Informationen noch immer in Papierdokumenten und unstrukturierten Dateien verborgen sind.

Genau hier setzt alago an. Wir sind ein Team von 15 Personen und entwickeln KI-gestütztes Projektmanagement für die Baubranche. Bereits heute vertrauen uns mehr als 40 Kunden. Unsere Vision ist es, Risiken in Bauprojekten frühzeitig sichtbar zu machen – damit Großprojekte nicht mehr Jahrzehnte dauern oder scheitern.

Wir haben letztes Jahr eine Pre-Seed-Finanzierung von über 1 Mio. € von führenden VCs der Baubranche sowie einem der größten Projektentwickler Deutschlands abgeschlossen.

75 % der Infrastruktur, die im Jahr 2050 existieren wird, ist heute noch nicht gebaut. Lasst uns sie von Anfang an richtig bauen.

Tasks

Customer Experience ist bei uns kein Support-Ticket-Job. Du besitzt den kompletten Kundenlebenszyklus nach dem Vertragsabschluss — kommerziell, operativ und im Produkt.

Damit sitzt du an der Stelle im Unternehmen, an der beide Seiten gleichzeitig sichtbar sind: Du weißt, was Kunden wirklich brauchen und wofür sie zahlen — und du weißt, was das Produkt kann und was es kosten würde, es zu können. Genau daraus entstehen die besten Produktentscheidungen und die besten Deals.

Du bist die erste Person in dieser Rolle und baust den Bereich so, wie er in zwei Jahren für dreißig Leute funktionieren muss.

💰 Revenue Ownership

  • Du besitzt einen Kundenstamm mit klarer Umsatzverantwortung: Retention, Expansion, Renewals.

🚀 Value Creation über den gesamten Kundenlebenszyklus

  • Du verantwortest unseren Support: Anfragen beantworten, priorisieren, Muster erkennen.

  • Du debuggst Customer Flows in der Software selbst – du reichst ein Problem nicht weiter, du reproduzierst es, grenzt es ein und beschreibst es so, dass es lösbar ist.

⚙️ Product Engine – du baust mit

  • Du shippst selbst: Bugfixes, kleinere Features und Verbesserungen in den kundennahen Teilen des Produkts – mit Code-Review durch unser Engineering-Team.

  • Du baust Integrationen und Datenimporte: Anbindung an Kundensysteme, Migration von Projektdaten, Skripte, die ein Onboarding von Tagen auf Stunden verkürzen.

  • Du übersetzt, was Nutzer, Projektleitungen, IT und QM wirklich brauchen, in klare, priorisierte Produkt-Inputs – mit Belegen, nicht mit Bauchgefühl. Was du selbst lösen kannst, löst du selbst.

  • Du testest neue Releases aus Kundensicht, bevor sie live gehen, und bist die Stimme des Kunden im Produktprozess.

🏗️ Den Bereich aufbauen

  • Du schreibst die Playbooks für Onboarding, Rollout, Support und Upsell – und automatisierst sie, wo immer es geht.

  • Du entwickelst und betreibst die KI-Agents und Automatisierungen, die Customer Experience bei uns skalierbar machen, statt den Bereich mit Köpfen zu vergrößern.

Requirements

Muss-Kriterien

  • Du hattest bereits direkten Kundenkontakt in einer verantwortlichen Rolle – du hast Kunden selbst geführt, nicht nur zugearbeitet

  • Du hast Umsatzverantwortung getragen oder Umsatz ausgebaut (Renewals, Upsells, Expansion, Abschlüsse) und kannst das mit Zahlen belegen

  • Standort München oder Bereitschaft, dauerhaft von hier aus zu arbeiten

Pluspunkte

  • Du hast selbst schon aktiv entwickelt – eigene Projekte, Skripte, Integrationen, ein Side Project, das tatsächlich läuft

  • Du hast schon mit Claude Code (oder vergleichbaren Coding-Agents) echte Sachen gebaut und weißt, wie weit man damit ohne Engineering-Team kommt

  • Du kennst Teile unseres Stacks (TypeScript, React, Supabase) schon aus eigenen Projekten

  • Du hast schon in der Baubranche gearbeitet oder hast einen engen Bezug zu ihr

  • Du hast bereits in einem schnell wachsenden Early-Stage-Startup gearbeitet und weißt, wie es sich anfühlt, wenn es noch kein Playbook gibt

  • Du hast schon einmal einen Bereich oder Prozess von null aufgebaut

Wie du arbeitest

  • AI-native: Du nutzt KI reflexhaft, nicht gelegentlich. Du hast eigene Agents, Automatisierungen oder Tools gebaut (n8n, Claude Code, Lovable o. Ä.), testest neue Modelle sofort und weißt, was taugt.

  • Systems Thinker: Du siehst das System hinter dem einzelnen Kunden. Beim zweiten Mal baust du den Prozess, der das manuelle Lösen überflüssig macht – und dokumentierst ihn für die nächste Person.

  • Technische Tiefe: Du prüfst Daten, verfolgst Flows, liest Logs und grenzt Probleme sauber ein – und behebst sie, wo es geht, selbst mit KI-Tools. Du bist in der Software zu Hause, nicht nur in der Präsentation darüber.

  • Umsetzung & Ownership: Du bringst Dinge zu Ende, ohne dass jemand nachfassen muss.

Wenn du dich nicht in jedem Punkt wiederfindest, aber überzeugt bist, dass du zu alago passt, bewirb dich trotzdem. Entscheidend sind dein Potenzial und deine Lernkurve.

Warum Alago?

Du wirst einer der tragenden Pfeiler dieser Firma

  • Du bist die erste Person für Customer Experience und bestimmst Prozesse, Tools, Standards und Kennzahlen. Was du baust, bleibt.

  • Customer Experience ist einer von sechs, sieben Bereichen, die alago tragen – und du besitzt ihn.

  • Du sitzt am Tisch, wenn die Entscheidungen fallen, die die Firma prägen. Der Weg führt zum Head of Customer Experience mit eigenem Team.

Du entwickelst dich in eines der gefragtesten Profile überhaupt

  • KI-Unternehmen suchen händeringend Leute, die Kunde und Produkt zugleich beherrschen – bei Palantir heißt das Forward Deployed Engineer.

  • Du lernst, Vertrauen aufzubauen, schwierige Gespräche zu führen und Kunden über Monate zu messbarem Wert zu begleiten.

  • Ab Tag eins Zugriff auf unsere Codebasis, Pairing mit dem Engineering-Team und echte Code-Reviews. Wer beides kann, hat danach jede Tür offen.

Du baust deine eigene Marke – und vervielfachst deinen Marktwert

  • Du begleitest unser Wachstum von 16 auf 30 Mitarbeitende in zwei Jahren.

  • Du knackst den Code, wie Onboarding, Rollout, Support und Upsell vorhersehbar und wiederholbar werden – und nimmst dieses Playbook überallhin mit.

Du beschleunigst deine Entwicklung

  • Ob eigene Gründung oder Head of Customer Experience: Halbjährliche Performance-Reviews, konkrete Entwicklungsschritte alle ~9 Monate.

  • Wöchentliche Trainings, erfahrene Coaches und Mentor:innen und eine umfangreiche Bibliothek.

Arbeite direkt mit den Foundern

  • Tag für Tag mit Janick (Go-to-Market & Strategy) und Ann-Christin (Product & Domain).

  • Frühe Phase heißt: viel Eigenverantwortung, kurze Feedback-Zyklen und die Freiheit, in die Rolle zu wachsen, die zu deinen Stärken passt.

Zusätzlich

  • Wellpass, zweimal pro Woche Team-Dinner und Unterstützung beim Relocation-Prozess.

  • Arbeitsplatz im WERK1, einem der aktivsten Startup-Hubs Münchens.

Bewerbungsprozess

  1. Bewerbung – Lebenslauf plus ein kurzes Beispiel, in dem du Verantwortung übernommen und Wirkung erzielt hast

  2. Erstgespräch (30 Minuten)

  3. Deep-Dive mit einem Founder (40 Minuten)

  4. Case Study (halber Tag vor Ort in München) – z. B. ein hängendes Rollout retten, einen Upsell-Case rechnen oder einen Customer Flow im Produkt debuggen

  5. Entscheidung – Rückmeldung innerhalb von 24 Stunden. Wenn es für beide Seiten passt – freuen wir uns sehr auf die Zusammenarbeit! 🎉

title: FPGA Engineer (Controls & Signal Processing)
descriptionHtml:
About Enact

The next defining technological breakthrough will be in the physical world. We stand at a historical inflection point: bringing general-purpose intelligence into robotics.

At Enact we rethink the entire robotic tech stack from model architectures and data pipelines, to the actuators and sensors that feed the model. Pushing beyond pure vision and language approaches, we build a proprioceptive nerve system, and the cortex that makes sense of it, to solve dexterity through whole-body force-awareness and deploy robots for thousands of tasks in industry and beyond.

We are shaping a company where brilliant and unconventional people thrive together on solving the hardest challenges of our time. We are truth seekers. We reason from first principles, test our beliefs against reality, and trust that the best ideas can come from anyone. We move fast. We care deeply about our work and colleagues and are driven by passion to change the status quo.

If this resonates, we're excited to hear from you.

In This Role You Will

  • Design, implement, and verify the FPGA fabric at the heart of our custom hardware, from real-time control and signal processing to high-speed sensor and data interfaces.

  • Own the build flow: synthesis, place & route, static timing analysis, and timing closure on real silicon.

  • Develop testbenches, simulation, and co-simulation to verify behaviour at unit and system level.

  • Take designs from RTL through board bring-up, integration, and lab debug under real operating conditions all the way through to production-ready.

  • Keep the design understandable: specifications, timing budgets, and verification plans.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong digital design fundamentals: RTL in SystemVerilog (or VHDL), and a solid grasp of computer architecture.

  • The ability to reason about fixed- and floating-point data paths and pipelines - where precision goes, where it costs you, and how a computation maps onto real hardware.

  • Experience closing timing: static timing analysis, writing constraints, clock-domain crossing, and synchronization.

  • Fluency with at least one vendor toolchain (Xilinx/AMD, Intel/Altera, or Lattice), in a heavily scripted setting.

  • Comfortable reading schematics, reasoning from first principles, and working shoulder-to-shoulder with electronics and mechanical engineers.

  • The ability to take designs from benchtop prototype to production ready.

  • Fluency in English (German not required, though useful!).

Bonus Points If You Have

Having done these before is a plus, not a prerequisite. You'll do much of it in the role:

  • Rust or embedded firmware experience.

  • DSP in fabric: filtering (FIR/IIR), FFT, and fixed-point implementation.

  • Control theory: system identification, plant modeling, and loop tuning.

  • High-speed ADC/DAC interfaces and sensor/communication protocols.

  • Expert knowledge of version control, especially git.

  • Safety-critical or certified design.

  • Experience collaborating across analog, software, and mechanical domains.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to make a real impact working on some of the biggest challenges of our time

  • A fast-paced learning environment alongside an outstanding, driven team

  • Ownership from day one, with the ability to iterate quickly and see your impact firsthand in an early-stage startup

  • Visa sponsorship & relocation benefits to hire the best in the world

  • A world-class in-person setup in central Zürich, with excellent prototyping, robotics, and technical infrastructure for hands-on builders

  • Competitive compensation and meaningful equity participation
