descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Spread Group is a renowned global provider of customized apparel and lifestyle products, distinguished by our commitment to made-to-order technology. Our core business model revolves around producing precisely what our customers desire, precisely when they desire it. As pioneers in this space, we combine sustainability with on-demand personalization, enabling individuals and businesses to express their unique identities through bespoke creations. Join us to be part of a global leader in the exciting world of personalized apparel and lifestyle products!

As we continue to expand our business, we are seeking a curious and passionate individual to join our team as of January 2027, as Fullstack Engineer (f/m/d) and drive our business forward.

What Will Your Role Be

As a Fullstack Engineer (f/m/d) in our Merchant Experience team, you’ll help build and evolve the digital products our partners and merchants interact with every day. You’ll work across the entire merchant journey — from the Partner Area, where designers manage their designs and shops, to the sign-up and publishing experience that turns an idea into a live SpreadShop, and the Merchant Area, where SpreadConnect merchants manage integrations with Shopify, TikTok, and other platforms. As a Fullstack Engineer (f/m/d), you’ll take ownership beyond individual UI components or API endpoints. You’ll design and implement features end-to-end, collaborate closely with product and design, and ensure that the experiences you build are reliable, performant, and easy to evolve. Your work directly impacts how merchants use and grow with our platform. You’ll build products that make their day-to-day work easier and help drive our business forward.

What You´ll Do

  • Build and evolve merchant-facing product surfaces — sign-up and shop creation flows, shop management, design and product administration, sales statistics

  • Build the new publishing journey for shops — from sign-up to a live SpreadShop — and take drop-off out of every step

  • Own small to medium features end to end: design the UI, build theKotlin/Spring endpoints behind it, model the data, and ship both together

  • Extend our backend services where your features need it — new REST endpointsin the shop and partner services, data model changes with a proper migration, and integrations with external platforms such as Shopify or TikTok on the SpreadConnect side

  • Design and consume our REST and GraphQL APIs, and push back when a responseshape makes the frontend's life harder than it needs to be

  • Contribute to our cross-team frontend architecture work — shared components,hooks and API clients, and how we render, test and ship our apps

  • Keep merchant tooling fast — data-heavy tables, sales statistics and editorsare where perceived performance is won or lost

  • Take on larger topics — an epic, a new integration, a new merchant surface —and break them down into something the team can execute: slices, dependencies, open questions, and a first piece worth shipping

  • Work in an agile cross-functional team with a product owner, designers and backend engineers, and connect what you build to merchant activation and conversion

What You´ll Bring

  • Solid proficiency in TypeScript and React — component design, hooks, statemanagement, and the performance patterns that keep a growing app fast

  • Around three or more years of professional experience building web products, with a track record of features you carried from first ticket to production

  • Real CSS craft and experience working inside a design system or shared component library, not just against one

  • Experience consuming REST or GraphQL APIs and working with structured, data-heavy responses — product catalogs, variants and attributes bring more complexity than they first appear to

  • Working experience in a JVM backend — Kotlin or Java with Spring — and the ability to build a REST endpoint, model the data behind it and write the migration, not just read the code

  • A solid grasp of relational databases and SQL, and of what happens to a query when the table stops being small

  • Self-direction: you take an under-specified problem, find out what is actually needed, break it into deliverable pieces and drive them to donewithout waiting to be handed tickets

  • Testing as a habit rather than an afterthought, and a working relationship with code review

  • A keen eye for UI detail — you care about how something feels, not only whether it works

  • A product mindset: you ask who benefits from a change before you ask how to build it

  • Good communication skills in English

  • Development and Growth: We believe that the greatest professional and personal growth happens when you're challenged. If you're looking to build your career, you'll find plenty of opportunities to do so.

  • We Win as a Team: Work alongside ambitious, motivated colleagues who challenge and support each other to achieve exceptional results. Through honest feedback, high standards, and shared ambition, we bring out the best in one another.

As a Technical Lead at Nearform, you will be responsible for leading and guiding development teams while working directly with clients to translate business and technical requirements into impactful applications.   • Provide technical and line-management leadership to your development team.

What we are looking for in this person:

  • Significant experience in software engineering as either a Senior Engineer leading projects and mentoring or as a Technical Lead. For this particular role, you will ideally be using Golang, experience with additional other languages such as JavaScript or Python would be desirable. 
  • Experience working directly with clients or customers to understand technical requirements.

  • Deep understanding of agile ways of working, best practices and design patterns.

  • Understanding of operational concerns (such as monitoring, performance testing, security considerations, accessibility, GDPR)
  • Empathy and people skills
  • Financial services industry experience

  • Annual Company Bonus - We all help Nearform to hit company goals so we all receive a share of the profits on an annual basis in line with company performance. 
  • Work Remotely and Flexibly - We have a genuine dedication to work/life balance. Our flexible working culture allows you to work around what matters - school run, no problem!

Our Interview Process

Talent Call (30 mins via Zoom)
An initial conversation with a member of our Talent Team to explore your background, leadership experience, and career goals. We’ll provide an overview of Nearform, discuss potential alignment, and answer any questions you may have. This step helps us assess initial alignment.

Technical Lead Assessment (90 mins, Zoom)

Architecture Design – We want to see how you approach a high level problem, demonstrating your design thinking and decision-making process.
Technical Implementation – How do you turn a design into reality, taking into account business needs?
Code Standards and Feedback – We want to see not just your own skills, but also how you improve those around you

Hiring Manager Interview (45 mins via Zoom)
A conversation with a Hiring Manager focused on your approach to teamwork, client collaboration, and problem-solving in an enterprise development setting. We'll also share more details about Nearform and the potential projects you may join.

There may also be an additional interview with the client depending on the project.

title: Head of Community, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity.

The Community team focuses on finding exceptional power users of our tools and turning real usage into stories and signals that shape both product direction and how the world understands OpenAI. We do that by learning directly from users, then working together to package insights and use cases into formats that can travel: playbooks, webpages, launch assets, event series, and clear guidance on how people actually use our tools.

About the Role

The Head of Community, EMEA,will lead OpenAI’s community presence across the region and be responsible for setting and evolving an evidence-based Community strategy in markets, including hiring local community leads and managers .

The role is responsible for how we create trusted relationships with power users and translate those relationships into participation, insight, enablement, and stories across the region. They will partner with senior leadership to recommend where Community can have the greatest impact across EMEA, laddering up to company and country level priorities.

Immediately, they will oversee our Student Collective motion in EMEA markets, including working with our global team, global agency and hiring Student Community Managers and coordinators in markets. They will also shape how we roll out additional community work with SMBs and Pro subscribers in close collaboration with the global program leads.

We’re looking for an experienced community leader who has held senior roles at multiple companies, including those where community is central to how people learn, build, create, or share their work.

They understand how to combine thoughtful relationships with programs that can reach many more people. They are comfortable building the first relationships themselves, identifying what makes them valuable, and developing a team that can sustain that quality as the work grows.

They bring strong judgement about which communities and fandoms to invest in, how global programs should adapt to local needs, and how community learning can inform decisions across OpenAI.

In this role, you will:

Build the broader EMEA Community strategy:

  • Map the EMEA community landscape and develop a point of view on which user communities OpenAI should know, support and learn from.

  • Build high-trust direct relationships with power users across relevant segments, and help scale that relationship building motion across EMEA where strategically justified.

  • Define a clear expansion logic: which communities and fandoms to explore, why they matter, what Community can uniquely contribute and what resourcing they require.

  • Develop country and regional priorities together with country leads, combining local community insights, market context, and company goals.

  • Create repeatable playbooks for launching, learning from and scaling community programs across EMEA without losing local relevance.

Lead regional community programs:

  • Partner with country leads and local Community teams to develop market priorities and programs, drawing on local user insights and cultural context while maintaining accountability for regional outcomes.

  • Work with global program leads and country leads to adapt global programs, develop initiatives originating in markets, and share successful approaches across EMEA, with clear expectations for member experience, participation, and learning.

  • Oversee the Student Collective across EMEA, working with the agency partner and hiring and supporting local Student Community Managers and Coordinators in markets.

  • Shape and deliver SMB and Pro subscriber programs with global and country leads, including targeted engagement with knowledge worker communities and fandoms where there is a clear opportunity.

Turn relationships into participation, insights, and stories:

  • Source and curate compelling use cases and stories, spotlight community members, and equip them to share their knowledge with wider audiences, helping more people discover practical ways to use AI

  • Synthesise patterns by market, community, segment and use case; distinguish isolated anecdotes from signals worth acting on.

  • Publish regular updates and recaps that highlight progress, insights, risks and opportunities and clear recommendations.

  • Work cross-functionally to route relevant learnings into product, research, brand and product marketing, education, communications,and global affair teams so that these stories and insights can benefit millions more around the world.

Operate and scale the function:

  • Hire, support, and develop regional and market teams needed to grow EMEA Community work, maintaining the quality of user relationships as programs scale.

  • Work with our global team to build the systems, dashboards, cadences, xfn partners, templates and decision making processes needed to run EMEA Community work well.

  • Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment, clear ownership and follow-through.

  • Manage multiple workstreams across markets and communities while keeping priorities clear and execution moving.

  • Identify where additional local capacity, agency support, translation or specialist expertise is needed.

  • Represent OpenAI credibly with community members, campus partners and regional ecosystem stakeholders.

What success looks like:

  • Strong regional and market community team delivering effective community programs, including the Student Collective and emerging SMB and Pro subscriber initiatives. Clear recommendations on which communities and programs to scale, adapt, pause, or invest in, developed with country leads.

  • A clear, evidence-based view of which EMEA communities and markets matter most now and next. A practical regional operating model that can scale across markets while preserving local relevance.

  • High-trust user relationships that lead to robust participation, useful insights, and breakthrough stories, helping OpenAI improve product, marketing, education, and communications decisions while growing advocates in the region.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 10+ years of experience building, leading or scaling communities, user programmes or ecosystem initiatives across EMEA.

  • Have experience hiring and developing community teams, managing contractors and agencies, and leading cross-functional workstreams across markets with clear priorities and strong follow-through.

  • Are an excellent executor who can operate in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

  • Bring strong qualitative judgement and can build trust, identify patterns and turn community signals into clear recommendations.

  • Have excellent written and verbal communication skills and can influence stakeholders without direct authority.

  • Are experienced and comfortable working across markets, cultures and time zones, and willing to travel for community activations and relationship-building.

  • Have a strong interest in AI and practical familiarity with how people use ChatGPT or other AI tools.

Preferred qualifications:

  1. Experience with student, campus, youth, creator, developer, professional, or other power-user communities.

  2. Strong network across relevant EMEA communities, institutions, or ecosystem partners.

  3. Experience translating community insight into stories, playbooks, launches, programs, or product recommendations.

  4. Fluency in one or more additional EMEA languages.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Head of Compliance and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one.

You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area.

What You’ll Own

  • Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures.

  • Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite.

  • Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients.

  • Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity.

  • Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments.

  • File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR.

  • Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board.

  • Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest.

  • Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters.

  • Prepare the firm for the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027.

  • Build the compliance and AML team as the business grows.

What We’re Looking For

  • Significant experience in AML/CTF at a regulated EU financial institution. Ideally at an investment firm, neobroker, neobank or e-money institution.

  • Experience with digital onboarding and remote identity verification at scale.

  • Hands-on experience building risk assessments, monitoring scenarios and EDD processes.

  • Experience filing suspicious activity reports and handling regulatory inspections.

  • Knowledge of MiFID II conduct and investment-services compliance, or the ability to learn it fast.

  • Experience selecting and overseeing KYC, screening and monitoring tools.

  • Strong judgment and the confidence to challenge senior colleagues.

  • Clear, concise writing for policies, board reports and regulators.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a key function holder.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania or the FNTT.

  • Knowledge of Lithuanian AML law and Bank of Lithuania instructions.

  • Experience with clients across several EEA countries.

  • CAMS (ACAMS) or ICA certification.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • People who copy policies from templates without fitting them to the business.

  • People who say no without offering a compliant way forward.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

title: Head of Finance / FP&A (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du machst unser Wachstum steuerbar.

TEILE entwickelt und produziert High-End-Lautsprecher, DJ- und Audio-Equipment sowie Merch – Design-Objekte mit kompromisslosem Klang. Eine Brand, die man nicht nur hört, sondern auch tragen will. Unsere Systeme spielen in Clubs, auf Festivals, in Bars, Hotels und Restaurants.

Hinter TEILE steht eine weltweite Community mit sehr hoher Reichweite. Gerade bauen wir neue Vertriebskanäle auf: eigener Onlineshop, Social Commerce, Handels- und Objektpartner sowie Kooperationen mit großen Marken. Wir wachsen schnell – und bisher ohne Finanzfunktion. Es gibt kein Controlling, keine strukturierte Datenbasis, keine Systeme, die miteinander sprechen. Genau das baust du auf.

Deine Rolle

Du wirst die Person, die TEILE steuerbar macht. Du bringst den Blick eines CFO mit und baust trotzdem gern selbst – vom ersten Forecast bis zur Datenpipeline.

Dabei arbeitest du direkt mit unserem CEO und dem Gründerteam zusammen und machst KI von Anfang an zum Kern unserer Steuerung: automatisierte Reportings, datenbasierte Entscheidungen und smarte Prozesse statt manueller Routinen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Finance & FP&A aufbauen: Planung, Forecast, Liquidität und Reporting – mit einer Steuerungslogik, die mit uns skaliert.

  • Profitabilität sichtbar machen: Deckungsbeiträge pro Produkt, Kanal und Projekt – von der Werkstatt bis zum Webshop.

  • Finanzierung begleiten: Darlehen, Working-Capital-Finanzierung und Investoren-Unterlagen.

  • Eine Datenbasis für alle: Shop-, Marketing-, Produktions-, Vertriebs- und Finanzdaten in einer Plattform zusammenführen (z. B. Shopify) – Dashboards statt Excel-Silos.

  • AI-First denken: Abläufe in Finance, Marketing, Supply Chain und Customer Service automatisieren

  • Tech-Landschaft verantworten: Tools auswählen, Systeme verbinden, externe Dienstleister steuern.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Finance, Controlling oder FP&A – idealerweise in einem produzierenden Unternehmen mit physischen Produkten

  • Du hast Planung, Controlling und Reporting schon einmal selbst aufgebaut – nicht nur übernommen

  • Ein Plus: Hintergrund bei einer Big-4-Gesellschaft (PwC, KPMG, EY, Deloitte)

title: Head of KYC  - CDI (F/H)
descriptionHtml:
Lemonway est un établissement de paiement agréé, au cœur de la nouvelle économie européenne.

Nous sécurisons les paiements des plateformes de financement participatif, d’économie collaborative, des marketplaces et des e-commerçants, avec un fort engagement contre la fraude et pour la protection des fonds.

Réglementée par l’ACPR et bénéficiant du passeport européen dans 29 pays, Lemonway est basée à Paris et Hambourg et rassemble 150 Lemonheroes multiculturels et engagés.

Plus de 400 marketplaces nous font confiance. Nous gérons 1,4 million de portefeuilles utilisateurs et avons levé 50 M€ auprès de Breega, SpeedInvest et Toscafund.

Rentable depuis quatre ans et en croissance de +25 % en 2025, Lemonway vise à rester parmi les leaders du paiement en Europe grâce à une croissance saine et durable.

  • Secteur : FinTech / Paiements en ligne

  • Localisation : Paris, France (Quartier du Sentier, 2e arrondissement)

  • Télétravail : Jusqu'à 3 jours par semaine (au choix)

LE POSTE

Le/la Head of KYC Operations est un acteur clé dans la mise en œuvre du système de lutte contre la criminalité financière de l’entreprise et de notre approche centrée sur le client : une véritable opportunité de relever de nouveaux défis au sein d’une FinTech à taille humaine, évoluant dans un cadre réglementaire en perpétuelle évolution.

Rattaché(e) au VP AML au sein du Département Conformité et Risques, en tant que manager opérationnel KYC, vous superviserez le cadre de gestion KYC de Lemonway.

Les principales responsabilités :

  • Management d’une équipe : 5 collaborateurs à temps plein ainsi que des stagiaires/CDD

    • Superviser la productivité quotidienne de l’équipe pour s’assurer de la charge de travail et du respect des délais.

    • Superviser l’équipe externalisée et gérer la relation avec les prestataires.

    • Veiller à ce que les processus de collecte et d’analyse des documents et informations, à l’onboarding et tout au long du cycle de vie des clients, soient conformes, efficaces et réalisés avec qualité.

    • Coordonner des revues de qualité pour s'assurer que les membres de l'équipe effectuent correctement leurs missions et escalader les problèmes identifiés.

    • Formation continue des collaborateurs : fournir des feedbacks constructifs, des évaluations, des coachings et des formations

    • Réaliser des revues périodiques de qualité KYC et accompagner vos équipes sur les dossiers les plus complexes.

  • Conseil interne : Vous serez également en charge de conseiller les différentes parties prenantes internes et de veiller à répondre aux problématiques liées au KYC adressées par les clients.

    • Animer des formations sur les politiques KYC et évaluer leur efficacité.

    • Agir comme point de contact central pour l'équipe et point d’escalade pour les dossiers complexes.

  • Concevoir et superviser l’amélioration de notre cadre KYC

    • Mettre en œuvre et maintenir les politiques et procédures KYC.

    • Réaliser des évaluations des risques liés au cadre KYC et mettre en œuvre les recommandations des régulateurs, audits internes et contrôles internes.

    • Participer à la mise en place du cadre global de sécurité financière.


Expérience

  • Vous avez au moins 6 ans d’expérience et une spécialisation dans la lutte contre la criminalité financière et organisée.

  • Le management d’équipe fait une partie importante de votre expérience et vous appréciez l’opportunité de manager un équipe.

  • Vous avez un excellent niveau d’Anglais et de Français conversationnel.

Compétences techniques

  • Bonne compréhension du cadre réglementaire lié à la LCB-FT/Conformité/KYC.

  • Connaissance approfondie des différents cadres KYC.

  • Bonne connaissance des enjeux liés aux risques de sécurité financière.

  • Vous aimez les sujets d’IA et d’optimisation des processus.

    Compétences relationnelles

  • Vous êtes un(e) manager sensible et efficace, capable de tirer le meilleur de votre équipe.

  • Vous êtes un(e) vrai(e) joueur(se) d’équipe avec un sens profond de la collaboration, mais également à l’aise pour travailler de manière autonome.

  • Vous savez gérer votre temps efficacement et prioriser votre charge de travail dans un environnement rapide et compétitif.

  • Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour vos compétences organisationnelles et de gestion de projets.


NOS AVANTAGES

  • Bureaux au cœur du Sentier (Paris 2e)

  • Poste hybride (2j TT / semaine)

  • Carte Swile

  • Mutuelle Alan

  • Prise en charge à 50% du pass Navigo/Vélib

  • Accès à Gymlib

  • Prime vacances Syntec & RTT

Lemonway s'engage à promouvoir la diversité, notamment en favorisant le mixité Femme/Homme et l'emploi de personne en situation de handicap.

title: Head of Platform / Senior Platform Manager
descriptionHtml:
UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

We are looking for a hands-on Head of Platform / Senior Platform Manager to own the architecture, automation and operation of our secure infrastructure capability.

You will solve a distinctive engineering challenge: enabling customers to deploy, operate, monitor and recover our platform independently, including in environments where UFORCE has no direct access to systems. You will combine deep technical execution with platform leadership, establishing repeatable deployment patterns today and helping shape the team as the function grows.

What You'll Do

  • Design and deliver secure, repeatable infrastructure for air-gapped, on-premise, customer-hosted and cloud environments.

  • Build infrastructure-as-code capable of standing up isolated environments reliably on reference hardware.

  • Provision and operate Kubernetes across cloud and bare-metal infrastructure.

  • Develop automated configuration, deployment, upgrade and recovery processes.

  • Create platforms that customers can install, monitor, maintain and troubleshoot independently.

  • Own core infrastructure foundations across identity, networking, compute, storage, secrets, CI/CD and observability.

  • Translate security, assurance and accreditation requirements into automated, auditable platform controls.

  • Establish service ownership, SLOs, incident response, problem management and resilience practices.

  • Partner with Security, Product and Delivery teams to balance assurance requirements with delivery velocity.

  • Provide technical leadership, set engineering standards and help grow the platform capability over time.

Required Skills

  • Proven experience deploying cloud-style infrastructure onto customer-owned, on-premise or bare-metal systems.

  • Experience designing for air-gapped, disconnected, sovereign or similarly restricted production environments.

  • Experience leading a substantial high-assurance audit or compliance programme, such as SOC 2 Type 2, PCI DSS, DEFSTAN 05-138 or FedRAMP.

  • Strong Linux, Kubernetes, infrastructure automation and troubleshooting expertise.

  • The ability to write code and scripts, configure infrastructure primitives and personally debug complex platform issues.

  • Experience designing systems that remain supportable when vendor engineers have limited or no access to the customer environment.

  • Strong technical leadership and the ability to align senior engineers and cross-functional partners.

  • Experience navigating the technical, security and certification constraints associated with highly regulated deployments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in defence, government, banking, critical national infrastructure or another highly regulated sector.

  • Experience designing or operating secure R&D and software-development enclaves.

  • Familiarity with FIPS 140-3, DEFSTAN 05-138, STANAG, NIST or Cyber Essentials Plus.

  • Practical knowledge of zero-trust access, bastion or jump-host workflows, immutable logging and automated vulnerability management.

  • Experience coaching engineers, leading a small team or building a platform function.

  • Experience working in a start-up, scale-up or urgent operational environment.

Technology Stack

You will work across:

  • Kubernetes: K3s, RKE2 and OpenShift

  • Infrastructure as code: Terraform, Pulumi or comparable IaC tooling

  • Configuration management: Ansible or equivalent

  • Linux administration: Ubuntu and RHEL

  • Bare-metal provisioning: PXE, MAAS, IPMI/Redfish or similar technologies

  • Container tooling: Docker, containerd and Helm

The nature of combat has changed.

Tomorrow’s battlefield success depends on autonomy, speed, and adaptability.

And UFORCE is ready.

Are You?

descriptionHtml:
Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets.

We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.

Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.

About This Role:

We are looking for a Head of Product Operations (m/f/d) to join our Product team in Munich, Madrid, London or Paris with a hybrid work setup. In this role, you will lead and improve the operations that are directly linked to our products. Your work will directly impact our operational integrity notably by enhancing fraud detection, streamlining customer support processes, or managing cash projections. All of which are critical to delivering a trustworthy and seamless experience for our users.

This dedicated product operations position was triggered by the launch of new offer types within our product, and the scope of the role will expand as we innovate with our product.

Our Benefits:

At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

  • A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
  • A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
  • 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
  • A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
  • Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
  • Mental health coaching to support your well-being.
  • Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.
  • The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.
  • A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

*These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.

Responsibilities:

In this role, you will:

  • Drive end-to-end fraud management and detection strategies across all product types and payment flows.
  • Streamline customer support workflows to improve resolution speed, operational efficiency, and user trust.
  • Oversee the operational maintenance and reliability of coupon auto-apply and app-to-app features.
  • Partner with Finance to forecast and manage cash allocations and liquidity across provider accounts.
  • Work cross-functionally with Product and key teams to translate business needs into scalable operational solutions.
  • Champion AI and automation initiatives to generate operational insights and drive continuous process improvements.

Your Profile:

We're looking for someone with

  • 3 - 5 years of experience in strategy consulting, mergers and acquisitions, or operations in tech
  • Strategic & Analytical Skills: Strong problem-solving and analytical capabilities, with the ability to break down complex business problems, identify opportunities, and develop scalable solutions.
  • Operational Excellence: Proven ability to design, standardize, and optimize processes across complex or rapidly evolving products and organizations.
  • Leadership & Collaboration: A strong leadership track record
  • Mindset: A proactive and persistent mindset, adaptability in a dynamic environment, and a strong interest in leveraging AI and automation to improve operational efficiency and decision-making.
  • Language requirements: Fluent in English and any other European languages is a plus.

Our hiring process:

  1. TA Call: Meet one of our Talent Experts and get to know Atolls better.
  2. Technical Round: Focus on the technical aspects of the role (Through a Live Case), and meet your potential manager.
  3. Final Round: Meet other Atollians 🏝️
    It varies from 1 to 3 interviews

*Some processes might slightly change according to needs

Ready to apply?

Be part of a destination where your work helps millions of people make better decisions every day. One focused application is all we need. If you truly fit more than one role, you're welcome to apply to up to three. This helps us match you with the right opportunity faster.

We review every application with equal care and will reach out if your profile aligns. Apply now with your CV in English.*Portfolios, writing samples, or certifications may be requested based on the role.

descriptionHtml:
Über Rotzinger Transver

Rotzinger Transver mit Standorten in Kaiseraugst und Altendorf in der Schweiz ist ein führender Anbieter von Lösungen für Produktflusssteuerung, Pufferung, Verteilung und Fördertechnik für die Lebensmittel-, Süsswaren- und Verpackungsindustrie.

Unser Portfolio umfasst eine breite Palette innovativer Systeme, die eine zuverlässige Produkthandhabung, eine stabile Linienleistung sowie eine effiziente Verbindung zwischen Verarbeitungs- und Verpackungsprozessen gewährleisten. Mit modularen, skalierbaren und hygienischen Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, Produktverluste zu reduzieren, Stillstandszeiten zu minimieren und die Gesamtanlageneffektivität (OEE) zu steigern. Wir sind bestrebt, unser Angebot und unsere Kompetenzen kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln, um den sich wandelnden Anforderungen unserer Kunden gerecht zu werden.

Weitere Informationen über Rotzinger Transver und unser umfassendes Leistungsspektrum finden Sie auf der Website: www.rotzingertransver.com.

Rotzinger Transver ist Teil von Coesia, einer weltweit tätigen Unternehmensgruppe für innovative Industrie- und Verpackungslösungen mit Hauptsitz in Bologna. Coesia ist in 34 Ländern vertreten, vereint 21 Unternehmen und beschäftigt per 2026 mehr als 8'000 Mitarbeitende weltweit.

Über die Rolle

Als Head of Project Management (m/w/d) übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für das Projektportfolio an unseren Produktionsstandorten in Kaiseraugst und Altendorf. Sie führen ein Team von Project Managern und sorgen für die erfolgreiche Umsetzung unserer internationalen Kundenprojekte. Dabei treiben Sie die Weiterentwicklung des Projektmanagements aktiv voran und tragen dazu bei, Projekte effizienter, transparenter und profitabler umzusetzen.

Hauptaufgaben und Verantwortungen

title: Head of Regulatory  - CDI (F/H)
descriptionHtml:
Lemonway est un établissement de paiement agréé par l'ACPR, spécialisé dans les solutions de paiement pour les plateformes digitales, les marketplaces et les acteurs de la finance alternative.

Présent dans toute l'Europe, Lemonway accompagne des centaines de clients dans la gestion des flux financiers de leurs utilisateurs, avec une exigence forte en matière de conformité et de sécurité.

Au sein du département Compliance & Risk, la fonction Regulatory est un pilier stratégique : elle garantit la conformité de Lemonway vis-à-vis de ses obligations d'établissement de paiement agréé, assure la relation avec les régulateurs, et accompagne l'évolution du business dans un environnement réglementaire en mutation constante.

Le département Compliance & Risk est composé de 4 équipes : Regulatory, AML, Legal et Internal Control & Operational Risk. Dans cette organisation, le Head of Regulatory reporte directement au Chief Compliance & Risk Officer.

Vos missions

Relation avec les autorités de tutelle

  • Être l'interlocuteur principal de Lemonway auprès de l'ACPR et des superviseurs européens des pays dans lesquels Lemonway fournit ses services (passporting)

  • Préparer et coordonner certains reportings réglementaires périodiques français et européens

  • Piloter les réponses aux demandes d'information des autorités et assister la Chief Compliance & Risk Officer dans la gestion des inspections réglementaires

Maintien et évolution de l'agrément PSP

  • Superviser le respect permanent des conditions d'agrément : fonds propres, cantonnement des fonds clients, gouvernance

  • Instruire les dossiers d’extension ou de nouvel agrément liés au développement de nouveaux services ou à l'expansion géographique

  • Gérer les procédures de passeporting vers de nouveaux États membres de l'UE

Conformité réglementaire produit & business

  • Analyser la conformité réglementaire des nouvelles plateformes clientes ainsi que celle des nouveaux projets des clients existants

  • Être le point de contact des équipes commerciales afin d’apporter un conseil opérationnel sur les contraintes réglementaires liées à certains types de clients, secteurs ou marchands

  • Intégrer la dimension réglementaire dès la phase de conception des nouveaux produits et services

  • Garantir la conformité de l’entreprise au RGPD

  • Rédiger, maintenir et actualiser les politiques et procédures réglementaires internes

Veille et analyse réglementaire

  • Assurer une veille proactive sur l'évolution des textes réglementaires applicables à Lemonway en tant que PSP ainsi qu’à ses plateformes clientes, en France et en Europe (DSP3, AMLR, ECSPR, GDPR, IA Act, DORA, virements instantanés, etc.)

  • Analyser les impacts opérationnels et business des nouvelles réglementations et formuler des recommandations claires aux équipes concernées (Produit, Tech, Commercial, Finance)

Management & développement de l'équipe

  • Manager et faire monter en compétences le/la Regulatory Officer en poste

  • Structurer et animer la fonction Regulatory avec des processus clairs et scalables


Formation

  • Bac +5 en droit des affaires, droit bancaire et financier, ou équivalent

  • CAPA (avocat) ou formation en conformité réglementaire

Expérience

  • > 8 ans d'expérience dans un rôle de conseil ou de conformité réglementaire dans l'univers des services de paiement, de la FinTech ou de la banque

  • Une première expérience managériale ou de coordination d'équipe

Compétences

  • Maîtrise approfondie de la réglementation relative à l’encaissement pour compte de tiers et aux services de paiement (DSP2/DSP3, agrément ACPR, règles prudentielles)

  • Bonne connaissance des sujets émergents : ECSP, MiCA, DORA, IA Act, open banking, virements instantanés et VoP, etc.

  • Expérience d’une procédure d’agrément ou d’extension d’agrément auprès de l’ACPR

  • Capacité à traduire des textes réglementaires complexes en actions concrètes pour des équipes non-juristes

  • Rigueur, sens de l'ownership et proactivité

  • Aisance relationnelle avec des interlocuteurs variés (régulateurs, dirigeants, équipes opérationnelles)

Langues

title: Head of Socials - Freelance, CDI, CDD
descriptionHtml:
Chez iara, on cherche notre Head of Socials : la personne qui va prendre la tête de tout ce qu'on a construit sur les réseaux, le structurer, et l'emmener à l'international.

iara, c'est quoi ? Une app beauté unique qui mixe prise de rendez-vous et réseau social. Tu réserves des soins, tu postes tes photos, tu recommandes des pros… et tu gagnes de l'argent.

Ce qu'on a déjà, et que tu prendras en main :

  • une équipe social media de 3 personnes (2 créatrices de contenu et 1 graphiste)

Ce qu'on n'a pas encore, et que tu vas construire : le paid (les premiers budgets se lancent maintenant, tout est à poser), et le playbook d'internationalisation. C'est la nouvelle phase, et c'est pour ça que le poste existe.

Notre Instagram : https://www.instagram.com/iaraonthegram/

Vos missions

1. Stratégie & vision

  • Renforcer et faire grandir la ligne éditoriale existante, sans la dénaturer.
  • Traduire l'usage réel de l'app et les enjeux produit en contenus compréhensibles et désirables.
  • Garantir la cohérence de la marque dans un contexte de croissance rapide.

2. Créativité & formats

  • Imaginer et faire évoluer des formats récurrents, séries, concepts.

  • Identifier les contenus à fort potentiel et faire le lien entre création, performance et produit.

3. Paid & influence

  • Lancer nos premières campagnes paid : structure de compte, tests, mesure, scaling.

  • Très bonne compréhension de TikTok et Instagram — en praticien·ne, pas en observateur·rice.

title: Head of Strategy and Product
descriptionHtml:
About Act

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

 

About the Role

You will work closely with core teams on the highest impact initiatives across engineering, product, hiring, operations, and business development. As the company grows, you'll help solve new challenges, build new capabilities, and drive execution wherever it matters most.

We're looking for people who learn quickly, think deeply, and enjoy solving difficult problems in a fast-moving environment.

 

What You Will Be Doing

  • Drive high-priority initiatives across the business.

  • Work with leadership to solve business and product challenges.

  • Build new teams, processes, and capabilities as the company grows.

  • Lead cross-functional projects from planning through execution.

  • Research new markets, products, and business opportunities.

  • Improve how we operate by identifying problems and implementing practical solutions.

  • Take ownership of projects and deliver meaningful business outcomes.

 

What You Will Need

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new challenges.

  • Comfortable working across different business functions.

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.

  • Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.

 

How We Work

The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams.

We operate with high talent density, high ownership and high standards. We value people who can think independently, move quickly and solve problems without waiting for instructions.

This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly to the company's success.

 

Interview Process

If there appears to be a fit, we will schedule up to 3 interviews.

Applications are reviewed by members of our leadership and hiring teams. Interviews may be conducted virtually or onsite.

We value speed, transparency and decisiveness throughout the process.

title: HR Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Sie möchten einen echten Beitrag zum Erfolg von Mitarbeitenden und Führungskräften leisten? In dieser vielseitigen Position übernehmen Sie eine zentrale Rolle als strategischer und operativer Ansprechpartner in allen personalrelevanten Themen. Mit Ihrem Gespür für Menschen, Ihrer arbeitsrechtlichen Expertise und Ihrem Blick für nachhaltige HR-Lösungen gestalten Sie die Employee Experience aktiv mit und unterstützen unsere Führungskräfte dabei, leistungsstarke, engagierte Teams aufzubauen und weiterzuentwickeln. Gemeinsam treiben Sie wichtige HR-Initiativen voran und tragen maßgeblich zu einer positiven Unternehmenskultur sowie zum langfristigen Unternehmenserfolg bei.

Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Agieren Sie als vertrauenswürdiger HR Business Partner und beraten Führungskräfte strategisch sowie operativ in allen personalrelevanten Fragestellungen.

  • Unterstützen und begleiten Sie Mitarbeitende und Führungskräfte während des gesamten Employee Lifecycles und fördern Sie eine positive Employee Experience sowie ein hohes Engagement.

  • Steuern und koordinieren Sie HR-Initiativen in den Bereichen Talententwicklung, Performance Management und Mitarbeiterbindung.

  • Gestalten und begleiten Sie den Performance-Management-Prozess, einschließlich Zielvereinbarungen, Leistungsbeurteilungen und individueller Entwicklungspläne.

  • Analysieren Sie HR-Kennzahlen und Personaldaten, identifizieren Sie Trends und leiten Sie geeignete Maßnahmen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung ab.

  • Arbeiten Sie eng mit dem Talent Acquisition Team und den Führungskräften zusammen, um eine hochwertige Recruiting- und Onboarding-Erfahrung sicherzustellen.

  • Stellen Sie die Einhaltung arbeitsrechtlicher Vorgaben, interner Richtlinien und HR-Standards sicher und beraten Sie Führungskräfte zu Best Practices.

  • Unterstützen Sie organisatorische Veränderungsprozesse, die Zusammenarbeit mit dem Betriebsrat sowie komplexe arbeitsrechtliche und mitarbeiterbezogene Themen, um den nachhaltigen Unternehmenserfolg zu fördern.

Qualifikationen

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Human Resources, Betriebswirtschaftslehre oder in einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet.

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einer generalistischen HR-/People-Funktion innerhalb eines größeren, international ausgerichteten Unternehmens.

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse im Arbeitsrecht, in HR-Richtlinien sowie in modernen Personalmanagement-Praktiken.

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sowie ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Wort und Schrift.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit den gängigen Microsoft-Office-Anwendungen sowie Erfahrung im Arbeiten mit HR-Systemen und digitalen Tools.

  • Ausgeprägte Fähigkeit im Stakeholder-Management sowie im Aufbau und der Pflege vertrauensvoller Beziehungen auf allen Unternehmensebenen.

  • Analytische Denkweise und Erfahrung in der Nutzung von HR-Kennzahlen, Datenanalysen und Insights zur Unterstützung fundierter Entscheidungen.

  • Hohe Organisationsfähigkeit sowie eine selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise mit der Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten gleichzeitig zu managen, Fristen einzuhalten und sowohl eigenverantwortlich als auch im Team erfolgreich zu arbeiten.

Über DP World


Handel ist das Lebensblut der Weltwirtschaft, er schafft Chancen und verbessert die Lebensqualität der Menschen auf der ganzen Welt. DP World existiert, um den weltweiten Handelsfluss zu verbessern und die Möglichkeiten für die Kunden und Gemeinschaften, die wir weltweit bedienen, zu verändern.


Mit einem engagierten, vielfältigen und professionellen Team von mehr als 115.000 Mitarbeitern aus 159 Nationalitäten in 77 Ländern auf sechs Kontinenten treibt DP World den Handel weiter und schneller voran, hin zu einer nahtlosen Lieferkette, die für die Zukunft gerüstet ist.


Wir transformieren und integrieren unsere Geschäftsbereiche – Häfen und Terminals, Seeverkehrsdienste, Logistik und Technologie – schnell und vereinen unsere globale Infrastruktur mit lokaler Expertise, um stärkere, effizientere End-to-End-Lieferkettenlösungen zu schaffen, die den weltweiten Handel verändern können.


Darüber hinaus gestalten wir die Zukunft neu, indem wir in Innovationen investieren. Von intelligenten Liefersystemen bis hin zur automatisierten Lagerbeladung sind wir auf dem neuesten Stand der disruptiven Technologie und treiben den Sektor zu besseren Handelsmethoden an, um Störungen von der Fabrikhalle bis zur Haustür des Kunden zu minimieren.


DP World hat es sich zur Aufgabe gemacht, Grenzen zu überschreiten und die Kluft zwischen allen Nationen und Kulturen zu überbrücken – nicht nur in dem, was wir tun, sondern auch in unserem Verhalten.


Wir sind bestrebt, eine Kultur zu schaffen, in der sich jeder respektiert, unterstützt und befähigt fühlt, sein volles Potenzial auszuschöpfen. Wir glauben, dass die Akzeptanz von Inklusion und Vielfalt Innovation und Wachstum vorantreibt und uns hilft, Menschen, Unternehmen und Gesellschaften zu verbinden. Freie Geister und unterschiedliche Perspektiven verändern unsere Welt, und gemeinsam können wir verändern, was möglich ist.


Die DP World-Familie besteht aus Syncreon, Imperial und P&O.

WE MAKE TRADE FLOW
TO CHANGE WHAT'S POSSIBLE FOR EVERYONE.

title: HubSpot Full-Stack Expert (m/w/d): Onboarding & Implementierung von Starter bis Enterprise

  • Implementierungen planen und steuern: Datenmodell, Properties, Custom Objects, Pipelines, Lifecycle Stages, Lead-Management, Teams und Berechtigungskonzepte

Du kennst das Agenturleben mit mehreren Kund:innen parallel, denkst in Kundennutzen und Ergebnissen und weißt, wie man Beratung, Umsetzung und Wirtschaftlichkeit zusammenbringt
  • Mehrere HubSpot-Onboardings und -Implementierungen selbst verantwortet, gern auch Professional- und Enterprise-Portale
  • Fundiertes Know-how über alle Hubs hinweg, inkl. Smart CRM, Custom Objects, Workflows, Reporting, Berechtigungen und Datenqualität

title: InfoSec Lead
descriptionHtml:
Orbital is the AI platform for real estate legal work.

Real estate shapes the world around us: our homes, our workplaces and our cultural landmarks. It’s the infrastructure that powers everyday life and is the world's largest asset class. Yet behind every single deal, real estate and legal teams work hard to navigate decades-old complexity; manually connecting documents, hidden obligations, geo-spatial context, and multiple parties into a path forward. We connect the legal and physical record, so that path is clearer than ever before. Our mission is to make real estate transactions faster, clearer, and less manual.

Here, you'll be part of changing how the deals behind the largest asset class get transacted, and will help shape the future of real estate.

A bit about us:

🚀 We’re building at the forefront of AI technology, without losing the deeply human expertise our clients depend on.

🏢 Orbital is built with former practising real estate lawyers and 250+ years of combined legal expertise. We're purpose-built for the complexity of real estate: accelerating due diligence, drafting and negotiation, and deal coordination with legal-grade precision.

💰 We've just raised a $60m Series B, led by Brighton Park Capital, to accelerate our global expansion – $75m raised to date.

🤝 We're trusted by 5,000+ real estate professionals, spanning UK Magic Circle and US Am Law 100 firms, to household names like M&S. Leading firms like BCLP, Orrick, Goodwin, Womble Bond Dickinson and Clifford Chance rely on Orbital to remove the busywork, freeing legal and real estate teams to focus on sharp judgment, standout client service, and closing deals faster.

💡 Working at Orbital means joining a bold, ambitious team, with the trust to take ownership and make a real impact from day one.

The Role

Orbital has been scaling fast, and we’re scaling or security and compliance with it. We're hiring a senior, London-based InfoSec Lead to own our information security due diligence, compliance, and vendor risk end-to-end - bringing structure and consistency to work that's currently covered on a contractor basis.

Now is the time to bring this function in-house, focusing on automating manual tasks (such as customer DDQs), enhancing our compliance stance, and ultimately securing the Infosec function as a proactive enabler of our growth.

This is a full-time InfoSec role, working alongside our IT Manager. Whilst experience in IT operations or IT management is helpful, the Infosec Lead and IT Manager report independently to our Head of Operations and own separate (but naturally interconnected) remits.

You’ll also work closely with Engineering, Product, Legal and our external Infosec support, to keep security and compliance embedded in how the business runs, not bolted on after the fact.

 

What You'll Own

 

InfoSec & Compliance Delivery

You will:

  • Own our InfoSec strategy and roadmap: set the direction for how security and compliance scale with the business, not just an executor; identify control gaps and weaknesses, prioritize remediation, and track it through to completion.

  • Own our risk program: run risk identification, assessment and treatment, keep the risk register current. You're making the call on what's an acceptable risk.

  • Own third party risk assurance, in both directions: run vendor security reviews for vendors we bring on (or are renewing with) and own customer & vendor due diligence (DDQs) when we’re the ones being assessed.

    • Pull in support required from the rest of the business and jump on client calls when needed to resolve DDQs.

    • Drive automation on the DDQ side specifically, so it doesn’t eat a disproportionate share of your time as the function matures.

  • Own our existing and future compliance certifications: you’ll be responsible for maintaining compliance with existing standards (ISO 27001 and SOC2 Type 2) and pursuing future certifications relevant to us. Management of the compliance program will be end-to-end, and involve ISMS management reviews, quarterly access control reviews, audit evidence gathering, scheduling and remediation tracking.

    • This also includes keeping policy & public-facing security documentation (eg. our trust centre) current - so certification is a continuously-run capability rather than a periodic scramble.

  • Partner cross-functionally: work with Engineering, Product, and Legal to embed security and compliance requirements into how we build and sell, and stay close enough to product changes that customer-facing security information is always accurate.

What We're Looking For

  • Significant senior in-house or scale-up InfoSec leadership experience: you've owned due diligence, vendor review, and compliance work end-to-end inside a fast-moving business, not just advised from the outside.

  • Strong understanding of cloud & cloud security, and ideally previous technical background in IT Security or SWE / DevOps.

  • A track record of scaling due-diligence processes, not just running them manually, you know how to spot what can be templated, automated, or self-served, and you make that happen rather than just wishing for it.

  • Comfortable being close to engineering: you don't need to write code, but you're happy sitting in technical conversations, understanding product changes, and knowing enough about IT systems to weigh in sensibly on security-sensitive changes.

  • Pragmatic and delivery-focused: you know the difference between a genuine risk and a distraction, and you keep due diligence and audit work moving at commercial pace rather than becoming a bottleneck.

  • AI-literacy with working familiarity with AI governance (ISO 42001, EU AI Act etc).

  • Comfortable operating independently: this is an individual-contributor role to start, with real ownership of the roadmap rather than a narrow, audit-only remit.

  • Working knowledge of privacy law is important (GDPR/CCPA/US state privacy laws) to partner with our legal function.

 

Why This Might Not Be For You

  • You want to run day-to-day IT operations or manage IT staff. That sits with our IT Manager, not this role.

  • You prefer tasks defined and handed to you. This is a role for an independent decision maker... you're expected to identify what needs doing, set the plan, and drive it to closure yourself, not wait to be briefed.

  • You feel more comfortable with a narrowly-defined, audit-only remit. This role sits close to Engineering, Product, and Legal, and is expected to actively reduce manual DDQ overhead over time, not just process tickets.

 

Why Join Orbital

  • Shape how security and compliance scale with the business... the processes and playbooks here are still being built.

  • Genuine cross-functional influence: you'll be close to Engineering, Product, and Legal, not sitting outside them.

  • Genuine momentum: $60m Series B, doubling headcount, expanding across two continents.

  • Work alongside a leadership team that treats security as a business enabler, not just a risk function.

🔒 Security is everyone’s responsibility at Orbital. We ask all team members to follow our security policies, complete regular awareness training, and handle sensitive data with care in line with ISO 27001 standards. Spot something unusual? Reporting risks or incidents quickly helps us maintain the strong culture of security and compliance we all depend on.

💡 At Orbital, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We especially welcome applications from people who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. Even if you don’t meet every single requirement, or if the right role isn’t listed yet, we’d still love to hear from you.

💰 This hiring range is a reasonable estimate of the base pay range for this position at the time of posting. Pay is based on several factors, which may include job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and business requirements.

Everyone who works with Orbital goes through background screening before they start. It's part of how we keep Orbital secure, for the people who work here and for the client information we're trusted with.

  • Deutsch ist unsere Arbeitssprache: Du erklärst Kolleg*innen technische Themen verständlich, sprichst mit Dienstleistern und dokumentierst auf Deutsch. Dafür brauchst du fließende Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1) sowie gutes technisches Englisch. Bei uns hast du die Chance, wirklich etwas zu bewegen und zu gestalten. Die „Grüne Wiese“ wartet auf deine Ideen und Initiative. Werde Teil unseres dynamischen Teams und gestalte die Zukunft der Med-Tech-Branche aktiv mit!

Unsere Benefits

title: Jr Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights.

Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi.

About the Role

We're looking for a natural Sales person who is passionate about hospitality. Sales is at the heart of our business growth right now, and you will be driving it forward in your day-to-day. This role is about more than closing deals, it is about blending with the hospitality scene and winning the market.

In your day-to-day you can expect a mix of top of funnel activities, field sales, cold sales, networking, events and more.

What You’ll Do

Our sales are not your typical SaaS or office sales. We meet our customers where they operate:

  • Find the coolest new hospitality spots in town that everyone talks about

  • Create engaging ways to show our product

  • Use creative communication strategies to close the deal that will help the merchant operate smarter

  • Do a smooth handover to the onboarding team to make sure we go live quickly and successfully

  • Efficiently use our CRM and other Sales tools (Hubspot, Clay, AI) to leave more time for creativity and connection

  • Continuously improve and revisit our sales funnel

  • Keep an eye on the new developments in the industry and the merchants’ needs to create our own path

What You’ll Need

You are a natural relationship builder with a passion for hospitality industry:

  • Hands-on approach, independence and hunger for fast-paced operations

  • Natural curiosity and a healthy appetite for calculated risk - we want you to try new things and not be afraid to fail

  • Strong and engaging communication skills - you can grab an attention of a busy hospitality owner and keep them interested

  • Passion and curiosity for hospitality and hospitality tech

  • A minimum of 1 year of experience in Sales, Commercial Account Management or Hospitality

  • You are comfortable working in both English and Dutch

If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers.

Benefits:

  • Start-up Equity

  • Competitive Salary

  • Flexible time off

  • Team events

What is Restaurant Software?

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

How we use AI at Tebi

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

Mr. Lunch versorgt Unternehmen über Essensautomaten und eine digitale Online-Kantine mit frisch gekochten Gerichten. Deine Aufgaben

Kundenservice und Reklamationen

  • Du bist Ansprechpartner für unsere Bestandskunden.
  • Du bearbeitest Fragen, Änderungswünsche und Reklamationen.

  • Du stellst sicher, dass offene Vorgänge nicht liegen bleiben, sondern vollständig abgeschlossen werden.
  • Du erkennst wiederkehrende Probleme und gibst diese zur Verbesserung unserer Abläufe weiter.

Vorbereitung der Auslieferungen

  • Du erstellst die Pack- und Auslieferungslisten für unsere Fahrer.
  • Du gleichst Bestellungen, Liefermengen, Kundenstandorte und Touren miteinander ab.
  • Du berücksichtigst Besonderheiten und Vereinbarungen einzelner Kunden.
  • Du kontrollierst die Angaben auf Vollständigkeit und Plausibilität.
  • Du stellst Küche und Fahrern alle benötigten Informationen rechtzeitig zur Verfügung.
  • Du koordinierst kurzfristige Änderungen bei Mengen, Terminen oder Lieferorten.
  • Du bearbeitest Rückmeldungen aus den Touren und veranlasst notwendige Folgemaßnahmen.

Koordination mit der Küche

  • Du übermittelst der Küche die benötigten Bestell- und Liefermengen.
  • Du stimmst Verfügbarkeiten, Produktionsmengen und Besonderheiten ab.
  • Du klärst Abweichungen zwischen Bestellung, Produktion und Auslieferung.
  • Du sorgst dafür, dass Änderungen alle beteiligten Mitarbeiter rechtzeitig erreichen.
  • Du kontrollierst, ob die erforderlichen Informationen und Freigaben vollständig vorliegen.

Planung neuer Automatenstandorte

  • Du übernimmst neue Kunden nach dem Vertragsabschluss aus dem Vertrieb.

Daten und Arbeitsabläufe

  • Du pflegst Kunden-, Bestell-, Liefer- und Standortdaten.

Das bringst du mit

Location: London (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Data & Analytics | Type: Permanent

Champion innovation. Grow capabilities. Deliver real-world outcomes.

The Role

As a Data Analytics Principal Consultant, you'll take a central role in supporting the continued growth of Capco's UK Data Practice. You'll lead complex data and analytics programmes across the Financial Services sector while mentoring talent, guiding clients and driving innovation across Cloud, AI and Machine Learning. You'll champion AI-enabled ways of working, helping clients and teams adopt modern approaches that improve productivity, accelerate insight and deliver measurable business outcomes, while ensuring responsible AI practices and appropriate human oversight.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the delivery of complex data transformation and analytics programmes across leading Financial Services organisations, helping clients unlock value through modern data and AI capabilities.
  • Provide leadership and mentoring to data consultants, fostering technical excellence, continuous learning and the effective adoption of AI-enabled tools and modern delivery practices.
  • Build trusted client relationships, shape data and AI propositions, and contribute to business development activities by identifying opportunities to deliver measurable business value.
  • Engage with technical and non-technical stakeholders to promote data literacy, AI adoption and data-driven decision-making, translating complex concepts into clear business outcomes.
  • Represent Capco's Data Practice externally through industry engagement, partnerships and thought leadership, contributing to the evolution of Capco's data and AI offerings.

What We're Looking For

  • Minimum five years' experience in consulting or a senior leadership role delivering complex data and analytics initiatives within Financial Services.
  • Strong expertise across data and analytics disciplines, including data quality, governance, business intelligence, AI and machine learning, with an understanding of how these capabilities enable enterprise transformation.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence audiences from C-suite executives through to delivery teams and communicate complex technical concepts clearly.
  • Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale data transformation programmes, with an understanding of responsible AI, governance and modern AI-enabled delivery approaches.
  • Ability to lead multiple workstreams while developing internal capability, embracing AI-enabled ways of working to improve delivery quality, efficiency and client outcomes.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience supporting business development, proposition development or pre-sales activities within a consulting environment.
  • Hands-on familiarity with modern data science, MLOps, AI operationalisation or cloud-native analytics platforms.
  • Knowledge of responsible AI, AI governance, model risk management or enterprise analytics operating models.
  • Experience supporting organisational change, business analysis or large-scale transformation programmes involving data and AI.
  • Confidence operating across both strategic and technical client discussions, with the ability to connect business objectives to modern data and AI capabilities.

Why Join Capco

  • Deliver high-impact technology solutions for Tier 1 financial institutions.
  • Work in a collaborative, flat, and entrepreneurial consulting culture.
  • Access continuous learning, training, and industry certifications.
  • Be part of a team shaping the future of digital financial services.
  • Help shape the future of digital transformation across FS & Energy.

Benefits

  • Core Benefits: Discretionary bonus, competitive pension, health insurance, life insurance and critical illness cover.
  • Mental Health: Easy access to CareFirst, Unmind, Aviva consultations and in-house first aiders.
  • Family-Friendly: Maternity, adoption, shared parental leave, plus paid leave for sickness, pregnancy loss, fertility treatment, menopause and bereavement.
  • Family Care: 8 complimentary backup care sessions for emergency childcare or elder care.
  • Holiday Flexibility: 5 weeks of annual leave with the option to buy or sell holiday days based on your needs.
  • Continuous Learning: Minimum 40 Hours of Training Annually: Take your pick—workshops, certifications, e-learning—your growth, your way. Business Coach assigned from Day One to help accelerate your development.
  • Healthcare Access: Convenient online GP services.
  • Extra Perks: Gympass (Wellhub), travel insurance, Tastecard, season ticket loans, Cycle to Work and dental insurance.

Inclusion at Capco

We're committed to making our recruitment process accessible and straightforward for everyone. If you need any adjustments at any stage, just let us know – we'll be happy to help. We value each person's unique perspective and contribution. At Capco, we believe that being yourself is your greatest strength. Our #BeYourselfAtWork culture encourages individuality and collaboration – a mindset that shapes how we work with clients and each other every day.

 #LI-DNI
