title: Lead Database Administrator
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

Job Overview

We are at a pivotal point in our tech progression. We're looking to grow our technical estate, architect new systems, remove technical debt and scale our platform. It's an exciting time to join Partnerize, and we are looking for a technical leader to help spearhead this evolution.

As a database engineer, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy, acting as the principal technical authority and taking end-to-end ownership of our database estate. You will be a strategic anchor within the Technical Operations team, interfacing directly with business, development, and IT functions. While you will own the database architecture and design solutions for the future, a fundamental, non-negotiable part of this role is hands-on Business As Usual incident management. You must be comfortable rolling up your sleeves to handle daily operations, backups, and performance tuning alongside project delivery.

Your deep expertise in MySQL, alongside strong Linux system administration and a working knowledge of network troubleshooting, will be critical to your success. You will design, build, and secure the underlying servers our databases run on, proactively analyse current implementations, and act as the ultimate technical escalation point for our database infrastructure in both our physical datacenters as well as our public cloud estate.

While we need your advanced technical skills, we are equally focused on character. We are looking for a highly proactive communicator who collaborates seamlessly without needing to be prompted. Crucially, you must be able to independently plan out complex technical work, such as database upgrades, and clearly articulate the step-by-step process and business impacts to stakeholders. You must thrive both when working independently to tackle complex problems and when operating collaboratively within a broader team. Furthermore, you will actively seek out opportunities to coach and mentor other engineers, elevating the overall DBA knowledge across the company. This role is fully remote and open to candidates based anywhere in the UK or the US.

As a Database Engineer at Partnerize, You Will:

  • Primary Operational Ownership: Take complete, hands-on ownership of daily database operations. Managing and maintaining the database infrastructure for day-to-day use, including backup management, resolving slow-running queries, and performance tuning, is a fundamental pillar of this role.
  • Infrastructure & Server Support: Be comfortable in providing operational support by designing, securing, and robustly maintaining the underlying Linux servers that our large distributed databases run on.
  • Project Planning & Stakeholder Communication: Plan, manage, and deliver large technical projects like database upgrades and migrations. You will autonomously map out step-by-step execution plans, proactively communicate technical considerations, and clearly articulate the business impact of your work to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Technical Leadership & Strategy: Scope incoming work, delegate to team members where appropriate, and act as the definitive database escalation point for support teams within the wider organisation.
  • Proactive Optimisation & Automation: Measure and optimise system performance to push our capabilities forward. Lead the automation of management and monitoring for the database platform infrastructure.
  • Collaboration & Documentation: Partner closely with development teams, product owners, and other stakeholders to ensure database needs are met and to improve the testability of database aspects within software deployments. Document procedures, best practices, and troubleshooting steps for knowledge sharing.
  • Delivery & Out-of-Hours/On-Call Support: Plan, prioritise, and estimate tasks using Jira, and provide essential support for any critical database-related issues both during and outside of normal business hours.
  • Mentorship: Actively mentor and coach other engineers, providing technical leadership on database design, optimisation, and migration strategies to elevate overall team knowledge.

Essential Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • MySQL & On-Premise Infrastructure: Advanced administration of MySQL in production environments, whether on-premise or in the cloud. Crucially, as our primary database is on-premise, you must possess strong Linux system administration and networking awareness to independently support, secure, and maintain the underlying servers.
  • Independence: Experience as either the sole or lead owner for large production database infrastructure within a SaaS environment with demonstrable accountability for its availability and performance. A proven track record of managing these responsibilities while coordinating with external technical stakeholders and adhering to light change management processes.
  • High Availability & Replication: Advanced experience configuring and troubleshooting complex MySQL replication setups (such as primary-replica, multi-master, and GTID). Proven ability to quickly resolve replication lag, manage smooth failovers, and execute disaster recovery plans.
  • Monitoring: A working understanding of database monitoring tools and patterns. What to measure, appropriate thresholds, and response mechanics.
  • Performance Optimisation: Deep expertise in query tuning, slow query analysis, and advanced schema optimisation (including normalisation, partitioning, query rewrites, and indexing strategies).
  • Upgrades, Migrations & Scripting: Proven track record of executing minimal-downtime upgrades and complex migrations (in-place, cross-database, or migrating ancillary workloads). Highly skilled in automating these processes using Python and/or Bash to build robust, version-controlled scripts.
  • Database Security & Compliance: Experience securing database infrastructure through SSL/TLS encryption, user access control, audit logging, and automated backup encryption.

Desirable Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • Automation, Containers & CI/CD: Hands-on expertise using Ansible for configuration management, deploying and managing databases within Kubernetes/containerised environments, and managing version control and pipelines via GitLab for any database related change.
  • Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Hands-on experience deploying and configuring monitoring/alerting stacks (such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Percona Monitoring and Management) for proactive issue resolution and database health tracking.
  • PostgreSQL & Hybrid Estates: Advanced administration of PostgreSQL, alongside experience managing database workloads across a hybrid environment (e.g., combining on-premise architecture with AWS).
  • OLAP & Data Warehousing (Apache Druid / Snowflake): Familiarity with columnar databases and cloud data platforms, particularly Apache Druid and Snowflake. Experience with schema design, data sharding strategies, OLAP query optimisation for long-running queries, and managing zero-downtime upgrades in distributed environments.
  • Service Management Tooling: Experience using Jira and Confluence for managing workflows, project tracking, and creating technical documentation.

Growth & Innovation:

    • Openness to learn the required technologies.
    • An interest in development, new technologies and innovation.
    • Supporting development teams into the refactoring of technical debt.

At Partnerize, we recognise it is unrealistic for a candidate to fulfil 100% of the criteria in this job description. We encourage you to apply if you feel you meet the majority of the requirements above. We know that skills evolve over time, so if you have a keen appetite to learn and evolve alongside us over time, come join our team!

US Benefits & Perks

  • Flexible Time Off Policy – Take the time you need
  • Enhanced parental leave (16 weeks for birth parent, 8 weeks for non-birth parent at full pay)
  • Regular company events and activities
  • Robust Company Sponsored Health & Welfare Benefits
  • 401k Plan – 4% employee match
  • Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Fridays program

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization's success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.

Privacy and data protection. The data collected as part of this application will be used for the recruitment process and any subsequent employment. You can find further information in Partnerize privacy policy here: https://partnerize.com/privacy-policy/

Notice to Recruiters and Staffing Agencies: To protect the interests of all parties, Partnerize will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate or an approved vendor that has a written and signed agreement in place with Partnerize. Please do not contact or forward resumes to our company employees or locations. Any unsolicited resumes will be considered Partnerize property. Partnerize is not responsible for any charges or fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: Lead Engineer - United Kingdom
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Lead Homologation Engineer (m/w/d) – EU-Typgenehmigung
descriptionHtml:
Du bringst die neue Generation auf Europas Straßen.

Bei HEERO Motors entwickeln wir ein neues elektrisches Fahrgestell für den europäischen Markt – Designed in Munich, kompatibel zum europäischen Aufbauherstellernetzwerk, gemacht für Betriebe, die jeden Tag liefern müssen. 2027 steht die Typgenehmigung an. Die Weichen dafür stellen wir jetzt.

Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel: Du sorgst dafür, dass unser Fahrzeug von Anfang an homologationsfähig entwickelt wird – und führst die Genehmigung anschließend selbst durch. Keine Zuarbeit, keine Schnittstellenpflege. Du bist die Person, die am Ende den Weg zur Zulassung frei gemacht hat.

Was du verantwortest

  • Homologationsfähigkeit von Tag eins: regulatorische Anforderungen identifizieren und verbindlich in Lastenheft und Produktspezifikation verankern

  • Homologationsstrategie weiterentwickeln und umsetzen: unseren Genehmigungsweg nach (EU) 2018/858 schärfen und konsequent umsetzen – inklusive Mehrstufengenehmigung gemeinsam mit Aufbauherstellern

  • Genehmigung selbst durchführen: Prüfprogramme planen, Tests begleiten, Dokumentation erstellen, Termine mit Technischen Diensten und Genehmigungsbehörde führen

  • Entwicklungspartner steuern: Nachweise, Gutachten und Daten bei unserem Fahrzeugpartner und Zulieferern einfordern und auf Vollständigkeit prüfen

  • Regulatorik im Blick: General Safety Regulation, Hochvoltsicherheit, EMV, Cybersecurity und Software-Updates – und was kommt

  • Fundament für die Serie: Conformity of Production, Änderungsmanagement und Varianten so aufsetzen, dass wir schnell neue Aufbauten und Derivate bringen können

Was du mitbringst

  • Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in der Fahrzeughomologation, idealerweise Nutzfahrzeuge (N1/N2) bei OEM, Aufbauhersteller oder Technischem Dienst

  • Sicherer Umgang mit EU-Typgenehmigungsrecht und UN-Regelungen; Erfahrung mit Elektrofahrzeugen ist ein klares Plus

  • Mindestens eine Typgenehmigung, die du maßgeblich selbst verantwortet hast

  • Technisches Studium oder vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Hartnäckigkeit, Struktur und die Fähigkeit, auch internationale Partner auf Termin zu bringen

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und Englisch

Was wir bieten

  • Die seltene Chance, die Erstgenehmigung einer neuen Fahrzeuggeneration zu verantworten

  • Echte Gestaltungshoheit über Prozesse, die du von Grund auf aufbaust

  • Ein AI-natives Unternehmen, in dem KI Dokumentation und Abstimmung beschleunigt, statt sie zu verwalten

  • Kurze Wege zu Management und Board, schnelle Entscheidungen

  • Ein Team, das das Rückgrat der europäischen Wirtschaft elektrisch in die Zukunft führt

Dazu: hybrides Arbeiten mit mobilem Anteil, Corporate Benefits, gute ÖPNV-Anbindung, kostenfreie Parkplätze und regelmäßige Teamevents.

Mach die neue Generation zulassungsreif. Bewirb dich mit deinem Lebenslauf und nenn uns die Genehmigung, auf die du am meisten stolz bist.

title: Lead Product Manager, Landing Pages
descriptionHtml:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

Landing pages are one of GetYourGuide's most important product surfaces — the moment where acquisition meets experience, and where the quality of what we build directly determines whether a visitor becomes a customer.

Your mission

As Lead Product Manager for Landing Pages, you will own a high-traffic surface that sits at the intersection of growth, acquisition, and user experience. You will work closely with paid search, paid media, and SEO stakeholders to ensure the pages you build perform across channels, while keeping the traveller's needs at the centre of every decision. Your cross-functional team includes engineers, designers, analysts, and researchers.

This is a role for someone who thinks in systems, is energised by the product-marketing boundary, and wants to build something that scales — not just ship features. The work has direct visibility into how GetYourGuide grows, and the decisions made here have a measurable impact on the business from day one.

We are looking for a Lead PM who brings both strategic clarity and executional rigour — someone who can set a vision, bring stakeholders along, and deliver.

What You'll Do

  • Build modular, reusable infrastructure — page templates, content modules, and page logic — that compounds in value over time. You are not optimising individual features; you are building the foundation that makes everything that follows faster and cheaper.

  • Develop and implement a strategy for your product area, set clear measurable goals, and take full responsibility for outcomes. Connect your roadmap to the company's mission, break it into actionable steps, and create genuine excitement for the long-term vision — with your team, across functions, and with executive leadership.

  • Apply your understanding of acquisition channel economics and how landing page content drives channel performance. Partner closely with paid search, paid media, and SEO stakeholders to ensure pages serve channel needs without being built around any single one. Hold user experience and channel performance goals together rather than trading them off.

  • Design and own an experimentation system at scale — not just individual A/B tests, but the architecture and cadence that enables rapid, parallel testing across page types and channels. Build toward a model that increases the speed and independence of experimentation over time.

  • Use customer feedback, market trends, and business metrics to drive decisions. Prioritise ruthlessly, re-evaluate the roadmap as new insights arrive, and make clear calls on sequencing to maximise both impact and learning.

  • Represent customer interests at all levels of the organisation. Act with openness and transparency with your team, peers, and leadership. Coach and mentor team members, foster a culture of continuous improvement, and bring others along on the vision.

Your toolkit

  • 6+ years of experience in product management, with at least 2 years as a Lead or Senior PM owning a product area end-to-end — including strategy, goal-setting, roadmap execution, and KPI accountability.

  • A systems thinker who builds for scale. You have experience building product infrastructure or platforms — not just features — and you understand how foundational work compounds over time.

  • Experience working at the intersection of product and marketing, growth, or acquisition. You have a working understanding of how channels like paid search, paid social, or SEO use product surfaces to drive performance, and you're comfortable holding user experience and channel performance goals together.

  • Strong analytical skills with demonstrated experience in experimentation — designing testing methodology and cadence, not just interpreting results. You know how to build a testing culture and move a team toward data-informed decisions at speed.

  • Proven ability to build alignment across engineering, design, analytics, and marketing stakeholders. You bring people along through clear thinking and strong communication rather than through authority.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. You can translate complex product and technical concepts for executive, marketing, and engineering audiences equally well.

  • Bonus: Experience in a marketplace, e-commerce, or travel business.

  • Bonus: A background in engineering or data science — particularly valuable given the technical architecture nature of this role.

How we’ll make your career journey extraordinary

  • Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development

  • Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year

  • A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time. 

  • Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events

  • Monthly transportation and fitness budget

  • Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities

  • Language reimbursement program

  • Health and wellness benefits

And more…

The position you are applying for is placed at level 7.

How to apply

Our commitment is that every qualified person will be evaluated according to their skills regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. Please refrain from including your picture and age with your application.

title: Lead Product Manager - Patient Data Collection (x/f/m)
descriptionHtml:
Set a new pulse for healthcare!

 

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to join the Patient Profile team in the Patient domain.

Your mission will be to make the patient health record complete, accurate and current enough that everything else we build can act on it, the health recommendations, care plans and assistant experiences that help people take their health into their own hands. You will work in a feature team developing the Patient Health Record, health trackers, patient account and online identity, contributing directly to the quality of the medical support we provide to both patients and practitioners. 

A patient record is built from four channels: what patients enter themselves, what they share when preparing a consultation, what we retrieve from health professionals' systems, and what they connect from third-party sources such as Apple Health, Google Health Connect and national health record services. Three of those channels belong to teams you will not manage. You will own the outcome across all four, the most leveraged place to sit in a health platform, and only reachable through other people.

You will also work inside a hard regulatory perimeter: health data, GDPR, consent by design. 

 

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Own the end-to-end patient data collection programme across every channel a patient record is built from, and be accountable for the result across all four

  • Define what a useful record actually means for the teams that depend on it, make that definition measurable, and instrument it rather than inheriting a dashboard

  • Partner with the channel-owning teams inside and outside the group: set the inter-team contracts, agree how each channel contributes, and arbitrate collection priorities

  • Own record quality and freshness rather than volume, alongside health data storage consent, patient account and online identity

  • Ship the layers that serve this data to the rest of the product: the patient feature store, the patient context service and the Patient Health Record feature

  • Lead the Patient Profile team's roadmap and delivery, from PHR (patient health record) and trackers through to the feature store and context service

Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you:

  • You have owned a coverage, completeness or data quality metric as your primary objective, and can say what it went from, to what, and over how long

  • You have worked at millions-of-records scale

  • You have moved that metric through teams that did not report to you, setting interfaces, contracts and SLAs with partner teams

  • You have shipped under a hard regulatory or consent constraint, in health, finance or identity, with privacy and consent by design

  • You have real technical depth: you have owned a data platform component as a product, a feature store, a context or profile service, or an identity layer. 

  • You are fluent in English

It would be fantastic if you:

  • You have had a data quality problem surface only once it reached a downstream consumer, and you changed how you worked because of it

  • You have built a completeness or quality definition and made an organisation adopt it

  • You have worked on interoperability, health data standards, or identity and account models

What we offer

  • Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children

  • 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT

  • Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care

  • Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

  • Lunch vouchers (Swile card) worth €8.50 per working day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib

  • A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class

  • 50% reimbursement of your public transport subscription

  • ParentCare Program: Enjoy full salary coverage (100%) during your first month of birth leave and 75% during the second, covered by Doctolib

  • For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support

  • Relocation support in case of international mobility

  • Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training

Our interview process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview (Maxime Balme)

  • Hiring Manager Interview (Léo Lanzarotti) 

  • Case Study with Product Panel

  • Behavioral Interview with peers, including at least one channel-owning team

  • At least one reference check

We want your experience to be clear, respectful, and transparent. Learn more about our hiring process on our candidate experience page.

Job details

  • Permanent position

  • Full-time

  • Levallois-Perret, France

  • Hybrid work setup (2 remote days per week)

  • Start date: as soon as possible

We welcome everyone

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, or disability.

To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g., pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process.

Die Ares GmbH ist ein inhabergeführtes Unternehmen, das seit 2013 individuelle und qualitativ hochwertige Produkte aus Glas – wie Spiegel, Duschabtrennungen und Türen – sowie maßgefertigte (Bad-)Möbel herstellt. Unsere Kunden finden uns fast ausschließlich über Suchmaschinen. Wie gut wir bei Google ranken und wie wirtschaftlich unsere Anzeigen laufen, entscheidet direkt über unseren Umsatz.

Dazu bauen Sie unser Affiliate-Marketing aus. Die Stelle ist bewusst bei uns im Haus in Lünen angesiedelt: Sie arbeiten eng mit Geschäftsführung, Kundenservice und Produktion zusammen und sind vor Ort präsent.

SEO – Suchmaschinenoptimierung: Volle Verantwortung für unsere organische Sichtbarkeit: technisches SEO, On-Page-Optimierung von Kategorie- und Produktseiten, Keyword- und Wettbewerbsanalysen, Content-Briefings und Linkaufbau – mit eigener Umsetzung, nicht nur Konzept

title: M365 Operations & Support Engineer (Bern/Zürich/hybrid) 60-100%
descriptionHtml:
Montagmorgen, 08:15 Uhr: Bei einem Kunden kann niemand mehr auf SharePoint zugreifen, zwei neue Mitarbeitende warten auf ihr Intune-Gerät und eine Postfachregel leitet seit Freitag Mails ins Leere. Alles ist irgendwie dringend und nicht alles ist gleich wichtig. Du bringst Ordnung hinein: Du erkennst, was brennt, löst selbst, was du lösen kannst, und gibst den Rest gezielt an die richtigen Specialist Engineers weiter. Unsere Kunden merken davon vor allem eines, nämlich dass es funktioniert.

Wir bei Epic Fusion sind ein AI-native Team: unkompliziert, kurze Wege, viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Wir probieren Neues aus, ganz im Sinne von «Learn it over Know it», und bauen es direkt in unsere Prozesse ein. Unseren Helpdesk verstehen wir als intelligente, agentengestützte Serviceplattform und nicht als Ticketsystem. Nicht alles funktioniert auf Anhieb, aber wir lernen schnell und bauen auf dem auf, was sich bewährt. Ein fertiges Prozesshandbuch für jede Situation gibt es bei uns nicht. Wenn du das brauchst, sind wir nicht die Richtigen. Wenn du es lieber selbst schreibst, schon.

Das gestaltest du bei uns:

  • Den Überblick behalten: Du übernimmst die Ticket-Triage im B2B-Helpdesk, setzt Prioritäten und sorgst dafür, dass jeder Case beim richtigen Menschen landet.

  • Selbst lösen: Second-Level-Anfragen rund um Microsoft 365 bearbeitest du eigenständig, vom Troubleshooting über die Konfiguration bis zur Wurzelursachenanalyse. Du willst wissen, warum etwas kaputt war, und nicht nur, dass es wieder läuft.

  • SLAs im Griff haben: Du überwachst SLAs und offene Cases und greifst ein, bevor etwas eskaliert.

  • Kunden auf Augenhöhe begleiten: Du pflegst die Kundenbeziehung proaktiv. Unsere Kunden wissen, wen sie anrufen können, und vertrauen dir.

  • Im Team spielen: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Operations- und Workplace-Specialists zusammen und gibst Fälle so weiter, dass niemand nachfragen muss.

  • Den Helpdesk smarter machen: Was zweimal von Hand passiert, schaust du dir genauer an. Du gestaltest mit, wie AI-Agents und automatisierte Workflows Triage, Analyse und Kommunikation im Helpdesk übernehmen.


Du passt zu uns, wenn …

  • du Microsoft 365 aus der Praxis kennst und Intune, Entra ID, Exchange, Teams oder SharePoint für dich keine Fremdwörter sind. Erfahrung mit Software-Paketierung, Printix oder Azure ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.

  • du bereits in einem Helpdesk oder IT-Operations-Umfeld gearbeitet hast und weisst, wie sich ein voller Montagmorgen anfühlt.

  • du auch unter Druck ruhig bleibst und einem gestressten Kunden in zwei Sätzen erklären kannst, was als Nächstes passiert.

  • du AI-Tools schon ausprobiert hast, weil es dich interessiert hat und nicht weil es jemand verlangt hat.

  • du auf Deutsch und Englisch souverän kommunizierst.

… und dich diese Benefits ansprechen:

  • AI ohne Limit: Auf unserer eigenen Frontier Engine arbeitest du mit den 30 führenden Frontier-Modellen (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Mistral, Moonshot), dazu kommt Microsoft Copilot inklusive Cowork. Ein Token-Budget gibt es nicht.

  • Weiterbildung: Du bildest dich gezielt weiter, zum Beispiel mit Microsoft-Zertifizierungen, und wächst mit uns Richtung Specialist oder Engineer.

  • Pensum, das passt: 60–100 %, je nachdem, was zu deinem Leben passt.

  • Arbeiten, wo es passt: in unseren Office-Hubs in Zürich oder Bern oder remote aus der ganzen Schweiz.

  • 6 Wochen Ferien, geschäftliche Fahrten SBB 1. Klasse und eine exzellente Pensionskassenlösung.

title: Member of Technical Staff - Safety
descriptionHtml:
About Black Forest Labs

We're the team behind Latent Diffusion, Stable Diffusion, and FLUX—foundational technologies that changed how the world creates images and video. We're creating the generative models that power how people make images and video—tools used by millions of creators, developers, and businesses worldwide. Our FLUX models are among the most advanced in the world, and we're just getting started.

Headquartered in Freiburg, Germany with a growing presence in San Francisco, we're scaling fast while staying true to what makes us different: research excellence, open science, and building technology that expands human creativity.

Why this role

FLUX models ship as open weights, which gives anyone full access to the model. Our safety efforts focus on suppressing harmful behaviors and mitigating the risk of misuse, so safety has to be built into the models themselves, not bolted on afterwards.

As a Member of Technical Staff on our safety research team, you'll research and ship methods that make FLUX models safe by design: from what goes into the training data to how the models are mid- and post-trained, across images, video and the text that conditions them. This is a role with real ownership: you won't just do research on model safety, you'll shape it. The methods you build ship in FLUX models with over 75 million downloads on Hugging Face and in production at some of the largest platforms in the world.

What you'll work on

  • Develop mid- and post-training safety methods for FLUX models, such as safety SFT, preference optimization and RL with safety rewards, and concept erasure.

  • Build safety data filtering that runs at pretraining scale: classifiers and pipelines that screen billions of images, video clips and captions, with measured Pareto frontiers and precision/recall trade-offs.

  • Make safety hold up for open-weight releases, including robustness to adversarial prompts and to downstream fine-tuning.

  • Extend safety to the text side of the stack: prompts, captions and the text encoders that condition our models.

  • Design evaluations and red-teaming that measure harmful generations alongside image quality and prompt following, so safety gains don't come at the cost of performance.

  • Work directly with pretraining and post-training teams so your methods land in the release model, and publish where it makes sense.

What we're looking for

  • Hands-on research experience in visual safety: safety of text-to-image, text-to-video or vision-language models, such as harm classifiers, safe generation methods or safety benchmarks.

  • Proven experience in at least one of:

    • Large-scale safety data filtering: building and running classifiers or filtering pipelines over hundreds of millions of samples or more.

    • Safety mid- or post-training: safety SFT, DPO or RL with safety objectives, or unlearning applied to large generative models.

  • Deep familiarity with concept erasure methods (e.g. ESD, UCE, adversarial unlearning) and their failure modes, such as concept recovery and collateral damage to unrelated concepts.

  • Track record of shipping: top-venue publications (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV) paired with production impact, or unambiguous production wins at a frontier lab.

  • Experience with distributed training at multi-node scale.

  • Strong PyTorch fluency; you write research code that others can build on. You work fluently with coding agents to move faster, and have the depth to verify their output and own the result.

  • Experience running multi-agent workflows: you know which tasks to hand off and which to keep yourself, and you use the speed-up to raise the quality bar, not lower it.

We'd be especially excited if you:

  • Know how to keep safety intact after release, when others fine-tune open weights.

  • Have tackled safety for video generation, where harm can emerge across frames rather than in any single frame.

  • Bring experience with audio safety, especially for jointly generated audio and video, where each modality can amplify harm in the other.

  • Have unlearned concepts from text encoders or built safety-tuned encoders (e.g. Safe-CLIP-style approaches).

  • Have worked on text safety: LLM safety tuning, prompt and jailbreak defenses, or text safety classifiers, ideally across languages.

  • Have applied latent-space safety methods, such as activation steering or safe guidance.

  • Have built VLM-based safety judges or guard models for filtering or evaluation.

How we work together

We're a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. You'll join us in Freiburg at least 2 days a week (or one full week every other week). We'll cover reasonable travel costs to make this possible. We think in-person time matters, and we've structured things to make it accessible to all. We'll discuss what this will look like for the role during our interview process.

Everything we do is grounded in four values:

  • Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful.

  • Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task.

  • Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect.

  • Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos.

If this sounds like work you'd enjoy, we'd love to hear from you.

Compensation

EUR 160K-220K + equity, depending on profile

This is an amazing opportunity to join our fastest growing sales segment with the ability to advance into the Upper Mid-Market and Enterprise segments as well as sales leadership. This is a hybrid role based in our London office, with in-office attendance required 3x per week and travel to customer sites up to 3x per month to win large deals.

title: Operations Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:

Isembard is building a network of high-performance factories for critical industries. Run operations in Hamburg from order to delivery: dates, throughput and material. We have two machines today and seven by April, plus guild partner factories and suppliers we do not own. You decide which job sits on which machine, what goes outside and what we promise.

title: Patient Support Coordinator
descriptionHtml:
At Montu UK, our Patient Support Coordinators do much more than answer calls. They play an important role in supporting patients who rely on us for their treatment, care and ongoing wellbeing.

This is a demanding but incredibly rewarding position, where the conversations you have can make a genuine difference to someone's life. Many of our patients are living with complex, chronic or debilitating medical conditions, and we recognise that accessing treatment can sometimes be an emotional and challenging experience.

We are looking for people who genuinely care about others, who have the patience to listen, the resilience to manage difficult conversations and the ability to provide compassionate, professional support in a busy environment.

This is not a traditional customer service role. It requires empathy, emotional intelligence and a genuine commitment to patient care. For the right person, it is an opportunity to be part of something meaningful, where every conversation has the potential to make a difference.

What is the job?

As a Patient Support Coordinator, you will be one of the first points of contact for patients accessing treatment through Montu UK.

This is a predominantly telephone-based role, handling approximately 450 calls each week. You will support patients with a wide range of enquiries, from appointment bookings and treatment-related administration to more complex and sensitive situations requiring patience, understanding and reassurance.

No two conversations will be the same. Some patients may be anxious, frustrated or distressed, and you will need to remain calm, professional and compassionate while finding practical solutions to their concerns.

The role requires you to balance a high volume of calls with delivering a consistently high standard of patient care. It can be challenging, but the support you provide has a direct impact on the patient experience and their confidence in accessing treatment.

This is a fully remote, UK-based position, working 40 hours per week across five days. Shifts are either 7:30am to 4:30pm or 9:30am to 6:30pm, with Saturday working required as part of the five-day working week.

We are looking for someone who understands the demands of a busy patient-facing environment and takes genuine pride in providing care and support to those who need it.

What will you be doing?

  • Managing a high volume of inbound and outbound patient calls, approximately 450 per week

  • Supporting patients with a wide range of enquiries, including complex, sensitive and emotionally challenging situations

  • Providing reassurance, guidance and practical support throughout the patient journey

  • Booking appointments, completing documentation and resolving patient queries accurately and efficiently

  • Managing difficult conversations with empathy, patience and professionalism

  • Working closely with our Clinical and Pharmacy teams to ensure patients receive timely support and continuity of care

  • Maintaining accurate patient records and ensuring compliance with GDPR and internal procedures

  • Balancing call volumes and performance expectations while maintaining a compassionate and patient-centred approach

What do you need?

  • Previous experience in a high-volume, telephone-based customer service, contact centre or patient support environment

  • Experience handling complex enquiries and managing difficult or emotionally challenging conversations

  • Genuine empathy, patience and a strong desire to help others

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to listen actively and adapt your approach to different situations

  • Emotional resilience and the ability to remain calm and professional under pressure

  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment

  • Confidence using multiple systems, with excellent attention to detail

  • The ability to work independently in a remote environment while remaining connected to a wider team

Previous healthcare experience would be beneficial, but what matters most is your attitude, resilience and genuine commitment to supporting patients.

Why join Montu UK?

  • Meaningful work: Make a genuine difference to patients living with complex medical conditions

  • Remote working: Work from home within the UK

  • Annual leave: 25 days, increasing to 27 days after one year and 30 days after two years, plus bank holidays

  • Pension: Employer matching contributions of up to 5%

  • Career development: Opportunities to learn, develop and progress within a growing healthcare organisation

  • Patient-centred purpose: Be part of a business dedicated to improving access to treatment and patient care

About Montu UK

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM), dedicated to improving patient access to safe and effective treatments.

Our mission is to improve patients' lives by combining innovative technology with high-quality clinical care, ensuring people receive the support they need throughout their treatment journey.

As our patient community continues to grow, our Patient Support team remains central to the care and experience we provide. Every conversation matters, and every member of the team has an important part to play.

Als Berliner Healthcare Start-up mit finanzstarken Investoren im Rücken wachsen wir schnell – und genau dieses Wachstum treibst du in deiner Rolle aktiv mit voran.

Als Payment Operations Manager (w/m/x) wirst du Teil unseres Partner & Payments Management Teams (aktuell 5 Personen) und berichtest direkt an unsere Senior Team Lead Partner & Payments Management. Wenn Pflegekassen die Kosten für die Patronus-Uhr übernehmen, steckt dahinter ein komplexer Prozess: vom Antrag auf Kostenübernahme über die Bestätigung und die Abrechnung bis zum Zahlungseingang. Genau diesen geschäftskritischen Prozess verantwortest du – mit direktem Einfluss auf unseren Cashflow.

Was uns als Team ausmacht: Echte Ownership statt Abarbeiten, schnelle Umsetzung und offene Kommunikation. Wir sind ein bisschen nerdy, wenn es um saubere Prozesse und gute Daten geht – und mindestens genauso begeistert, wenn ein Problem endlich an der Wurzel gelöst ist. Deine Mission

  • Du verantwortest die Abrechnung mit Pflegekassen End-to-End – vom Antrag auf Kostenübernahme bis zum Zahlungseingang – und packst dabei selbst operativ mit an.
  • Du steuerst unseren Abrechnungsdienstleister sowie weitere externe Partner und treibst offene Themen mit ihnen und den Kassen konsequent bis zum Ergebnis.
  • Du prüfst Abrechnungs- und Zahlungsdaten, erkennst Auffälligkeiten und finanzielle Risiken früh und machst Zahlen und Prozesse mit einem aussagekräftigen Reporting transparent.
  • Du löst nicht nur Einzelfälle, sondern erkennst Muster, behebst Ursachen und baust Abläufe so auf, dass sie dokumentiert, skalierbar und wo sinnvoll automatisiert sind.

Dein Talent

  • Du bringst mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Operations, Prozessmanagement, FinOps, Partnermanagement oder Abrechnungsmanagement mit, idealerweise im Healthcare- oder Tech-Umfeld.
  • Du hast nachweislich Prozesse von Grund auf aufgebaut und externe Dienstleister gesteuert.
  • Du bist proaktiv, übernimmst Ownership, erkennst Verbesserungspotenzial und packst operativ mit an. Dabei kommunizierst du klar und verbindlich – intern wie extern.
  • Du arbeitest analytisch und sehr genau, bist sicher in Google Sheets/Excel und nutzt AI-Tools wie Claude oder ChatGPT selbstverständlich im Arbeitsalltag.
  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und Englisch mindestens auf B2-Niveau.

Plus:

  • Erfahrung in der Abrechnung mit Pflege-/Krankenkassen

title: Photonics Design Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Overview

This role will focus on the design, optimisation, and development of high performance photonic components for next generation Photonic Integrated Circuits (PICs), contributing directly to our future tape-outs and core IP roadmap.

You will work closely with photonics designers, layout engineers, and testing teams to improve the performance of integrated photonic devices through theoretical analysis, simulation, modelling, and design innovation.

This is a highly technical role suited to someone who enjoys solving difficult physics and engineering problems in a collaborative deep-tech environment. You will contribute to the development of key building blocks within our optical switching and photonic systems roadmap, and other integrated photonic components critical to future high port count architectures.

Depending on experience, we are open to candidates at Senior, Lead, or Principal level.

What you'll be doing

  • Design and optimise integrated photonic components for silicon photonics and related PIC platforms

  • Perform electromagnetic simulations, modelling, and theoretical analysis to improve device performance

  • Validate simulation results against experimental measurement data

  • Develop innovative component designs informed by current research and emerging techniques

  • Collaborate with layout engineers to integrate components into PDK libraries and tape-out flows

  • Work closely with fabrication and testing teams to iterate on device performance

  • Contribute to the development roadmap for future photonic components and architectures

  • Support long term improvements in PIC loss, manufacturability, and scalability

  • Participate in technical discussions, design reviews, and cross functional problem solving

  • Stay current with advances in integrated photonics through research literature and conferences

What we're looking for

  • PhD, or equivalent industry experience, in Photonics, Physics, Optical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related field

  • Strong theoretical understanding of guided optics and photonic device physics

  • Hands-on experience designing and simulating integrated photonic components

  • Experience working with silicon photonics or InP photonic platforms

  • Strong analytical and mathematical problem solving capability

  • A track record of meaningful technical contributions, whether through publications, patents, or shipped technology

  • Experience using photonic simulation tools and modelling workflows

  • Python programming experience for simulation, analysis, or automation

  • Deep understanding of Photonic IC design and fabrication flows

  • Knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing processes

  • Experience working in commercial R&D or product development environments

  • Strong communication skills and attention to detail

  • Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary engineering teams

You will join a highly ambitious deep-tech company operating at the intersection of AI infrastructure, semiconductors, and photonics. We are building foundational technology with the potential to reshape the performance envelope of future AI systems.

Alongside a collaborative and research-driven environment, you will have the opportunity to work on genuinely difficult engineering problems with direct impact on product direction and company growth.

If you're excited by integrated photonics, advanced device design, and solving hard engineering problems at the frontier of AI infrastructure, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Polymechaniker & Techniker
descriptionHtml:
About Enact

The next defining technological breakthrough will be in the physical world. We stand at a historical inflection point: bringing general-purpose intelligence into robotics.

At Enact we rethink the entire robotic tech stack from model architectures and data pipelines, to the actuators and sensors that feed the model. Pushing beyond pure vision and language approaches, we build a proprioceptive nerve system, and the cortex that makes sense of it, to solve dexterity through whole-body force-awareness and deploy robots for thousands of tasks in industry and beyond.

We are shaping a company where brilliant and unconventional people thrive together on solving the hardest challenges of our time. We are truth seekers. We reason from first principles, test our beliefs against reality, and trust that the best ideas can come from anyone. We move fast. We care deeply about our work and colleagues and are driven by passion to change the status quo.

If this resonates, we're excited to hear from you.

In dieser Rolle

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Hardware-Team zusammen und sorgst für eine qualitativ hochwertige, reproduzierbare Produktion unserer Aktuatoren und Robotersysteme. Mit deinem Feedback trägst du dazu bei, Hardware und Prozesse laufend zu verbessern.

  • Mechanische Montage, Fertigung & Build-Umsetzung: Du bist verantwortlich für den mechanischen Aufbau, die Montage und die Fertigungsschritte unserer Robotersysteme.

  • Fertigungs- & Prototyping-Support: Du stellst mit Fertigungsmaschinen und 3D-Druckern kundenspezifische Teile her (Vorrichtungen, Lehren und Produktionsteile) und bringst Vorschläge ein, wie sich der Prozess verbessern und vereinfachen lässt.

  • Prozessbegleitende Qualitätskontrolle: Du führst systematische Qualitätskontrollen anhand unserer Qualitätskennzahlen durch und dokumentierst die Ergebnisse, damit die Produktion rückverfolgbar bleibt.

  • Maschinenverfügbarkeit & Wartung: Du verantwortest den Unterhalt unserer zentralen Maschinen und übernimmst regelmässige Wartung, Kalibrierung und Fehlerbehebung.

  • Du hilfst mit, die Werkstatt selbst weiterzuentwickeln: Layout, Werkzeuge und Abläufe verbessern, während wir wachsen.

Was wir suchen

  • Technische Fähigkeiten: Praktische Erfahrung in der mechanischen Montage, sicherer Umgang mit Werkstattwerkzeugen (Messschieber, Lötkolben, Bohrmaschinen), 3D-Druck und grundlegende Maschinenbedienung.

  • Technischer Hintergrund: Eine einschlägige Berufsausbildung (z. B. Polymechaniker/in, Automatiker/in, Elektroniker/in EFZ oder eine vergleichbare Lehre) oder gleichwertige praktische Berufserfahrung in mechanischer Montage, Mechatronik oder elektrischen Systemen.

  • Problemlösung: Du kannst Hardwareprobleme selbstständig analysieren und beheben und hinterfragst deine eigene Arbeit kritisch, um Verbesserungen zu finden.

  • Du liest technische Zeichnungen sicher und arbeitest selbstständig nach schriftlichen Anleitungen.

  • Sorgfalt: Du schätzt einen aufgeräumten, funktionalen Arbeitsplatz und gehst technische Aufgaben systematisch an.

  • Fliessend Englisch oder Deutsch, mit mindestens Grundkenntnissen in Englisch (A2/B1) und der Bereitschaft, dazuzulernen (wir sind ein internationales Team).

Pluspunkte, wenn du

  • Erfahrung im Formenbau, im Vergiessen/Verkapseln oder in der Elektromotorenproduktion hast

title: PR Account Director
descriptionHtml:
Consumer PR - Account Director
Large Beauty FMCG 

Department: Consumer PR & Influence 
Location: London 
Contract type: 12-Month FTC 
Full Time/Part time: Full Time 
Reporting into: Business Director 
 
 

About Ogilvy:  

Ogilvy UK has been creating iconic ideas that deliver impact at scale for clients ever since David Ogilvy founded the company in 1948. The agency specialises in bringing together brand advertising, customer experience marketing, PR, influence and consulting, all fueled by Behavioural Science. Our world-class award-winning creative campaigns deliver solutions for clients including Sainsbury’s, Lloyds Banking Group, Madri, Unilever and Mondelēz International. 

Ogilvy’s influencer marketing practice is the largest globally and the agency also hosts the world’s biggest festival of behavioural science and creativity, Nudgestock – which is now in its 12th year. James Murphy is the CEO of Ogilvy Group UK, which includes Ogilvy UK and New Commercial Arts (NCA), a boutique creative agency he co-founded in 2020, recently acquired by WPP. 
 
  

The Role:  
As Account Director, you'll champion "earned first" thinking to create impactful, culturally relevant consumer PR campaigns. You'll lead a team, build strong client relationships, and drive innovative strategies that generate buzz and deliver measurable results. This role is fun and energetic, offering great opportunities to learn and develop with a variety of complex but rewarding clients. You will be responsible for fostering a positive and collaborative work environment within the account management team, encouraging open communication and constructive feedback. You will manage relationships with third-party vendors, to ensure the agency delivers high-quality work that meets client expectations. You will also act as a liaison between the client and the agency's internal teams, providing clear communication and direction to ensure all parties are aligned on project goals and timelines. You can see opportunity in risk and you’re not afraid to be brave and challenge your clients to want to achieve a better result for all. 
  
 

Key Responsibilities:  

  • Inspire & Lead: Mentor a team to develop and execute breakthrough, "earned first" PR & Influence campaigns. 
  • Client Partnership: Build trusted advisor relationships with clients, understanding their business and anticipating their needs. Guide them across media and social communications. 
  • Creative Strategy: Collaborate with creative teams to develop compelling narratives and assets that resonate with target audiences. 
  • Data-Driven Optimization: Monitor campaign performance, leveraging data and analytics to optimize results and demonstrate ROI. 
  • Innovation & Trends: Stay ahead of industry trends, identifying new opportunities and approaches to enhance campaign effectiveness. 
  • Budget Management: Manage client budgets effectively, ensuring campaigns are delivered on time and within budget. 
  • New Business: Support new business efforts, participating in pitches and developing compelling proposals. 
  • Crisis Management: Develop and implement crisis management plans to protect client reputation. 
  • Inclusivity: Champion inclusiveness, diversity, and equity in all aspects of work. 

Requirements: 

  • Extensive experience in consumer PR and influence, with a proven track record of driving successful campaigns.

  • Interest and desire across beauty and FMCG projects

  • Share and use media knowledge to guide clients on what you believe is the best for their brand 
  • Deep understanding of consumer behavior and ability to develop creative strategies that resonate with target audiences. 
  • Demonstrated ability to think "earned first" and create campaigns that generate organic buzz. 
  • Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.  
  • Excellent project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. 
  • Data-driven mindset and analytical skills. 
  • Knowledge of industry trends and best practices. 
  • Experience in crisis management. 

  • Champion inclusiveness, diversity, and equity in all aspects of work.
     

How we help you Thrive: 

  •  25 days annual leave + 1 Volunteer Day   
  • Bupa Healthcare  
  • Enhanced Maternity, Adoption and Shared Parental Leave  
  • We have a Flexible Working Model with core working hours: 10am – 4pm  
  • A 1.5:1 Matching Pension Structure  
  • Wellbeing and Health: Up to £25.00 per month towards physical or online exercise class membership, Unmind membership, LifeWorks tool and annual eye tests and development budgets and Wellbeing incentives and activities throughout the year   
  • Season Ticket Loan and Cycle to Work Scheme  
  • Life Assurance

We are an equal opportunity employer and we’re committed to creating an inclusive, welcoming environment for everyone who wants to work at Ogilvy. title: Principal Field Engineer, US Remote
descriptionHtml:
About Exa

We raised a $250M Series C to build the search engine for AIs. Led by a16z, with existing investors Benchmark, Lightspeed, and YC doubling down, the round brings Exa's valuation to $2.2 billion.

Exa is building a search engine for the AI era. Our Search API currently powers Agents, Fortune 500s, and AI labs as we transform an industry that hasn't been disrupted since the 90s. We're a largely SF-based team of ~100 from Harvard, MIT, Meta, Google Research, ex-founders, and dropouts alike.

We are rapidly building the most intelligent search engine in history. We're high agency, low-ego, and united by the feeling that this is one of the last problems worth getting right.

About the Role

Our Solutions Architects and Forward Deployed Engineers are aligned to accounts, segments and Account Executives. This role isn't. As a Principal Field Engineer, you work across the whole business: every region, every segment, presales and post-sales. Your job is to make Exa impossible to ignore for developers and technical buyers, and to make every Field Engineer better at showing what Exa can do.

You'll build the demos, workshops and on-demand training the team and our customers use everywhere, take Exa on the road to conferences, meetups and user groups, and become the go-to expert the team pulls in when a deal or a customer needs someone who knows Exa inside out. You'll spend a lot of time where developers are, and a lot of time on a plane. This is not a slideware role. You are an engineer who builds, teaches and shows.

In this role, you will:

descriptionHtml:
Description

QuantumDiamonds (QD) is entering its next phase: with the start of production, we are evolving from a startup into an industrial company. This transition requires an operational foundation built on clean, lean and scalable processes. Join the CEO Office and play a key role in establishing this foundation. As a Process Optimization Intern, you will map our processes in Odoo, from purchase request to bookkeeping, streamline workflows that have grown organically, and automate manual steps. You will work closely with Finance, Procurement and Manufacturing, and your work will have a direct and visible impact on our daily operations.

Who we are

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

Why join QuantumDiamonds?

Picture this:

  • Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

  • Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

  • Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

  • An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.

Still unsure about why joining us?

  • You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.

  • From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.

  • Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

  • You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.

Let’s make the invisible visible!

  

What will you do

  • Map our end-to-end processes in Odoo, from purchase requests and purchasing to goods receipt, inventory, manufacturing and accounting

  • Analyze existing workflows with Finance, Procurement and Manufacturing, identify bottlenecks and fix them yourself instead of just reporting them

  • Configure and extend Odoo modules, master data and approval flows, and help decide how the ERP grows with QD

  • Take projects live that make a visible difference in daily work, for example barcode scanning in goods receipt and warehouse

  • Automate repetitive manual steps with n8n and connect Odoo to the rest of our tooling stack

  • Build AI agents with Claude that read documents, check data and prepare transactions

  • Document processes and train colleagues so new workflows are adopted and stick

  • Keep data quality high and help set up reporting that gives management a clear view of operations

 

What is expected of you

  • You are enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Business Informatics, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Computer Science, or a related field

  • You have experience with an ERP system, ideally Odoo

  • You understand processes in purchasing, warehousing, manufacturing, or accounting

  • You have experience with automation tools such as n8n, Make, or Zapier

  • Experience with LLM-based workflows or agents, scripting in Python or JavaScript, or knowledge of SQL and data modeling is a plus

  • Experience in a fast-growing hardware or manufacturing company is a plus

  • You have a hands-on mentality: you implement things yourself instead of passing on requirements

  • You are available for a full-time internship of 4 to 6 months and can work from our Munich office

  • Fluent English is required, German is a plus

Our benefits

  • Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 24 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired.

About us

QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act.

title: Procurement & Supply Chain Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Focused Energy & SourceLight

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. As a spin-out of Focused Energy, SourceLight is turning breakthrough laser-driven radiation source technology into practical solutions for some of the world's most demanding inspection and material characterization challenges.

We are building on cutting-edge scientific innovation to develop scalable technology for industrial applications, including nuclear waste characterization, security screening, and non-destructive testing of safety-critical components.

As our technology moves from development toward industrial application, building a robust and scalable supply chain is essential to our success.

Your Role

We are looking for a Procurement & Supply Chain Manager to establish and lead this function from the ground up. This is a unique opportunity to take ownership of procurement and supplier strategy across the company, shaping how we identify, qualify, engage, and manage suppliers while ensuring our engineering teams have the components and resources they need to deliver.

You will work closely with our Product and Engineering teams, Finance, Legal, and external partners to establish company-wide procurement standards, negotiate complex technical and commercial agreements, and build a supplier ecosystem capable of supporting our growth.

Initially operating as a senior individual contributor, you will have significant autonomy and influence over how this function develops. As SourceLight scales, you will have the opportunity to expand the team, introduce new capabilities, and evolve procurement and supply chain into a fully established organizational function.

If you enjoy building structure in a fast-moving technical environment, navigating complex supplier relationships, and creating the operational foundations that enable innovative technology to reach the market, this is an opportunity to make a lasting impact.

What You'll Do

  • Build and lead the Procurement & Supply Chain function: Establish the strategy, processes, tools, and operating standards required to support procurement across all SourceLight product and engineering teams.

  • Develop a strategic supplier ecosystem: Identify, evaluate, qualify, and manage suppliers across specialized technical categories, particularly high-value optical, laser, mechanical, electrical, and other advanced hardware components.

  • Own sourcing and commercial negotiations: Lead supplier selection, RFQs, commercial negotiations, pricing discussions, lead-time agreements, and framework contracts to secure favorable terms while balancing cost, quality, technical requirements, and delivery timelines.

  • Manage complex technical agreements: Lead commercial negotiations for strategic supplier agreements and Joint Development Agreements (JDAs), partnering with Engineering, Legal, Finance, and leadership to ensure appropriate commercial, operational, and contractual outcomes.

  • Enable engineering and product teams: Take ownership of procurement activities from request through purchase order and supplier follow-up, allowing technical teams to focus on engineering, integration, testing, and product development.

  • Establish scalable procurement processes: Implement standardized purchasing workflows, supplier documentation, approval processes, contract management practices, and procurement systems that support transparency, efficiency, and accountability.

  • Drive supply chain planning and risk management: Monitor supplier capacity, component availability, lead times, delivery performance, and potential supply disruptions. Develop mitigation strategies for critical components and proactively communicate risks to stakeholders.

  • Partner with Finance and Legal: Coordinate purchase order approvals, budget alignment, payment processes, contract reviews, and compliance requirements while maintaining clear decision-making and escalation pathways.

  • Ensure quality and compliance: Establish supplier qualification and performance standards that account for technical specifications, quality requirements, cleanroom and safety considerations, and applicable regulatory or industry requirements.

  • Build visibility and accountability: Develop reporting on procurement status, supplier performance, purchasing cycle times, cost savings, delivery risks, and sourcing priorities to support informed operational decisions.

  • Scale the function over time: Identify future capability and resourcing needs, contribute to hiring plans, and establish the processes and knowledge base required to develop and lead a growing Procurement & Supply Chain team.

Who You Are

  • You bring significant experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, supply chain management, or technical purchasing, ideally within a complex engineering, hardware, deep-tech, industrial technology, or advanced manufacturing environment.

  • You have experience building or significantly improving procurement processes and supplier management practices, ideally within a growing organization where structure and systems are still evolving.

  • You are comfortable managing technically complex sourcing activities, working with engineers to understand requirements, and translating technical needs into effective commercial and supplier strategies.

  • You have a strong track record of negotiating supplier agreements, pricing, delivery terms, and commercial contracts, with the confidence to manage high-value and strategically important supplier relationships.

  • You understand the importance of balancing cost, quality, lead time, technical risk, and long-term supplier reliability when making sourcing decisions.

  • You have experience developing supplier qualification frameworks, evaluating supplier performance, and proactively managing supply chain risks and constraints.

  • You are highly organized and process-oriented, with the ability to establish practical, scalable workflows without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.

  • You operate with a high degree of ownership and independence, bringing structure to ambiguous situations and making sound decisions while knowing when to involve stakeholders or escalate.

  • You are a strong cross-functional partner who communicates proactively, builds trust with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and can influence decisions without relying on formal authority.

  • You are comfortable operating as a hands-on individual contributor today while thinking strategically about the capabilities, processes, and team structure needed for tomorrow.

  • You are motivated by the opportunity to build a function, develop future team members, and grow into broader leadership responsibility as the organization scales.

  • You communicate confidently in English; German language skills are an advantage.

What We Offer

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Equipment: We offer state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptops. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1.

  • Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

  • Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs—whether it’s a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing you choose what fits your lifestyle.

  • Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.
