title: Product Lead
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Logistics is a $12 trillion industry powered by hard-working people, yet much of its operational work is still manual and running on tribal knowledge. We believe another software tool won’t solve this, but we need to change how work gets done in logistics.

That’s why we’re building Logistica OS: a flexible, multi-agent platform that understands how logistics teams work and takes on back-office tasks, starting with pallet accounting. We chose this first use case because we experienced the problem firsthand while running a digital forwarder for food logistics.

Backed by leading European investors, we partner with some of Europe’s most sophisticated logistics teams to create a new category of logistics technology.

The Role

As our Product Lead, you will shape our platform strategy and own the product roadmap from first insight to shipped feature.

We are building a scalable platform, not a services business. Every customer project teaches us something, and your job is to turn those lessons into platform capabilities that make the next customer faster and cheaper to onboard. You will decide what becomes a configurable platform feature and what we deliberately don't build into the platform.

Tasks

Our product:

Logistica is offering a flexible platform that lets logistics teams automate document-based workflows. Our focus use case is simplifying the load carrier management (pallets, crates, etc.) for wholesalers and logistics service providers. From this niche we are expanding to adjacent use cases that cover post- and pre-shipment operations. Currently the platform combines unstructured data sources, automates workflows and helps connecting partners. It’s built upon the following principles:

  • An AI-first approach to solve operational problems

  • A flexible platform built for how logistics actually operates

  • Built-in network features that help customers optimize across company boundaries

What you will do:

  • Define what is a platform feature vs. a configuration vs. a customization. Our customers value our platform’s flexibility, but you help to strike the balance between scalability and speed

  • Filter customer requests. You look past individual customer requests to the problem behind them, define the solution and ship it in steps that build on each other

  • Drive self-service functionality. Enable non-technical operators to set up and optimize workflow automations without engineering assistance

  • Design how our AI workers work. You go deep on how operators run load carrier accounts, document flows and exceptions. Then you translate that into agent behavior, extraction logic, human-in-the-loop flows and evals.

  • Drive the roadmap end to end. You pull together input from customers, CS, sales and engineering, force the prioritization calls and write specs engineers want to build from.

  • Stay close to users. You visit customers regularly in their warehouses, admin offices and HQs across Europe

  • Make the product sellable. You shape the product narrative with sales, support key demos and feed market learnings back into our playbooks

Requirements

  • +3 years experience in product (AI, B2B software, tech platform businesses)

  • Technical background or deep technical understanding

  • Proven experience building with LLMs

  • Communicate clearly to diverse audiences

  • Early stage experience

  • German at C1 level, English for working in an international team

  • Based in Berlin or willing to relocate

  • Open to customer visits across Europe

  • Experience in logistics or supply chain

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and equity package

  • Work at the frontier of applied AI with a brilliant tech team

  • Full product ownership as the first product hire

  • Wide surface area to develop our platform - by use case depth and along new use cases and industry verticals

  • An early-stage AI startup at a hyper growth stage and product-market fit

  • Hybrid setup in Berlin, with regular team in-persons and quarterly offsites

  • A healthy, performance-driven culture where impact matters most

  • Co-shape how work is done in one of the largest global industries

title: Product Lead (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Product Lead (m/w/d) - Lern-Ökosysteme für Unternehmen, Bildungszentren und Verbände

80–100 % · Zürich · Festanstellung · per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung

Über MaxBrain

MaxBrain AG wurde 2016 in der Schweiz gegründet und ist ein führender Anbieter für digitale Lernlösungen mit aktuell 12 Mitarbeitenden. Mit einer innovativen Kombination aus Learning Management System (LMS) und Learning Experience Plattform (LXP) übersetzt MaxBrain Lernstrategien in ganzheitliche, digitale Lern-Ökosysteme für Unternehmen, Bildungszentren und Verbände.

Renommierte Bildungsinstitutionen sowie zukunftsorientierte Unternehmen vertrauen auf die Expertise von MaxBrain, darunter Bildungspartner wie Digicomp, WEKA und Talentus, führende Berufsverbände wie SwissAccounting, Electrosuisse und die OdA beider Basel sowie Marktführer wie Zweifel Chips & Snacks, InfoGuard, BLT Basellandschaft Transport und Baumann Koelliker und viele mehr.

Worum es geht

Lernen ist für uns kein Pflichtprogramm. Lernen ist ein Motor für Entwicklung, Performance und Kultur.

Unsere Vision: MaxBrain wird die People-Development-Plattform für mittelständische Unternehmen. Das Fundament steht: geschäftskritische Lern-Ökosysteme für Bildungsinstitute und Verbände. Darauf bauen wir auf. Künftig bildet MaxBrain nicht nur Lernmassnahmen ab, sondern auch die Prozesse, die bestimmen, wer was, wann und weshalb lernt: Skill Management, Performance Management, Compliance, Onboarding und Karrierepfade. KI ist dabei kein Zusatzmodul, sondern unterstützt in jedem Schritt: beim Finden passender Inhalte, beim Abgleich von Skills und bei Lernwegen, die sich automatisch anpassen.

Deine Rolle: Als Product Lead machst du aus dieser Vision eine Strategie und aus der Strategie ein Produkt. Du trägst die strategische Produktverantwortung für die MaxBrain SaaS-Plattform. Du entwickelst sie konsequent vom Markt, von Kundenproblemen und vom wirtschaftlichen Nutzen her. Du setzt Prioritäten, reduzierst Komplexität und schaffst Klarheit.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Entwicklungsteam in Kroatien und dem Team in Zürich zusammen, berichtest direkt an den CEO und hast die Perspektive, Teil der Geschäftsleitung zu werden.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Produktvision und -strategie: Du entwickelst die Vision von MaxBrain als People-Development-Plattform weiter und übersetzt sie in eine klare Produktstrategie. Du legst fest, welche Probleme wir für welche Kunden lösen und welche nicht.

  • Markt und Positionierung: Du kennst den L&D- und HR-Tech-Markt im DACH-Raum. Du beobachtest Wettbewerb und Trends und schärfst gemeinsam mit dem CEO unsere Positionierung.

  • Fokussierte Roadmap: Du leitest aus Strategie und Kundenbedürfnissen eine nutzenorientierte Roadmap ab. Du setzt klare Prioritäten und sagst auch Nein. Du reduzierst Komplexität, statt Feature-Listen zu verwalten.

  • Produktmanagement: Du erkennst und validierst Kundenbedürfnisse und triffst daraus klare Produktentscheidungen. Du konzipierst Features im Design-Thinking-Prozess, verantwortest das funktionale und das UX-Design und schreibst klare User Stories.

  • Lernen als strategische Infrastruktur: Du verankerst Lernen in den HR-Prozessen, die bei unserer Kundschaft täglich laufen: Onboarding, Compliance, Jahresgespräche und Weiterbildung. Integrationen in HR-Systeme wie Personio, Abacus oder Microsoft machen die Plattform zur Infrastruktur statt zur Insel.

  • KI als Hebel: Du nutzt KI-Werkzeuge intensiv für Research, Spezifikation, Prototyping und Design. So deckst du mit einem schlanken Setup viel ab und entscheidest schneller und besser.

  • Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest Hand in Hand mit Engineering, Sales und Customer Success. Du schaffst Alignment über Prioritäten und Nutzen.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast einen nachweisbaren Track Record im L&D-, EdTech- oder HR-Tech-Umfeld.

  • Du bringst 5–7 Jahre Erfahrung im Product Management, Product Design oder einer vergleichbaren Produktrolle mit, idealerweise mit einem komplexen B2B-SaaS-Produkt.

  • Du hast eine Produktstrategie entwickelt und umgesetzt. Du hast Produkte oder grössere Features von der Discovery bis zur erfolgreichen Einführung geführt.

  • Du kennst Corporate Learning und People Development. Erfahrung mit LMS, Skill- und Performance-Management oder angrenzenden HR-Produkten ist ein grosses Plus.

  • Du denkst strategisch und arbeitest hands-on. Du sprichst gerne direkt mit Nutzern, strukturierst komplexe Probleme und arbeitest selbstständig mit Design- und Prototyping-Tools wie Figma.

  • Du denkst in Nutzerproblemen statt in Features. Du wägst Kundenwünsche, Marktchancen, Unternehmensziele und Aufwand gegeneinander ab.

  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch (C2) und Englisch (mind. C1). Französisch, Italienisch oder Kroatisch sind ein Plus.

Was wir bieten

  • Eine Kultur, die lebt, was wir verkaufen: Wir lernen selbst jeden Tag dazu, teilen Wissen offen und nehmen «Make Learning Matter» auch intern ernst.

  • Viel Gestaltungsspielraum und direkte Verantwortung für Produktvision, Strategie und Positionierung im Wachstumsmarkt EdTech mit Fokus auf People Development.

  • Die Chance, unsere KI-Strategie von Grund auf mitzugestalten und in wertstiftende Produkte zu übersetzen.

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege, direkter Austausch mit dem CEO und enge Zusammenarbeit mit Customer Success und Entwicklung.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Erreichbarkeit während der Kernarbeitszeiten.

  • Ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit mindestens zwei Tagen pro Woche in unserem Büro in Zürich.

  • Fünf Wochen Ferien und ein fixes Weiterbildungsbudget inklusive bezahlter Weiterbildungszeit.

Interessiert?

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein kurzes Begleitschreiben. Sag uns, warum diese Rolle zu dir passt und wohin du MaxBrain als Produkt entwickeln würdest. Zeig uns gerne an konkreten Beispielen, wie du heute mit KI arbeitest. Wir freuen uns darauf, von dir zu hören.

title: Product Manager - Security
descriptionHtml:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

We’re looking for a Security Product Manager to join our team. Security Product Manager is responsible for conveying the company’s security strengths to customers, partners and the market at large. This includes participating in relevant security partnership initiatives, influencing security positioning and branding, and working closely with internal teams to ensure company’s security posture and security products is communicated effectively to all stakeholders. By combining expertise in compliance requirements with a customer-centric approach, Security Product Manager helps position security as a competitive advantage rather than just an internal obligation. 

Your responsibilities will include: 

1. Product Management 

  • Define the vision and roadmap for Nebius’ security products. 
  • Owning the ideation, postmortem, prioritization, backlog, and customer feedback processes. 
  • Guiding new features, systems and services from inception to launch, while keeping customers at the center of everything. 

2. Customer-facing communications 

  • Lead public-facing communications around security updates or changes in compliance status. 
  • In the event of a security incident, coordinate user messaging (email notifications, press releases, FAQs) with support from the Head of Security Products and CISO. 
  • Gather user feedback on user experience and security to guide continuous improvements. 

 3. Competitive analysis and market research 

  • Conduct ongoing research on industry benchmarks, emerging security standards and technologies, and competitor certifications. 
  • Identify gaps and opportunities in organization’s product security posture; propose strategic initiatives that differentiate the company’s security story in the market. 
  • Stay informed about new regulations or frameworks that may influence future product certifications or transparency requirements (e.g., privacy laws, data sovereignty standards). 

 4. Certification and audit support, service ownership 

  • Collaborate with the CISO office to gather technical evidence or make necessary product enhancements that satisfy certification requirements. 
  • Take ownership of some security-related services of Cloud platform. 
  • Track and maintain a certification roadmap (ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPPA, etc.), working closely with CISO, GRC & Compliance, Corporate Security departments. Communicate timelines, goals and status updates to leadership and sales representatives. 

5. Cross-functional collaboration 

  • Coordinate with multiple Product Managers to align security goals with other product roadmaps, ensuring a consistent narrative between product security and external messaging. 
  • Work with Platform Security, GRC & Corporate Security and legal teams to gather essential information for security products enhancements (e.g., penetration test summaries, compliance reports). 
  • Work with Customer-facing teams to address client inquiries about security posture and guide them on using security features optimally. 

We expect you to have: 

  • 3+ years of Product Management or Program Management experience with a focus on security initiatives. 
  • Basic knowledge of compliance frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR) and familiarity with how they translate into business value. 
  • Proven ability to communicate technical concepts in a clear, customer-friendly manner (e.g., writing content, speaking at webinars or conferences). 
  • Stakeholder management skills to align with other Product Managers, CISO staff, engineering, marketing, and customer-facing teams. 
  • Analytical mindset: comfortable defining success metrics (e.g., security feature adoption, NPS around trust, certification progress) and making data-driven decisions. 
  • Project management skills: demonstrated ability to manage inter-team collaboration within company-wide projects, ensuring timely delivery of cross-functional tasks and alignment with compliance goals. 

It will be an added bonus if you have: 

  •  Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or PMP; prior experience in regulated industries; prior experience working for Cloud Service Provider.

About Nebius

Nebius AI is an AI cloud platform with one of the largest GPU capacities in Europe. Launched in November 2023, the Nebius AI platform provides high-end, training-optimized infrastructure for AI practitioners. As an NVIDIA preferred cloud service provider, Nebius AI offers a variety of NVIDIA GPUs for training and inference, as well as a set of tools for efficient multi-node training. 

Nebius AI owns a data center in Finland, built from the ground up by the company’s R&D team and showcasing our commitment to sustainability. The data center is home to ISEG, the most powerful commercially available supercomputer in Europe and the 16th most powerful globally (Top 500 list, November 2023).  

Nebius’s headquarters are in Amsterdam, Netherlands, with teams working out of R&D hubs across Europe and the Middle East. 

Nebius AI is built with the talent of more than 500 highly skilled engineers with a proven track record in developing sophisticated cloud and ML solutions and designing cutting-edge hardware. This allows all the layers of the Nebius AI cloud – from hardware to UI – to be built in-house, distictly differentiating Nebius AI from the majority of specialized clouds: Nebius customers get a true hyperscaler-cloud experience tailored for AI practitioners. We’re growing and expanding our products every day. 

If you’re up to the challenge and are excited about AI and ML as much as we are, join us!

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

title: Product Marketing Manager (m/f/d)

title: Quadrants: Compiler Lead
descriptionHtml:
What Quadrants is

Quadrants is an open-source translation layer that turns ordinary Python into optimized machine code at runtime, across CPU (Arm64, x86) and GPU (AMDGPU, CUDA, Metal, Vulkan) backends. CUDA is the primary target, with x86 the strong runner-up, especially for real-time simulation. The others drive adoption and support fast prototyping for research.

The ambition is explicit: build the best “Python compiler” in the world for physics and performance-critical numerical computing. We are fully committed to it, and we intend to beat leading alternatives like Nvidia Warp, Numba, or Triton.

It’s a standalone project with its own roadmap, built in the open. Genesis, our physics simulator, is its first and top-priority user, the source of its hardest workloads and its benchmarks. But Quadrants is general-purpose infrastructure for anyone writing performance-critical numerical Python, not an internal tool that happens to be public.

The bet: high-performance code should feel natural to write. Engineers write plain Python in a NumPy or PyTorch style, and Quadrants makes it fast.

The role

You own Quadrants end to end: the API, the IR and lowering, the optimization passes, the numerical primitives, and the roadmap.

Our ultimate objective: engineers write for readability and maintainability, never for performance. They write the version of an algorithm they are most comfortable with, and Quadrants rebuilds it into kernels that run as if an expert had hand-tuned them. Performance is the compiler’s job, not theirs. Getting there is a frontier problem, part research and part engineering, and we intend to define the state of the art on it, relentlessly pushing the limit further.

It calls for two things at once: the low-level GPU and compiler skill to make a single kernel optimal, and the ability to keep the whole system coherent as it grows.

The core tradeoff is settled: usability comes first. When usability and performance collide, usability wins, unless the cost is severe. We will limit what the system supports to go fast (static shapes and fixed-size allocation baked into kernels, say), but never the convenience of the API itself. Experts who want maximum performance and full control over the generated code get lower-level escape hatches, down to inline assembly, C, or PTX.

Your mandate is to build the best open-source Python compiler for physics simulation out there. No limit on what that takes. If it means replacing the entire engine, your call. Either way, you keep Quadrants healthy and unblocking the company in the meantime.

What you’ll own

  • API & authoring experience. The surface that physics and numerical-computing engineers write against, and, as an open-source library, the product’s face to the world. Idiomatic, natural to Python users, never a separate language bolted onto Python. Clean decorators, legible constraints, sharp errors, real escape hatches.

  • IR, lowering & backends. A stable IR that lowers to multiple backends, with room to grow and the door kept open for differentiable simulation. Today the computation graph is expressed through Quadrants’ own constructs. Recovering it automatically from ordinary Python is hard, and a long-term goal rather than today’s reality.

  • Optimization. Turn naive code into strong execution plans: vectorization, register and shared-memory usage, barriers and atomics, cooperative threading, dead-buffer and redundant-traffic elimination, dropping needless synchronization. Move low-level optimization off users and into the platform.

  • Primitives. Cholesky, eigendecomposition, matmul, reductions, solver kernels. Each owned with its correctness, benchmarks, and regression tracking.

  • Watching Genesis and the compiler together. Hunt for performance wins on both sides, in Genesis and in Quadrants itself. Propose API changes that cut duplication, improve readability, and reduce platform-specific special-casing. Less to maintain, more that simply works.

  • The project as a product. Benchmark real workloads, track performance over time, catch regressions early. Stay close to users (Genesis first), find friction and missing abstractions, drive adoption, set direction.

Who you are

You reason about whole systems and have taste for where complexity should live. You measure before you optimize, and you reach for memory traffic and launch overhead before FLOPs. You have opinions about API design. You write tests and benchmarks as you go, not afterward.

The ground that judgment stands on:

  • GPU. What optimal looks like and why: access patterns, registers, shared memory, barriers, atomics, threading. CPU intuition a plus.

  • Python & API taste. Idiomatic Python. A feel for what’s natural to Python users. APIs that free users rather than constrain them.

  • Compilers. The path from authoring to kernels (IR, lowering, optimization), weighed against maintainability.

And how you work: proactive and largely self-directed. You fetch context across the company instead of waiting for it. You’re comfortable talking to the engineers who use what you build, and at ease designing in the open for users you’ll never meet. Ready to grow into leading a small team (a couple of people, near term).

What great looks like

People adopt Quadrants from outside Genesis. Engineers write clearer code with less boilerplate. Kernels keep getting faster. Performance is tracked, not guessed. The architecture gets easier to extend, not harder.

What we’re uncompromising about

How you work is up to you. What matters is that your ownership grows over time: blind spots shrink, the parts you can vouch for expand, technical debt goes down, the core stays sound.

That takes treating understanding as real work, not overhead. You read and challenge the codebase instead of just stacking features on it. You take nothing you did not write for granted. You watch the competition and what’s coming next, and you bring it in and ship it.

Use AI agents if they help. They are productivity tools, not code owners. You are.

Du testest den Prozess von Anfang bis Ende, dokumentierst jeden Schritt mit Uhrzeit und Screenshot und markierst die Stellen, an denen etwas hakt oder unklar bleibt.

Vor jedem Auftrag bekommst du eine Anleitung mit Schritten, Zeitrahmen und den Fragen, die am Ende beantwortet sein müssen. Kein Rätselraten, kein Vertrieb, keine Kaltakquise. Getestet wird auf deinem eigenen Gerät, in deiner Nähe.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Digitale Produkte testen: App, Website oder Online-Prozess einmal vollständig durchlaufen – von der Anmeldung bis zum Abschluss.
  • Abläufe vor Ort prüfen: in Filialen, Shops oder Servicestellen, mit Blick auf Wartezeit, Beratung und Abwicklung.
  • Auffälligkeiten festhalten: Screenshot machen, Uhrzeit notieren, in zwei bis fünf Sätzen beschreiben, was passiert ist.
  • Bericht einreichen: die vorgegebenen Fragen beantworten, Dauer je Schritt angeben, Ergebnis knapp zusammenfassen.
  • Nachfragen beantworten: wenn das Team zu einem Befund etwas wissen möchte, kurz und sachlich antworten.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du bist mindestens 18 Jahre alt.
  • Du hast ein Smartphone oder einen Laptop mit Internetzugang – Geräte für App- und Website-Tests stellst du selbst.
  • Du drückst dich in klaren, verständlichen Sätzen aus und arbeitest sorgfältig.
  • Du hältst Termine ein und meldest dich, wenn etwas nicht klappt.

Das brauchst du nicht

  • Kein Studium, keine Ausbildung in einem bestimmten Bereich, kein Führerschein.
  • Keine eigene Firma, keine Anmeldung beim Finanzamt.
  • Keine Kosten – weder für die Bewerbung noch für die Ausrüstung.

Vergütung pro Auftrag

Feste Pauschale je abgeschlossenem Auftrag, gestaffelt nach Umfang. Ausgezahlt wird monatlich, sobald der Bericht abgenommen ist – unabhängig davon, wie lange du gebraucht hast.

Richtwerte. Das konkrete Honorar steht in jedem Auftrag, bevor du ihn annimmst. Die Pauschale ist so bemessen, dass der gesetzliche Mindestlohn für die aufgewendete Zeit nicht unterschritten wird.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Faire Pauschale – bis zu 49 € pro Auftrag, monatlich ausgezahlt, ohne Provision und ohne Abzug.
  • Anstellung statt anonymer Crowd – Arbeitsvertrag und feste Ansprechperson statt Bewertungsplattform.
  • Minijob oder Teilzeit – Minijob bis zur Geringfügigkeitsgrenze (2026: 603 € monatlich), Teilzeit bis 20 Stunden pro Woche.
  • Flexible Einteilung – du sagst, wann du Zeit hast; keine festen Schichten.
  • Klare Vorgaben – jede Aufgabe mit Anleitung, Zeitrahmen und den Fragen für den Bericht.
  • Persönliche Begleitung – im Panel erreichst du deinen Supervisor direkt, ohne Ticket-System.
  • Kurzer Weg – Bewerbung in etwa zehn Minuten, Rückmeldung meist innerhalb von zwei Werktagen.

So läuft die Bewerbung

  1. Zehn Fragen beantworten (etwa 5 Minuten) – online, ohne Anmeldung, ohne Lebenslauf.
  2. Persönliche Daten eintragen – Name, Anschrift, Geburtsdatum, Kontaktdaten.

  4. Arbeitsvertrag digital unterschreiben – Minijob oder Teilzeit.
  5. Onboarding im Panel – kurze Einführung, danach die ersten Aufträge.

Gut zu wissen

  • Keine Provision: bezahlt wird der abgeschlossene Auftrag, nicht die Anzahl gefundener Fehler.
  • Keine Vorkasse, keine Kaution, kein Verkauf an Freunde oder Familie.

title: Quantitative Analyst Intern
descriptionHtml:
Talos: Institutional Fabric for the Digital Asset Market

Founded in 2018, Talos provides institutional-grade trading technology for the global digital asset market, powering many of the major players in the crypto ecosystem. Our mission is clear: to advance the mass adoption of digital assets by seamlessly connecting institutions to the digital asset ecosystem. We are committed to building the most innovative and trusted platform in the world, supporting the entire trading lifecycle.

At Talos, you’ll find an environment that champions kindness and respect, values diverse perspectives, and upholds inclusivity at every turn. We believe every member of our team brings invaluable insights and abilities that drive Talos forward. In our pursuit of excellence, we foster a culture of trust, integrity, collaboration, and mutual growth.

We are a tight-knit yet globally distributed team of highly experienced engineers and business leaders, with hubs in New York, London, Singapore, and Cyprus. Whether in-office or remote, you’ll be part of a hybrid-friendly environment where your unique talents and insights will play a crucial role in building something extraordinary.

Quantitative Analyst Intern

As a Quantitative Analyst Intern, you will support our team in analyzing trading and proprietary data, and helping produce quantitative models that drive the decision making behind our quantitative execution offerings. You will assist in producing quantitative signals, impact models, and analyze Talos unique trading datasets to support improvements of the trading products and beyond.

You will work alongside experienced team members, including product owners, quantitative analysts, and managers who will provide guidance and mentorship. This role offers excellent exposure to quantitative trading technology and will provide hands-on experience with financial markets data analysis. You'll gain practical experience while working with experienced professionals in the field.

This is a 12-week internship running from June 1, 2027 to August 27, 2027 for NYC based candidates. Compensation for this role will be $50/hr for NYC candidates.

Want to learn more about Talos’s engineering culture? Check out Sonic, our first open-source project which allows Talos to achieve microsecond network stack latency in Go: https://github.com/talostrading/sonic

Responsibilities

Quant Modelling

  • Assist in analyzing trading data, proprietary intraday signals, to produce quantitative execution alphas

  • Help create bespoke analytics visualizations using Talos data to illustrate trading patterns and execution insights

  • Learn to use internal tools and systems for data analysis

Quantitative Execution Algorithms

  • Work with Talos quants upon quantitative strategies that utilize execution alphas to drive trading decision making

  • Help gather and organize data related to trading algorithm performance

  • Learn about market microstructure and best execution practices

Business Support

  • Assist in preparing quantitative content for client meetings, presentations and academic research reporting

  • Work with the  Quant strategies to backtest real-world trading features for the pleasure of top leading crypto firms in the space

Qualifications

  • Graduating class of 2029 pursuing a Masters or Doctorate degree in Computer Science or related field

  • Programming Skills: Advanced proficiency in Python, with hands-on experience in data science libraries (especially pandas) and a strong understanding of dataframe architecture for data manipulation, transformation, and analysis. Familiarity with Python-based data visualization tools is a plus.

  • Database and Query Languages: Experience with SQL, including constructing and optimizing complex queries for large datasets; experience with BigQuery or other cloud-based querying platforms is a strong advantage.

  • Computational Finance: Exposure to computational finance concepts, with familiarity in using quantitative methods and tools for finance-related applications.

  • Statistics and Data Analysis: Strong statistical knowledge, including probability distributions, hypothesis testing, and data sampling methods. Ability to apply statistical analysis techniques to analyze financial data.

  • Mathematics and Machine Learning: Solid foundation in mathematical principles, including linear algebra and calculus, with a focus on regression analysis. Exposure to machine learning and deep learning algorithms and methods in the presence of sparse data, including common imputation approaches. .

  • Portfolio Optimization: Knowledge of portfolio optimization methodologies, specifically the Markowitz risk-return models is a plus.

  • Local to New York HQ or our London office

title: Regional Vice President, Commercial - Northern Europe
descriptionHtml:
About Us

At LangChain, our mission is to enable every company to own its intelligence. We believe agents will transform how companies operate, and we're building the foundation to make that future possible. Our open-source harnesses and LangSmith platform give developers and enterprises the infrastructure to run, improve, and govern agents at scale.

We've raised $460M to date, with our most recent funding round valuing the company at $3B, backed by leading investors including Sequoia, Benchmark, IVP, and CapitalG. As we continue to expand our platform and tackle some of the hardest challenges in agent engineering, every team member has the opportunity to make a meaningful impact and help shape both our technology and the future of the industry.

More than 7,000 organizations rely on LangSmith, from fast-growing startups to Fortune 500 enterprises, including NVIDIA, Bridgewater, LinkedIn, Workday, and Rippling. We're just getting started on making high-performing agents easier to build and manage at scale.

About the role

We're hiring a Regional Vice President within EMEA to own and lead our Northern European Commercial business. You'll inherit a team of four quota-carrying Commercial AEs across the region and be responsible for building the management layer, operating model and partner ecosystem that takes Northern Europe from early traction to consistent, scaled revenue.

This is a Director-level hire with second-line ambition. You'll report directly to the VP EMEA and operate with meaningful autonomy across pipeline, hiring, partner relationships and executive engagement.

 

What you'll own

Team leadership and performance

  • Lead, develop and expand the Commercial Sales teams across Northern Europe from day one

  • Run weekly pipeline reviews, deal coaching sessions and forecast calls with precision and consistency

Revenue

  • Own the Northern European regional number: quarterly and annual quota attainment across the commercial segment

  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline that supports consistent delivery and predictable forecasting to VP EMEA and leadership

  • Engage directly in strategic deals as executive sponsor, bringing credibility and commercial weight to negotiations

  • Establish the region's strongest lighthouse accounts across key industry verticals, building referenceable wins that anchor LangChain's market position in EMEA

Hiring

  • Manage multiple open roles across Northern Europe simultaneously: owning the full hiring lifecycle across pipeline, assessment and closing

  • Partner with the retained search firm and internal talent team to move at pace without compromising on quality

  • Define the headcount profile for Northern Europe beyond Q1 and feed into H2 planning, ensuring the team is built ahead of the revenue curve

Partner ecosystem

  • Owns hyperscaler and GSI/RSI relationships (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, and key SIs) across Northern Europe

  • Develop a structured partner motion that generates qualified pipeline and supports deal acceleration, reduces risk and drives expansion

  • Represent LangChain at partner QBRs and executive engagements in region

Market presence

  • Represent LangChain as a keynote-ready leader at partner events, customer engagements, and industry conferences across the region

  • Build LangChain's brand with technical buyers, CIOs and innovation leaders across EMEA's most important commercial accounts

  • Bring intelligence on the Northern European market back to the VP EMEA and product teams to inform roadmap and go-to-market positioning

 

What we're looking for

Experience

  • 8+ years in commercial SaaS sales, with at least 3 years in a regional or sub-regional leadership role managing quota-carrying AEs

  • Demonstrable track record of hitting and exceeding regional revenue targets across multiple quarters

  • Experience managing teams across multiple countries and time zones, with the cultural intelligence to operate across the Northern European region

  • Background selling to technical buyers (engineering leaders, CTOs, platform teams): you understand how developer tools get evaluated and adopted

  • Experience in the AI, data, or developer tooling space strongly preferred; familiarity with the LangChain ecosystem is a meaningful plus

Leadership

  • You've run teams of 6+ AEs before and know the difference between managing and coaching

  • You can hold a forecast conversation with a VP and a deal coaching session with an AE in the same afternoon and add value in both

  • You hire well and fast. You know what good looks like for commercial AE profiles and you can run structured hiring processes across four open roles simultaneously

  • You've built or contributed to a partner motion before: you understand what "partner pipeline" means in practice, not just in theory

Operating style

  • You bias toward action. You don't wait for a playbook to be handed to you: you build it

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and early-stage scale. This is not a role with a fully defined motion; you'll shape a significant part of it

  • You communicate clearly and directly, to your team and to leadership

title: Enterprise Account Executive - EMEA
descriptionHtml:

Founded in 2020 by two former CFOs, we’ve grown into a global team of 100+ people across 30+ nationalities. Headquartered in New York, we have offices in Toronto and Barcelona. We’re trusted by industry leaders such as Dish Networks, Strava, BetterUp, Kajabi, JG Wentworth, Abridge, Cortex, and hundreds more.

We have raised over $100m, closing in June 2025 our $60M Series B, led by Scale Venture Partners, with the strong participation of Cathay Innovation, Y Combinator, Atomico, Creandum, and angel operators from Adyen, Zapier, and Twitch.

Our mission is ambitious and we can’t do it alone - join Abacum as we build the future of Business Planning!

We are looking for...

An enterprise seller who already knows the Office of the CFO. You've carried a number selling planning, EPM, FP&A or finance software. You know how a CFO buys, how a steering committee stalls, and how to get a multi-stakeholder deal signed.

At Abacum you'll own a named territory of enterprise and upper mid-market accounts across EMEA. Many of them run legacy planning tools or spreadsheets that can't keep up with the business. Your job is to show them a better foundation, and win.

- Work with Solutions Engineering, Product and Leadership to shape deals, and feed what you hear in the market back into the roadmap

What we need...

- 6+ years of quota-carrying B2B SaaS sales, with at least 3 years closing enterprise deals

- Experience selling EPM, FP&A, planning, or other Office-of-the-CFO software (finance, ERP, spend, or data platforms)

Bonus points if you have...

Why sell Abacum

You know the category. Here's why this is the product you want in your bag.

1. A market ready to switch. Finance teams are stuck between rigid legacy planning tools that need a rebuild every time the business changes, and spreadsheets and AI tools no one can trust. Abacum is the governed, AI-native foundation that fixes both. That's a displacement story you can tell in every account.

2. AI that stands up to a CFO. Plenty of vendors claim AI. Ours runs on a governed financial model, so the AI reasons and the math stays exact. CFOs and IT teams can trust the output, and that wins technical evaluations.

3. Faster time to value than legacy EPM. 700+ integrations and self-service data pipelines mean customers see value in weeks, not after a long implementation. That shortens your cycle and makes the business case easy to sign.

4. Channels that bring you deals. Abacum is the only FP&A platform to pass NetSuite's SuiteCloud Developer Network review, is listed on the Sage Intacct Marketplace, and is a verified Microsoft Dynamics 365 partner. Those ecosystems and our implementation partners mean co-sell pipeline, not just cold outbound.

5. A product that keeps getting stronger. New AI skills ship every week. Abacum works where finance already works: Excel, Slack, Claude and ChatGPT, through MCP-native infrastructure. You'll have something new to show every quarter.

6. Funded to win enterprise. Abacum raised a $60M Series B to scale into larger customers. You'll join as we build the enterprise motion, with the room to shape it and grow with it.

What you get

title: Full-Stack Engineer (Backend Leaning) - Payments Engineering
descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

The Payments team owns how ElevenLabs charges customers: billing, usage tracking, pricing and payments across self-serve and enterprise. Everything we do has to be correct, because it underpins the company's revenue and is immediately visible to every customer and team.

We are hiring full stack engineers (backend leaning) to expand and evolve our payments systems. Your responsibilities might include:

  • Building and maintaining usage tracking so that requests are metered accurately without impacting latency.

  • Leading our migration of enterprise pricing and usage processing, including new stream-processing services for usage events.

  • Making it easy for customers to upgrade and pay, including paying through different entities and supporting new payment providers.

  • Working with Finance and Tax teams to meet compliance, audit and reporting requirements.

  • Enabling pricing and Growth experiments with Growth and product teams.

  • Debugging complex customer billing scenarios: piecing together what happened from the customer's experience, logs and code, and fixing the cause.

  • Collaborating with Sales, FDEs, Finance and engineers across the company.

Much of this work extends or replaces systems that already exist, so you will scope carefully, plan migrations, and roll changes out without disrupting customers.

Requirements

We do not require any formal experience, certifications, or degrees. Instead, we are seeking engineers who can show they have solved impressively hard problems, through past projects or GitHub contributions. We do require:

  • Expertise in Python.

  • A strong background in backend development.

  • Experience with common software and system design patterns and infrastructure, including APIs, cloud infrastructure tools, storage solutions and data structures.

  • Strong test design and security fundamentals.

  • Care and attention to detail when changing live systems that handle money.

  • The ability to learn a large existing system quickly and to debug complex production issues.

Bonus:

  • Experience with payment processing providers, or with billing and usage-based pricing systems

  • Experience with stream processing or high-throughput event pipelines.

  • Experience working with finance, tax or audit requirements.

  • Experience with Kubernetes.

Location

Our team is based across the UK, EU and US, and this is our main focus. We are flexible for exceptional candidates elsewhere. You can work remotely, or from our offices in Dublin, London, New York, San Francisco and Warsaw.

title: Principal, Global Campaign Operations
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Principal to lead global campaign operations at Prosci. You will turn Marketing plans for our Individual and Enterprise audiences into consistent, well-built campaigns across regions.

You will own how campaigns are planned, built, tested and measured in HubSpot. You will direct a specialist partner team, and set the standards that let regional marketers move quickly while maintaining quality and governance.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will be our senior Marketing-side expert in campaign operations and HubSpot, setting the operating model, standards and quality bar while directing specialist delivery support. You should be comfortable building and troubleshooting when needed, but your main job is making the whole campaign operation work well at scale.

Requirements

What you will do

  • Partner with Individual, Enterprise and regional Marketing leaders to translate demand strategy into scalable campaign execution
  • Own the end-to-end campaign process, from brief and plan to build, launch, QA and measurement, across email, nurture, webinars, events and landing pages
  • Set global campaign standards, templates and processes that regional teams can use with confidence
  • Act as the senior Marketing expert on how HubSpot is used for campaigns, including audiences, segmentation and automation
  • Direct and quality-check the work of our specialist partner team
  • Define campaign measurement requirements, and make sure every campaign has the right taxonomy, tracking and data structure so Marketing can understand what is working
  • Own Marketing campaign activation across the website, including landing pages, forms, conversion paths and related content updates, working with Digital Experience on platform, development and broader website improvements
  • Identify opportunities to automate, simplify and standardize campaign operations, including appropriate use of AI
  • Work with RevOps on lifecycle, routing and CRM data, and with reporting partners on what needs measuring
  • Enable regional marketers to execute more independently, with clear standards, templates and guardrails


What you bring

  • 7+ years in marketing operations, including campaigns across multiple regions or markets
  • Deep, hands-on HubSpot Marketing Hub experience: workflows, lists, segmentation, email, landing pages and forms
  • A working understanding of how HubSpot and Salesforce connect, and the judgment to know when a problem belongs with the CRM team
  • Experience directing agency or partner teams and holding them to a clear quality standard
  • A strong QA instinct: you catch the issue before it reaches a customer or a report
  • Strong campaign measurement fluency, including tracking, UTMs, attribution concepts and the data foundations required for reliable analysis
  • Clear writing, and the ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical colleagues


Nice to have

  • HubSpot certifications
  • Experience with consent and privacy requirements across regions, including GDPR
  • Experience supporting ABM or BDR-led motions
  • Localization and multilingual campaign experience
  • Practical use of AI tools to automate or speed up campaign work


How you will work with other teams

Revenue Systems owns shared CRM administration and governance. Digital Experience leads the website platform and technical roadmap. Reporting partners own routine reporting delivery. You will work closely with each of these teams to make campaigns effective, measurable and well run.

Your first 90 days

  1. First 30 days: learn the campaign estate, the partner model and regional needs, and see where QA currently catches problems
  1. By 60 days: run the campaign process end to end, and set the briefing and QA rhythm with the partner team

By 90 days: establish the initial global campaign standards, templates and operating rhythm, and agree campaign measurement requirements with Marketing leadership and reporting partners

Work Location: Remote within the US.

Benefits: Through our experience and strategic focus on the people side of change, we know that by taking care of our people, we are taking care of our business. In addition to the compensation detailed above, we offer comprehensive wellness benefits, including generous flexible paid time off, holidays and volunteer time, medical, dental, vision, long-term and short-term disability programs, life insurance, pet insurance, 401k with company matching, and access to LinkedIn Learning. Our “mostly virtual” culture is vibrant with many opportunities to collaborate with colleagues from around the world, get involved in employee-led interest and resource groups, and to meet up with team members at in-person local or market-wide events.

title: Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
Software is not just vital but a strategic cornerstone of our operations. We’re looking for a Product Designer to set the cross-application UX direction for our commercial software - from pharma cold-chain visibility that helps temperature-sensitive medicines move safely around the world, to ULD tracking for airlines. You’ll define a consistent, high-quality experience across our modules and applications and support our specialised designers in bringing that experience to life, while remaining hands-on in discovery, from the first user conversation through to the final UX.

📍 Location: We are open to candidates based anywhere within the UK, Spain, and the Netherlands, with remote working available within these countries. Hybrid option available in the Netherlands.

Founded in Switzerland in 2012, SkyCell is transforming global pharmaceutical supply chains through a combination of advanced temperature-controlled containers, IoT connectivity, and digital solutions.

Our integrated product ecosystem helps leading pharmaceutical companies reduce risk, improve operational efficiency, and ensure the safe delivery of life-saving medicines worldwide.

Today, SkyCell operates at the intersection of hardware, software, data, and logistics - combining Swiss engineering excellence with a growing digital platform to shape the future of connected pharma supply chains.

Why SkyCell?

🌱 Purpose-Driven Work: Make a real difference by contributing to a more sustainable future in global logistics and healthcare.

🚀 Innovation at Heart: Work with cutting-edge technology and be at the forefront of supply chain innovation.

🌎 Stronger together: Join a supportive team of talented individuals from over 40 countries, where we work together every step of the way.

💡 Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in our people – continuous learning and development are key pillars of SkyCell.

🏆 Award-Winning Culture: Join a workplace recognized for its commitment to excellence with a ‘Great Place to work’ award, as well as a Platinum Ecovadis rating highlighting our sustainability and employee well-being.

What You'll Do:

A dedicated framework team owns our Design System and Design Guidelines, while embedded designers craft the screens and flows within each product module. Your role is to set the overall direction for the experience they design towards — including experience principles, end-to-end journeys and measurable outcomes that help multiple modules feel like one product.

You will:

  • Lead discovery end-to-end, including user research and interviews, journey mapping, jobs-to-be-done, pain points and opportunities, and translate research into a shared foundation for UX and product decisions

  • Create wireframes, mock-ups and prototypes hands-on using Figma and/or code to explore and test concepts during discovery, and run evaluative tests with users and engineers

  • Define the cross-application UX vision, design principles and success metrics together with Product and Marketing

  • Support and align our specialised designers - framework and embedded - around a consistent experience across modules and applications

  • Communicate UX principles and investment priorities to senior leadership, demonstrating the value and potential impact of UX-related roadmap items

  • Maintain the UX roadmap and prioritise pattern and design investments with the framework team

  • Produce high-level experience flows and service blueprints that connect journeys across applications and domains

  • Review Design System and module deliverables for alignment with experience strategy and brand

  • Support embedded designers from discovery through to delivery by co-framing problems, reviewing flows against the cross-application blueprint and ensuring continuity across user journeys

  • Set KPIs and use analytics, user research, A/B tests and competitive analysis to inform and refine design decisions

  • Promote a UX culture centred on user needs, inclusive design and accessibility standards such as WCAG across the organisation

  • Collaborate with Marketing on tone, terminology and brand consistency across products


What You'll Bring:

  • Degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

title: Product Manager, Agent Platform
descriptionHtml:
Meet Siena

Siena is the Agent of Record for CX, built for consumer brands like Spanx, FIGS, Brooklinen, and Grüns.

It runs as a connected multi-agent stack on top of a shared intelligence layer: agents that sell, support, listen, handle social and voice across the entire customer journey, turning every conversation into signal you can act on.

The team

We are a small, fully distributed, global team. We have built leverage into how we work, which is what lets a team this size move at the speed we do.

We hire athletes. Everyone here owns real outcomes, defaults to writing over meetings, communicates with directness, and acts the moment they see something worth acting on. Low ego, high standards, fast clock.

If you want to set the bar rather than follow one, keep reading.

The Role

Siena runs customer experience for consumer brands through a connected multi-agent stack. As Product Manager, Core Agent Platform, you'll own the platform those agents run on, from its current capabilities to where it goes next. You'll own how we measure, test and improve agent performance, and how customers see it. You'll work directly with engineering, deployment and customers, and you'll be expected to build as well as specify.

What You'll Do

  • Own the core agent platform end to end, including the roadmap and the day-to-day product decisions.

  • Build and ship the evaluation, testing and monitoring systems that make agent performance measurably better over time.

  • Design and run structured experiments and A/B tests across agent workflows.

  • Give customers clear visibility into how their agents are performing.

  • Prototype your own ideas with coding agents, and ship them where you can, rather than waiting on a hand-off.

  • Work with customers and our deployment team to understand what's working in the field and turn it into product.

Who You Are

The Bar: If you're missing any of these, this isn't the role for you.

  • 3+ years as a PM in CX, ecommerce, helpdesk or AI automation.

  • Technical fluency: you can explain how webhooks, OAuth and integrations work and have made product decisions around them.

  • AI-native builder: you use tools like Claude, Cursor or v0 daily and have prototyped your own product ideas with them.

Strong Signal: Not dealbreakers, but what separates a good hire from a great one.

  • You've run structured experiments or A/B tests and can say what the data did and didn't tell you.

  • You've built dashboards or visibility features people actually relied on.

  • You're confident with customers: you've sat in on calls, run demos, and know what end users really complain about.

  • You act like the CEO of your product area: strong opinions, and a habit of building and talking to customers without being asked.

Nice to Have: Bonus, not required.

  • Engineering background, or you've shipped production code yourself.

Not a Fit If:

  • You wait to be told what to build.

  • You want a narrowly scoped PM seat with a fixed roadmap handed to you.

  • You're not comfortable being customer-facing or getting on a call to demo your own work.

  • You'd rather stay behind the product than own the messy, ambiguous parts.

  • You need a designer or engineer to turn your product vision into something people can click.

Why Siena?

Real ownership. You will own problems, not tasks, with the autonomy to solve them your way and the trust to do it without a manager in your inbox.

Work that ships and matters. What you build reaches real consumer brands fast.

A category we are creating. The Agent of Record is new ground, with unsolved problems and cutting-edge models, not a crowded field to compete in.

A team that respects your judgment. Globally distributed, async-first, low bureaucracy. We hire adults and treat you like one.

Great salary plus equity or stock grants. Own a piece of what you build.

Learning budget. If you are growing, so are we.

AI-fluency by default. Few places will push your work with production AI further or faster.

Our values

The people who thrive here are curious, customer-obsessed, and take ownership without being asked. They fix problems first and explain later. They're direct about feedback - both giving and receiving it - because they care more about getting things right than being polite.

They maintain high standards while moving at startup speed, and they build real relationships with teammates because they know that's how great work gets done. When things get tough, they adapt and keep pushing forward.

Our approach to AI

The people who thrive here treat AI like a natural extension of themselves. They've built their own ecosystem of agents - some for research, others for debugging, writing, analysis, or writing code. They know which AI works best for what problem.

Everyone gets premium accounts (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity Pro, Cursor, Lovable) plus a quarterly budget for new tools. But the magic happens in how we share knowledge. Demo days where someone shows off a clever workflows. Slack threads about which model handles a specific use case better. Learning from each other's AI workflows.

At Siena, we're not just looking for people who can do a job. We're looking for people who want to break boundaries, create the future, and reshape industries. If that's you, we look forward to your application.

How we hire

We use AI-assisted screening tools as part of our hiring process. All decisions are made by humans. You can request a human-only review at Siena provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

title: Research Staff, Voice AI Foundations [UK - Remote]
descriptionHtml:
Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

The Opportunity

Voice is the most natural modality for human interaction with machines. However, current sequence modeling paradigms based on jointly scaling model and data cannot deliver voice AI capable of universal human interaction. The challenges are rooted in fundamental data problems posed by audio: real-world audio data is scarce and enormously diverse, spanning a vast space of voices, speaking styles, and acoustic conditions. Even if billions of hours of audio were accessible, its inherent high dimensionality creates computational and storage costs that make training and deployment prohibitively expensive at world scale. We believe that entirely new paradigms for audio AI are needed to overcome these challenges and make voice interaction accessible to everyone.


The Role

As a Member of the Research Staff, you will pioneer the development of Latent Space Models (LSMs), a new approach that aims to solve the fundamental data, scale, and cost challenges associated with building robust, contextualized voice AI. Your research will focus on solving one or more of the following problems:

  • Build next-generation neural audio codecs that achieve extreme, low bit-rate compression and high fidelity reconstruction across a world-scale corpus of general audio.

  • Pioneer steerable generative models that can synthesize the full diversity of human speech from the codec latent representation, from casual conversation to highly emotional expression to complex multi-speaker scenarios with environmental noise and overlapping speech.

  • Develop embedding systems that cleanly factorize the codec latent space into interpretable dimensions of speaker, content, style, environment, and channel effects -- enabling precise control over each aspect and the ability to massively amplify an existing seed dataset through “latent recombination”.

  • Leverage latent recombination to generate synthetic audio data at previously impossible scales, unlocking joint model and data scaling paradigms for audio.  Endeavor to train multimodal speech-to-speech systems that can 1) understand any human irrespective of their demographics, state, or environment and 2) produce empathic, human-like responses that achieve conversational or task-oriented objectives.   

  • Design model architectures, training schemes, and inference algorithms that are adapted for hardware at the bare metal enabling cost efficient training on billion-hour datasets and powering real-time inference for hundreds of millions of concurrent conversations.

The Challenge

We are seeking researchers who:

  • See "unsolved" problems as opportunities to pioneer entirely new approaches

  • Can identify the one critical experiment that will validate or kill an idea in days, not months

  • Have the vision to scale successful proofs-of-concept 100x

  • Are obsessed with using AI to automate and amplify your own impact

If you find yourself energized rather than daunted by these expectations—if you're already thinking about five ideas to try while reading this—you might be the researcher we need. This role demands obsession with the problems, creativity in approach, and relentless drive toward elegant, scalable solutions. The technical challenges are immense, but the potential impact is transformative.


It's Important to Us That You Have

  • Strong mathematical foundation in statistical learning theory, particularly in areas relevant to self-supervised and multimodal learning

  • Deep expertise in foundation model architectures, with an understanding of how to scale training across multiple modalities

  • Proven ability to bridge theory and practice—someone who can both derive novel mathematical formulations and implement them efficiently

  • Demonstrated ability to build data pipelines that can process and curate massive datasets while maintaining quality and diversity

  • Track record of designing controlled experiments that isolate the impact of architectural innovations and validate theoretical insights

  • Experience optimizing models for real-world deployment, including knowledge of hardware constraints and efficiency techniques

  • History of open-source contributions or research publications that have advanced the state of the art in speech/language AI


Ideal Researcher Profile

An ideal researcher, as evidenced by the recurring themes across these foundational papers, excels in five key areas: (1) Statistical & Mathematical Foundations, (2) Algorithmic Innovation & Implementation, (3) Data-Driven & Scalable Systems, (4) Hardware & Systems Understanding, and (5) Rigorous Experimental Design. Below is a synthesis of how each paper highlights these qualities, with references illustrating why they matter for building robust, impactful deep learning models.



1. Statistical & Mathematical Foundations

Mastery of Core Concepts

Many papers, like Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models and Neural Discrete Representation Learning (VQ-VAE), reflect the importance of power-law analyses, derivation of novel losses, or adaptation of fundamental equations (e.g., in VQ-VAE's commitment loss or rectified flows in Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers). Such mathematical grounding clarifies why models converge or suffer collapse.

Combining Existing Theories in Novel Ways

Papers such as Moshi (combining text modeling, audio codecs, and hierarchical generative modeling) and Finite Scalar Quantization (FSQ's adaptation of classic scalar quantization to replace vector-quantized representations) show how reusing but reimagining known techniques can yield breakthroughs. Many references (e.g., the structured state-space duality in Transformers are SSMs) underscore how unifying previously separate research lines can reveal powerful algorithmic or theoretical insights.

Logical Reasoning and Assumption Testing

Across all papers—particularly in the problem statements of Whisper or Rectified Flow Transformers—the authors present assumptions (e.g., "scaling data leads to zero-shot robustness" or "straight-line noise injection improves sample efficiency") and systematically verify them with thorough empirical results. An ideal researcher similarly grounds new ideas in well-formed, testable hypotheses.


2. Algorithmic Innovation & Implementation

Creative Solutions to Known Bottlenecks

Each paper puts forth a unique algorithmic contribution—Rectified Flow Transformers redefines standard diffusion paths, FSQ proposes simpler scalar quantizations contrasted with VQ, phi-3 mini relies on curated data and blocksparse attention, and Mamba-2 merges SSM speed with attention concepts.

Turning Theory into Practice

Whether it's the direct preference optimization (DPO) for alignment in phi-3 or the residual vector quantization in SoundStream, these works show that bridging design insights with implementable prototypes is essential.

Clear Impact Through Prototypes & Open-Source

Many references (Whisper, neural discrete representation learning, Mamba-2) highlight releasing code or pretrained models, enabling the broader community to replicate and build upon new methods. This premise of collaboration fosters faster progress.


3. Data-Driven & Scalable Systems

Emphasis on Large-Scale Data and Efficient Pipelines

Papers such as Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision (Whisper) and BASE TTS demonstrate that collecting and processing hundreds of thousands of hours of real-world audio can unlock new capabilities in zero-shot or low-resource domains. Meanwhile, phi-3 Technical Report shows that filtering and curating data at scale (e.g., "data optimal regime") can yield high performance even in smaller models.

Strategic Use of Data for Staged Training

A recurring strategy is to vary sources of data or the order of tasks. Whisper trains on multilingual tasks, BASE TTS uses subsets/stages for pretraining on speech tokens, and phi-3 deploys multiple training phases (web data, then synthetic data). This systematic approach to data underscores how an ideal researcher designs training curricula and data filtering protocols for maximum performance.


4. Hardware & Systems Understanding

Efficient Implementations at Scale

Many works illustrate how researchers tune architectures for modern accelerators: the In-Datacenter TPU paper exemplifies domain-specific hardware design for dense matrix multiplications, while phi-3 leverages blocksparse attention and custom Triton kernels to run advanced LLMs on resource-limited devices.

Real-Time & On-Device Constraints

SoundStream shows how to compress audio in real time on a smartphone CPU, demonstrating that knowledge of hardware constraints (latency, limited memory) drives design choices. Similarly, Moshi's low-latency streaming TTS and phi-3-mini's phone-based inference highlight that an ideal researcher must adapt algorithms to resource limits while maintaining robustness.

Architectural & Optimization Details

Papers like Mamba-2 in Transformers are SSMs and the In-Datacenter TPU work show how exploiting specialized matrix decomposition, custom memory hierarchies, or quantization approaches can lead to breakthroughs in speed or energy efficiency.


5. Rigorous Experimental Design

Controlled Comparisons & Ablations

Nearly all papers—Whisper, FSQ, Mamba-2, BASE TTS—use systematic ablations to isolate the impact of individual components (e.g., ablation on vector-quantization vs. scalar quantization in FSQ, or size of codebooks in VQ-VAEs). This approach reveals which design decisions truly matter.

Multifold Evaluation Metrics

From MUSHRA listening tests (SoundStream, BASE TTS) to FID in image synthesis (Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers, FSQ) to perplexity or zero-shot generalization in language (phi-3, Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models), the works demonstrate the value of comprehensive, carefully chosen metrics.

Stress Tests & Edge Cases

Whisper's out-of-distribution speech benchmarks, SoundStream's evaluation on speech + music, or Mamba-2's performance on multi-query associative recall demonstrate the importance of specialized challenge sets. Researchers who craft or adopt rigorous benchmarks and "red-team" their models (as in phi-3 safety alignment) are better prepared to address real-world complexities.



Summary

Overall, an ideal researcher in deep learning consistently demonstrates:

  • A solid grounding in theoretical and statistical principles

  • A talent for proposing and validating new algorithmic solutions

  • The capacity to orchestrate data pipelines that scale and reflect real-world diversity

  • Awareness of hardware constraints and system-level trade-offs for efficiency

  • Thorough and transparent experimental practices

These qualities surface across research on speech (Whisper, BASE TTS), language modeling (Scaling Laws, phi-3), specialized hardware (TPU, Transformers are SSMs), and new representation methods (VQ-VAE, FSQ, SoundStream). By balancing these attributes—rigorous math, innovative algorithms, large-scale data engineering, hardware-savvy optimizations, and reproducible experimentation—researchers can produce impactful, trustworthy advancements in foundational deep learning.




Foundational Papers

This job description was generated through analysis of the following papers:

  • Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision (arXiv:2212.04356)

  • Moshi: a speech-text foundation model for real-time dialogue (arXiv:2410.00037)

  • Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers for High-Resolution Image Synthesis (arXiv:2403.03206)

  • Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models (arXiv:2001.08361)

  • BASE TTS: Lessons from building a billion-parameter Text-to-Speech model on 100K hours of data (arXiv:2402.08093)

  • In-Datacenter Performance Analysis of a Tensor Processing Unit (arXiv:1704.04760)

title: Rust Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Rust Engineer

Location: Berlin and surrounding

At Deepslate, we are building Speech to Speech Voice AI models that sound and act indistinguishably from a human. And we believe everyone should be able to use them.

With its endless languages, dialects, accents, subtle intonations, and speech melodies, voice remains a highly complex unsolved frontier.

That is exactly why we started Deepslate.

Backed by top-tier investors from the Tech and AI sectors, as well as a major German VC fund, we are incredibly well-funded and moving fast.

We are building the future of communication.

We aren't trying to build another standalone platform; instead, we are the intelligence engine powering countless other applications. Whether it's integrated as a module by a CRM provider, plugged into another Voice AI platform, or directly embedded into an enterprise system by our integration partners, our model is built to work wherever it is needed.

Your Role

Many core parts of our model stack are written in Rust. At the heart of it is our inference engine, written entirely in Rust.

Your mission is to build and improve these systems. You will work on the inference engine, take ownership of other Rust projects, and help decide how everything fits together. We need someone who enjoys writing good Rust code and can design software that stays understandable and maintainable as it grows.

Our models need to respond in real time. The software you build will directly influence how fast and reliable they are in an actual conversation.

What You'll Do

  • Build in Rust: Develop our inference engine and other core components of the model stack. Take projects from the first architectural decisions to running in production.

  • Design the Architecture: Decide how components and services communicate, where responsibilities belong, and how we can extend the system without making it harder to work on.

  • Work on Real-Time Systems: Build async Rust systems that handle concurrent workloads and streaming audio with low latency.

  • Improve Performance: Find bottlenecks, understand what's causing them, and improve latency, throughput, and resource usage.

  • Write Production-Ready Code: Build software that we can test, debug, and operate reliably. Help improve our tooling, documentation, and development practices along the way.

What We're Looking For: Must-Haves

  • Strong hands-on experience with Rust, including ownership, borrowing, composition, and idiomatic Rust design patterns.

  • Solid experience with async Rust. You know how to structure concurrent applications and deal with synchronization, cancellation, and backpressure.

  • Experience building and working with microservice architectures.

  • A true startup mindset: You are comfortable navigating the glorious chaos of an early-stage codebase. Inconsistent structures, missing docs. You name it, you'll help fix it.

  • Drive and Vision: You aren't just looking to blindly process Jira tickets. You want to actively shape the product, architect solutions, and take complete project ownership.

Ideally, You Also Bring

  • Knowledge of actor systems and experience using actors to structure concurrent applications.

  • Experience with real-time systems, whether in embedded environments or the cloud. Both are relevant to us.

  • Experience with C/C++ interoperability, including generating Rust bindings with bindgen.

  • German, spoken and written.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with CUDA or GPU computing.

  • Contributions to open-source projects.

  • Python knowledge.

  • Experience with lower-level performance engineering, such as debugging memory leaks or understanding performance at the machine instruction level.

What We Offer

  • Technical Ownership: Our Rust stack is central to the company. You'll have the trust and freedom to make architectural decisions and see them through.

  • True R&D Freedom: We give you the time, resources, and trust to research and build technology that simply doesn't exist yet. There are difficult problems here, and room to try different approaches.

  • Competitive Compensation: We are well-funded by top-tier VCs. We offer a highly competitive salary. We are looking for top talent, and we are ready to pay for it.

  • Serious Compute: You will have access to the hardware and cloud infrastructure necessary to build, test, and optimize the systems running our models.

Deepslate is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic origin, religion, disability, age, or sexual orientation.
