title: Sales Manager, AI
descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🏡 Where you'll fit in:

We need a commercially sharp sales leader who can take ownership of growing Kraken’s Agentic Customer Service business globally. Someone who can decide where we focus, lead the team, shape our biggest deals and make sure growth translates into profitable, contracted revenue.

They would lead both the Principal Engagement Managers and any future sales hires, setting the direction across winning initial deployments and expanding clients into broader adoption. They need to see the whole business while staying close enough to the detail to intervene where it matters.

🧠 What you’ll bring to the party:

Commercial judgement needs to be their strongest quality

They naturally question the economics of a deal: what the customer is committing to, what we are charging, what it costs us to deliver and how the margin changes as usage grows. They understand how conversation volumes, channel mix, implementation effort, partner costs and contractual commitments fit together.

They can defend our value and negotiate firmly while maintaining a strong customer relationship. Discounts, additional scope and flexible terms are deliberate decisions with a clear return. They recognise when a large headline number hides weak commitments, expensive delivery obligations or an agreement that will be difficult to scale.

They are comfortable working through contracts with Legal and Finance, taking ownership of the commercial decisions and knowing when an issue needs escalation.

They have an agentic background and ideally a utilities background

They need to have sold agentic AI before ideally to large scale customers for enterprise software.

We have identified that a weakness in the wider AI team is an understanding of how agentic translates into real life issues encountered by utilities. This hire would ideally also have a utilities background to ensure both credibility with clients and that we do not become Sierra 2.0.

They can turn customer interest into a buying decision

They can sit with a CEO, COO or CFO and explain what Agentic Customer Service could change about their business, what that change is worth and what it will take to achieve it.

They challenge business cases and distinguish measurable value from optimistic assumptions. They also understand the power of humans and why certain AI needs to remain in the hands of humans to maintain their excellence.

They consistently bring conversations back to who will decide, what budget is available, what evidence is needed and what the customer is prepared to commit to.

They lead capable people and raise their performance

Their team should gain clear direction, strong coaching and useful challenge from this person. They set expectations across qualification, account strategy, negotiation, forecasting and expansion, with clear ownership between the roles.

They can inspect a deal and identify where the team needs help: an absent economic buyer, an unconvincing business case, a weak negotiation position or an expansion opportunity nobody is actively pursuing. They develop the team’s judgement while personally leading the situations that need their seniority.

They make the organisation work around the opportunity

Much of the reality is aligning Sales, existing Account Teams, Product, Delivery, Legal, Finance and Sierra. This person builds trust across those groups and gets clear decisions when priorities conflict.

They protect Kraken’s commercial position within the Sierra partnership, including customer ownership, costs, responsibilities and the route to scale. They also ensure customer commitments reflect what Product and Delivery can support, challenging constraints and securing resources where the opportunity justifies it.

They bring focus and follow through

They can choose which accounts deserve attention, where senior involvement will make a difference and which opportunities should wait. Their forecasts stand up to scrutiny, and they spot slippage early.

They are comfortable with an evolving product and incomplete information. They ask good questions, make decisions and follow through until there is a clear outcome.

title: Senior Agronomist - Digital Agronomist Products (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
The team at Klim is building the operating system for regenerative agriculture. We help farms restore their soil - and turn that into real, measurable business value for the food companies, banks and insurers who depend on it.

We’re a Berlin-based agritech startup backed by $22M in Series A funding, partnering with global food leaders such as Nestlé and ADM to build supply chain resilience through regenerative agriculture. Since 2020, we’ve supported +4,000 farmers managing over 900,000 hectares.

Join our incredible team of 80+ dedicated people across Germany, the UK, Poland and Czechia to help build a more sustainable, resilient food system and drive real climate impact.

Your mission:

You are responsible for translating regenerative agricultural expertise and science in arable farming systems in temperate climates into actionable, scalable digital products for farmers on Klim's platform.

You ensure that Klim’s digital products are agronomically sound, farmer-relevant, commercially viable and delivered with high quality.

Your responsibilities:

  • Own the agronomic logic behind farmer-facing recommendations and assessments - cover crop mixes, tillage transitions, rotation changes, nutrient decisions - and judge whether a given recommendation makes sense for a given soil, location and goal.

  • Translate agronomy into buildable products. Turn agronomic principles into clear product and engineering specifications.

  • Bring empathy to the farmer’s context into our products. What is going on around our product for the farmers, what data are accessible and reasonable to ask for, what value we can deliver back to famers.

  • Act as a sparring partner to product, design and modelling. Challenge assumptions, find the gaps in our thinking, and say when an approach won't land with a farmer.

  • Challenge models and outputs against field reality. You dig into the numbers, spot what doesn't add up, and explain why a result contradicts what you would expect from experience.

  • Think like the farm owner, not just the agronomist. Tell us where farmers will hesitate, what proof they'll ask for, and what makes the change worth it to them, in money and beyond.

  • Own and review agronomic datasets, literature, and assumptions used in digital products.

  • Contribute to roadmap and prioritization decisions based on farmer value, willingness to pay, partner value, technical feasibility, and strategic relevance.

  • Support farmer validation through interviews, feedback analysis, test cases, and field-reality checks.

  • Support expansion into new regions by working out how farming systems differ and what that means for our recommendations.

Your profile:

  • You have 5+ years of experience in farm management, agronomic advisory, farm business consultancy, or a comparable role where you carried responsibility for real decisions on real farms.

  • You have a solid academic background in agronomy, agricultural sciences, or a related discipline. A strong practical track record can stand in its place.

  • You have strong, hands-on experience in open-field arable systems (cereals, oilseeds, root crops) in temperate Europe.

  • You have a deep understanding of regenerative arable farming, including soil health, nutrient management, crop rotations, cover crops, tillage, and reduced-input systems.

  • You have proven hands-on farm economics experience. You have built an investment case alongside a farmer and know which arguments actually convince, and which don't.

  • You combine regenerative conviction with practical judgment. You believe in regenerative impact and know what farmers will realistically adopt: no evangelism, no greenwashing.

  • You are interested in technology. You have used farm software, and follow what is happening in the space and believe in the potential but also see the issues.

  • You can find your way around a spreadsheet or a set of performance figures and spot where the logic breaks.

  • You have a creative spark. Given a half-formed idea, you improve it rather than only evaluate it.

Languages

  • Fluent English and fluent German. Most of our farmers are German, and you will be talking to them, reading their feedback and reviewing German farmer-facing copy. Experience of the German market is a strong advantage.

Your benefits:

  • Opportunity: Be part of our journey from the very beginning, working on an equal footing with the leadership team to build a new company.

  • Impact: Make a daily and active contribution to combating climate change, promoting consumer education, and fostering fair conditions for our climate-conscious farmers.

  • Autonomy: Take ownership of your projects and enjoy a high degree of creative freedom.

  • Flexible work model: At Klim, we foster a flexible, hybrid work approach and facilitate remote work (within the EU). It is advantageous for this role if you live in Berlin or can be present in our office regularly.

  • Additional benefits for Germany-based employees: We offer a subsidy for a membership in Urban Sports Club or the Deutschlandticket, a company pension scheme, plus team lunches (if based in Berlin) and regular team events.

At Klim, we believe that a thriving workplace is built on the diverse backgrounds, talents, and perspectives of our team. We grow stronger together by embracing and building on each individual’s unique strengths.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. All hiring and personnel decisions are made solely based on qualifications, performance, and the needs of the company - ensuring fairness and equal opportunity for all.

If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. You might be the perfect fit for our team in ways you don’t yet realise!

title: Senior AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Codat

Codat is an advisory intelligence solution purpose-built for modern commercial banking. Through rich, specialized data, forward-looking insights, and integrated workflows, Codat empowers banking teams to deepen their relationships, grow their revenue, and simplify their day-to-day work.

Founded in 2017 and backed by JPMorgan, PayPal, Amex, Plaid, and Shopify, Codat has successfully powered over 350,000 connections to business customers’ financial systems — and is trusted by industry leaders to turn scattered information into actionable, strategic advantages in real time, every time.

The Role

Some of the biggest commercial banks in the world already work with us. Their relationship managers would rather spend time with clients than dig through the books to find out what's changed. We're building this for them.

We're building the Advisory Intelligence Platform. It puts Codat's client intelligence inside the assistant a banker already uses, starting with Microsoft Copilot. A banker can ask it anything about a client and get an answer from that client's actual books. If they don't ask, it tells them anyway when something important changes, and suggests what to do.

It's a senior role and a hands-on one. Bankers make real decisions based on what the assistant says, so impressing people in a demo isn't enough. It has to be right. Codat is AI-first, not AI bolted onto SaaS, and we work that way ourselves, with agents handling the repetitive work so engineers can focus on the hard problems. You'll build what you design and look after it once it's live, and you'll have a real say in where we take it.

What You'll Work On

  • The reasoning layer. What goes into the model's context, which tools it calls, and when it should break a question into steps. Every number it gives has to trace back to a source, and it needs to know when to say it doesn't know. That last part is harder than it sounds.

  • Evals. You'll build the eval sets and harness, and do the analysis that tells us whether a change made the assistant better or just different. When a banker corrects an answer, that correction becomes a new test case.

  • Model choice and token economics. Which model should handle which job, and what that costs us per answer. Caching or a smaller model is often enough. For some questions a banker needs the strongest model available, and that's worth paying for.

  • The semantic and signal layers. You'll work on both with the data engineers. That means the definitions the model is allowed to use, and the signals that spot when something changes for a client. How the model uses them is down to you.

  • The agents and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers behind the assistant. This covers the tools the assistant can call, including the ones that will eventually let it draft that email. You'll work out how they break, and add the tracing we need to see what happened inside an answer.

  • Classical modelling where it beats an LLM. Anomaly detection, peer benchmarks, classifiers. Sometimes the best answer is a simple statistical model, not an LLM.

You'll Probably Have

  • Shipped LLM features that people actually used, and been the person they came to when something broke. You've designed how a model works with tools or structured data, and there are things you'd do differently now.

  • Built evals for your own work, and probably had one mislead you. We'd like to hear what you changed.

  • A feel for numbers, whether that comes from a quantitative degree or from your work. You want the denominator before you believe a percentage, and you notice when a headline figure is really about the mix of the data.

  • Opinions about models that come from using them. You've chosen between models on how well they did and what they cost, and you know when a classical model would do a better job.

  • Good engineering habits in Python or another general-purpose language. That means tested, modular services rather than notebooks. Strong SQL as well, and some experience with CI/CD, Docker, cloud (we're on Azure) and tracing for LLM systems.

  • Led work without having the title. People followed an approach you set because you made the case with evidence, and you can explain the trade-offs to someone who isn't technical.

  • AI as part of how you work, for research and prototyping as well as code.

  • Useful, not essential: fintech, lending or accounting; Spark or Databricks; semantic layers or metric views; fine-tuning.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We're more interested in what you've built and how you knew it worked than in a perfect match.

How We Work

We're a small team with plenty to do. Things move fast: we'd rather ship something useful and improve it than polish it in private. What you build is yours from start to finish.

There's no return-to-office mandate, and you can work hybrid or fully remote. We trust you to be around when the team needs you and to deliver what you said you would. What we don't want is anyone staying online late to prove a point.

Compensation: £98K – £120K • Offers Equity

The User Experience team is the origin point of adjoe Ads. Everything the system knows about a user, every prediction the ML models make, every bid placed in an auction. It all starts with code this team ships.

The team owns two responsibilities. On the SDK side, a native Kotlin and Swift code runs inside hundreds of publisher apps. It participates in 120 million daily auctions, renders ad creatives across multiple formats, and captures the behavioral signals that power 50 billion predictions per day. The constraint that defines this work: you're executing inside someone else's app, on someone else's device, with zero tolerance for instability. Every ad impression has to feel native and fast to the user.

On the analytics side, the dashboards, investigation tools, and data frameworks that turn raw data into decisions: real-time revenue performance across active campaigns, infrastructure cost visibility, and data quality assessments. If a number matters to the business or to engineering, this team makes it accessible.

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For:

  • Kotlin & Android Internals Expertise: You will own the core development and optimization of the adjoe Ads SDK, which runs inside hundreds of publisher apps. We are looking for someone with 8+ years of Android experience (or 3+ years specifically in SDK/library development) who works primarily with Kotlin and has a deep understanding of Android lifecycles, ProGuard/R8, and multithreading to ensure zero tolerance for instability on millions of devices.

  • High-Performance Network Design: You will collaborate with backend teams to design APIs and capture behavioral signals that power 50 billion daily ML predictions. You need a strong track record in API design, maintaining strict backward compatibility for thousands of external integrators, and working with high-performance networking protocols like gRPC, Protobuf, Wire, and OkHTTP.

  • Resource-Constrained Optimization: You will ensure every ad impression feels native and fast while participating in 120 million daily auctions. You must know how to design for minimal footprint, optimizing battery impact and memory usage, as your code executes directly inside someone else’s app and device.

  • Data-Driven Observability: You will monitor, debug, and maintain SDK reliability at scale across millions of global users. You will leverage observability and data tools—including Sentry, Kibana, and AWS (S3, QuickSight, Athena)—to track errors, investigate SDK behavior, and turn raw data into clear engineering decisions.

  • Build Automation & Delivery: You will maintain and improve our CI/CD pipelines to guarantee efficient, reliable SDK delivery. This requires hands-on experience with Gradle and GitLab CI to automate the testing, building, and packaging of our mobile libraries.

  • Plus – AdTech & Low-Level Systems: It is a major plus if you bring experience in ad-tech or programmatic advertising (aligning products with IAB specifications). Additionally, experience with NDK/JNI (C/C++ interop on Android) or parallel iOS development experience is highly valued to help support our cross-platform ecosystem.

🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team.

What’s in It for You?

At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

  • Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries.

  • Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum.

  • Be Direct. Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams.

  • Thrive Together. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other.

  • Have Fun. Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy.

We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company.

title: (Senior) B2G Manager: Public Sector & Research Funding (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
“This is not your typical B2G role.”

B2G sounds boring, until you realise it's money from the state and you own it. You'll be responsible for a big share of RIZM's funding sources, with real influence on RIZM's cash flow and on how fast we grow. You'll be tapping into new sources that most companies never even look at.

Why this role exists

RIZM builds RIZMO, an AI agent that makes energy decisions for industrial companies. Our next lever is the public sector: municipalities, utilities and economic development agencies have to implement heat plans, keep business parks competitive and relieve the grid. We're looking for someone to own B2G as a business line at RIZM, from public funding all the way to municipalities as paying customers.

What you'll own

  • Public funding as a growth channel. Forschungszulage (Germany's R&D tax allowance), EU grants, ERDF (EFRE) and other programmes: build the pipeline, actively own and track our running programmes, forge consortia and get applications approved.

  • Connect research. Coordinate our research collaboration with Stanford and translate it into funded projects.

  • Build the machine, AI-first. Set up your own systems, tracking and automation, so one person can run a funding pipeline that usually takes a whole team. You decide how the role works behind the scenes.

  • Take over and scale ReNET-EV. Own our part of the ERDF project ReNET-EV (grid-friendly energy supply for business parks in the Münster/NRW region) and roll the model out to more municipalities.

  • Turn municipalities into customers. Win cities, municipal utilities and economic development agencies that use RIZM for heat planning, climate strategy and business park development. Set up offers and procurement routes for the public sector.

  • Orchestrate the ecosystem. Bring chambers of commerce (IHKs), economic development agencies, utilities and industry partners together in joint projects.

  • Build the data foundation. Tap into public and municipal data that makes our models more precise at regional level.

  • Create visibility. References with municipalities and mayors that show publicly what's happening in their region.

  • Leadership. Over time, build a small B2G team, including working students.

You're a fit if you

  • Have several years of experience in the public sector, politics, municipal utilities, economic development agencies, associations or funding management.

  • Have successfully won funding (EU, federal, state) or led consortia.

  • Know how municipalities make decisions and buy, and have a strong network in NRW or beyond.

  • Understand energy transition topics such as municipal heat planning, grid congestion and flexibility.

  • Think like an entrepreneur and see public funding as a path to a business case.

  • Are curious about AI and enjoy building your own tools and workflows.

  • Speak business-fluent German and bring good English for EU programmes.

What we offer

  • A business line you build from scratch, with a direct line to the management team.

  • Real financial leverage: what you win shows up directly in RIZM's cash flow.

  • A product already running at industrial customers like BMW and BSH.

  • Salary plus equity.

How to apply

No cover letter needed. We'd rather hear how you think. Two questions, a few honest sentences each:

  • A mayor gives you 5 minutes in an elevator. What do you tell them about RIZM?

  • What's the most absurd hurdle you've hit in public funding or procurement, and how did you get around it?

title: Senior Business Development Manager Europe (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Odys

At Odys, we’re mobilizing power, with Hybrid Power Systems developed for aerospace and in-demand everywhere. It’s the kind of mission diversity that demands a fresh way of thinking.

We began with an early bet on hybrid, when the mobility industry was focused on batteries. We designed, tested, and validated our first 1 MW high-speed generator in 12 months. And then we pushed further, developing systems with greater power density in less time. Today, our Hybrid Power Systems offer outputs ranging from 20 kW to 4 MW, with applications in the air or on the ground.

One of those applications is Laila, an unmanned drone designed for critical logistics and defense missions. With its 100 kW-class onboard Hybrid Power System, Laila can support medical cold-chain transport or serve as an aerial platform for counter-UAS measures.

The market interest has been overwhelming: Over 30 inbound requests from leading US and global manufacturers, and 14+ DoD contracts.

Our team comes from deep tech and aerospace, with backgrounds spanning drone and aircraft development, high-volume production, and electrified mobility.

We operate with urgency and ownership at every level. We validated high-speed generator technology faster than our peers, not because we skipped steps, but because we've been doing this long enough to know which ones matter most.

Creating the future of power, in the air and on the ground, is a challenge we’ve been training our entire lives for. If that sounds like you, this is the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

 

About The Role

Odys Aviation is seeking a senior business development manager for Europe. Your role is to turn European interest in Odys into signed contracts across aircraft, certification services, and power systems. The role sits with Odys Aviation GmbH in Munich, our European entity, reports to the GmbH Managing Director, and works integrated with our business development team in the US.

The targets are set: first revenues by mid-2027, and 25% of the GmbH cost covered from its own revenues by the end of 2027. Your pipeline secures our growth beyond 2028: Growth of the GmbH, and growth of the Odys group. Every Euro you bring in builds the GmbH: site, test facility, Design Organisation Approval, and jobs.

This is a hands-on role in a lean environment. You directly own your numbers, not a team, and no layers. There is no established European sales organization to inherit. You start from our current leads to get first tangible projects, you open new doors, and you run each deal yourself: From the first call, through technical alignment involving our experts, to negotiation, to the contract ready to sign, to continuing key account support of the customer.

You bridge two worlds: US startup speed and the way European customers decide and buy. You are Odys' boots on the ground in Europe. You balance quick wins with deals of real impact, and you secure the group resources your contracts need.

Don't meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Odys, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.

What You'll Do

  • Convert our current European leads into signed contracts for aircraft, certification services, and power systems

title: Senior Commercial Counsel
descriptionHtml:
Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

Opportunity:

We’re looking for an exceptional commercial lawyer to join our lean, high-impact legal team as our second commercial lawyer. This role is for someone who thrives at the intersection of law and business strategy — a deal-maker with sharp instincts, sound judgment, and genuine excitement about what Deepgram is building and how we are changing what is possible with speech.

Our legal team has a real seat at the table. You’ll close deals that matter, shape legal strategy at the frontier of AI, and craft commercial frameworks that are being built for the first time in this space. You’ll also help establish a legal function that scales with a company on a steep trajectory, reporting directly to our AssociateGeneral Counsel (Commercial). This role will be based in the UK/EU and will play a lead role in supporting our growing UK/EU and APAC business, including our expanding presence in the UK, EU, India, Australia, and Singapore.

This is a role for a builder.

What You’ll Do

  • Structure, negotiate, and close enterprise sales and partnership agreements, along with supporting a range of other commercial deals (including vendor and services agreements, data licenses, and marketing arrangements)

  • Serve as a trusted partner to our sales and business development teams, helping them move faster and smarter

  • Bring customer empathy to every negotiation, understanding the businesses we serve well enough to craft agreements that close faster and hold up longer

  • Design and implement scalable legal processes — standardizing deal terms, building templates, and streamlining the path to signed agreement

  • Provide clear, practical guidance on privacy, intellectual property, data security, and AI-specific legal issues as they arise

  • Navigate cross-border commercial and regulatory issues across the UK/EU and APAC and structure appropriate data transfer mechanisms (SCCs, adequacy decisions, BCRs) for our voice data processing

  • Stay ahead of the evolving legal landscape for AI technologies and their impact on customers, translating developments into actionable guidance for our teams

  • Roll up your sleeves on the full breadth of legal issues that come with being a fast-growing startup

You’ll Love This Role If You

  • Value working with leadership that has tenure and a track record of success, along with A Players as cross-functional partners

  • Get energized by building systems from scratch and establishing foundational practices

  • Are very practical in addressing legal issues and allergic to unnecessary friction

  • Have an abiding spirit of idealism about your chosen profession — you’re not just closing deals, you’re building something that matters

  • Have a point of view on what good lawyering looks like and a healthy sense of humor about everything else

It’s Important To Us That You Have

  • JD, LLM, or equivalent law degree/qualification from an accredited institution and 5–12 years of experience in legal practice (or more), in-house, at a firm, or both

  • Demonstrated strength in commercial transactions internationally, particularly across UK/EU and APAC markets, across enterprise deals, partnerships, and other strategic relationships

  • Fluency in the issues that matter most to us: IP, privacy, data security, and data licensing. A successful candidate will have depth of experience in at least some of these areas, and a willingness to learn the rest.

  • Practical experience with data protection regimes relevant to our footprint and with structuring cross-border transfer mechanisms

  • Recognize that law is about the grey areas, and are comfortable living in them, while giving clear and actionable advice.

  • Exceptional writing — precise, plain, and compelling

It Would Be Great if You Had

  • Experience helping a high-growth startup scale its sales motion — you know what good looks like and how to build legal infrastructure that accelerates rather than slows the business.

  • Hands-on experience with commercial and legal issues in the AI space

  • Prior experience supporting a U.S.-headquartered company’s commercial expansion into the UK/EU and/or APAC

We read cover letters! If you want to stand out: Tell us about your strategy for effectively closing deals, or how you’ve used AI to increase the impact of your work

title: Senior Configuration Manager (All Genders)
descriptionHtml:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

A solution- and results-oriented team in a supportive environment, focused on continuous knowledge building to remain constantly high-performing, competitive, and pioneering. Operating at the core of Systems Engineering, this growing team connects hardware development, software, and production to ensure absolute product traceability and design integrity across fast-paced defense programs.

YOUR MISSION

You own configuration management for our unmanned systems, from the first baseline to the unit in the customer's hands. You set and hold the baselines, run change control with the engineering teams, and keep every drawing, document and software release traceable to the product it describes. You join a new configuration management team in Systems Engineering that is growing, with room for you to take on more responsibility.

The role sits between systems engineering, hardware and software development, production, quality and logistics support. Our products move from design iteration to series production quickly and under the scrutiny of defence customers and authorities, so you build configuration management that holds up in a customer audit and keeps pace with engineering.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

Configuration management governance

  • Own the configuration management plan and process in line with SAE EIA-649C, ISO 10007 and STANAG 4427, and tailor them per product and customer.
  • Teach engineers to raise, assess and close changes themselves, so you are not needed at every step.
  • Work closely with engineers so their work meeting configuration standards.

Identification and baselines

  • Define configuration items, part numbering and product structure in our PLM system.
  • Establish the functional, allocated and product baselines at the design reviews and keep them under control.
  • Keep the as-designed, as-planned and as-built configuration traceable for every serial number.

Change control

  • Sit on the change control board as the configuration authority and run the review of engineering change requests.
  • Assess every change for its impact on drawings, documents, manuals, training material and safety assessments.
  • Track change actions to closure, so no outdated drawing or document reaches production or the field.

Status accounting and audits

  • Release the configuration item data list at each baseline and keep status accounting current.
  • Build up functional and physical configuration audits with Production and Quality.
  • Keep the configuration record ready for customer and authority audits at any time.

Documentation and data release

  • Own the document management system: document lifecycle, sign-off and revision control.
  • Work closely with technical authors, and write documentation yourself where needed.
  • Release the engineering bill of materials to Production and track which document revision each customer holds.
  • Release technical data packages to customers and partners.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • 5+ years in configuration management in defence, aerospace or space.
  • You have run or sat on change control boards and handled engineering change requests with impact analysis.
  • You have set baselines, kept status accounting and run configuration audits.
  • Hands-on experience with an enterprise PLM or document management system such as 3DEXPERIENCE, Teamcenter, Windchill or SAP.
  • Working knowledge of SAE EIA-649C and ISO 10007.
  • A technical degree in engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • English at C1 or above.

NICE TO HAVE

  • German at C1 or above.
  • Experience in systems engineering or system safety.
  • Experience writing technical documentation, ideally to S1000D, or preparing technical data packages.
  • Experience with unmanned aerial systems or loitering munitions.

If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English. We're looking forward to meeting you!

SECURITY CLEARANCE

Due to the nature of our work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain the appropriate security clearance required for this position. Details will be provided during the recruitment process.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

We are looking for more great people to join our Digital and Strategy practice; new colleagues with a passion for a high-performance culture, problem solving, enabling growth and delivering value through the use of technology to help CIOs deliver cost effective, positive and tailored user and customer experiences.  
  
Our industry growth along with our continued progressive geographic expansion means that we can offer our employees great progression and development across a diverse range of engagements.  

We’re looking for someone who can contribute to the success of the D&T Technology Strategy team and help build new capabilities, particularly around digital strategy, where technology connects with customer experience and engagement. You will be helping our clients transform their organisations, deploy new business models, optimise their IT spend, source better, improve ways of working, comply with regulation and exploit new digital technologies such as XaaS, cloud, artificial intelligence or the internet of things.  
  
As well as spending time with our client’s teams to understand their strategy and technology concerns, you will be working with our subject matter experts across industry and technology sectors to ensure we bring our cutting edge thinking and expertise to our clients.  

What you will be doing

  • Manage technology workstreams for M&A, post-merger integration (PMI), and separation programmes.
  • Lead the delivery of sustainable technology initiatives, while managing project teams, risks, and client relationships.


Your skills and experience

  • Exposure to strategic-sourcing, outsourcing, offshoring and/or supplier optimisation
  • Commercially minded, with previous experience of business cases
  • Awareness of business goals and how they can be enabled through technology and digital
  • Experience of transitioning from legacy end of life systems to modern, resilient frameworks and architectures
  • Hands-on delivery focus as well as strategy
  • Growth driven mindset to help build trusted client relationships and develop new opportunities
  • Passionate about people and practise development
  • Experience in ITIL and SIAM is preferred
  • Experience of M&A, PMI and separation activities, including technology due diligence would be welcomed   

What a career at Baringa will give you 


Putting People First.

Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include: 

  • Generous Annual Leave Policy: We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service. 
  • Flexible Working: We know that the ‘ideal’ work-life balance will vary from person to person and change at different stages of our working lives. To accommodate this, we have implemented a hybrid working policy and introduced more flexibility around taking unpaid leave.

title: Senior Controls Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Voor onze afdeling Controls Engineering in Gorinchem zijn we per direct op zoek naar een ervaren Senior Controls Engineer voor het programmeren van de aansturing van onze nieuwste voedselproductie lijnen voor onze klanten van het merk Tromp uit Gorinchem. Dit betreft een full time functie, met veel afwisseling en hulp van betrokken teamgenoten om de meest slimme/ efficiënte besturingsoplossingen te bouwen.

Ontwerp en programmeer jij graag de nieuwste deegverwerkingsmachines van AMF Bakery Systems? Step dan in als Senior Controls Engineer! Heb je ervaring als software, controls of mechatronica engineer in machinebouw, ben je vertrouwd met programmeren in structured text en ben je bekend met Siemens besturingstechniek? Hecht je aan betrokken en slimme collega's waarmee je samen 'state of the art' voedselproductielijnen ontwerpt, programmeert en bouwt? Super, dan zijn we op zoek naar jou!

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Maandsalaris tussen €4.00,00 en €5.800,00 o.b.v. 40 uur; afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring, excl. toeslagen

  • Reiskostenvergoeding (€0,25 / km); vitaliteitsbudget tot €25,00 netto per maand en een zeer goede pensioenvoorziening (PME)

  • Flexibele werktijden, deels thuiswerken mogelijk

  • Vakantiegeld 8%

  • CAO Metalektro waaronder 27 vakantiedagen en 13 adv dagen per jaar

  • Winstdeling, afhankelijk van de winst betreffende het jaar, tot max. €2.000,00

  • Uitstekende opleidingsmogelijkheden zodat jouw vakkennis up to date is en blijft

  • Werken in een enthousiast en innoverend team

  • Informele werksfeer, teamuitjes, vrijdagmiddagborrel

  • Alle ruimte om te groeien in je functie afhankelijk van jouw ambities

Wat ga je doen:

  • Ontwikkelen / programmeren, configureren en integreren van software van onze machines (PLC + HMI). We passen veel techniek toe van Siemens en Allen Bradley.

  • Testen op locatie Gorinchem (IO, netwerk, drives, functioneel)

  • Softwarematig helpen met voorbereiden van productielijnen voor de FAT

  • Inzetten van jouw software expertise voor ondersteuning van Assembly, Buitendienst en aan klanten bij complexe software gerelateerde issues

  • Incidenteel naar de klant voor ondersteuning van commissioning van nieuwe productie lijnen

  • Als onze software expert werk je intensief samen met Electrical en Mechanical engineers, collega's van Sales, Projectmanagers, Assembly Engineers etc. Je bent dan vraagbaak en neemt besluiten mbt onze software oplossingen.

  • Bijdragen aan het continue verder verbeteren van onze technische controls oplossingen conform onze Markel Business aanpak

  • Helpen met verder standaardiseren van onze software oplossingen van onze product portfolio van het merk Tromp in Gorinchem.

  • Je werkt zelfstandig aan jouw projecten


  • HBO Elektrotechniek, Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar, of ROC Mechatronica niv 4 met ruime ervaring

  • Gedegen kennis van en ervaring met Siemens Tia Portal en of Allen Bradley Studio 5000

  • Kennis van hogere programmeertalen (vb. Structured text of VBA)

  • Teamplayer, pragmatisch en leergierig

  • Communicatief vaardig (goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal)

In wat voor bedrijf kom jij te werken?

Bij AMF Bakery Systems ben je onderdeel van een hechte en trotse groep collega’s die wereldwijd bijdraagt aan het succes van industriële bakkerijen. Wat ons verbindt, is onze drive om te innoveren én onze zorg voor de wereld om ons heen. Zo ontwikkelden wij samen de eerste industriële oven op waterstof – een grote stap richting een duurzamere toekomst.

We werken met ruim 220 collega’s in Nederland – vanuit Gorinchem, Amersfoort en Nieuwleusen – en maken deel uit van de internationale Markel Food Group. Binnen AMF voelt iedereen zich thuis: of je nu op kantoor werkt, in de werkplaats of bij de klant op locatie. We geloven dat we samen sterker zijn als iedereen zich welkom, gehoord en gewaardeerd voelt.

Diversiteit en inclusie zitten dan ook in ons DNA. We staan open voor mensen met verschillende achtergronden en ideeën, omdat we weten dat juist die mix leidt tot slimme oplossingen en sterke teams. Jij hoort erbij – precies zoals je bent.

Samen bouwen we aan iets groters dan alleen machines. We bouwen aan een toekomst waarin we samen kunnen groeien, leren en impact maken.

The team

We are the Credit and Commercial Strategy team with a goal to drive intelligent decision-making and pricing strategy by applying advanced statistical analytics to a wealth of data. At the heart of the Risk function, our focus is to deliver high-quality instant decisions and pricing strategies for our customers around the world.

Risk team is a global team covering Portfolio Analytics, Credit and Commercial Strategy, Underwriting and Collections. We're on a mission to grow Liberis into the world's leading embedded business finance provider, and we're looking for a Senior Credit & Commercial Strategy Analyst to help us make that happen!

The role

You'll design world-class decisioning and pricing strategies that deliver value to both our customers and Liberis. This is your chance to work on diverse projects that aim to fund as many customers as possible while staying within our risk appetite and to help us achieving our ambitious commercial goals.

We're looking for someone with experience in an analytical role who can use data to solve business problems, influence decision-making, and deliver meaningful commercial insights.

What you’ll get to do:

  • Shape lending decisions: Analyse application data and portfolio performance to recommend changes to eligibility, acquisition, pricing and credit decisioning strategies.
  • Develop and test strategies: Design and evaluate credit and pricing policies that help us fund more businesses while managing risk and supporting profitable growth.

  • Monitor performance: Own and improve monitoring of decisioning rules, model performance and portfolio outcomes, including as new products and partners launch. Investigate changes and recommend action.

  • Make better use of data: explore new and existing data sources; work with predictive models to improve lending decisions, propose features with our Machine Learning team, and contribute to model validation and governance.
  • Turn analysis into action: Build clear proposals, explain assumptions and trade-offs, and present recommendations to senior risk and business leaders.
  • Work across the business: Represent Risk and partner with Risk, Product, Commercial, Technology and partnership to put strategies into practice and assess their impact

The interview process:

  • Screening call with the Talent Team (30 mins)
  • Video interview with the Hiring Manager (45 mins)
  • Task based interview (1 hour)
  • Interview with the wider Risk Team (30 mins)

What we think you’ll need:

  • Hands-on analytical experience, with examples of projects you've owned and recommendations that have informed business decisions.
  • Strong SQL and Excel skills, with the ability to investigate data, check its reliability and turn findings into practical recommendations.
  • Experience in one or more relevant areas, such as lending risk management, credit decisioning, acquisition strategy, pricing, commercial analytics or applied data science.
  • Sound judgement when weighing commercial opportunities against potential risks, with a willingness to challenge assumptions.
  • The ability to explain complex findings clearly and adapt your communication to different audiences.
  • A proactive, autonomous approach, with attention to detail and the confidence to ask for support when needed.
  • An appetite to understand how machine learning models are developed.
  • Python, GCP and experience with visualisation tools such as Looker, Power BI or Tableau would be helpful, as would exposure to predictive model development, validation or monitoring.

What happens next?

Next steps If this opportunity feels like the right fit for your next career move, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Senior CRM Executive - Lifecycle
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the team

This position will be part of the central CRM & Ops team, composed of 18+ specialists, dedicated to driving and executing global strategic initiatives to grow and retain our New Customer base. Collectively, the team is targeted on growing orders, expanding our subscriber base, improving engagement metrics to retain Deliveroo customers. Serving as the voice of the customer, the CRM & Ops team does this by enhancing personalised user experiences, activating best-in-class campaigns, and putting relevancy at the heart of everything. 

The Role

As a Marketing Manager within the Lifecycle CRM & Ops team you are the voice of Deliveroo when speaking with our customers across the globe. You'll operate under a hybrid work model, spending a minimum of three days a week at our London HQ.

Reporting into the Senior Marketing Manager on the New Customer squad, and working closely with stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Global CRM, Marketing Promotions, and Data Science, You’ll be a technical, commercially minded CRM marketer who is hands-on in the tooling: building Lifecycle journeys, setting up experiments and audiences, and configuring promotions and in-app merchandising. You’ll have end-to-end ownership of the New Customer Lifecycle, from journey design and build through to measurement and ROI. You’ll also use personalisation and AI to make journeys more relevant. Your primary focus will be on creating customer-centric journeys that are highly relevant, using the right channels at the right time to deliver meaningful business impact, while working with local markets as you scale your initiatives internationally. 

What you'll be doing

  • Collaborate with multiple stakeholders to support growing the new customer base by combining data-driven insights with CRM best practice to initiate and deliver programs internationally 
  • Build and configure multi-channel journeys (email, push, in-app), including audience logic, triggers, testing and QA
  • Design and build multi-variant Lifecycle experiments
  • Create promotions for new customer acquisition and retention, ensuring accurate setup, targeting and tracking
  • Manage in-app merchandising placements, working with Product and Marketing Promotions
  • Deliver personalisation at scale, and test where AI can improve content and efficiency
  • Own operational delivery, optimisation, reporting of campaigns and weekly trading
  • Proactively monitor and report on campaigns to stakeholders & propose/manage changes and optimisations where necessary
  • Collaborate with the New Customer Lifecycle Manager and Marketing Promotions teams to develop the global CRM new customers lifecycle strategy
  • Collaborate with stakeholders on key projects to create and implement test strategies that optimises performance of new & existing campaigns
  • Be comfortable with data targeting, segmentation & analysis - pulling it, manipulating it and interpreting it, whilst using marketing technology to help achieve customer touchpoints faster and more efficiently than ever before
  • Drive innovative ideas and solutions in response to business and customer needs
  • Provide regular communication with stakeholders, such as the central marketing team, product and engineering teams and local markets, to ensure workloads & deadlines are managed efficiently (we love Slack channels for everything)
  • Conduct post campaign reporting, pulling out the most interesting lessons and using these to guide your future ideas

Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree (Marketing or Business preferred) or strong relevant experience
  • A minimum of 3+ years CRM experience
  • Can work in a fast-paced environment and prioritise workload
  • Attention to detail and campaign deadlines are adhered to, maintaining high standards of accuracy
  • Highly computer literate with:
    • HTML familiarity (ability to understand where changes need to be made)
    • Liquid logic 
  • Technical knowledge in CRM automation development
  • Good communication skills and ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders groups
  • Data visualisation tools & reporting experience (Looker preferred)
  • CRM deployment experience (Braze or similar is a plus!)

Why Deliveroo

Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.

Workplace & Benefits

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits in areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific, please ask your recruiter for more information..

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. title: Senior Customer Solutions Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Life at Plume

At Plume, we believe that technology isn't about moving faster, it's about making life's moments better. Which is why we've built the world's first, and only, open and hardware-independent service delivery platform for smart homes, small businesses, enterprises, and beyond. Our SaaS platform uses WiFi, advanced AI, and machine learning to create the future of connected spaces—and human experiences—at massive scale.

We now deliver services to over 60 million locations globally and have managed over 3 billion devices on our platform. We're expanding rapidly, pioneering a new category, and we achieved our Series F funding in just four years. Our customers include many of the world's largest Internet Service Providers (ISPs) who look to Plume to help them evolve their smart home offerings while gleaning insights from their own data.

With a bias for action and a love for being trailblazers, the team at Plume embodies a combination of relentless curiosity and imaginative innovation. We challenge ourselves to think in ways that other companies don't, work to do what should be done (rather than what can), and if we can't do it exceptionally well, we don't do it. It's how we've assembled a team of world-class builders, thinkers, and doers. And it's how we're reinventing what's possible every day.

Plume is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Senior Customer Solutions Engineer to join our dynamic team. As a key technical advisor, you'll work directly with Internet Service Providers (ISPs), acting as the bridge between their business needs and our cutting-edge solutions. You'll play a crucial role in the sales process, from initial discovery to successful deployment, ensuring our partners achieve maximum value from our products.
This is a fantastic opportunity for a technically adept individual with a passion for networking, cloud, and AI who thrives in a customer-facing role.

Responsibilities
  • Technical Trusted Advisor: Engage with ISPs to deeply understand their technical and business requirements, and then effectively demonstrate how Plume's solutions can meet and exceed those needs.
  • Product Demos & Trials: Conduct compelling product demonstrations and manage complex proof-of-concept (PoC) and field trials, showcasing the tangible benefits of Plume's technology.
  • System Integration: Collaborate with our internal Customer Engineering, Product Management, and Operational teams to understand and deliver Plume's solutions within a customer's ecosystem. You'll work to integrate our solutions into their existing BSS/OSS, CRM, ticketing, and AI platforms using APIs and other integration methods.
  • Sales Enablement: Work closely with the sales organization to drive revenue, achieve sales quotas, and contribute to the overall growth of the business.
  • Presentations & Events: Prepare and deliver high-impact presentations, including Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), and represent Plume at industry events and conferences.
  • Product Development Input: Provide valuable feedback to our product and engineering teams based on customer requirements and market trends, helping to inform the development of new features and solutions.
  • Technical Support: Offer prompt local and remote technical support for PoCs, lab trials, and deployment ramp-ups, ensuring a smooth and successful customer journey.
  • Industry Expertise: Continuously research and stay up-to-date on the latest industry standards and emerging technologies in networking, cloud architectures, and AI.
Experience & Qualifications
  • Hands-on Technical Experience: Strong hands-on experience in the configuration and deployment of software and hardware, including Wi-Fi, networking equipment, and cloud services. A fundamental understanding of cloud architectures and AI principles is essential. Deep understanding and knowledge of Residential and SMB Gateways is a big plus.
  • ISP SaaS Experience: Proven experience working with ISPs to deploy large-scale SaaS network solutions to millions of endpoints.
  • Communication & Collaboration: A track record of developing and maintaining professional, cooperative relationships with all levels of staff and customers.
  • Networking & Cloud Certifications: Relevant certifications such as CWNA, CCNA, or AWS Solutions Architect are highly preferred.
  • Problem-Solving: Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues in a fast-paced environment.
Qualification Requirements
  • Experience: 5+ years of related experience working with network, security, SaaS, and/or AI industries.
  • Education: A BS/BA degree in a relevant field or equivalent work experience.
  • Industry Knowledge: In-depth industry knowledge and a strong understanding of SDN and wireless technologies, solutions, and product offerings are preferred.
  • Communication Skills: Advanced written and oral communication skills.
  • Travel: Ability to travel >70% of the time.
Location/Language: This is a remote position. Candidates must be based in United Kingdom or Netherlands and be fluent in English.

About Plume

As the creator of the only open, hardware-independent, cloud-controlled experience platform for ISPs and their subscribers, Plume partners with over 400 ISP customers, including some of the world's largest such as Charter, Liberty Global, and J:COM.

Using OpenSync, the most widely supported open-source, silicon-to-cloud framework for smart spaces, Plume's software-defined network allows ISPs to decouple their service offerings from hardware and rapidly curate and deliver new services over a multi-vendor, open-platform architecture.

title: Senior Customer Success - EMEA
descriptionHtml:

Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action.

At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative.

As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future.

We are a fast-growing, global and remote-first company, and we believe the best work combines purpose, impact and innovation. You’ll work alongside talented people across the world who care about what they build, how they build it, and the impact they make on the broader cybersecurity ecosystem.

title: Senior Data Analyst, Marketing Measurement
descriptionHtml:
Help Us Build The Future of Travel

At Airalo, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world.

Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy.

We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone.

Your Next Destination

  • Location: Remote.
  • Contract: Full-time, permanent.
  • Benefits: Learn more about our benefits here in this link - https://airalo-public.notion.site/Benefits-25396a97ffca81fb9bc1f0be479f1be3?pvs=74
  • Languages: English is our main working language day to day, so you'll need to be comfortable communicating in it both in meetings and async.

Airalo's fully remote Data team is growing, and so is our ambition for how we measure marketing. You'll help Airalo decide where to invest the next dollar by owning how we measure marketing performance: attribution, the data models behind it, and incrementality testing that shows what really works, turning evidence into investment decisions across the globe.

You'll pair solid measurement expertise, including causal inference, with strong core analytics. You'll guide teams on what to measure and test, defend our framework with senior stakeholders, and make sure data changes decisions. This is a small, growing team and a capability that is new to the business: you'll build the process, not inherit it. Expect your time to be split between measurement work (attribution, data modelling and incrementality) and the day-to-day analytics Growth and Marketing rely on.


What You'll Do
  • Support our marketing attribution models and methodology: review how conversions are credited across channels, reconcile platform-reported and first-party numbers, and keep the approach trusted and documented.
  • Design and maintain the marketing data models behind measurement (spend, attribution, orders and customer cohorts) with Analytics Engineering, with clear definitions, tests and documentation.
  • Support Growth and Marketing with ad-hoc and core analytics, such as campaign and market performance, self-serve dashboards and AI-assisted analytics.
  • Design and run geo experiments from simulation-based power analysis and market selection to success criteria and read-out, working with the marketing performance team.
  • Co-own a prioritised quarterly incrementality test roadmap across channels and markets, ranked by decision value, cost, feasibility (including properly powered tests) and learning, and track each test through to a decision.
  • Handle spillover, seasonality and small-market noise, and report incremental CAC and incremental ROAS with honest uncertainty.
  • Turn test results into investment guidance: estimate marginal returns and saturation by channel and market, and recommend where the next dollar should go and where to pull back.
  • Help set and document our causal measurement standards: which method when, what counts as sufficient evidence, and how results calibrate attribution and MMM for budget allocation.
  • Defend the framework under challenge from channel owners and leaders, and pressure-test platform claims.
  • Guide Growth, Acquisition and Finance from business question to testable hypothesis to budget decision, and build literacy on attributed versus incremental performance.
  • Build reusable experiment tooling and templates, work with Analytics Engineering and MarTech on the data experiments needed, and document every test and decision as you build this capability from scratch.

    • What You'll Bring
  • 3+ years of experience in marketing measurement (attribution, incrementality or marketing mix modelling), with a track record of analysis that changed real budget decisions.
  • Solid grounding in causal inference and experimental design: randomised and quasi-experimental methods such as synthetic control and difference-in-differences, simulation-based power analysis to size and design tests, and knowing when each approach breaks.
  • Strong statistical judgement: you can quantify uncertainty, explain it simply, and resist overclaiming.
  • Hands-on experience with marketing attribution models and their limits, including reconciling platform-reported results with first-party data.
  • Familiarity with how experiments calibrate MMM and attribution, and with marginal-return and budget-optimisation thinking (saturation, diminishing returns).
  • Expert SQL and Python, production-quality code, a modern warehouse (BigQuery or Snowflake) and a BI tool such as Lightdash or Looker.
  • Strong data modelling skills: designing clean, tested and documented models (dbt or similar) for marketing spend, attribution and customer data, and working closely with Analytics Engineering.
  • Strong core analytics skills: marketing and customer metrics (CAC, LTV, retention, funnel and cohort analysis), dashboards and self-serve BI, and the judgement to prioritise ad-hoc requests alongside the test roadmap.
  • Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders: you hold a position under challenge, have shaped a roadmap, and say no with a clear rationale.

title: Senior Data Science Manager
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do.

Our EMEA Data Science organisation sits at the heart of Deliveroo and Wolt, powering decision-making across product, commercial and operational teams through experimentation, causal inference and deep business understanding. As part of DoorDash, our EMEA Data Science team brings together colleagues across Deliveroo and Wolt, creating opportunities to learn from different markets and tackle complex local-commerce challenges.

We’re looking for a Senior Data Science Manager to shape data science strategy across a broad area of our Logistics organisation. You’ll combine strong people leadership, technical judgement and commercial thinking to help our teams make better decisions and deliver measurable business impact.

About The Logistics Team

Logistics makes our marketplace work in the real world: connecting riders with orders and helping deliveries happen efficiently and reliably. The organisation works on problems such as predicting demand, improving delivery-time estimates, and matching orders with riders, all in an efficient way to ensure we can offer the most affordable pricing to our customers.

These are interconnected challenges. Decisions about supply, incentives and network efficiency can affect consumers, riders and restaurant and retail partners at the same time. Data Science helps us understand those relationships, test new approaches and balance delivery reliability, rider experience and sustainable business economics.

It’s an environment where rigorous experimentation meets real-world complexity, and where your team’s work can shape both everyday operational decisions and longer-term product strategy.

What You’ll Be Doing 

You’ll own the data science direction and measurable impact of a broad Logistics problem space spanning multiple cross-functional teams. You’ll:

  • Set strategy and priorities with Product, Engineering and Operations leaders, focusing investment on the highest-impact opportunities across immediate needs and longer-term goals.
  • Build and develop a high-performing, inclusive team through hiring, coaching and performance management, growing leaders who can deliver independently.
  • Guide solutions to complex marketplace challenges, from balancing supply and demand to evaluating incentives and improving delivery performance and economics.
  • Set the technical bar for experimentation, causal inference and analysis, staying close enough to challenge approaches and ensure decisions reflect real marketplace effects.
  • Influence senior stakeholders and align teams around shared outcomes, resolving competing priorities and turning evidence into product and operational decisions.
  • Directly lead projects that resolve highly complex challenges, which often span across multiple parts of the business and unlock new vectors of impact, boosting company-level goals.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring:

  • A track record of leading and developing high-performing data science or closely related analytical teams, with responsibility for complex work spanning multiple teams or business areas.
  • Experience setting analytical strategy and allocating people and effort across competing priorities, with clear evidence of product, operational or commercial impact.
  • Strong technical foundations in experimentation, causal inference and statistical analysis, with the judgement to select appropriate methods, challenge conclusions and coach experienced practitioners.
  • The ability to reason about interconnected systems and trade-offs, including how an intervention in one part of a marketplace can affect outcomes elsewhere.
  • Experience influencing senior cross-functional leaders, aligning teams around shared goals and turning complex evidence into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • A thoughtful approach to building teams: hiring, coaching, managing performance and developing future technical and people leaders.
  • Comfort creating structure in ambiguous environments, making pragmatic decisions with incomplete information and adapting as new evidence emerges.

Experience developing other people managers would be particularly valuable. Experience in marketplaces, logistics, mobility, pricing, incentives or other operationally complex businesses is helpful, but not essential. We also value leaders who can bring relevant approaches from other domains.

You don’t need to have worked on every problem listed here. We’re interested in the depth of your leadership, the quality of your judgement and the impact you enable through others.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

  • Verantwortungsbewusstsein und die Fähigkeit, auch bei technischen Störungen einen kühlen Kopf zu bewahren

  • Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

  • Bereitschaft, sich in bestehende Systeme einzuarbeiten und deren Weiterentwicklung aktiv voranzutreiben

Idealerweise bringst du außerdem Erfahrungen mit folgenden Technologien und Bereichen mit:
