title: Senior Director, Digital Marketing
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity 

Digital marketing has been fundamentally restructured by AI — and we need a leader who doesn't just understand that shift, but is actively shaping it. This is not a role for someone catching up; it's for someone who's already operating in the new paradigm. 

As Senior Director of Digital Marketing, you will own AvePoint's end-to-end digital presence and performance — from how we're discovered by AI answer engines to how we convert pipeline on the website. You'll lead SEO/GEO, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), paid media, and web conversion strategy, building a fully AI-powered digital org that stays ahead of the curve on every front. 

What You'll Own 

Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) & GEO 

  • Define and lead AvePoint's strategy for AI-driven search visibility across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Claude, Gemini, and emerging LLM platforms. 
  • Build AEO accountability frameworks: benchmark tracking, citation monitoring, share-of-voice in AI-generated answers, and input/output OKRs across contributing teams. 
  • Partner with Brand, Demand Gen, and AR teams on content and structural approaches that increase AvePoint's citation frequency in AI answer surfaces. 
  • Stay 6–12 months ahead of platform changes — from structured data to semantic search to agent-based browsing — and translate emerging signals into actionable strategy. 

SEO Strategy & Organic Performance 

  • Own organic search strategy across the full funnel — from brand and category terms to long-tail buying-stage content — with direct ownership of Ahrefs (Brand Radar) and GA4 reporting. 
  • Lead technical SEO: site architecture, Core Web Vitals, crawlability, schema markup, and content velocity programs. 
  • Build AI-assisted content workflows that accelerate topical authority without sacrificing quality signals or E-E-A-T. 
  • Establish and track SEO/GEO channel benchmarks across impressions, clicks, and campaign members as part of the full marketing funnel measurement model. 

Paid Media & Performance Marketing 

  • Oversee paid media investment across Google, LinkedIn, display, and programmatic — with direct accountability for MQL volume, cost per MQL (benchmark: $4K), and SAL conversion rates. 
  • Deploy AI-native campaign management: automated bidding, creative testing at scale, predictive audience modeling, and intent signal integration from 6sense and Clearbit Reveal. 
  • Partner with RevOps and Analytics to connect paid spend to pipeline attribution as the attribution model matures (Dreamdata evaluation in progress). 
  • Manage paid media budgets with rigor — optimizing channel mix across regions (AMER, EMEA, ANZ) and product categories (AI Governance, Resilience). 

Website & Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) 

  • Own the AvePoint website as a revenue-generating asset: information architecture, UX, messaging alignment, and conversion performance across all campaign and product landing pages. 
  • Lead CRO programs — A/B testing, personalization (in partnership with 6sense and Clearbit), and conversion path optimization — with GA4 and pipeline as the primary success metrics. 
  • Collaborate with Product Marketing on solution and persona-based web journeys; with Brand on design system consistency; and with Demand Gen on campaign landing page performance. 
  • Evaluate and integrate AI tools for dynamic content, intelligent chat, and web personalization to improve engagement and self-service pipeline creation. 

Building an AI-Powered Digital Org 

  • Model and enforce AI proficiency standards across the Digital Marketing team — targeting L4 proficiency (The Neuron's 5-Level Framework) by year-end, with at least one L5 agent deployed. 
  • Identify, pilot, and scale AI tools across every digital function: content generation, keyword research, ad creative testing, reporting automation, and audience intelligence. 
  • Create a culture of continuous learning and experimentation — running fast, documenting what works, and distributing knowledge across the broader growth marketing org. 
  • Serve as the internal subject matter expert on AI-driven digital marketing, educating the ELT and cross-functional stakeholders on implications and opportunities. 

How We'll Measure Success 

You'll be accountable to AvePoint's full marketing funnel — from impressions to pipeline — with digital owning specific stages: 

Metric

AEO Citation Share

Who You Are 

  • 8+ years of B2B digital marketing experience, with at least 3 years in a senior leadership role owning paid media, SEO, and web. 
  • Demonstrated expertise in AEO and GEO — you've been tracking and optimizing for AI-generated answer surfaces, not just reading about them. 
  • Deep hands-on experience with GA4, paid search/social platforms (Google Ads, LinkedIn), SEO tooling (Ahrefs, SEMrush), and marketing automation (Marketo preferred). 
  • Proven ability to connect digital spend to pipeline outcomes — you understand attribution, work well with RevOps, and don't hide behind vanity metrics. 
  • Experience scaling AI tooling across a team — not just using AI yourself, but building processes, workflows, and capability frameworks for others. 
  • Strong analytical instincts: you read data, form hypotheses, test them, and ship results. 
  • Executive-ready communication — you can translate digital performance into business impact for ELT and board audiences. 

Strongly Preferred 

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, security, or data governance — familiarity with complex, multi-stakeholder buying processes. 
  • Experience with ABM platforms like 6sense or intent data tools (Bombora, Clearbit Reveal). 
  • Exposure to Dynamics 365 and Marketo in a pipeline-reporting context. 
  • Comfort operating in a global org with regional go-to-market nuance (AMER, EMEA, ANZ). 
  • Active participant in digital marketing communities, newsletters, or public thought leadership on AI-driven marketing. 

The Signal We're Looking For 

The right person for this role doesn't wait for the industry to settle before making a move. They're already running experiments in AEO. They've replaced manual reporting workflows with AI agents. They have a point of view on where search is going in 18 months — and they're building for it now. They hold themselves accountable to pipeline, not just impressions. 

Any personal data you share with us during the application process will be processed strictly in compliance with applicable data protection laws and our Privacy Notice.

title: Senior Director, Pricing Operations
descriptionHtml:
Role Summary

The Senior Director, Pricing Operations will lead the transformation of Sophos's SecOps pricing function: building a centralized team, a disciplined operating cadence, and an AI-assisted governance model that let pricing move at the pace of the market. This is a build role. The Director will design the target operating model, stand up the team and the cadence behind it, and give senior leadership a clear, early view of competitive and market shifts, with a strong dotted line into the Network Security group to keep pricing decisions connected across both businesses.


What You Will Do

  • Design and build a centralized Pricing Operations function, bringing pricing work that sits across multiple teams today into one function with clear ownership of strategy, analytics, and deal support.

  • Define and implement a segment-aware pricing cadence, replacing episodic reviews with a disciplined, regular cycle, tuned to how fast each part of the business needs to move.

  • Stand up a pricing council and governance model so every approved change carries clear rationale, ownership, and advance communication to sales, finance, and customer-facing teams.

  • Direct the build-out of AI-assisted digital worker capabilities for competitor pricing analysis, discount analysis, discount depth analysis, and market alerts, so the function operates at pace without growing headcount.

  • Give senior leadership early visibility into market-moving events, including competitor pricing moves and market disruption, ahead of the standard review cycle.

  • Build a strong dotted-line partnership with the Network Security group to keep pricing decisions aligned across SecOps and Network Security.

  • Define and report the metrics that prove the new model is working: cadence adherence, time from decision to communication, and discount discipline.


What You Will Bring

  • Track record of building or transforming a pricing, revenue operations, or deal desk function at a B2B SaaS or technology company, ideally in cybersecurity or another subscription-driven business.

  • Experience leading organizational change: centralizing a distributed function, standing up new governance, and bringing a business along through the transition.

  • Familiarity with discount governance and competitive pricing intelligence, including using data and AI-assisted tools to monitor competitor pricing and discounting patterns.

  • Strong people leadership experience, with the ability to build a new team and establish its operating rhythm from the ground up.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build conviction for a new way of working across sales, finance, and executive stakeholders.

  • Comfortable designing pricing approaches that flex by customer segment and channel, balancing speed and stability where each is needed.

  • Bachelor's degree in business, finance, economics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

descriptionHtml:
Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, where you gain a tremendous amount of responsibility? Do you want to be part of an exceptional entrepreneurial team with young, motivated and extremely driven people? And are you curious or passionate about finding or creating great stories and content? If so, you might be our Senior Editor.

About us

"Private Equity Insights is the world's leading Private Equity community. We connect and develop more than 240,000 investment professionals across the world, through our platforms, which include conferences, webinars, magazines and news reports.

For more than 10 years, PEI has helped Investors, Fund Managers and CXOs rethink what it takes to fundraise, invest, operate and exit in Private Equity, and does so via online engagement and cutting edge conferences in Singapore, UK, France, Poland & CEE, Benelux, Switzerland, Iberia, Germany, Italy, Nordics and DACH."

As our Senior Editor you have the unique opportunity to be part of building the greatest brand within Insurtech. • Unlimited growth potential in our company - we strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally

Your Responsibilities

Your responsibility will be to build the greatest physical magazine which entails that you:

• Interview relevant people
• Copywrite, write, edit and proofread content for our magazines
• Construct the magazines including photos, design and artwork (with help from our Graphic Designer)

What we expect from you

You possess an unparalleled work ethic with a high sense of urgency. You have a relentless drive and desire to be the very best at what you do. You take ownership of everything you do, are proactive and follow through on commitments. Moreover, you’re humble and you share our passion for building and executing new businesses. Furthermore, we expect that you:

• Possess an exceptional attention to detail
• Are well-organised and able to structure and prioritise your work

Startdate

Flexible

title: Senior Engineering Manager (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About the Company

Affinidi is a technology company dedicated to changing data ownership for good. We empower businesses and individuals with control and ownership of their data, with a comprehensive approach to managing their holistic identity – accounting for all aspects of their digital footprint while ensuring privacy and security.

Affinidi’s technology enables users to benefit from decentralised digital identity solutions. We believe that everyone has the right to own and control their data, and we are committed to creating a trusted digital credentials ecosystem that empowers businesses and individuals to securely exchange data and services across borders and industries.

About the role:  

We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Engineering Manager with deep expertise in backend systems (TypeScript, microservices, cloud) to lead multiple engineering teams building the Affinidi Elements platform. While you will manage and support teams working across the full stack (backend, frontend, platform infrastructure), your technical depth and demonstrated experience in backend engineering will be crucial in guiding architecture, ensuring quality, and driving technical strategy. 

This role blends people leadership with technical leadership: you will grow high-performing fullstack teams, define best practices across the stack, and remain hands-on in critical technical decisions to ensure our systems are secure, scalable, and performant.

  • We are unapologetically customer-focused  
  • We invest in cultures and teams to enable high performance  
  • Embraces experimentation and builds fast  
  • We have the courage to be misunderstood  
  • We work together to unlock data    

What’s in it for you:   

  • Lead multiple engineering teams, providing vision, direction, and coaching to managers, staff engineers, and senior ICs 
  • Drive engineering execution and on-time delivery of secure, performant, and customer-centric systems 
  • Oversee and contribute to the design and development of high-scale, high-performance distributed production systems 
  • Collaborate with product, design, and business stakeholders to define and execute the technology roadmap 
  • Establish and evolve engineering best practices, delivery processes, and quality standards to scale effectively

 You will be a great match if you:

  • Are skilled at balancing strategic vision with practical execution, aligning engineering teams with business outcomes

  • Demonstrate proven success in designing, deploying, and scaling microservices in cloud environments, specifically, Amazon Web Services (AWS) 
  • Advocate for privacy, security, cryptography, and resilient system design; experience with asynchronous cryptography and identity/authentication domains is a strong plus 
  • Are skilled at balancing technical leadership and people leadership, growing teams while staying engaged in critical technical decisions

descriptionHtml:
Vestiaire Collective is the leading global online marketplace for desirable pre-loved fashion. Our mission is to transform the fashion industry for a more sustainable future by empowering our community to promote the circular fashion movement. Vestiaire was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Paris with offices in London, Berlin, New York, Singapore, Ho Chi Minh, and warehouses in Tourcoing (France), Crawley (UK), Hong Kong and New York. We currently have a diverse global team of 600 employees representing more than 50 nationalities. Our values are Activism, Transparency, Dedication and Greatness and Collective.

The role

Vestiaire Collective is looking for a Berlin-based Senior Engineering Manager to lead our cross-hub Discovery team across Berlin and Paris.

The Discovery team plays a critical role in how buyers explore, discover and engage with our catalog. The team owns key user-facing surfaces such as search, browsing, merchandising exposure, and content-driven discovery, with the objective of helping buyers find the right items at the right time while balancing business, operational and brand considerations.

As an Engineering Manager, you will lead a comprehensive, cross-functional squad encompassing frontend, backend, machine learning, and data science to execute the Discovery roadmap end-to-end. You will work closely with Product, Design, Marketing, Merchandising and Data to deliver impactful features that improve user engagement, performance and scalability. Because our Discovery experience is heavily driven by search ranking and personalization algorithms, your squad will also actively integrate and rely on solutions built by our Data Scientists.

Reporting to the Director of Data Science and Engineering, you will combine people leadership, delivery ownership and technical contribution, while growing a strong, autonomous and product-oriented engineering team.

What you’ll do

  • Lead the end-to-end execution of the technical roadmap, delivering high-quality, scalable Discovery features.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners (Product, Design, Marketing, Merchandising, CRM, Data) to align business priorities, user value, and technical feasibility, effectively balancing a global and local portfolio.

  • Drive the overarching Discovery Strategy, a key investment pillar for 2027, by partnering directly with leadership and cross-functional stakeholders. You will operate in a high-visibility, milestone-driven environment to ensure predictable, high-quality delivery.

  • Act as the technical bridge between software engineering and machine learning, leveraging your cross-functional domain expertise across disciplines to build upon the multi-stage composable search stack

  • Manage and mentor a unified squad of 9 members across software engineering and data science. You will drive their professional growth through tailored coaching, impactful 1:1s, and clear career development plans, ensuring every specialist feels supported within a unified team culture.

  • Actively contribute to technical discussions, system design and architectural decisions.

  • Drive operational excellence and foster a healthy engineering culture by championing automation, code quality, observability, and continuous improvement.

Who you are

  • 5+ years of experience in software or machine learning engineering, with 3+ years in an Engineering Management or technical leadership role.

  • Domain experience in Search & Recommendation systems (bonus if E-commerce or Marketplace platforms) and experience in managing cross-functional squads to enable rapid onboarding and architectural alignment across disciplines.

  • You have a proven track record of building high-traffic, user-facing products. You are comfortable designing distributed systems and managing real-time data pipelines that power search and recommendation engines.

  • Proven track record of hiring, retaining and mentoring senior engineers, and building high-performing teams.

  • Strong communication skills and executive presence. You thrive in a high-accountability culture, comfortably navigating ambiguity, and aligning cross-functional stakeholders around shared company goals.

Our tech stack

LanguagesGolang, Python, TypeScript, Swift, Kotlin

Data & InfrastructureOpenSearch, Kafka, Redis, Airflow, MariaDB
AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible

Data & AnalyticsSnowflake, Snowplow, Tableau, Streamlit, Dust

ToolingGithub, Jira, OpenAPI,

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation and 28 days of paid annual leave.

  • Health and wellness support through Urban Sports Club.

  • A BVG Job Ticket for public transport in Berlin.

  • Corporate Benefits discounts of up to 40% with participating providers, including leisure activities and subscriptions.

  • A company pension scheme to help you build additional retirement savings.

  • Investment in your learning and growth, with the opportunity to shape how millions of people discover pre-loved fashion.

  • Two days to volunteer with an organisation of your choice through our Two Days to Help programme.

  • A global team representing more than 50 nationalities, working together to make fashion more circular.

Equal opportunities at Vestiaire Collective

Vestiaire Collective is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. We value the different experiences and perspectives people bring to our teams.

Beware of recruitment scams

Vestiaire Collective only contacts candidates from official email addresses ending in ----- or from If you receive a suspicious message, please report it to We may use AI tools to support parts of our hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analysing CVs, assessing responses or flagging information in application materials that may need verification. These tools support our recruitment team. People make all final hiring decisions. If you’d like more information about how we process your data, please contact us.

title: Senior Enterprise Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our principles to see how we work.

your mission:

You will be pivotal to telli’s growth. Your mission is to drive revenue by building trusted relationships with enterprise customers and closing complex, high-value deals (€100k+ land deal size). As one of the first Sr. Enterprise AEs at telli, you’ll play a key role in shaping how we win, navigate, and scale our enterprise sales motion.

 

what you'll do:

  • Own complex enterprise deals end-to-end: Lead €100k+ deals from first discovery through signature, including demos, business cases, security reviews, procurement, legal, contract negotiations, and executive alignment. You uncover where telli creates measurable value and build the case to make it a priority.

  • Build and own your pipeline: Our SDR team supports you, but you can generate own Enterprise pipeline. You identify the right accounts, develop account strategies, write outbound, make the calls, and create opportunities where none existed before.

  • Navigate complex buying committees: Build relationships across Sales, Operations, CX, IT, Security, Legal, Procurement, Finance, and the C-Suite at large organizations. You identify champions, understand internal politics, and create consensus across multiple stakeholders.

  • Run strategic, multi-threaded sales processes: You don't rely on a single champion. You map the organization, understand who influences the decision, and build relationships at multiple levels long before procurement enters the process.

  • Own a quota and close €100k+ deals: Drive meaningful new ARR and take full accountability for your forecast, pipeline coverage, and revenue target.

  • Build compelling business cases: Translate telli's product into measurable commercial impact for the customer and make the ROI clear enough to win internal budget and executive sponsorship.

  • Bring the customer into the company: Feed structured insights back into product, marketing, and strategy. You sit closest to some of our most important prospects and customers, and your signal helps shape what we build next.

 

what makes you a great fit:

  • You have 3+ years of experience closing enterprise deals: You have proven experience owning complex €100k+ sales cycles and selling to senior and C-Suite economic buyers.

  • You know how to navigate complexity: You've worked through long sales cycles involving multiple departments, procurement, security, legal, and competing internal priorities, without losing control of the deal.

  • You're an elite relationship builder: You know the difference between a contact, a champion, and an economic buyer. You build trust quickly and have won deals because of the relationships you created across an organization.

  • You're a hunter: You know how to manufacture pipeline without relying on a warm inbound stream. You're comfortable breaking into large accounts and creating urgency from scratch.

  • You have executive presence: You can hold your own with C-Suite stakeholders from the first interaction. You communicate clearly, challenge thoughtfully, and earn credibility quickly.

  • You think strategically about accounts: You don't just run meetings, you map stakeholders, identify blockers, understand incentives, and continuously think about what needs to happen for the deal to move forward.

  • You're commercially sharp: You understand how to build a business case, quantify value, negotiate confidently, and protect deal quality while getting complex agreements across the line.

  • You're obsessively prepared: You know more about the prospect's business, priorities, and challenges than they expect you to. Every interaction has a purpose.

  • You're low ego and high accountability: You're not above doing the grunt work. You take ownership when things go wrong, act on feedback quickly, and share credit when things go right.

  • You speak business-level German and English

  • You want to work on-site 5 days a week in Berlin

 

you may not be a good fit if:

  • You wait for pipeline to be handed to you. Sr. Enterprise AE means you generate

  • You need detailed instructions and shy away from taking responsibility

  • You only show up for the "strategic" parts of the deal and skip the procurement/security-review grunt work

  • You've never personally carried a quota or closed deals end-to-end

  • You want to work remotely. We're an in-person team

  • You think this role looks like a 9-to-5 job

descriptionHtml:
Realisiere mit Fastned die Mobilität von morgen!

Wir wollen unser Expansionsteam für die Region Süd rund um München verstärken.

Die Mobilität verändert sich grundlegend. Elektrofahrzeuge werden zum Alltag, neue Technologien entwickeln sich rasant und der Bedarf an leistungsfähiger Ladeinfrastruktur wächst. Fastned gestaltet als Unternehmen für ultraschnelles Laden diese Entwicklung aktiv mit.

Als Pionier im Bereich der Schnellladeinfrastruktur haben wir es uns zum Ziel gesetzt, bis 2030 ein europaweites Netz von über 1.000 Schnellladestationen aufzubauen.

Dafür arbeiten mehr als 500 Kolleg:innen aus über 50 Nationen in zehn Ländern zusammen. Bei Fastned triffst du auf Menschen aus unterschiedlichsten Fachbereichen und Kulturen, die eine gemeinsame Mission verbindet: Wir wollen die Mobilitätswende beschleunigen und Elektromobilität für alle zugänglicher machen.

Ein Job an der Schnittstelle von Immobilien, innovativer Technologie und Nachhaltigkeit

Als Senior Expansion Manager:in entscheidest du mit, wo die nächste Generation unserer Schnellladestationen entsteht. Du identifizierst attraktive Standorte in deiner Region, sprichst Eigentümer:innen, Projektentwickler:innen, Unternehmen und Kommunen an und entwickelst daraus langfristige Partnerschaften.

Du arbeitest in einer innovativen und schnell wachsenden Branche, in der sich Markt, Technologie und rechtliche Rahmenbedingungen kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln. Dabei verbindest du dein Immobilien- und Verhandlungsgeschick mit einem konkreten Beitrag zur nachhaltigen Mobilität.

Deine Arbeit hat sichtbare Ergebnisse: Aus deinen Analysen, Gesprächen und Verhandlungen entstehen neue Schnellladestationen, die täglich von Menschen in ganz Deutschland und Europa genutzt werden.

Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Projekte und arbeitest gleichzeitig eng mit unseren Teams aus Architektur, Legal, Construction und Operations zusammen. Gemeinsam entwickelt ihr Lösungen, teilt Wissen und bringt neue Ideen in die Umsetzung.

Ausserdem wollen wir in deiner Region ein kleines Team aufbauen, womit sich dir die Chance bietet Verantwortung für juniorigere Teammitglieder zu übernehmen.

Bei Fastned hast du die Möglichkeit, in einem Unternehmen zu arbeiten, welches nicht auf etablierte Standards wartet, sondern diese aktiv gestaltet. Elektromobilität und Schnellladeinfrastruktur sind für dich noch neu? Kein Problem. Wir unterstützen dich mit einem umfassenden Onboarding und relevanten Workshops.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast mindestens 6 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung, idealerweise in der gewerblichen Immobilienwirtschaft, Standortakquise, Projektentwicklung.

  • Du hast praktische Erfahrung in der Akquise von Standorten oder Immobilien und im Aufbau von Beziehungen zu Eigentümer:innen, Projektentwickler:innen, Unternehmen oder Kommunen.

  • Du bist erfahren in der Vorbereitung und Führung von Verhandlungen, idealerweise im Zusammenhang mit Pacht-, Miet- oder Kaufverträgen.

  • Du verfügst über ein grundlegendes Verständnis dafür, wie Immobilien und Standorte bewertet werden. Dazu gehören beispielsweise Lage, Sichtbarkeit, Erreichbarkeit, Verkehrsanbindung, wirtschaftliche Attraktivität und grundsätzliche Machbarkeit.

  • Du kannst relevante Informationen strukturiert analysieren und daraus eine fundierte Einschätzung oder Empfehlung ableiten. Erfahrung mit Karten-, CRM- oder Analysetools ist von Vorteil.

  • Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu, kommunizierst sicher und arbeitest gerne mit unterschiedlichen internen und externen Partner:innen zusammen.

  • Du arbeitest eigenständig, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert und bringst deine Projekte aktiv voran.

  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • Du bist bereit das Deutsche Team einmal im Monat in Köln zu besuchen, regelmäßig innerhalb Deutschlands zu reisen und freust dich auch auf gelegentliche Besuche in unserem Headquarter in Amsterdam

Du musst kein:e Expert:in für Elektromobilität oder technische Immobilienbewertung sein. Wichtig ist, dass du relevante Erfahrung in der Standortakquise mitbringst, wirtschaftliche und praktische Zusammenhänge verstehst und Lust hast, dich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten.

Wir suchen erfahrene Profile auf Senior-Level. Entscheidend ist für uns nicht nur, was du bereits gemacht hast, sondern vor allem, ob du Dinge gestalten, Verantwortung übernehmen und gemeinsam mit anderen etwas bewegen möchtest.

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About us

STRATOS builds the commercial digital twin that large industrial companies run on. We work with global B2B companies to synchronize strategy and execution and ensure commercial success is driven by potential, not gut feel or old data. STRATOS is a category-defining, rapidly growing startup, profitable and majority founder-owned with our Series A still ahead of us, funded by high-profile investors (e.g., Accel) and trusted by 15 global industrial leaders and Fortune 500 customers. Our software integrates complex datasets into a unified solution, combining deep data integration, best-in-class workflows, and cutting-edge generative AI.

The role

Lead the deployments that decide how some of the world's biggest industrial companies grow. As a Senior FDE, you own the technical side of a client relationship, set the architecture, ship to production and grow the engineers around you, with founders who stay close to the work.

What you'll do

  • Lead deployments end to end for one or more clients, from scoping with their leadership to running production systems

  • Own the architecture for data pipelines, ontologies and AI workflows on Palantir Foundry and AIP

  • Be the technical lead in the room at client senior level: you're the engineer they trust to tell them what's possible and what to build first

  • Grow the FDEs around you through code review, pairing and setting the bar for quality and speed

  • Shape the roadmap with Product and our founders, turning patterns you see across clients into reusable product

You might be a fit if you

  • Have 4+ years in data engineering, software engineering or forward-deployed roles, with production systems you're proud of

  • Write expert Python, PySpark and SQL, and design data models that hold up at scale

  • Have led client-facing technical work and can explain trade-offs to executives

  • Make good decisions quickly with imperfect information, and back them

  • Want a big say in how a profitable, fast-growing company builds its engineering team

Nice to have

  • Palantir Foundry or AIP in production

  • TypeScript, API development or front-end work

  • ERP (SAP, Oracle) or CRM data at enterprise scale

  • Experience in specialty chemicals, building materials or other industrial sectors

Why engineers join us

  • Big clients, small team. Some of the biggest names in industry, served by a team of 40. Your work reaches their leadership in weeks, not years.

  • Own the stack. We fully control our stack and choose our tools. No committees, no tickets passed between five teams, no egos.

  • Built to last. Profitable, founder-led and majority founder-owned, backed by high-profile investors (e.g., Accel), with our Series A still ahead of us. That means growth on our terms and real upside for early joiners.

  • Learn from people who've done it. Founders who have run a $1B business, plus people from Palantir, McKinsey and BCG, all in the same room.

  • In person, on purpose. Three days a week together in Farringdon. Fast feedback, fast decisions and fast shipping.

What we offer

  • Equity through our stock option programme, so you share in the long-term success and growth of the company

  • A highly competitive salary

  • Direct access to Fortune 500 executives from your first months, at a level most people wait a decade for

  • Work alongside former MBB consultants and Fortune 500 executives who will teach you directly — our team is small enough that this happens in person, not through a training curriculum

  • Private healthcare

  • Pension scheme

  • 25 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays

  • Work from abroad — up to four weeks a year, and up to two weeks at a time

  • Hybrid office policy, with visa sponsorship available

  • A company committed to social and environmental responsibility — we pledge to be a net-zero CO₂ company and donate 1% of our revenue to social causes

How we hire

  • Intro call with our recruiter

  • Technical task, reviewed by our engineers within a day or two

  • Call with Solomon, our VP Engineering

  • Two hours in person with Marco (CTO) and Solomon

  • 30-minute final conversation with Nico, our CEO

Practicalities

  • London-based, 3 days a week in our Farringdon office

title: (Senior) FP&A Analyst
descriptionHtml:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a (Senior) FP&A Analyst based in United Kingdom.

As a (Senior) FP&A Analyst, you will play a key role in shaping financial strategy and driving business performance within a globally distributed organization. You will lead financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and performance management activities, translating complex financial and operational data into actionable insights. Working closely with senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, you will help guide strategic decisions, identify risks and opportunities, and strengthen financial discipline across the business. You will also develop robust financial models, reporting tools, and performance indicators to support sustainable growth. This is an opportunity to combine analytical expertise with commercial thinking in a fast-paced, international, remote-first environment.


Accountabilities:

You will oversee financial planning and performance management processes while acting as a trusted business partner to leadership and operational teams. Your work will help ensure accurate reporting, informed decision-making, and alignment between local financial performance and broader organizational objectives.

  • Lead annual budgeting, monthly and quarterly forecasting, and long-range financial planning processes across the business.

  • Analyze financial and operational performance, identifying variances, risks, opportunities, and actionable recommendations for senior leadership.

  • Collaborate with commercial, operational, functional, local finance, and group finance teams to support strategic initiatives and improve business performance.

  • Develop and maintain financial models, dashboards, KPIs, and reporting packages to facilitate decision-making and investment assessments.

  • Ensure consistency between local German reporting requirements and group-level expectations within a U.S. publicly listed company environment.

  • Drive continuous improvements in FP&A processes, planning tools, data quality, reporting automation, and performance management routines.

  • Support corporate reporting activities and collaborate with external auditors and system implementation partners when required.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines strong financial expertise with a strategic mindset and the ability to influence stakeholders across an international organization. You should be comfortable working with complex financial information, challenging assumptions, and translating analysis into meaningful business recommendations.

  • Approximately 7 years of progressive experience in FP&A, financial controlling, corporate finance, or a related finance function, ideally within an international or matrixed organization.

  • Strong expertise in budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, management reporting, variance analysis, and business performance management.

  • Good understanding of the relationships between the balance sheet, profit and loss statement, and cash flow statement.

  • Advanced Excel skills and practical experience with ERP, financial planning, and reporting tools such as Oracle NetSuite, Oracle Fusion, Power BI, Tableau, Anaplan, Hyperion, OneStream, or similar platforms.

  • Strong commercial awareness, analytical thinking, and problem-solving abilities.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the confidence to challenge assumptions and influence strategic decisions.

  • Fluency in English is required.

    • Additional assets include:

title: Senior Fraud Operations Coordinator
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. 
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE 

The Returns, Quality and Fraud team is seeking a highly independent, detail-oriented and proactive Senior Fraud Operations Coordinator to own fraud operations for Quince Europe. As the sole member of the Fraud team based in Europe, you will be the primary owner of all inbound fraud, chargeback, security and privacy activity for the region, working across every fraud system and tool to identify, investigate and resolve customer fraud. The ideal candidate is exceptionally organized, solution-driven and self-directed, with the judgment to make sound decisions and move work forward without day-to-day oversight from a manager or coworkers.

The candidate should thrive in a fast-paced, continuously evolving environment and be able to independently prioritize across live order monitoring, chargeback management, escalations and prevention initiatives. Because the majority of the team operates in US time zones, this person must be an outstanding communicator: proactively sharing updates, documenting decisions, escalating risks at the right time, and partnering across multiple teams and systems to synthesize data into clear narratives about customer behavior that drive effective resolutions and measurable fraud savings.

Responsibilities

Regional Ownership & Independent Operation

  • Serve as the end-to-end owner and single point of contact for all fraud inbound for Quince Europe, including fraud, security and privacy inboxes, escalations, chargebacks and active order monitoring queues
  • Operate independently across all fraud systems, payment processors and internal tools, making day-to-day decisions without reliance on real-time manager or peer support
  • Build and manage your own workflows, queues and prioritization to consistently meet SLAs as the sole regional resource
  • Provide structured, asynchronous updates to US-based leadership and partners (e.g., daily/weekly summaries, escalation logs, KPI reporting), with clear hand-offs across time zones
  • Exercise sound judgment on when to act independently and when to escalate, documenting rationale for key decisions
  • Identify regional gaps in tooling, process or coverage and proactively propose and implement solutions

Fraud Investigations & Escalations

  • Lead investigations into customer fraud activity across European markets, including credit card chargeback requests and suspicious activity escalations from Service, Auditing, Security, Privacy and other partners
  • Triage and resolve fraud, security and privacy inbox requests within 24 hours
  • Conduct account-level deep dives to identify linked behaviors, repeat offenders and coordinated abuse
  • Act as a strong steward of the Quince brand, balancing fraud prevention with customer experience

Chargeback & Dispute Management

  • Manage daily chargeback processing for Quince Europe across Stripe, Braintree, PayPal and any regional payment processors or methods
  • Ensure all disputes are responded to and actioned a minimum of 14 calendar days prior to due dates
  • Optimize representment documentation to improve dispute win rates
  • Identify root causes driving chargebacks and recommend preventative controls

Active Order Monitoring & Asset Protection

  • Conduct real-time review of high-risk and high-dollar transactions prior to fulfillment
  • Investigate suspicious purchases across vulnerable categories such as gift cards, jewelry, 3P vendor products (e.g., Therabody, coffee makers) and gold bars
  • Oversee order cancellations when fraud thresholds are met
  • Coordinate shipment interception and asset recovery efforts with European carriers and fulfillment partners when necessary
  • Track performance metrics including approval rates, cancellation rates, fraud loss prevented and recovery outcomes

Fraud Detection, Reporting & Legal Follow-Up

  • Identify trends of abuse and systemic vulnerabilities across delivery, returns, gift card purchasing, referral programs and high-value SKUs, including patterns specific to European markets
  • Partner with Analytics to develop robust reporting that streamlines insights and accelerates fraud detection and prevention efforts
  • Extrapolate case-level findings into broader fraud themes and prevention strategies
  • Partner with Legal to determine customer recourse strategy, including account closures, recovery actions and escalation frameworks, in line with applicable European regulations (e.g., GDPR, PSD2/SCA)
  • Track savings and impact measurement tied to fraud prevention initiatives

Cross-Functional & Operational Support

  • Collaborate with CX, Payments, Security, Product, Legal, Analytics and third-party vendors, both in Europe and the US, to strengthen fraud controls
  • Track and lead key operational projects for the region, including savings measurement and process optimization
  • Own and maintain European SOPs and documentation standards across fraud workflows, ensuring processes are well-documented and aligned with global standards
  • Provide flexible support for emerging initiatives and priorities that fall outside of standard responsibilities as the business scales

Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in fraud operations, payments risk, chargeback management or trust & safety, ideally in e-commerce
  • Proven track record of working autonomously, ideally as a sole or remote team member supporting a globally distributed organization
  • Hands-on experience with payment processors and dispute platforms (e.g., Stripe, Braintree, PayPal) and fraud tooling
  • Working knowledge of European payments and data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, PSD2/SCA, 3DS)
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to deliver clear, concise asynchronous updates
  • Highly organized, with strong prioritization and time management across multiple queues and deadlines
  • Strong analytical skills; comfortable working with data to identify trends and quantify impact
  • Additional European language(s) a plus

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. 

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

title: Senior GRC Engineer
descriptionHtml:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebratingour wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

About the Team 

Security Trust & Risk owns governance, risk, compliance, vendor & customer assurance and business continuity across Anaplan's ecosystem. This role is a genuine ground-floor opportunity. You'll help build the technical backbone that lets GRC operate as an engineering discipline, pivoting away from point in time audits and risk scores, into a continuously measured heartbeat, driving prioritization and high visibility and even higher impact decisions. 

Your Role 

As a Senior GRC Engineer based in the UK, you're the technical bridge between GRC and the rest of the business, with a natural focus on UK/EU regulatory and market-access requirements. You're comfortable sitting in a room with engineering and talking architecture on some days, and on other days, feeling confident on a call with a customer and translating security in practice to build trust. Your north star is compliance by design: instead of audits being a point-in-time scramble to assemble evidence, they should be a natural byproduct of controls, monitoring, and processes that run continuously, year-round.

A core part of that is thinking in terms of build once, apply to many: using our cross-framework control crosswalk to identify where requirements across our certified standards, including ISO 27001, 27017, 27018, 27701, and 42001, SOC 1/2 Type 2, Cyber Essentials, ENS, and TX-RAMP genuinely overlap, so our partners build to a single common control instead of a different bespoke solution for every certification. Just as important as the automation itself is making the reasoning behind it visible: helping partners across the business understand the why behind a given control, whether it traces back to a compliance obligation, a customer request, or an emerging threat, not just the what. Over time, you'll develop genuine fluency in how the Anaplan product and platform actually work, how our infrastructure and internal systems are managed, and where our security controls live operationally. 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Act as a technical GRC partner to technical and non-technical teams, translating compliance, governance, and risk requirements into implementation details, and engaging credibly in architecture/design discussions 
  • Use the cross-framework control crosswalk to identify synergies across regulatory requirements, so engineers build one common solution instead of duplicating effort per certification 
  • Support customer-facing security/compliance conversations requiring deeper technical context (platform architecture, control implementation, how obligations are met) 
  • Build the processes, scripts, workflows, and tooling that embed controls into daily operations, and design automation that keeps compliance/risk data current continuously rather than refreshed only ahead of audits 
  • Create knowledge-sharing resources and clear documentation/diagrams that help partners understand the reasoning behind a control - whether it's a compliance obligation, a customer request, or an emerging threat, not just the mechanics of it; bring particular depth on UK/EU frameworks and market-access requirements (e.g., Cyber Essentials, GDPR, ISO 27701) into the crosswalk 
  • Partner with Risk Management to engineer risk identification, scoring, and monitoring into day-to-day operations; support continuous monitoring (ConMon) across Compliance, Risk, and Governance; and build working knowledge of the Anaplan product/platform over time 

About You 

You're as comfortable in a room full of engineers debating architecture as you are explaining to a customer how a specific control works under the hood. You don't just document controls - you build things: a script that automates an evidence pull, a workflow that keeps a risk register current, a diagram that makes an audit go faster because the auditor can actually see how the system works. You instinctively look for the one solution that covers several requirements at once, rather than building a separate one for each. You think about compliance as something that should run continuously in the background, not something the organization gears up for once a year. 

Qualifications 

  • Extensive commercial experience in security engineering, GRC, DevSecOps, or a closely related technical role, with hands-on exposure to compliance/regulatory frameworks 
  • Comfortable writing scripts or light code (Python, Bash, or similar) to automate evidence collection, reporting, or monitoring tasks 
  • Working knowledge of at least two of: ISO 27001 and its extensions (27017, 27018, 27701, 42001), SOC 1/2, and familiarity with UK/EU-relevant frameworks (Cyber Essentials, UK GDPR, ISO 27701, etc.), including experience using a cross-framework control mapping/crosswalk to reduce duplicate implementation effort 
  • Comfortable building and reading system/data-flow diagrams, and proficient with a GRC/risk platform (e.g., Drata, Vanta, Hyperproof, Archer, OneTrust, ServiceNow GRC, or similar) 
  • Experience translating compliance/risk requirements into implementation guidance engineering teams can act on 
  • Comfort engaging directly with both engineering teams and customers on technical topics, and building process/tooling in a growing function 

Nice-to-Have 

  • Hands-on experience applying AI/LLM tooling to a real operational workflow; for example, automating a repetitive review step or summarizing evidence for a control 
  • Familiarity with OSCAL or similar machine-readable control languages 
  • Experience with quantitative or semi-quantitative risk scoring methodologies (e.g., FAIR or similar) 
  • Experience with FedRAMP and/or HIPAA/HITRUST a plus, especially if you have experience across more than one of these 
  • Experience supporting external audits or assessments as a technical point of contact 
  • Exposure to sovereign/regional cloud regimes relevant to international expansion 

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day! 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  

Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer  

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.  

Anaplan does not:  

  • Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.   
  • Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.  

All emails from Anaplan would come from an ----- email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to ----- before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.   

Privacy & AI Notice

Candidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to assist our team in evaluating qualifications.

title: (Senior) Growth Manager France (f/m/d) - FinTech Startup
descriptionHtml:
We co-founded and led Viafintech (Barzahlen) to 100+ FTE — one of the most successful German fintechs, active in 17 markets across the EU and USA — and sold it in 2021 for a €three-digit million amount to NYSE-listed Paysafe Group. Now we're off to our next venture.

This time we're building a global champion for prepaid products: gift cards (Apple, Amazon, Google), airtime and eCash — all in one simple API. Think of finperks as the Stripe/Adyen for all prepaid products and payments.

We started in summer 2025 and in just a few months we have already onboarded 1,000+ brands, with 4 clients currently live. Many people completely underestimate the market size: about €600bn sold per year today, growing to €1.8tn by 2028.

Instead of 5 players in the chain (brand → issuing tech → global distributor → local distributor → client), we connect brands directly with clients via the finperks platform.

We're a team of 20 in Berlin-Charlottenburg. A mix of our best people from the last journey and brilliant new joiners. High ownership. Low ego. Kind humans. We ship fast, help each other, and celebrate wins. Join early. Help build the global champion for prepaid.

Tasks

As a (Senior) Growth Manager, you work closely with Founder Sebastian Seifert to identify, develop, and scale strategic, high-impact partnerships across industries such as Banks & Fintechs, Retailers, HR & Payroll providers, Crypto providers, and consumer brands. Your role focuses on building a small number of highly relevant enterprise partnerships with significant long-term impact. Moreover, as a (Senior) Growth & Partnerships Manager France, you will have a special focus on the French market and French-speaking clients, but not exclusively.

Since you will be the first employee for the French market, you will be leading the market and have the opportunity to grow into a country manager role.

Your key responsibilities include:

  • Owning the end-to-end business development process from initial outreach and relationship building to product demos, negotiations, and closing.
  • Acquiring a limited number of highly strategic enterprise partners (approximately 5–6 per year), prioritizing quality and long-term value over high-volume customer acquisition.
  • Managing complex B2B sales cycles of up to 6 months, involving multiple stakeholders and decision-makers on the partner side.
  • Proactively identifying and engaging partners with the potential to generate €10M+ in annual voucher turnover per partnership.
  • Developing tailored partnership and value propositions aligned with industry specifics, partner needs, and decision-making structures.
  • Driving commercial discussions and deal structuring in close collaboration with the founder and internal stakeholders.
  • Representing Finperks in partner meetings, industry events, and on-site visits across Europe, with regular travel (approximately 2–3 trips per month).
  • Building and maintaining a focused, high-quality partnership pipeline, ensuring clear prioritization, transparency, and realistic forecasting.
  • Continuously gathering market and partner insights to refine Finperks’ partnership strategy and growth roadmap.

Requirements

To thrive in this role, you bring a combination of essential qualities and relevant experience.

Must-haves:

  • A structured and disciplined working approach, with the ability to prioritize, plan, and manage complex sales processes over extended periods of time.
  • A hungry, ambitious, and goal-driven mindset, motivated by building meaningful partnerships and closing high-impact deals.
  • High frustration tolerance and resilience, with the persistence to continue engaging prospects despite multiple rejections and long sales cycles.
  • Genuine passion for working with people, building trust, and winning partners over through strong interpersonal skills.
  • Clear willingness to personally execute operative, hands-on sales work, including outreach, follow-ups, demos, and negotiations.
  • Strong commercial and negotiation skills, with the ability to structure and close partnership agreements with significant revenue impact.
  • Ability to work closely with founders or senior leadership, acting as a trusted sparring partner in strategic and commercial discussions.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills in French (mother-tongue) and English (C1), suitable for interactions with C-level and senior stakeholders.
  • Ability to conduct business professionally in French and English.
  • Willingness and flexibility to travel within Europe approximately 2–3 times per month.
  • High level of ownership, self-organization, and accountability, with comfort operating in an early-stage startup environment.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Several years of experience in management or strategy consulting, ideally with exposure to commercial strategy, go-to-market, or partnership-driven business models.
  • Several years of experience in B2B business development, partnerships, or enterprise sales, ideally in a startup, scale-up, fintech, SaaS, or platform environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage long and complex B2B sales cycles (up to 6 months) involving multiple stakeholders and decision-makers.
  • Experience working with high-value, low-volume deals, focusing on a small number of strategic customers rather than high-frequency transactional sales.

title: Senior Growth Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:
Are you an ambitious growth marketer with an entrepreneurial spirit and a track record of scaling customer acquisition? Do you love diving into data, spotting opportunities, and turning ideas into measurable growth? Are you excited by opening new acquisition channels and finding smarter ways to grow in an AI-driven world?

AIHR is looking for an experienced Senior Growth Marketing Manager to help accelerate growth across our B2C and B2B businesses. You'll work across the entire acquisition funnel, from scaling paid media and improving conversion to launching new growth initiatives that drive MQLs and revenue.

You'll join an ambitious, results-driven Growth Marketing team, working closely with our specialists to challenge existing approaches, experiment with new ideas, and deliver results. You'll have the autonomy to lead initiatives, the support of an experienced team, and the opportunity to make a direct impact on a global e-learning business.

About AIHR

Founded in 2016 with the mission to future-proof HR, the Academy to Innovate HR (AIHR) has become the world’s market leader in online training for human resources (HR) professionals. We have a global customer base spread across 140+ countries, amongst which companies like Unilever, Reckitt, Goldman Sachs, Philips, Deloitte, Nike, Heineken, and UBS. It is our goal to continuously upskill and empower 1,000,000 HR Professionals.

We are an international team of 100+ people, driven by excellence, innovation, and a hunger to grow in everything we do. As such, we strive to provide the world’s best courses and excellent support to our customers while continuously optimizing every aspect of our work. With over 30 nationalities, our team is diverse, yet we all share a few traits: we're friendly, enthusiastic, and great team players.

Being a fast-growing company, working at AIHR means taking on a lot of responsibility and getting countless opportunities to develop yourself in new areas and the potential to craft your own role.

Role and Responsibilities

As our Senior Growth Marketing Manager, you'll play a key role in accelerating customer acquisition across our B2C and B2B businesses. Working closely with the Head of Growth Marketing and VP of Marketing, you'll help us achieve our ambitious growth targets, improve acquisition efficiency, and identify new opportunities to scale.

A core part of your role will be diving into performance data to understand what's working, what's not, and where our biggest growth opportunities lie. You'll work closely with our Performance Marketing Specialist to scale paid acquisition, challenge existing strategies, test new approaches, and support campaign execution where needed. You'll also collaborate with our CRO Specialist to identify opportunities across landing pages, website journeys, and conversion funnels, turning insights into experiments that drive more leads and revenue.

You'll bring a strong growth perspective to our email marketing efforts, working with the team to analyze nurture flows, promotional campaigns, and audience segments, and identify opportunities to improve performance. Beyond optimizing existing channels, you'll explore, launch, and scale new acquisition opportunities, including those emerging from the changing AI- and LLM-driven marketing landscape.

Most importantly, this is a hands-on role where you'll do more than develop strategies and bring ideas to the table. You'll actively execute initiatives yourself or work closely with the wider team to bring them to life. Whether you're launching a new campaign, testing an acquisition channel, or improving conversion, you'll take ownership of turning opportunities into measurable business results.

On a typical week

It's Monday morning, and you start the week with a coffee and a look at last week's acquisition performance. You open GA4, HubSpot, and your marketing dashboards to see how we're tracking against our B2C and B2B MQL targets. While digging into the data, you notice that one of our paid campaigns is generating plenty of traffic, but conversions have dropped. You investigate further, identify a few potential causes, and head into the Growth Marketing stand-up with some ideas to improve performance.

After the stand-up, you catch up with our Performance Marketing Specialist to review campaign performance and discuss opportunities to scale. You identify a promising new audience and agree to test a different creative approach. Rather than just handing over your ideas, you jump into the advertising platform to help set up the campaign and work with the team to get the new creatives ready for launch.

On Tuesday, you're focused on improving our B2B acquisition funnel. You've spotted an opportunity to increase conversions on the AI for HR Boot Camp landing page. You meet with our B2B Marketer and CRO Specialist to review the data, discuss your hypothesis, and agree on an experiment. You brief the team, align with sales on the proposed changes, and help move the experiment towards launch.

Wednesday is a work-from-home day, giving you time to dive deeper into our acquisition strategy. You've been exploring how AI and LLMs are changing the way HR professionals discover training providers. You identify a potential new acquisition opportunity, research the market, and put together a practical plan to test it. Later, you meet with the Head of Growth Marketing to challenge your assumptions, refine the approach, and agree on the next steps.

On Thursday, you review the performance of our B2C email nurture flows with the Email Marketing team. You notice an opportunity to improve conversions from leads to MQLs and propose a change to the messaging and sequence. After lunch with colleagues in the office, you turn your attention to an upcoming quarterly campaign, working with the wider Marketing team to finalize the messaging and coordinate the launch. You also start investigating new channels that could help expand the campaign's reach and attract new audiences.

Friday starts with reviewing the results of a recent landing page experiment. The changes have improved conversion, so you work with the CRO Specialist to roll them out more broadly. You also catch up with our BizOps team to improve HubSpot reporting, ensuring we have better visibility into acquisition performance and opportunities for growth. Before wrapping up the week, you review progress against our growth priorities, share your findings with the team, and identify the next opportunities worth pursuing.

After a productive week of analyzing, experimenting, and driving initiatives forward, you close your laptop and join your colleagues for Friday drinks.

We offer

  • A revenue-generating role in a fast-growing scale-up company;

  • Competitive, benchmarked compensation;

  • A high degree of autonomy in a vibrant, result-driven, inclusive, and international team;

  • A beautiful office right across Rotterdam Central Station (Milleniumtower) and a satellite office in Amsterdam;

  • 26 paid holidays per year + 1 extra day for the first 5 years you work at AIHR

  • Exchange any 2 public holiday days for 2 other days of your choice;

  • Work from anywhere policy, where you can work abroad for 20 days in a calendar year;

  • Pension plan;

  • 4 Trust days per year (ad-hoc recovery days to take whenever you're overwhelmed, exhausted, or need to deal with something personal);

  • Access to OpenUp mental health platform;

  • Personal development budget, training, and we pay for the books you read;

  • All public transport expenses covered (NS Business Card);

  • MacBook + all other equipment you need to do your work;

  • Daily lunch prepared by a chef, weekly drinks, and fun team activities;

  • Free access to the office gym.

Get a taste of AIHR experience and check out our AIHR Benefits Guide!


Who you are

We're looking for an ambitious, data-driven, and commercially minded growth marketer with an entrepreneurial spirit. Someone who loves identifying opportunities, challenging existing approaches, and turning ideas into measurable results. You're not just a strategic thinker; you're equally excited about getting operational, executing ideas yourself, and making things happen.

You have:

  • 8+ years of experience in growth marketing, with a proven track record of scaling customer acquisition, ideally across both B2C and B2B businesses in SaaS, e-learning, or other high-growth industries;

  • Demonstrable experience scaling paid acquisition campaigns, including managing or scaling advertising budgets of €100,000+ per month;

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to dive into performance data, identify growth opportunities, and translate insights into actionable initiatives;

  • A strong understanding of full-funnel marketing, including paid acquisition, CRO, landing page optimization, email marketing, and growth economics such as CAC and LTV;

  • Strong experience with HubSpot or comparable CRM platforms, including segmentation, automation, lifecycle marketing, attribution, and reporting;

  • Experience identifying, testing, and scaling new acquisition channels and growth opportunities;

  • Strong AI proficiency, with experience using ChatGPT and Claude to analyze data, improve workflows, and accelerate execution;

  • An understanding of how AI and LLMs are changing customer acquisition, with a forward-thinking approach to emerging marketing channels;

  • A proactive, hands-on approach, with the ability to independently lead and execute initiatives while collaborating effectively with the wider team;

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with a collaborative mindset, openness to feedback, and a hunger to grow;

  • Bonus: Experience in event marketing, community-led growth, or account-based marketing (ABM).

Apply for the job

Are you excited to become our new Senior Growth Marketing Manager? Then we'd love to hear from you! We are looking to hire for this role as soon as we find an eligible candidate.

P.S. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women tend to apply only when they meet 100% of them. So if you think you have what it takes, but don't necessarily meet every single point above, please still apply. We'd love to consider you and see if you could be a great fit.
