title: Senior Manager, Paid Social
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. 
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Senior Manager, Paid Social

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Paid Social to join our growing team. 

Paid social is one of the main ways Quince finds new customers, and this role sits at the centre of it. As Senior Manager, Growth Marketing (Paid Social), you will own strategy, execution and optimisation across Meta and other social platforms for a set of Quince departments, turning business goals into efficient media investment and steady, scalable growth.

This is a hands-on, analytical role. You will manage significant media budgets against clear efficiency targets (ROAS, CAC and NC MTA ROAS), work out what is really driving performance, and work closely with creative, merchandising and analytics colleagues so that targeting and creative keep getting better. The role is critical to scaling our paid social acquisition engine.

Responsibilities

Paid social strategy and investment (the main focus of the role)

  • Own paid social strategy and delivery for selected Quince departments across Meta, TikTok and emerging social channels.
  • Manage and optimise significant paid media budgets to meet customer acquisition and efficiency targets.
  • Monitor performance across campaigns, audiences and creative, and act quickly on what you find.
  • Run a continuous programme of testing across audience segmentation, creative formats, messaging, bidding and budget allocation.
  • Scale the campaigns that work, and deal with underperformance promptly.
  • Adjust spend quickly in response to performance signals and changing product priorities.

Performance analysis and optimisation

  • Analyse campaign results across different attribution frameworks.
  • Identify what drives incremental customer acquisition and revenue growth, and turn those findings into practical campaign and creative decisions.
  • Build and maintain dashboards, reporting frameworks and performance analyses.
  • Work with our analytics team to improve the accuracy of measurement and attribution.

Creative and testing collaboration

  • Work closely with the Creative, Studio and Production teams to shape creative that performs.
  • Develop ways of working that make sure creative suits each platform.
  • Keep testing volume high enough to support growth targets, with a steady supply of new creative.

Cross-functional collaboration

  • Work with Merchandising and Product to agree priority categories and launches.
  • Partner with Analytics and Data on attribution and measurement.
  • Present performance insights and growth opportunities to leadership.

Growth experimentation and channel development

  • Find opportunities to expand into new paid social surfaces and formats.
  • Test new growth approaches, including audience expansion, creator-led ads and performance creative formats.
  • Keep improving our testing frameworks so we can run more experiments and learn more from each one.

What success looks like

In this role, you will:

  • manage and optimise significant paid social spend for your departments against clear targets for ROAS, CAC and NC MTA ROAS;
  • drive scalable customer acquisition through testing, experimentation and analysis;
  • find new audience, creative and bidding opportunities that unlock incremental growth;
  • build a high-performing creative pipeline in partnership with the creative teams;
  • use data and attribution models to guide budget allocation and channel strategy; and
  • respond quickly, and sensibly, to what the numbers are telling you.

Qualifications Required:

  • six or more years of experience in performance marketing or paid social growth;

  • deep experience managing Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram) at scale, with real ROAS and CPA pressure;

  • experience managing TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube and other paid social channels;

  • strong analytical skills, with experience of attribution models and performance data;

  • a proven record of managing and optimising large paid media budgets;

  • experience of running performance creative tests and working closely with creative teams;

  • a data-led mindset, together with strong operational discipline; and comfort working in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. 

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. We're looking for a Senior Manager, Product Design to lead a team of product designers working across some of Contentful’s most foundational product areas: content performance optimization, application platform capabilities, business foundations, and design systems. You'll balance strategic design leadership with people management: coaching designers, raising the bar on craft, and ensuring design has a strong voice in how these foundational parts of the platform take shape.

 What To Expect?

  • You'll manage designers across three product areas: content performance optimization, application platform capabilities, business infrastructure, and design systems. Optimization, Application Foundations and Business Foundations. While all teams strive to deliver solutions for a holistic, unified platform, each has a distinct focus. 
    • Our Optimization group focuses on advancing personalization and analytics capabilities. 
    • Our Application Foundations group includes design systems & information architecture, as well as workflows & automation tooling, and search & discoverability. Notably, the Contentful platform is built on our open source design system, Forma 36.

  • You can be located in or near our London hub. The product designers you manage will be located in EMEA as well, distributed across London, Dublin and our Berlin headquarters. Your manager will be US based and you will collaborate with colleagues globally. 
  • Some travel is expected. The organization typically has training and/or workshops located in our Berlin headquarters, approximately quarterly.

  • A track record of leading design for complex, multi-team product areas. You should influence a coherent vision that translates across teams supporting a unified platform. 
  • Experience owning or contributing to a design system at scale; familiarity with design systems like Forma 36.
  • Demonstrated success managing distributed, global teams. 
  • A genuine interest in AI-native product design, including shipping AI-powered customer-facing features, as well as evolving design tooling and workflows.
  • Strong portfolio evidence of coaching designers' career growth. Experience facilitating promotions, skill development, and performance management. 
  • Comfort operating in a technically complex, enterprise/platform context. The interfaces and user flows we design operate within a headless, API first context and a mindset of ‘systems thinking’ is paramount.

title: (Senior) Operations Manager in Remote E-Commerce Agentur (m/w/d) · Remote
descriptionHtml:
Das ist dein Job bei uns

Du möchtest die operativen Systeme einer wachsenden Agentur verantworten und Prozesse bauen, die auch ohne dich funktionieren? Operations ist bei EVOLVE der Hebel, der das ganze Team schneller macht. Deine Aufgabe ist es, dafür zu sorgen, dass Ziele, Prozesse und Automationen im Alltag perfekt ineinandergreifen.

Wie dein Arbeitsalltag aussehen kann:

Im wöchentlichen Check-in fällt dir auf, dass drei Quartalsprojekte seit zwei Wochen stillstehen. Du fragst nicht nach dem Status, sondern schaust dir den Prozess dahinter an. Gemeinsam mit dem Teamlead gehst du den Ablauf durch: Die Zahlen liegen verteilt an 3 unterschiedlichen Orten und müssten jeden Montag von Hand zusammengetragen werden. Kein Wunder, dass es nicht passiert.

Du baust den Ablauf neu. Es entsteht ein Workflow mit klaren Verantwortlichen und Fristen, die Zahlen laufen automatisiert in ein Dashboard. Umgesetzt mit unserem Prozess-Team.

Im Reporting an die Geschäftsführung liegt der Zielfortschritt jetzt jede Woche auf dem Tisch. Einen Tag später nimmst du dir schon den nächsten Bottleneck vor. Nicht weil sich jemand beschwert, sondern weil dir ineffiziente Abläufe von selbst auffallen.

Genau das ist der Job.

Wofür wir arbeiten

Wir sind einer der führenden ganzheitlichen Wachstumspartner für E-Commerce-Brands im DACH-Raum.

Denn was wir immer wieder sehen: Agenturen und Dienstleister betreuen Brands nischig und siloartig, Kanal für Kanal, ohne Blick aufs Ganze. Dabei bleiben enorme Potenziale auf der Strecke.

Wir verstehen uns deshalb nicht als Dienstleister, sondern als Teil des Unternehmens unserer Kunden. Dafür arbeiten bei EVOLVE 30 Spezialisten in sechs Fachbereichen zusammen, vollständig remote seit Tag 1. Weekly Recaps, Coffee Chats und Team-Events sorgen dafür, dass Remote bei uns kein Einzelkämpfertum bedeutet.

So funktioniert Operations bei EVOLVE

Nur Prozesse, die nachgehalten werden, haben Wirkung. Diese Rolle lebt deshalb vom Tagesgeschäft und von Details, nicht von reiner Strategiearbeit. Genau darin liegt ihr Hebel.

  • Ziele bis in den Alltag. Jahres- und Quartalsziele werden zu Maßnahmen, Meilensteinen und Check-ins, die wirklich stattfinden

  • Automation statt Handarbeit. Was zweimal manuell passiert, läuft danach über Make, n8n oder Claude

  • KI als Werkzeug im Alltag. AI ersetzt bei uns niemanden. Jeder nutzt KI wie einen Junior an seiner Seite, um besser und effizienter zu arbeiten

  • Das EVOLVE OS hält all das zusammen. Ziele, Prozesse, Automationen und KI sind bei uns kein Flickenteppich, sondern ein System hinter unserer Dienstleistung. Du sorgst dafür, dass es im Alltag funktioniert und laufend besser wird

Was dich hier erwartet

  • Ziele operativ machen: Du übersetzt Jahres- und Quartalsziele in konkrete Maßnahmen, Meilensteine und Checklisten. So bleibt die Strategie im Alltag greifbar

  • Operative Abläufe: Du steuerst die Abläufe innerhalb der Agentur, bei Bedarf zusätzlich in Finance und People Ops, von Rechnungswesen bis Onboarding

  • Automationen: Du führst neue Automationen und Prozesse über Claude, Make und n8n ein. Du setzt selbst um oder mit Unterstützung unseres Teams

  • Datenanalyse: Du entwickelst KPI-Dashboards und Übersichten dort, wo sie gebraucht werden, und betreibst das OKR-System im Alltag mit Check-ins und Remindern

  • Bottlenecks: Zusammen mit den Teamleads gehst du Engpässe im Tagesgeschäft durch und löst sie an der Wurzel, nicht mit einem Pflaster

Deine Rolle und deine Ressourcen: Du arbeitest mit den Teamleads aller sechs Fachbereiche auf Augenhöhe, ohne sie disziplinarisch zu führen. Für die technische Umsetzung von Automationen steht dir unser AI- und Prozess-Team zur Seite. Du entscheidest, was gebaut wird.

Das solltest du mitbringen

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Projektgeschäft oder Prozessmanagement, idealerweise im Agentur- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld

  • Du kennst Projektmanagement-Tools wie ClickUp oder Asana und verstehst Automation-Tools wie Make oder n8n

  • Analytisches und systemisches Denken mit Controlling-Grundlagen. Du siehst nicht nur die Kennzahl, sondern auch, was dahinter steckt

  • Klare, strukturierte Kommunikation nach innen und außen. Du arbeitest mit Teamleads auf Augenhöhe an ihren Prozessen

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Google Tabellen und Excel für Auswertungen und Datenstrukturen

  • Hohe Affinität für AI-Tools wie Claude und ChatGPT. Du nutzt sie, um Systeme zu bauen und Probleme zu lösen, nicht nur um Texte zu erstellen

  • Sehr gute Selbstorganisation, weil wir vollständig remote arbeiten

Der Rahmen

  • Klare Entwicklungsperspektive Richtung Head of Operations

  • 100 % Remote, kein Hybrid-Kompromiss

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Zweimal jährlich Team-Events und Workations, in Person und an wechselnden Orten

  • Wöchentliche Team-Recaps und Coffee Chats, damit Remote nicht heißt, den ganzen Tag allein zu arbeiten

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Jobrad und Firmenfitness über Wellpass

  • Steuerfreier Sachbezug von 50 € monatlich als Gutschein deiner Wahl

  • Laptop deiner Wahl und hochwertige Homeoffice-Ausstattung

  • Weiterbildungsbudget sowie interne und externe Quellen und Mentoren an deiner Seite

  • Voller Zugriff auf unseren internen AI-Stack

So läuft der Prozess

Deine Bewerbung. Dein Lebenslauf reicht. Wenn wir Rückfragen haben, schicken wir dir einen kurzen Fragebogen.

Erstgespräch. Ein kurzes Video-Gespräch mit Vanessa aus unserem HR. Es geht um gegenseitiges Kennenlernen, Rahmen und Erwartungen.

Fachgespräch. Hier geht es in die Tiefe, mit der Geschäftsführung oder dem Head of Operations.

Finales Kennenlernen. Mit der Geschäftsführung und deinem zukünftigen Ansprechpartner, menschlich und fachlich.

Entscheidung und Start. Wir entscheiden schnell und planen dein Onboarding gemeinsam.

Wie lange das dauert: Wir legen Wert auf einen schnellen Bewerbungsprozess. Zwischen den einzelnen Schritten liegen nur wenige Tage. Wenn du parallel in anderen Prozessen bist, sag uns Bescheid. Dann richten wir uns danach.

Deine Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

Die ersten zwei Monate. Du lernst die Abläufe unserer sechs Fachbereiche kennen und übernimmst das Zielsystem im Alltag mit Check-ins, Remindern und Dashboards.

Mittelfristig. Du verantwortest Prozesse und Automationen in deinen Bereichen eigenständig. Dazu kommt die operative Steuerung der Finance- und People-Ops-Abläufe.

Langfristig. Fachlaufbahn mit Schwerpunkt Systeme und Automation oder Führungslaufbahn in Richtung Head of Operations, sobald Zielsystem, Prozesslandschaft und KPI-Landschaft stehen. Beide Wege entstehen durch Ergebnisse und nicht durch Wartezeit.

Deine Ansprechpartnerin

Vanessa, unsere HR Managerin, ist dein erster Kontakt und freut sich auf deine Bewerbung.

title: Senior Partner Growth Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Us

We are Ocado Commercial, and we are revolutionising online grocery. We partner with the world's leading retailers, providing our innovative Ocado Smart Platform (OSP) – a powerful blend of automation and software – to elevate their e-commerce capabilities. Join us and be part of a team that's shaping the future of retail, working with global giants from Kroger to AEON. 

About the Role

The Senior Partner Growth Manager role is an exciting opportunity in our Partner Success Team to directly influence the commercial success of our partners, some of the largest retailers in EMEA. This position will require reasonable travel to Saudi Arabia and/or Europe. 

Businesses that partner with Ocado come in all shapes and sizes, and leverage our technology in different ways.  In this role, you will combine your knowledge of ecommerce, grocery retail, and online marketing with communication skills and analytical abilities to shape and influence how our partners grow online. 

The Partner Growth Manager will work with the Ocado Partner Account team to drive the growth agenda in our partner’s business, enabling our partners to improve commercial outcomes, grow their customer base, order volume, and overall profitability. 

You will build effective relationships with key commercial, marketing, and ecommerce stakeholders in our partners’ businesses. You will leverage knowledge of customer objectives, strategic know-how, knowledge of the Ocado Smart Platform (OSP), as well as the expertise of our central growth subject matter experts to create and implement successful growth strategies. You will become a first line of e-commerce growth support, leveraging our team of central subject matter experts for more in-depth support. You will support your internal stakeholders in the region with insights and reporting on growth topics, as well as be a source of information and support for your partners. 

As part of the Partner Success Team you will be responsible forsupporting our partners in their day to day use of OSP, ensuring that their webshop is configured optimally, using the most impactful OSP features, to drive maximum customer acquisition, retention and basket size.

You will consult with partners through both in-depth projects in close collaboration with our Central Growth and/or Technology teams, as well as ongoing optimisation forums aimed at improving their commercial performance. You will leverage data to drive recommendations that improve overall performance. 

  • The Partner Growth Manager is accountable for shaping and delivering growth strategy for their assigned Partner(s), supporting improved commercial outcomes including customer acquisition, retention, order growth and profitability.
  • Works closely with the Partner’s ecommerce, marketing and technology teams and cross-functional Ocado stakeholders to align growth priorities and execution.
  • Uses growth, trading and customer data and analytics to understand commercial performance, identify trends and opportunities, and deliver clear, actionable recommendations to Partners and internal stakeholders.
  • Accountable for translating Partner growth objectives into clear, prioritised growth initiatives and optimisation opportunities that support long-term commercial success, maximising the potential of the OSP platform.
  • Acts as Ocado’s primary growth and ecommerce subject matter expert for the Partner, using deep knowledge of OSP capabilities and growth / go-to-market expertise to shape recommendations on ecommerce configuration, trading, monetisation and customer experience, as well as sustainable marketing and communications adapted to the local competitive landscape
  • Owns the Partner relationship for e-commerce and growth OSP roadmap engagement, acting as the named point of contact for, trading, monetisation, customer experience roadmap topic, and, in general, any non-operational topic.
  • Represents Partner growth and ecommerce requirements and priorities into Ocado’s roadmap governance processes, supporting feature discovery with clear problem definition, context and Partner business case and value articulation.
  • Monitors delivery and adoption of growth-critical features and capabilities, working with internal teams and Partners to maximise realised commercial value and improve utilisation of growth-enabling functionality.
  • Identifies and escalates risks, dependencies or delivery issues that may impact the Partner’s ability to realise growth from OSP capabilities.

About you

  • Languages: Fluency in English is essential. Arabic and European languages are highly desirable.
  • Bias to action, capable of designing data-driven strategies but also secure implementation
  • Stakeholder, relationship building and networking skills
  • A team player who’s comfortable interacting with Partner teams
  • Self-motivated with an ability to deliver to deadlines and multi-task under pressure
  • Comfortable dealing with ambiguity and uncertainty
  • Able to handle difficult situations, facing challenges with positivity, confidence and pragmatism
  • Experience in one or several of the following fields:
    • Performance marketing within a direct to consumer business (grocery ecommerce experience a plus)
    • Commercial or trading experience in a direct to consumer business ( grocery ecommerce experience a plus)
    • Retail management consulting 
  • Familiarity and passion for data-driven marketing, consumer insight, and ecommerce
  • Familiarity with or experience with measuring and optimizing key growth metrics including user growth, conversion, LTV

What we offer

We believe in supporting our people with meaningful, flexible benefits that prioritise well-being and work-life balance. Here’s a snapshot of what you can expect:

  • Time to recharge:
    25 days annual leave (rising to 27 after 5 years), plus the option to buy more – and 30 days a year to work from anywhere in the world.

    Private Medical Insurance from your first month, wellbeing support through specialist apps and EAP, plus Income Protection and Life Assurance.

title: Senior Partner Marketing Manager - GSIs
descriptionHtml:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Your mission: turn n8n's strategic partnerships into enterprise pipeline — and decide where our limited partner marketing resources go to make that happen.

n8n works with some of the world's largest consulting and technology companies: global SIs such as Accenture, Capgemini and BCG, and technology partners such as SAP, Microsoft, AWS and NVIDIA. In May 2026 SAP made a strategic investment in n8n and announced plans to embed it in Joule Studio. Partnerships are now a core part of our enterprise go-to-market.

The hard part isn't generating ideas. Partners propose more campaigns, events and content than any team could run, and enthusiasm doesn't always turn into execution. Without this role, we invest in winning partners and never turn them into pipeline. You'll fix that by choosing a few programs that matter, securing real commitments from both sides, and driving them to measurable results.

 

Set partner marketing priorities

  • Build integrated, multi-quarter marketing plans with our priority partners, aligned with the Partnerships team on where each relationship is heading

  • Rank opportunities on clear criteria — enterprise reach, joint value proposition, commercial upside, partner commitment and ability to execute — and say no, with reasons, to what doesn't make the cut

Run programs that create pipeline

title: Senior Platform / DevOps Engineer (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Bei der EWERK Consulting GmbH verbinden wir Technologie, Business und Menschen. Wir unterstützen unsere Kunden dabei, digitale Lösungen nicht nur zu planen, sondern erfolgreich umzusetzen. Dabei setzen wir auf pragmatische Ansätze, moderne Technologien und Teams, die Verantwortung übernehmen.

Ein Teil unserer Projekte findet in Umgebungen statt, in denen Ausfälle keine Option sind: Betreiber kritischer Infrastrukturen (KRITIS) in Energie, Versorgung und öffentlicher Verwaltung. Systeme, auf die sich Menschen jeden Tag verlassen, ohne je darüber nachzudenken. Verfügbarkeit ist hier kein SLA-Wert in einer Tabelle, sondern der eigentliche Zweck der Arbeit.

Für uns bedeutet DevOps mehr als Tools und Prozesse. Wir suchen Menschen, die automatisieren, beraten und gestalten wollen – und die mit Entwicklern (m/w/d) genauso gut sprechen können wie mit dem Betrieb beim Kunden.

Deine Mission

  • Du baust und betreibst die Plattformen, auf denen unsere Lösungen laufen: Container-Infrastruktur, Deployment-Pipelines, Konfiguration, Automatisierung.
  • Du machst Systeme beobachtbar und belastbar: Monitoring, Logging, Tracing, Alerting – und ziehst aus dem, was du siehst, die richtigen Schlüsse.
  • Du triffst Infrastruktur- und Betriebsentscheidungen, dokumentierst sie und vertrittst sie gegenüber Team und Kunde.
  • Du bist technischer Ansprechpartner (m/w/d) für den Kunden in allen Fragen rund um Betrieb, Sicherheit und Skalierung.
  • Du bringst Entwicklungsteams bei, wie man betreibbare Software durch Reviews, Standards und Mentoring baut, statt durch Vorschriften.
  • Du automatisierst Prozesse, auch mit KI-Unterstützung, wo sie tatsächlich etwas bringt.


Darauf freuen wir uns

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung als DevOps Engineer (m/w/d), Platform Engineer (m/w/d) oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle.
  • Container und Infrastruktur: Docker und Kubernetes im produktiven Einsatz; Infrastructure as Code (Terraform oder vergleichbar), GitOps-Ansätze und reproduzierbare Umgebungen sind dir nicht fremd.

  • Sicheres Auftreten im Austausch mit Kunden, Stakeholdern und interdisziplinären Teams.
  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und gutes Englisch.


Was dich bei uns erwartet

  • Plattformen mit echter Relevanz: Systeme, deren Verfügbarkeit Konsequenzen hat.

Unsere Benefits

  • Flexibilität ist unser Motto - Office, remote, Homeoffice oder Workation in der EU? Entscheide selbst!
  • Familienfreundlich - Wir bieten flexible Arbeitszeiten für die optimale Work-Life-Balance.

title: Senior Platform Engineer - Developer Experience
descriptionHtml:
Senior Platform Engineer - Developer Experience

Hybrid in London or Remote within the United Kingdom

We're looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to join the Platform team.

You’ll enable everyone at iwoca to build and ship with confidence, from engineers to analysts. You'll make it simpler and safer for people to deploy apps on their own, and keep improving the experience as iwoca grows.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The Platform team leads iwoca’s developer experience work. It looks after three areas:

  • Infrastructure. iwoca’s Kubernetes platform, GitOps deployments, CI components, and developer environments.

  • The route to production. The templates, tooling, and safe defaults teams use to go from a repository to production and run their own services.

  • The AI platform. Access to the latest models, an internal Claude Code plugin marketplace, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that connect AI tools to iwoca’s systems.

The Platform team is part of Core Systems, a group of about a dozen people who provide the shared tools and infrastructure that iwoca’s engineering, data, and analytics teams rely on. You’ll be one of six engineers in the Platform team.

The role

As the Senior Platform Engineer, you’ll own the developer experience roadmap and agree with the team on where you can make the biggest impact for the platform’s users. You’ll decide how each self-service tool works and build it yourself, making clear trade-offs between developer experience, reliability, security, and cost. The tools you build help teams get code live faster which results in fewer support requests for the Platform team.

Today, getting a new service live takes many separate steps and a lot of platform knowledge. You’ll spend most of your time building new self-service tools, and the rest migrating existing tooling and talking to users about where they get stuck. If you haven’t worked deeply with Kubernetes, Terraform, or GitOps, you can learn them here, with the team and plenty of resources to help. You’ll likely start with the friction map below.

Live project examples:

  • Friction map. Measuring how long it takes someone outside Core Systems to get new code live, and how many steps they go through. The result could be written documentation or a dashboard.

  • New services. Turning the merge requests a new service needs into one guided flow, so fewer changes wait for review.

  • AI guardrails. Building the Claude skills and checks that help AI-written changes pass review and deploy cleanly first time.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Software engineering. You’ve written and maintained production code in Python or Go, including tools and automation.

  • Ownership. You’ve set the direction for a platform or tooling area and looked after it for the long term. You’ve decided what to fix first and seen the work through.

  • Building for internal users. You’ve built tooling and written documentation for other engineers, or for colleagues who aren’t engineers, and changed both based on how people used them.

  • AI leverage. You’ve used AI to produce work you couldn’t have delivered without it. You know where it speeds up changes, and where a change needs careful human review.

Bonus:

  • Kubernetes. You’ve deployed and debugged services on Kubernetes, and know its common resources and terms.

  • CI/CD and GitOps. You’ve built or maintained CI pipelines in GitLab CI or a similar system, and deployed services through a GitOps tool such as Flux or Argo CD.

  • Infrastructure as code. You’ve defined cloud resources in Terraform or a similar tool.

  • Delivery metrics. You’ve tracked measures such as lead time or deployment frequency, and used them to judge whether a change helped.

  • Developer environments. You’ve worked with cloud workspaces or devcontainers, and know what makes a developer environment pleasant to work in.

The salary

We expect to pay from £90,000 to £120,000 for this role. But, we're open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Compensation: £90K – £120K

title: Senior Presales and Solution Consultant
descriptionHtml:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The position of the Senior Presales and Solution Consultant (Internal Title: Senior Value Engineer) is a trusted advisor helping customers achieve their strategic goals and realise significant value using the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. A Value Engineer has full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers – landing, expanding, adopting and renewing. Responsibilities include translating customers’ objectives into value assessments or proof-of-value projects, building specific Celonis business cases and demos, running value workshops, and engaging with multiple senior stakeholders to deliver value driven results and secure long term partnership agreements.

The Role:

You are spearheading our mission of data-driven business transformation with our customers. You will work in partnership with the Celonis Sales Teams and have full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers. You are our customers' trusted advisor and help them achieve their strategic goals and realize significant value using Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. In collaboration with our partners and Celonis Services, you will drive measurable business impact across various processes and industries and accelerate the adoption of our platform. You will blend deep process and industry expertise with a proven consulting skill set with strong analytical skills at the forefront of one of the fastest-growing tech companies worldwide.

Native-level French proficiency is required for this role. Candidates must be able to lead customer workshops, conduct executive presentations, and manage stakeholder interactions in French.

The role is based in Paris.

The work you’ll do:

Identify & Frame Value

  • Discover and translate customers’ strategic priorities into high-impact Celonis use cases
  • Build demos and business cases, leveraging industry benchmarks and best practices in order to win new customers 
  • Undertake Value Assessments or Proof-of-Value Projects and communicate the value opportunity and strategic roadmap to C-Level executive

Realize Value

  • Facilitate business value workshops and use Celonis to identify and qualify opportunities for process enhancement
  • Derive improvement measures in core business functions and initiate improvement actions and enterprise-wide change initiatives
  • Present results and realized value to senior management and C-level executives

Scale Value

  • Responsible for the end-to-end customer value journey, landing, expanding, adoption and renewing
  • Build a strategic expansion roadmap for customers embedding Celonis Process Intelligence as a strategic business transformation platform in their organization and therefore drive adoption and expansion
  • Provide feedback to our product development teams to enhance the Celonis platform and Apps based on new use cases

The qualifications you need:

Live for Customer Value: Experience in an analytical role with the objective to demonstrate or secure value through business data analysis, business process improvement and respective Software deployment. Ideally in a customer-facing role in Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering or IT/Management Consulting with a Business Software / SaaS Provider or a Consultancy. Alternatively in an Inhouse role (e.g. Center of Excellence for Data Mining / Analytics / Intelligence) within an Enterprise.

Data, Analytics, Applications & IT: Good knowledge of Business Software / SaaS applications (e.g. SAP),  experience with implementing RPA and/or BI Tools and/or building Dashboards, Apps and Action Flows. Knowledge of Python and/or SQL. Experience in collaborating with IT teams.

Process Improvement & Value Realization: Experience in identifying use cases for business process improvement and deploying improvement measures,  being a change agent and training users/process owners to realize value

Project Management: Experience in planning and managing project scopes, expectations and timelines. You will manage multiple projects across your aligned accounts that will be at different parts of the value journey. Also, you will leverage partners from the Celonis Ecosystem wherever possible.

Executive Stakeholder Management: Experience in preparing and communicating (value) roadmaps and results to stakeholders and management, both internally and externally. Excellent communication and presentation skills.

Business Domain Expertise: Understanding of the Finance and/or Supply Chain domain as well as strategic transformation initiatives (e.g. Shared Services Transformation or System Transformation)

Industry Expertise: Ideally expertise in one or more industries (e.g. Manufacturing, Automotive, Consumer, Retail, Pharmaceuticals, Chemicals) and the ability to develop a deep understanding of industry trends and strategic opportunities 

Degree: In Technology & Management, Industrial/Business Engineering, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics or a comparable degree program

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.

title: Senior Pricing Analyst
descriptionHtml:
👋🏻 Hello, we're Laka

You might not have heard of us yet - that's OK, you've found us now - come and find out more about our journey...

Founded in 2017, Laka set out to transform insurance by connecting passionate cyclists to form a collective and protect their bikes for when things go wrong - a better model for insurance was born. For once people come first in insurance by fairly sharing the cost amongst each other. We exist to rewrite the rules of insurance so it’s something people stand with, not against.

Our model: Laka makes sure everything runs smoothly for The Collective - from exceptionally fast claims, splitting the cost fairly, guaranteeing a maximum price and all the other heavy lifting of a regulated insurance business. For that service, the collective pays Laka a fee relative to the claims in a month.

Take a closer look at exactly what this means and how it works here.

What have we been up to since then...?

In a nutshell, we've been very busy! Here are a few of the massive achievements we've had:

🚀 Raised $10.4 million at series B!

🚀 Grown the team to over 60 Lakanauts, based across the UK and NL, enabling a choice-based, remote-first way of working

🚀 Launched Laka in a total of 11 countries, essentially helping more people in more places!

🚀 Captured the UK and NL enthusiast cyclist market and expanded into commercial business partnering

🚀 Been awarded 'Best Cycle Insurance Provider' (for the past 8 years in a row - go us! 🥳)

🚀 Opened 3 shiny new offices in London, Bristol & Amsterdam to provide spaces for people to collaborate as they like

🚀 We've also achieved a 5* rating on Google Reviews and Glassdoor - go check us out!

Help us continue to change an outdated industry...

We’re growing real fast on our path to make the Laka collective model the industry standard and we’re expanding across segments, products, and territories. We’re looking for innovative, bold and brave minds to help us build the world’s best insurance company.

🧮 Pricing at Laka

Pricing our Collective is what makes Laka unique, so this role sits at the heart of what we do.

Each month, members pay their share of the Collective's claims and a fee for Laka's services, up to their own cap. A stop loss from our insurers picks up anything above the total of all caps. Pricing it well means keeping the Collective healthy while balancing the interests of our members, Laka and our insurance partners.

We have a fledgling pricing stack that we are looking to advance with your help.

🤘🏼 The role

You'll own pricing across all five markets and both sides of our business. One side is cyclists who buy from us direct. The other is the partners who sell or bundle our cover, from bike brands and retailers to leasing companies and delivery fleets. It's a broad, hands-on role, working with our Pricing Analyst.

What you'll be getting up to:

  • Define and deliver pricing for our Collective in the UK and Europe: members' caps, rating factors and fees, based on claims frequency and severity by market and segment.
  • Price our partner business, from bike brands and retailers to leasing companies and fleets, and support our Commercial team on new deals and renewals.
  • Prepare rate reviews and pricing proposals for our insurance partners, and work with them on stop loss and capacity terms.
  • Develop our pricing stack, tools and processes with Engineering and Data.
  • Manage and develop our Pricing Analyst.

You'll be successful by:

  • Reviewing retail and partner pricing across all five markets in your first three months and agreeing priorities with us.
  • Taking the first cap and fee changes live, with proposals our insurers approve first time.
  • Taking our pricing stack to the next level within your first year.

Requirements

🚀 Sound like you?

  • 👉🏻 This role will be a great fit if you:
    • Have 6+ years' experience in insurance pricing, with rate changes you've designed and taken live.
    • Ideally have priced both direct-to-consumer and partner or B2B business: deep in one, credible in the other.
    • Build pricing models in code: GLMs and GBMs in Python, with SQL.
    • Are sharp and commercially minded, balancing growth, retention and profitability.
    • Can explain technical work simply to partners, insurers and our leadership team.
    • Have managed or mentored an analyst and are happy to stay hands-on.
    • Already use AI tools like Claude and Claude Code, or are keen to make them core to how you work.
  • Plus points:
    • Actuarial exams (IFoA, AAG, DAV or Institut des Actuaires): welcome, but not required. We care most about what you've priced.
    • Dutch, German or French.
    • An interest in cycling.

Benefits

🌟 Our perks

🏠 Remote-first way of working - you choose whether you work from home or our beautiful offices in London, Bristol and Amsterdam(we have no minimum expectation of how many days you come in, although we'd love to see your friendly face!)

📈 Share options - we want you to be rewarded for Laka's success - everyone in the business is granted share options when they join

💰 Performance driven scheme - if the company hits its targets, you'll get a cash bonus of 5% of your base salary annually

🌴 Annual leave - 25 days holiday (plus bank holidays), with the option to roll over up to 5 days per year

💶 Pension scheme - Laka pays 3% of your base salary into your pension to help you save for the future

💊 Private medical insurance - we’ll give you individual private cover, with the option to add partners & dependants too (at a small cost)

🍽 Lunch on us - £15 every first Wednesday of the month to enjoy lunch on Laka - pop out locally with people in the office, or order-in at home, the choice is yours

💃 Company-wide events - we love getting everyone together as much as possible - expect regular events throughout the year, for team building, bonding, and general good old-fashioned fun!

🎳 Monthly socials - as if quarterly company events weren't enough, we also give each office a budget for a monthly social activity (think anything from low-key dinner & drinks through to adventure golf, paddleboarding, bowling, electric darts, trampoline parks and more!)

👚 Laka swag - we'll give you some lovely Laka kit to get you started, including a jumper & t-shirts so you can feel (& look) like part of the family

🚴 Laka credit - for all you cyclists, we'll give you £10 credit per month towards insuring your bike(s) with us - plus give you access to a bunch of cycling industry discounts

🧠 Mental health support - unlimited support via Spill, including one-to-one therapy sessions

🌈 Belonging at Laka

We're committed to building and sustaining a business that promotes diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging - our customer collective is broad and inclusive, and we'd like our own people to be too. We're fast becoming a global community of people and we believe each person's unique qualities should be celebrated as they are a huge part of what makes Laka a great place to be. We'd love you to bring your authentic self to work every single day, no matter your age, ethnicity, religion, citizenship, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, caring responsibilities, neurodiversity, or anything else that makes you, you. title: Senior Product Manager | Integrations & AI Foundations (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

Your Role

As Senior Product Manager for Integrations & AI Foundations, you're the product owner for bunch's integration and AI platform. You have two kinds of customers: external developers and fund-manager teams connecting to bunch, and the internal product teams building on top of what this team provides.

Integrations & AI Foundations is a new platform squad. It owns the infrastructure that lets data move securely between bunch and other systems, and lets every other product team build AI capabilities — extraction, retrieval, agents and evaluations — without each one solving the same hard problems again.

The team covers five connected areas:

  • Integrations / API layer — API contracts, authentication, versioning and deprecation, rate limits, uptime and SLA, and a Developer Portal

  • MCP layer — agent-callable tools built as thin wrappers over the same API contracts, including a customer-facing MCP offering

  • Document Parsing — a reusable ingestion, decomposition and extraction pipeline, with human-in-the-loop review and accuracy monitoring

  • Retrieval / RAG — chunking, embedding, vector store and retrieval, with access control enforced on every query, offered as a callable service

  • AI Agentic Layer — the agent framework, memory, guardrails, evaluation harness, observability and agent registry other teams use to ship their own agents

Document extraction, agent workflows, evaluations and multi-provider model fallback under EU data residency are already in production.

Fund managers don't want to retype data that already lives in their own systems, and they want to pull their bunch data into their own tools and their own AI. Customers and prospects ask for APIs, CRM and accounting syncs, automated exports of capital accounts, and MCP access.

You'll turn those signals into a coherent platform: one that customers integrate with, and that our own product teams build on, instead of a string of one-off builds.

You will:

  • Set platform strategy and sequencing across the five areas: decide how to slice the work and what ships first

  • Run APIs as a product: contracts, versioning and deprecation policy, rate limits, SLAs, Developer Portal and documentation, and time-to-integrate as a measure you actively drive down

  • Define and launch the customer-facing MCP offering: which capabilities get exposed, tool descriptions that agents actually invoke correctly, and a security review gate for anything customers touch

  • Generalise document parsing: the first use case is already live; your goal will be to take it over and generalise it so more teams can reuse its logic

  • Shape retrieval and the agentic layer as services other teams consume, with access control, guardrails, evaluations and observability built in rather than bolted on

  • Draw and hold ownership lines with domain teams. When a request doesn't map to a named responsibility, run the scoping conversation rather than absorbing it

  • Own platform-wide policy with Engineering and Security: data classification and residency, LLM cost and rate governance, and an integration and extraction registry so nothing gets built twice

  • Work directly with customers — fund managers, CFOs and their technical teams — and with Customer Success to understand integration needs, then turn them into platform decisions

  • Define success through goals and key results and clear metrics per area: API uptime and SLA, time-to-integrate, MCP adoption, extraction accuracy, and reuse across teams.

What success looks like

In your first 90 days

  • Resolve and document the MCP audience, governance model, and hand-off point between platform and domain teams

  • Agree a plan and timeline for moving extraction from the existing team onto the shared pipeline

  • Define a sequenced first slice, with baseline metrics for each area

In your first year

  • A versioned public API and Developer Portal that customers integrate with

  • A customer-facing MCP offering live

  • Multiple domain teams extracting from their documents on the shared pipeline, shipping an agent on the agentic layer, without having to run a separate vector store or having to rebuild extraction from scratch

About you

  • 6+ years in product management, with at least 3 on platform, API or developer-facing products in B2B SaaS

  • You've shipped and run public APIs: REST or GraphQL, OAuth and other authentication patterns, versioning, deprecation, and docs developers actually like

  • Hands-on experience shipping LLM features to production, whether extraction, RAG or agents. You understand evaluations, confidence scoring, failure modes and human-in-the-loop review, and can hold your own with Applied AI engineers on chunking, embeddings and model fallback

  • Working knowledge of MCP or agent tool-use, and a clear view on what makes a tool safe and reliable for an agent to call

  • Strong instincts for security and compliance with regulated data: access control, GDPR and data residency

  • You lead through influence. You're comfortable with internal teams as customers and can say no, or not us, clearly and with reasons

  • You write clearly and document decisions so others can build on them

Nice to have

  • Fintech, fund administration or private markets experience: capital calls, capital accounts, subscription documents, LP and portfolio reporting

  • Experience in an EU-regulated environment

  • You've built a Developer Portal or a partner integrations programme from zero

  • You've moved a capability out of one team and into a shared platform without breaking either side

  • Experience in a company moving from ops-led to product-led

Workplace & Benefits

  • Customizable benefits package (wellbeing, sport, mobility, food, and more)

  • 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays

  • Remote-flexible hybrid (3 days/week in office)

  • Up to 6 remote calendar weeks a year

  • A great tech and work setup

  • Work with a diverse team of 120+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains

Hiring process

  1. First interview with the People team (30 min) – Get acquainted with bunch and explore alignment

  2. Hiring Manager Interview with the VP of Product (60 min) – Discuss the role, your experience and your goals

  3. Case Interview with Product & Design (60 min) – Demonstrate how you think, work and communicate, based on a small case shared beforehand

  4. Final meetings with key stakeholders (3 x 30 min) – Learn more about the vision and discuss open questions

Curious to learn more?

Get a feel for who we are, how we work, and what we’re building:

  • About bunch – Our mission, product, and journey so far

  • Case Studies – About those who already build on bunch

  • Gathering insights – Our latest bunch of blog posts

  • Glossary – Explore commonly used private market terms

About bunch

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.

We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:
The Company

At AccountsIQ, part of the AIQ Group, we’re on a mission to deeply understand our customers and deliver technology that enriches their lives. Alongside ExpenseIn, a leading expense management platform within the group, we provide smart, feature-rich financial management software designed for ambitious businesses that have outgrown basic starter systems or seek a simpler, more affordable alternative to complex, costly ERP solutions.

Our cloud-based accounting software transforms the finance function, making it easier for multi-entity businesses to capture, process, and report their financial data with ease and efficiency.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to take the foundations set out in our growth strategy, our product vision and our customer focus and drive a throughline across every team, every launch and every customer touchpoint. You'll report to our Product Director and work closely with marketing, sales, account management, implementation and customer success, so the whole business tells the same story to the right customers. 

It's a hands-on role that balances strategy, operations and execution. You’ll inform critical decisions, do the work yourself and build the systems that let it scale. You'll also be the voice of our product, inside the business and out. There's plenty of room for this role to grow as the function does. 

What you'll be doing:

Understand 

  • Know our best fit customers better than anyone. Deepen our understanding of who we serve best, our core segments and the people involved in buying and using our products. Feed that directly into product decisions, and make sure messaging and launches are built around it. 
  • Reset competitive intelligence. Build a clear view of the landscape that helps teams win against the systems customers are outgrowing and the alternatives they're weighing up. 

Shape 

  • Develop the complete value proposition. Work with product and service leads so today's product, what's coming and the service experience (onboarding, implementation and customer success) all deliver on our positioning. 
  • Shape how customers see what we offer. Help evolve how our products and services are structured, named and packaged, in step with the roadmap, so the offer is easy to understand, shows where it's heading and gives every launch an obvious place to fit. 
  • Connect product value to commercial results. Understand how each release adds value for customers, and help us capture it in new business, expansion and retention. Measure the impact of launches and enablement on pipeline, win rates and adoption. 

Deliver 

  • Lead the go-to-market rhythm. Run how product, marketing and customer-facing teams across our product family prepare for and deliver launches, so the right work happens at the right time and everyone knows where things stand. 
  • Be the voice of our product. Speak at customer roadshows, events and webinars, and give our point of view on market shifts, such as what AI means for finance leaders in the UK and Ireland. 
  • Strengthen our core, open up what's next. Make our proven go-to-market motion sharper while building new ones for the new segments our product roadmap opens up.  
  • Enable the whole business. Make sure every team, from sales and customer success to support and product, understands our customers, segments, competitors and positioning well enough to move their own work forward at pace. Clear enough to act on, deep enough to rely on. 
  • Turn positioning into pipeline. Work hand in hand with demand generation on campaign messaging, ABM plays, paid copy and outbound sequences. 
  • Build a go-to-market system that stays current. Use AI and automation to keep customer and market insight flowing in, and keep messaging, battle cards, proof and customer stories up to date and easy to find. 

What you'll need:

  • Typically six or more years in B2B SaaS product marketing, including launches for a product bought through a considered, sales-led process. 
  • Experience being part of building or scaling a product marketing function, ideally in a scale-up. 
  • Scale-up instincts. You know what breaks as a business outgrows its earlier stage habits, and how to fix it. 
  • Hands-on use of AI to run product marketing better: synthesising research, keeping content current, and building workflows that save the team time, with the judgement to know when the output is right. 
  • Ownership of positioning and messaging, seen through to how the business sells, onboards and supports customers. 
  • A track record of running go-to-market across product, sales and customer success, leading through influence rather than authority. 
  • Customer understanding you've built first-hand: interviews, win/loss, segmentation and personas, and evidence it changed what a product team built. 
  • Based in the UK or Ireland, with regular time in our London and Dublin offices. 

Desirable: 

  • Experience in finance, accounting or fintech software, especially selling to finance leaders 
  • Marketing a multi-product suite, or bringing products and teams together 
  • Working with an offer where experience (implementation, onboarding, customer success) is part of the value

Nos solutions permettent d’optimiser les prises en charge, d’enrichir la compréhension des patients en continu pendant leur parcours de soin et d’accélérer la recherche clinique grâce à la collecte, la structuration et l’analyse fine des données de vie réelle. descriptionHtml:

You also guide colleagues through change control. Rather than executing every change yourself, you ensure people understand and follow the process, ask the right questions, consider the relevant implications, obtain the necessary approvals, and ensure that changes are completed Correctly and on time.

This role requires a strong analytical and systematic mindset combined with a pragmatic approach to quality. You should be comfortable identifying problems, but more importantly, finding workable solutions and alternatives. You understand the requirements of working in a regulated environment without approaching quality as simply enforcing rules. As you become familiar with how we work, you identify opportunities to improve the compliance and efficiency of the Change Control process and develop a clear plan for implementing those improvements.

This is what success looks like:

After 12 months, you are a trusted partner for colleagues working with our quality systems and Change Control process. You confidently support the organization in executing changes, ensuring they are well considered, appropriately approved, and completed on time. You have improved the Change Control process to strengthen both compliance and efficiency, and have identified and implemented improvements across other areas of the QMS. At Vitestro, ownership is not a slogan - it is an expectation. We trust people to take responsibility, make decisions, and drive work forward.

title: Senior Quantum Optics Scientist - Spin-Based Quantum Systems
descriptionHtml:
- About Quandela:

Quandela is a European deeptech scale-up developing modular, scalable and energy-efficient photonic and spin-optical quantum computers, accessible through the cloud and on-premises.

With over 140 employees, we develop our own hardware and software stack, from semiconductor quantum emitters and photonic processors to quantum control systems and algorithms.

Our ambition is to build large-scale, fault-tolerant quantum computers, combining quantum dot technologies, scalable spin-photon interfaces and distributed entanglement within future Spin-Optical Quantum Computing (SPOQC) architectures.

- About this position:

You will join Quandela's Semiconductor Optics Team, bringing together expertise in quantum optics, spin physics, semiconductor technologies and quantum information.

Your focus will be to develop and validate photon-mediated spin-spin entanglement protocols, improve spin coherence and operation fidelity, and advance optical control techniques for future hybrid quantum computing architectures.

We are looking for an experienced experimental scientist who can independently drive complex experimental activities, shape technical directions and translate scientific results into reliable technological building blocks, working closely with our research and engineering teams.

With several experimental building blocks still under development, you'll have room to shape technical choices, tackle open scientific challenges and directly influence our technology roadmap.

- What you'll do:

Spin-based quantum experiments

  • Design, develop and optimize optical experiments involving spin-photon sources.
  • Implement optical control schemes for spin initialization, readout and manipulation.
  • Characterize spin coherence, operation fidelity and entanglement quality.

Scientific and experimental ownership

  • Independently drive experimental investigations, from design to validation.
  • Structure and prioritize scientific activities, milestones and technical challenges.
  • Troubleshoot complex experimental systems and propose technical improvements.
  • Share expertise and support less experienced colleagues when relevant.

Technology development and integration

  • Develop and validate photon-mediated spin-spin entanglement protocols.
  • Collaborate with theory, electronics and semiconductor technology teams.
  • Improve experimental robustness, reproducibility and system performance.
  • Translate scientific results into demonstrators and technological building blocks for future multi-spin architectures.

- How You Will Grow:

During your first 3 months
You will become familiar with Quandela's experimental platforms and ongoing demonstrators, contributing your expertise to current technical challenges.

Within 6 months
You will drive dedicated experimental workstreams, contribute to key technical decisions and strengthen theory-to-experiment feedback loops.

Within 1 year
You will help shape the team's experimental direction, advance distributed entanglement demonstrations and contribute to future spin-based architectures.

Requirements

- What we're looking for

We are looking for an experienced experimental researcher combining strong scientific expertise, technical autonomy and the ability to drive complex research activities.

Must-have

  • PhD in Spin Physics, Quantum Optics or a related field.
  • Hands-on experience with spin-based quantum systems (control, readout or coherence measurements).
  • Proven autonomy in designing, optimizing and troubleshooting complex quantum experiments.
  • Strong understanding of quantum optics, spin coherence and experimental measurement techniques.
  • Ability to lead scientific activities and make independent technical decisions.
  • Comfortable collaborating across experimental, theory and engineering teams

Important, but you can grow here

  • Photon-mediated entanglement protocols and multi-spin architectures.
  • Semiconductor quantum emitters, quantum dots and spin-photon interfaces.
  • Advanced optical control, cryogenic platforms and fast electronics.
  • Experimental qualification, system integration and technology transfer.

Bonus points

  • Experience bridging academic research and industrial R&D.
  • Experience coordinating scientific projects or mentoring researchers.

- Career Stage & Team Contribution:

We primarily target candidates with a PhD and 4+ years of postdoctoral or equivalent R&D experience, combining scientific expertise with strong experimental autonomy.

Researchers completing a substantial postdoc are also welcome if they demonstrate scientific maturity, technical ownership and readiness for broader responsibilities.

People management experience is not required. What matters is your ability to drive scientific activities, tackle complex technical challenges and share your expertise with the team.

Benefits

  • Profit-sharing and a company savings plan.
  • Public transport subscription covered at 50%.
  • Annual sustainable mobility bonus for eco-friendly transport (e-bike, electric car).

Localisation of the position : Based at the IPVF campus in Palaiseau, within the Paris-Saclay research ecosystem.

Our spin-based platforms are still evolving, leaving room to explore new approaches, influence technical directions and take real ownership of experimental challenges.

title: Senior Sales Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Elite is the trusted automation platform for law firm operations across most of the world’s largest and most successful law firms. Elite has guided firms through every technology shift and today delivers the only cloud-native SaaS platform that unifies financial, invoice, time, and data management into a single system of action. With embedded AI, predictive analytics, and integrated payments, Elite’s products enable firms to shorten billing cycles, reduce write-offs, and unlock firm-wide insights, making financial operations the foundation for law firm innovation and growth. Learn more at elite.com.

Position Overview 

Elite is seeking a Senior Sales Engineer to lead complex, enterprise solution engagements across the global legal market. 

This role is designed for a strategic, business-minded pre-sales professional who thrives in high-visibility environments and operates as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders and a collaborative partner to Sales, Product, and leadership teams. 

We are seeking a candidate with strong enterprise software, ERP, financial systems, or SaaS experience who brings exceptional business acumen, executive communication skills, and the ability to quickly master complex platforms. Experience within the legal industry or Practice Management Systems is valuable but not required. 

In this role, you will shape deal strategy, guide executive discovery, and influence buying decisions by connecting client business priorities to differentiated, outcome-driven solutions. A key focus includes supporting firms through digital transformation initiatives, including on-premise to cloud migrations.   

Senior Sales Engineers are expected to elevate pre-sales standards, model value-based engagement, and positively influence team culture through collaboration, professionalism, and leadership without authority. 

Work Arrangement: ​Remote​ 

This role requires the individual to be based in ​UK Time Zone (GMT/BST)​  

Responsibilities 

  • Lead executive-level conversations centered on business outcomes, total cost of ownership, risk mitigation, scalability, and long-term strategic value.
  • Serve as the primary solution leader on complex enterprise opportunities from qualification through close.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Marketing, and leadership to align deal strategy and solution positioning.
  • Develop and articulate clear value hypotheses aligned to client-defined success metrics early in the sales cycle.
  • Conduct structured, consultative discovery with senior stakeholders across Finance, IT, Operations, and Firm Leadership.
  • Translate complex technical capabilities into compelling commercial narratives tailored to executive audiences.
  • Design and deliver high-impact demonstrations and strategic workshops aligned to client decision criteria.
  • Support pricing and commercial discussions by reinforcing quantified business value and transformation outcomes.
  • Influence deal direction by identifying risk, competitive differentiation, and expansion opportunities.
  • Act as a senior escalation point during evaluations, resolving complex functional or technical concerns with credibility and composure.
  • Contribute to evolving pre-sales methodologies and continuously raise the standard of execution.
  • Contribute to a high-performance pre-sales culture through collaboration, knowledge sharing, and modeling best-in-class execution.
  • Ensure disciplined deal execution through accurate opportunity alignment and forecasting collaboration.
  • Manage multiple concurrent enterprise pursuits with professionalism, responsiveness, and precision.
  • Perform other duties as assigned to support departmental and company objectives.​

Qualifications  

  • ​​​6–8+ years of experience supporting complex enterprise software sales (ERP, financial systems, SaaS platforms, or comparable enterprise solutions).
  • Proven experience leading consultative, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles.
  • Demonstrated ability to quickly learn and articulate complex software platforms.
  • Strong executive presentation and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate technical capabilities into measurable business value.
  • Experience supporting digital transformation initiatives, including on-premise to cloud migrations, strongly preferred.
  • Experience operating in competitive enterprise sales environments with multi-threaded stakeholder engagement.
  • Background in finance systems, enterprise applications, or industry-specific enterprise platforms.
  • Legal or Practice Management System experience (including 3E) is a plus, not required.
  • Strategic thinker with strong business acumen and structured problem-solving skills.
  • Executive-level communication presence with the ability to influence senior stakeholders.
  • Ability to travel up to 50% as business needs require.
  • Role requires the following physical capacity:​ ​Light: up to 20 lbs – occasional lifting or movement of light objects​
  • Must be legally authorized to work in​ ​United Kingdom​ 

What Success Looks Like: 

  • Elevates the quality and effectiveness of executive engagement across enterprise pursuits.
  • Strengthens value-based selling and business case positioning across the team.
  • Positively influences win rates and competitive positioning.
  • Serves as a collaborative leader and trusted partner across the organization.
  • Contributes to a culture of accountability, preparation, and continuous improvement. 

Benefits

  • Wellness Initiatives
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Generous Global Parental Leave
  • Calm, free premium subscription
  • Employee Discount Program

Please note that we do not offer sponsorship for this position.

Additional Information

At Elite Technology, we embrace an employee-centric, flexible work model that empowers you to do your best work in the environment that suits you. However, we also recognize the importance of in-person collaboration for key moments that truly matter.

In our flexible remote approach, you have the freedom to choose a workspace within your home country that best fits your needs. Our corporate offices are located in New York City, Los Angeles, Costa Rica, and the Philippines, providing additional options for those who prefer or need a hybrid work environment.

Our diverse global team spans the U.S., Canada, U.K., Costa Rica, the Philippines, and Australia. Please note that at this time, we are unable to hire employees located in Quebec or Ontario Provinces, Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, Louisiana, and Oklahoma.
