title: Senior Sales Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Us

With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world’s leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.

Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.

At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.

Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.

Reports To

VP Sales - Europe

What You Will Be Doing

• Own the full sales cycle for a portfolio of enterprise accounts — from first conversation through to close — and grow revenue across both existing relationships and new business within CPOs, retail, hospitality, amusement & recreation, and telecoms.
• Build and execute a territory plan for the UK that identifies the highest-value opportunities across charge point operators and destination verticals, leverages ChargePoint’s channel partners and resellers, and sequences deals with discipline.
• Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder organisations: you will engage operations directors, property managers, sustainability leads, procurement teams and C-suite decision-makers, often within the same deal.
• Develop consultative, solution-led proposals that combine ChargePoint’s hardware, software and energy management capabilities into outcomes your customers care about — whether that is network uptime for a CPO, dwell-time revenue for a hospitality brand, or footfall conversion for a retailer.
• Maintain a clean, accurate pipeline in Salesforce and deliver reliable forecasts — your leadership team will rely on your judgement.
• Collaborate closely with our Solutions Engineering, Marketing and Customer Success teams to deliver a seamless experience from pre-sale through deployment.
• Stay close to the evolving UK charging landscape: understand CPO business models, OZEV grant programmes, the UK’s ZEV mandate trajectory, and how destination charging is becoming a competitive differentiator for retail, leisure and hospitality brands.

What You Will Bring to ChargePoint

  • Enterprise sales credibility in complex environments — you bring at least five years of closing experience selling technical or SaaS solutions to large organisations, with a track record of personally originating, shaping and closing multi-stakeholder deals across operations, sustainability, procurement and C-suite contacts.
  • Territory-building discipline — you know how to build a market from a plan, not just work one you inherited. You can identify high-value targets across CPOs, retail, hospitality, amusement & recreation and telecoms, sequence deals with rigour, and balance your own prospecting with channel partner leverage and inbound pipeline.
  • Consultative, outcome-led selling — you move beyond product features to build proposals around what the customer actually cares about — network uptime for a CPO, dwell-time revenue for a hospitality brand, footfall conversion for a retailer — combining ChargePoint's hardware, software and energy management capabilities into a single, compelling business case.
  • Fluency in the UK charging landscape — you either understand CPO business models, destination charging economics, OZEV grant programmes, grid connection challenges and the ZEV mandate trajectory, or you can demonstrate you will get up to speed quickly enough to hold credible conversations from day one.
  • Forecast reliability and pipeline discipline — you maintain a clean, accurate Salesforce pipeline that your leadership team can trust, and you take personal accountability for the quality of your forecast — no sandbagging, no inflating, just honest commercial judgement.

Requirements

• You bring at least five years of enterprise sales experience, ideally selling technical or SaaS solutions to large organisations. E-mobility or energy infrastructure experience is a strong plus, but not essential if you bring the right commercial instincts and an understanding of how CPOs, retailers, or hospitality operators buy.
• You have a track record of consistently meeting or exceeding quota, and you can point to complex deals you personally originated, shaped and closed.
• You are comfortable building a territory from a plan — identifying targets, working with channel partners and managing your own prospecting alongside inbound pipeline.
• You understand the UK charging ecosystem or can demonstrate you will get up to speed quickly: CPO business models, destination charging economics, grid connection challenges, and how public and workplace charging strategies intersect.
• You communicate with clarity and credibility, whether presenting to a C-suite audience, writing a business case, or briefing internal stakeholders.
• You are based in the United Kingdom and willing to travel regularly across the territory.

Location

UK- Remote

title: (Senior) Sales Manager (m/w/d) | München-Nord
descriptionHtml:
Vertrieb, Beauty und Verantwortung für deinen eigenen Standort.

Du hast Freude am Verkauf, kannst Menschen begeistern und möchtest gemeinsam mit deinem Team etwas bewegen? Dann werde Sales Manager / Standortleiter (m/w/d) bei hairfree in München-Nord.

Bei uns verbindest du persönliche Kundenberatung mit aktivem Vertrieb und der Leitung unserer Lounge. Du berätst Menschen, die sich bereits für dauerhafte Haarentfernung interessieren, begleitest sie bis zum Vertragsabschluss und entwickelst deinen Standort gemeinsam mit deinem Team weiter.

Dein Vorteil im Vertrieb: Du arbeitest mit vorqualifizierten Anfragen von Menschen, die bereits Interesse an dauerhafter Haarentfernung¹ haben. So kannst du direkt an ihren Wünschen anknüpfen und dich auf überzeugende Beratung und erfolgreiche Abschlüsse konzentrieren.

Über uns

Die hairfree GmbH ist Marktführer für dauerhafte Haarentfernung¹ in der DACH-Region. Mit über 70 Standorten in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz sowie mehr als 100 Mitarbeitenden gehören wir zu den führenden Anbietern im Bereich ästhetischer Dienstleistungen.

Seit über 20 Jahren verbinden wir professionelle Beratung, innovative Behandlungskonzepte und echte Leidenschaft für Beauty. Unser Ziel ist es, Menschen zu einem neuen Hautgefühl zu verhelfen, sicher, individuell und mit höchstem Qualitätsanspruch.

Bei hairfree erwarten dich klare Strukturen, moderne Prozesse, ein starkes Team und echte Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

Was dich bei uns erwartet

  • Festgehalt plus ungedeckelte Provisionen: Neben deinem Grundgehalt verdienst du an deinem Verkaufserfolg mit.

  • Verantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum: Du bringst eigene Ideen ein und entwickelst deine Lounge gemeinsam mit deinem Team weiter.

  • Strukturierte Einarbeitung: Du lernst unsere Leistungen, Beratungsabläufe und Systeme Schritt für Schritt kennen.

  • Regelmäßige Coachings: Unsere Academy und interne Trainings unterstützen dich in Beratung, Verkauf und Führung.

  • Berufliche Entwicklung: Du baust deine Fähigkeiten aus und kannst bei entsprechender Eignung weitere Verantwortung übernehmen.

  • Abgestimmte Arbeitszeiten: Wir planen deine Einsätze gemeinsam und passend zu den Kundenterminen.

  • Unterstützung im Alltag: Du arbeitest eng mit der Vertriebsleitung zusammen und tauschst dich mit anderen Standorten aus.

  • Moderne Arbeitsumgebung und gute technische Ausstattung.

  • Mitarbeiterrabatte, Vergünstigungen und gemeinsame Events.

  • Gute Erreichbarkeit und Parkmöglichkeiten

Deine Aufgaben

  • Beraten und verkaufen: Du führst persönliche Beratungsgespräche, erkennst individuelle Bedürfnisse und gewinnst Kundinnen und Kunden für die passende Behandlung.

  • Vertragsabschlüsse erzielen: Du erklärst Angebote verständlich, beantwortest Fragen und führst Interessierte verbindlich bis zum Abschluss.

  • Kontakte nachfassen: Du bleibst an offenen Anfragen und Angeboten dran und vereinbarst konkrete nächste Schritte.

  • Deinen Standort steuern: Du behältst Umsatz, Vertriebskennzahlen und Terminauslastung im Blick. Daraus leitest du Maßnahmen ab, die deine Lounge voranbringen.

  • Dein Team unterstützen: Du gibst Orientierung, begleitest deine Mitarbeitenden im Vertriebsalltag und förderst ihre Entwicklung durch regelmäßiges Feedback.

  • Verlässliche Abläufe schaffen: Du sorgst dafür, dass Kundenanfragen zeitnah bearbeitet und vereinbarte Beratungsstandards eingehalten werden.

  • Informationen dokumentieren: Du pflegst Gespräche, Angebote und Vereinbarungen sorgfältig in unserem digitalen System.

  • Gemeinsam besser werden: Du tauschst dich mit der Vertriebsleitung und anderen Standorten aus und bringst Ideen für bessere Abläufe und Kundenerlebnisse ein.

Du übernimmst Verantwortung und bekommst dafür Rückhalt: Mit einer persönlichen Einarbeitung, regelmäßigen Trainings und einem Team, mit dem du Fragen und Herausforderungen gemeinsam angehen kannst.



  • Freude am Verkauf: Du berätst mit Überzeugung, gehst auf Fragen ein und begleitest Interessierte aktiv bis zum Vertragsabschluss.

  • Gespür für Menschen: Du hörst aufmerksam zu, erkennst Bedürfnisse und baust mit deiner offenen, empathischen Art Vertrauen auf.

  • Interesse an Beauty: Haut, Ästhetik und dauerhafte Haarentfernung¹ begeistern dich. Du möchtest unsere Leistungen kennenlernen und verständlich vermitteln.

  • Klare Kommunikation: Ob persönlich, am Telefon oder im Team: Du trittst freundlich, professionell und verbindlich auf.

  • Organisationstalent: Du behältst Kontakte, Angebote und Termine im Blick und fasst offene Themen zuverlässig nach.

  • Verantwortungsbewusstsein: Du möchtest deinen Standort voranbringen, gemeinsame Ziele erreichen und dein Team im Alltag unterstützen.

  • Lernbereitschaft: Du nimmst Feedback an und hast Lust, dich in Verkauf, Beratung und Führung weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Idealerweise passende Erfahrung: Du hast bereits im Vertrieb, in der Kundenberatung, im Einzelhandel, in Beauty, Kosmetik, Fitness oder einer anderen Dienstleistungsbranche gearbeitet. Erste Führungserfahrung ist ein Plus.

Du kommst aus einer anderen Branche? Auch als Quereinsteiger (m/w/d) bist du willkommen, wenn du Verkaufstalent mitbringst und bereit bist, Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Wir unterstützen dich mit einer strukturierten Einarbeitung und regelmäßigen Trainings.

Warum hairfree?

Klingt nach deiner nächsten Herausforderung?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung und darauf, dich kennenzulernen. Der Bewerbungsprozess ist bei uns unkompliziert und schnell. Du musst kein langes Anschreiben vorbereiten, ein kurzer Lebenslauf reicht uns für den Start völlig aus.

Wir melden uns zeitnah bei dir zurück.

Wenn du Fragen zur Position oder zum Team hast, melde dich jederzeit gerne direkt bei uns. Wir geben dir offen und ehrlich einen Einblick in die Rolle und unser Institut.

title: Senior SAP-Berater Finance & Controlling (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über die it-motive AG


Die it-motive AG zählt seit fast 25 Jahren zu den etablierten IT-Beratungsunternehmen in Deutschland.

Zu unseren Kunden gehören internationale Konzerne sowie große mittelständische Unternehmen aus den unterschiedlichsten Branchen. Die Nähe zu unseren Kunden und Mitarbeitern ist unser höchstes Gut, daher wird das Bild der it-motive AG durch eine solide und partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit nach innen und nach außen geprägt.

Für unseren SAP-Bereich suchen wir motivierte Teamplayer, die uns mit ihrem Know-how bereichern und zum weiteren Erfolg der it-motive AG beitragen.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Beratung und Betreuung unserer Kunden im Bereich SAP FI/CO

  • Analyse und Optimierung der Geschäftsprozesse im Finanz- und Controlling-Umfeld

  • Eigenverantwortliche Konzeptionierung und Implementierung SAP-Lösungen und übernehmen das Customizing

  • Umsetzung der S/4 HANA-Implementierungsstrategie

  • Durchführung von Schulungen und Workshops für Key-User und Endanwender

  • Unterstützung bei Rollouts, Migrationen und Systemintegrationen

Ihr Profil

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-) Informatik/ Betriebswirtschaft oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Projekterfahrung in der Implementierung und Betreuung von SAP FI/CO

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in SAP FI (z. B. Hauptbuch, Kreditoren, Debitoren) und CO (z. B. Kostenstellenrechnung, Innenaufträge)

  • Wünschenswert sind zusätzliche Erfahrungen mit S/4 HANA

title: Senior SDK Hardware Simulator Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Us:

Innatera is a rapidly growing Dutch semiconductor company that develops ultra-efficient neuromorphic processors for AI at the edge. These microprocessors mimic the brain’s mechanisms for processing fast data streams from sensors, enabling complex turn-key sensor analytics functionalities, with 10,000x higher performance per watt than competing solutions. Innatera's technology serves as a critical enabler for next-generation use cases in the IoT, wearable, embedded, and automotive domains.

To support our rapid development roadmap, we’re looking for a Senior SDK Hardware Simulation Engineer to help drive the development of our simulation environment by enabling early application development and system validation before hardware is available. As a key member of our SDK team, you’ll be responsible for designing and building accurate, high-performance C++ hardware simulators that accurately reflect our neuromorphic architecture. This role is critical to how our software and hardware teams collaborate to test, validate, and iterate on next-gen chip designs.

We will trust you with:

  • Design and implement simulation models in modern C++ (C++17/20) to replicate the functions of neuromorphic processors, CPUs, memory systems, and other components in the full SoC;

  • Convert technical hardware specs into high-performance, verifiable software models;

  • Contribute to performance modeling: simulate power consumption, latency to identify performance bottlenecks;

  • Support early application development with accurate and configurable hardware simulation tools;

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams (Digital Design, Firmware, SDK) to ensure models reflect the real hardware faithfully;

  • Take ownership of simulation infrastructure quality: write unit tests, review code, and continuously improve design and maintainability;

  • Collaborate on expanding our SDK feature set, ensuring the usability of the simulation for external developers.

  • Participate in team brainstorming and contribute to other SDK development tasks as needed.

What will you need to succeed:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field;

  • Strong C++ development skills (including C++17/20);

  • Proven track record of designing modular, maintainable, and testable software architecture;

  • Experience in transaction-level modeling of hardware components;

  • Solid understanding of digital hardware fundamentals (e.g., CPU, instruction sets, memory systems, DMA);

  • Familiarity with hardware/software co-design concepts;

  • Working knowledge of Python (e.g., for scripting, automation, or SDK integration);

  • Great communication skills.

Nice to have:

  • Experience working with RTL simulations, waveforms, and understanding how hardware behaves at the signal level;

  • Experience in low-power resource-constrained embedded programming;

  • Exposure to bare-metal firmware development, including assembly language;

  • Familiarity with RISC-V or ARM computer architectures;

  • Knowledge of machine learning, edge AI, and SNN (Spiking Neural Networks).

Whether you’re passionate about microarchitecture, excited by verification or physical design, driven by supporting operations, building strong teams, or mastering the details of accounting, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (Data Platform)
descriptionHtml:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join the team building and operating Nebius Data Platform — a distributed storage and a processing platform that acts as the company’s “source of truth” and the backbone of many internal (and some external) products.
Nebius Data Platform is a single multi-tenant ecosystem based on YTsaurus — instead of running separate HDFS/Kafka/HBase-style systems, we provide storage, compute, and analytics capabilities inside one platform.

We operate across data centers worldwide, running YTsaurus in dedicated Kubernetes clusters with Kubernetes operators and supporting services written primarily in Go. We maintain our own Nebius distribution, develop functionality across the core and platform services, and contribute upstream where it makes sense. This gives us the ability to take improvements from design through implementation to production.

At scale today, this includes ~500 servers, ~20k CPU cores and ~10 PB of compressed data in our largest production cluster, supporting workloads ranging from business-critical pipelines and financial transactions to large-scale ML/LLM training datasets and compute.
As an SRE, you’ll combine software engineering with production ownership: understand how the platform behaves, identify what limits its reliability and growth, and build lasting improvements alongside the developers and teams who use it.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own and improve the reliability, performance, and capacity of our YTsaurus clusters, with particular attention to data durability and predictable behavior under load.

  • Develop services, Kubernetes automation, and operational tooling in Go to simplify cluster provisioning, upgrades, and maintenance.

  • Improve monitoring, alerting, and diagnostic tools so we can detect problems early and understand their impact on users.

  • Investigate failures across Linux, networking, Kubernetes, and distributed storage and compute. Participate in on-call, lead incident investigations, and turn findings into lasting fixes.

  • Improve resource utilization and workload isolation as the platform grows and serves more teams.

  • Work with platform developers and users to make architectural decisions, deliver changes safely, and reduce repetitive operational work.

We expect you to have:

  • Experience operating distributed, stateful systems in production and taking responsibility for their reliability.

  • Strong Linux and networking fundamentals, including the ability to investigate resource bottlenecks and failures beyond the application layer.

  • Practical Kubernetes experience: deploying, operating, and troubleshooting production workloads.

  • Strong programming skills and experience building maintainable software. We primarily use Go; experience in another language and a willingness to learn Go are welcome.

  • A systematic approach to troubleshooting, using evidence from logs, metrics, traces, and system behavior.

  • The ability to drive improvements from problem identification through delivery, communicate trade-offs clearly, and collaborate with developers and platform users.

It will be an added bonus if you have:

  • Experience with Big Data systems (YTsaurus/Hadoop/Spark/ClickHouse/Kafka-like ecosystems).

  • Experience developing Kubernetes operators or controllers.

  • Experience with performance analysis, capacity planning, or resource management in multi-tenant systems.

We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

title: Senior Software Developer:in (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
KI verändert unseren Job gerade nicht jährlich, sondern monatlich. Und vielleicht merkst du, dass dein Umfeld da nicht mitkommt: KI ist verboten, wird ignoriert oder läuft als „mach mal KI“ nebenher. Bei uns ist das anders. Wir wollen KI nicht irgendwie in den Alltag kippen, sondern wirklich verstehen und als Werkzeug nutzen, das unsere Fähigkeiten erweitert, statt sie zu ersetzen. Wer die Veränderung gestalten will, muss schneller lernen, als sie passiert.

Das heißt auch: Umsetzen ist kein Hexenwerk mehr. Früher war der Job 70, 80 % Entwickeln, das dreht sich gerade. Umsetzung kann man delegieren, Entscheidungen nicht. Darum bist du bei uns der Übersetzer zwischen Fachlichkeit und Technik, und die Ownership für eine Entscheidung trägst du, keine KI.

Das machst du nicht in einem Bodyshop, der dir einen Stuhl beim Kunden besorgt. Und auch nicht in einer Beratung, die nach drei Monaten ein 200-Seiten-Dokument hinterlässt. Wir sitzen über Jahre als tragendes Element in den Entwicklungsteams unserer Kunden, meist in Digitalisierungsteams im Konzern, und schieben dort das ganze Team nach vorne.

Wie du startest

Du kommst in ein bestehendes Projekt mit einem von uns, gehst mit in die Termine und kommst schnell ins Doing, statt ewig Sachen zu lesen. Am Anfang hast du einen Paten, der dich im Team mitnimmt, und einen fachlichen Ansprechpartner. Nach etwa sechs Monaten führst du Termine alleine, setzt Themen eigenständig um und gehst in die Architekturplanung. Stück für Stück übergeben wir dir den Staffelstab, bis du in deinem Bereich die Verantwortung für den Kunden trägst. Leadership heißt bei uns: technische Führung nach außen, nicht nach innen.

Aufgaben

  • Du arbeitest bei einem Kunden, nicht bei dreien gleichzeitig. Mindestens einer von uns ist mit im Projekt, und ihr seid fester Teil der Routinen vom Kundenteam.

  • Du redest direkt mit dem Fachbereich und den Entscheidern. Keine Proxy-POs, kein Projektleiter dazwischen.

  • Du lernst die Fachsprache vom Kunden, modellierst die Domain und setzt sie um, im Backend mit Node/TypeScript, vorne mit React.

  • Du wartest nicht, bis dir jemand eine Aufgabe gibt. Du findest die Aufgaben, stimmst sie ab und übernimmst die Ownership dafür.

  • Ein Ticket ist schön. Und dann reden wir nochmal drüber, wie die Fachlichkeit wirklich ist.

  • Wir sagen nicht Ja und Amen zu allem. Wenn was keinen Sinn macht, sagst du das. Diplomatisch, aber klar.

  • Es geht um den Wert, der beim Kunden entsteht. Dafür baust du sauber und sagst dem Kunden transparent, was der nächste Schritt bringt und was er kostet.

Dein Profil

Was du mitbringst

  • Du bist eher in Fachlichkeiten und im Backend zu Hause als beim nächsten abgespacten UX-Feature. Denn sind wir ehrlich, das bekommt man mittlerweile gut automatisiert.

  • Du willst eine Fachdomäne durchdringen und im Großen mitdenken.

  • Du laberst keinen Bullshit, du stehst zu dem, was du sagst.

  • Offenheit und Interesse für die Chancen mit KI.

  • Rund 6 Jahre professionelle Softwareentwicklung, das meiste davon im Backend mit einer typisierten Sprache, am liebsten Node/TypeScript.

  • Node/TypeScript steht bei dir in einem echten Projekt, nicht nur in der Skill-Liste. Und dein letzter Backend-Einsatz in Produktion ist nicht ewig her.

  • Du hast Architektur nicht nur gesehen, sondern auch verantwortet und gestaltet.

  • Du kennst dich in einer Cloud aus, AWS, Azure oder GCP, und kannst sagen, welche Dienste du wofür genutzt hast.

  • Du hast Anforderungen selbst mit dem Fachbereich geklärt, Epics geschnitten und Aufwand mit Risiko benannt.

  • Du hast PoCs gebaut, Technologien ausgewählt und als ADR dokumentiert, Konventionen eingeführt und technische Schulden abgebaut.

  • Deutsch auf C1-Niveau, denn Deutsch ist unsere Domänensprache.

  • Du tickst nicht alle Boxen? Wenn dich das hier anfixt, bewirb dich trotzdem.

Nice to have

  • Du kennst die Baustoffbranche schon von innen. Einer unserer Kunden ist ein Baustoffhersteller.

  • Kubernetes löst bei dir keinen Angstschweiß aus.

  • Domain-Driven Design und hexagonale Architektur begeistern dich.

  • Du denkst eine API vom Vertrag her: OpenAPI, sauberes REST-Design, Backend for Frontend.

  • Du hast KI-Werkzeuge in einem Team eingeführt und weißt, wie man motiviert.

  • Du hast Leute gementort oder ein Projekt schon alleine verantwortet.

  • Du teilst gerne Wissen: Vorträge, Blog, Open Source oder ein Thema außerhalb vom Stack.

Wenn du nicht zu uns passt

  • Du willst ein Team führen. Wir sind zu sechst und planen keine mittlere Führungsebene.

  • Du nutzt KI, um Verantwortung abzugeben, statt deine Entscheidungskraft zu erweitern.

  • Du willst lieber am eigenen Produkt arbeiten als beim Kunden, oder lieber Konzepte malen als selbst bauen.

  • Du willst deine Arbeitsweise durchdrücken, statt aktuelle Praxis zu verstehen.

  • Der Teamtag alle 4 Wochen ist für dich eine lästige Pflicht.

  • Für dich ist es am Ende halt ein Job, und dich treiben vor allem Gehalt und Titel.

  • Du suchst eigentlich das nächste Freelance-Projekt und keine Festanstellung.

Der Prozess

Kurz und ohne fünf Gesprächsrunden.

  1. Erstgespräch mit mir, 30 Minuten remote. Du prüfst uns dabei genauso wie ich dich. Am Ende sage ich dir direkt, wie ich es sehe, und nicht hinterher in einer kalten Mail.

  2. Kennenlerntag mit dem Team, remote, 4 Stunden mit Pausen. Das ist keine Prüfung. Du reviewst Code und erklärst, was dir auffällt. Du baust mit deinem eigenen KI-Setup einen Fix, so wie du wirklich arbeitest. Und du führst ein Kundengespräch im Rollenspiel und lernst das Team in 1:1s kennen. Danach können wir beide klar sagen: passt oder passt nicht.

  3. Referenzen und Angebot. Wir entscheiden gemeinsam als Team und machen dir ein Angebot. Persönlich sehen wir uns spätestens beim Angebotsgespräch oder beim ersten Teamtag.

Nach jedem Schritt hörst du in ein, zwei Tagen von uns. Und wenn es nicht passt, sagen wir dir das persönlich und mit Begründung. Unser Ziel: höchstens zwei Wochen für den ganzen Prozess.

Benefits

Wie wir zusammenarbeiten

  • Wir arbeiten full remote, niemand sitzt im Büro. Alle 4 Wochen treffen wir uns in Darmstadt zum Teamtag. Das klappt gut, wenn du in etwa 4 Stunden bei uns bist.

  • Wir sind keine Family, wir sind gute Kollegen.

  • Warum wir suchen: Wir haben mehr Anfragen, als wir aktuell umsetzen können. Wir wollen nachhaltig wachsen sehen aber in unserer Größe in der aktuellen Zeit eine Stärke.

Unsere Formate

  • Check-in, jeden Morgen: nicht fachlich, sondern sozial. Und es ist voll okay zu sagen: Gerade ist echt nicht cool.

  • AI-Catchup, jede Woche: Wir schauen was letzte Woche in der KI-Welt passiert ist und wie wir unseren Workflow verbessert haben.

  • Weekend Checkout, jeden Freitag: 15 Minuten zum Abschluss der Woche.

  • 1:1 mit deinem Chef, alle 2 Wochen.

  • Retro, alle 2 Wochen, abwechselnd remote und am Teamtag. Daraus setzen wir Experimente mit klaren Zielen und Deadlines um. Dabei gilt Fail Fast: Wenn wir falsch lagen, feiern wir das eher, als uns drüber aufzuregen.

  • Pizzalounge, alle 4 Wochen remote: Pizza bestellen, Wissen austauschen, quatschen.

  • Teamtag in Darmstadt, alle 4 Wochen: am Vorabend ein Social Event, mal Minigolf, Kart fahren oder Axtwerfen. Am Tag selbst Retro und interne Themen.

  • Entwicklungsgespräch, jedes halbe Jahr: Wir setzen Ziele. Wenn du Zeit, Geld oder Ressourcen dafür brauchst, bekommst du sie.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Dein Chef ist Entwickler und quatscht kein Business-Blabla, sondern weiß genau, was du meinst.

  • Ein starkes Team, das TypeScript und React auf Expertenniveau macht.

  • Sicherheit und kein Projekthopping: KI ist wild, aber wir haben all unsere Kunden seit Anfang an und eine gute Basis für die nächsten Jahre.

  • 75.000 bis 95.000 € brutto im Jahr. Wo du einsteigst, hängt davon ab, wie vertraut dir unser Stack schon ist und wie erfahren du in Architektur, KI und Kundenkontakt bist.

  • Jährliche Gehaltsgespräche: Der Inflationsausgleich ist ein No-Brainer, alles on top ist das Ergebnis aus deinen Entwicklungsgesprächen.

Benefits

  • 30 Tage Urlaub und ein unbefristeter Vertrag.

  • 3 statt 6 Monate Probezeit.

  • Teilzeit ab 80 % geht, nach einem Start in Vollzeit.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, solange du beim Job to be done on track bist und keinen hängen lässt.

  • Ab zwei Stunden Anfahrt zum Teamtag gehen der ICE in der 1. Klasse und die Nacht im Hotel auf uns.

  • Ein top gespectes MacBook. Wenn du der Linux-Gott bist, bekommen wir das auch hin, aber Windows? No way.

  • Essenszuschuss, monatlicher Sachbezug als Gutschein und Firmenrad.

  • Nach Absprache: Mobiltelefon, Unterstützung bei der Kita, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, ÖPNV-Zuschuss, Urban Sports Club und weitere Leistungen über unsere Benefit-Plattform.

Unsere Werte

  • Ownership: Wir übernehmen Verantwortung für die ganzheitliche Lösung, nicht nur für ein Ticket. Wenn du einen Schritt nach vorne gehst, gehen wir alle einen Schritt nach vorne.

  • Verbindung: Beim Kunden sitzen wir als Beifahrer vorne statt auf dem Backseat: Wir gucken auf dieselbe Straße und geben uns ab und an das Lenkrad in die Hand.

  • Wertschätzung: Wir sagen offen, was gut läuft und was nicht, und supporten uns.

  • Entwicklung und Enablement: Was wir lernen, geben wir weiter.

  • Exzellenz statt Pflasterarchitektur: Eine KI kriegt vier, fünf Iterationen gut hin, bei der sechsten crasht es, wenn keiner auf die Qualität schaut. Wir schauen hin und intervenieren frühzeitig auf Hochniveau.

title: Senior Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

So, what’s the role all about?

We are looking for a Senior  software engineer who is passionate about solving infrastructure challenges through software engineering and automation. In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks that streamline cloud infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and operational processes.

You will build programmatic infrastructure solutions using Python, Jinja2, and Terraform, generating and managing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) at scale. You will also leverage Puppet for configuration management and develop PowerShell-based automation to support and optimize Windows environments.

This is a highly technical, coding-focused position. The ideal candidate is a software-minded engineer who writes clean, maintainable, and testable code every day—not just ad hoc scripts. You should be comfortable designing reusable automation components, applying software development best practices, and driving operational excellence through automation across complex cloud and hybrid environments.

How Will You Make an Impact?

  • Drive infrastructure standardization and operational excellence by designing and developing scalable automation frameworks in Python that enable consistent and repeatable deployments across cloud and on-premises environments.
  • Accelerate infrastructure provisioning by building and enhancing Terraform code-generation platforms using Python and Jinja2, enabling teams to produce validated, environment-specific infrastructure code from reusable templates.
  • Improve system reliability and compliance by developing and maintaining Puppet modules, manifests, and Hiera configurations that manage Linux and Windows environments at scale.
  • Increase operational efficiency across Windows platforms by creating robust PowerShell automation solutions for server management, Active Directory administration, and hybrid cloud integrations.
  • Simplify complex infrastructure workflows by developing internal automation tools, command-line utilities, and APIs that empower engineering teams to self-service common operational tasks.
  • Enhance the speed and safety of infrastructure delivery by integrating automation frameworks with CI/CD pipelines, enabling automated validation, testing, and deployment of infrastructure changes.
  • Improve software quality and reduce deployment risk by implementing comprehensive testing strategies for infrastructure code, including unit testing, linting, and integration testing.
  • Partner closely with cloud, platform, and application teams to identify manual processes, eliminate operational toil, and drive automation-first solutions across the organization.
  • Enable long-term scalability and maintainability by creating clear documentation, standards, and runbooks for automation frameworks and infrastructure templates.
  • Contribute to a strong engineering culture by participating in code reviews, sharing best practices, and continuously improving the quality, security, and maintainability of automation solutions.

Have you got what it takes? 

Python & Automation Development

  • 5+ years of Python development experience — not scripting, but structured, testable application code
  • Strong understanding of Python packaging, virtual environments, dependency management (pip, Poetry), and code quality tooling (pylint, black, mypy)
  • Experience building CLI tools and automation frameworks using Python (Click, Typer, or similar)
  • Hands-on experience with Jinja2 templating — building reusable, parameterised templates for configuration and infrastructure code generation
  • Experience with pytest for unit and integration testing of automation code

Terraform & IaC Code Generation

  • Strong Terraform proficiency: module design, state management, remote backends, workspaces, and dependency graphs
  • Proven experience generating Terraform HCL programmatically using Python and Jinja2 — building template-driven pipelines that produce valid, linted, plan-ready infrastructure code
  • Familiarity with Terraform tooling: tflint, tfsec, terraform-docs, Terragrunt, or Atlantis
  • Understanding of Terraform provider internals and resource lifecycle management

Puppet & Configuration Management

  • Hands-on Puppet experience: writing manifests and modules, Hiera data hierarchies, node classification, and r10k / Code Manager workflows
  • Experience managing mixed Linux and Windows environments with Puppet at scale
  • Familiarity with puppet-lint, rspec-puppet, and automated Puppet module testing pipelines
  • Understanding of Puppet Enterprise or open-source Puppet Server administration

PowerShell Scripting

  • Proficient PowerShell scripting for Windows Server administration, task automation, and hybrid cloud integrations (AWS Tools for PowerShell, Azure PowerShell)
  • Experience writing reusable PowerShell modules, functions, and error-handling patterns
  • Familiarity with Pester for PowerShell unit testing
  • Experience automating Active Directory, Group Policy, or Windows networking tasks via PowerShell

Cloud & Infrastructure

  • Solid AWS experience: EC2, EKS/ECS, Lambda, S3, RDS, VPC, IAM, and CloudWatch — understanding of services as automation targets
  • Familiarity with CI/CD platforms and integrating infrastructure code pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI)
  • Comfortable working with Linux  and Windows Server in production environments

What’s in it for you?

Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NICE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NICEr!

Enjoy NICE-FLEX! 

At NICE, we work according to the NICE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.

Requisition ID: 11294
Reporting into: Director, Cloud Operations CXone, EMEA

Role Type: Individual Contributor

About NiCE

NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions.

Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30+ countries.

NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Add-Ons
descriptionHtml:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.
The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

addons.mozilla.org (AMO) is the foundation of the Firefox add-ons ecosystem. It’s a showcase for developers to publish and grow their extensions, and a place of discovery for millions of users who customize Firefox to make it their own. Behind the scenes are the DevHub which enables developers to manage their extensions. To manage the ecosystem there are a series of Reviewer tools and automated moderation systems. 

As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll bring a passion for crafting resilient systems that accelerate our review and moderation teams to provide a first-class experience for Add-on developers. You’ll work closely with engineers, reviewers, developer support, and Add-ons leadership to turn ideas into polished features, modernize the platform and its architecture, and see your work reach millions of people around the world.


What you’ll do: 
  • Deliver major features and architectural improvements across the Add-ons stack, including automated moderation pipelines, Reviewer tools, and DevHub.
  • Help establish and maintain engineering standards across areas such as code review, definition of done, production readiness, runbooks, incident response, on-call practices, coding conventions, and infrastructure as code.
  • Create robust observability systems and data-backed insights.
  • Provide peer feedback, share knowledge and help others grow.
  • Build and improve the systems that enable Add-ons engineering to safely develop, deploy, observe, and operate production services.
  • Improve our CI/CD pipelines using declarative, pipeline-as-code approaches that make changes reproducible, testable, and easy to review.
  • Deliver work iteratively using a visible backlog, short feedback cycles, retrospectives, and demonstrations to stakeholders.
  • Write clear technical documentation, including design notes, Architecture Decision Records, runbooks, and incident write-ups.
  • Work effectively in unfamiliar codebases, tracing requests and asynchronous jobs end-to-end to understand failures and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Collaborate with designers, product managers, QA, and community contributors to deliver end-to-end improvements.
  • Contribute in the open through pull requests, code reviews, and discussions.
  • Work on:
    • Feature development: submission flows, trust and safety signals, DevHub and Reviewer tools modernization.
    • AMO application systems: Work within our Python/Django, MySQL, React/TypeScript, and asynchronous processing systems.
    • Internal developer platforms: Create tools and paved paths that make it easier for teams to ship and operate software safely and consistently.
    • Team Process: Contribute to team ceremonies, execute process improvement, and provide feedback on team effectiveness. 
    • Engineering standards: Help make production readiness, testing, recoverability, documentation, and safe deployment part of the normal development lifecycle. 
    • Platform reliability: Deployments, monitoring, and incident response.

What you’ll bring: 

  • Strong hands-on experience building and maintaining production applications with Python/Django.
  • Experience operating and improving production software systems where reliability and safe delivery matter.
  • Strong experience with CI/CD systems and treating pipelines and infrastructure declaratively as code.
  • Experience designing or improving automated testing and deployment workflows, including integration testing and staged or progressive delivery.
  • Strong understanding of observability as an engineering discipline, including metrics, logging, tracing, service-level objectives, and actionable alerting.
  • Experience building or maintaining internal tools or platforms used by other engineering teams, with an understanding that internal systems have users, reliability expectations, roadmaps, and lifecycle considerations.
  • Experience defining or improving engineering practices such as code review standards, operational readiness, runbooks, incident response, on-call expectations, or definitions of done.
  • Ability to read and understand unfamiliar codebases and trace application behavior across frontend, backend, asynchronous jobs, data stores, and infrastructure.
  • Experience debugging complex production issues and turning what you learn into lasting system improvements.
  • Strong technical writing skills, with experience creating useful documentation such as design documents, ADRs, runbooks, and incident reports.
  • Experience working iteratively with a visible backlog, regular stakeholder feedback, and retrospectives that result in concrete improvements.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills in a distributed team environment.
  • A willingness to share knowledge and mentor peers in operational and reliability practices.
  • Commitment to our values:
    • Welcoming differences
    • Being relationship-minded
    • Practicing responsible participation
    • Having grit

Bonus points for:

  • Experience with Google Cloud and operating Kubernetes.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tooling and policy-as-code.
  • Experience establishing SLOs and error-budget-based reliability practices.
  • Experience with chaos engineering, disaster recovery testing, or production readiness reviews.
  • Experience with trust and safety, automated moderation, abuse prevention, or other adversarial systems.
  • Contributions to open source projects

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla 

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission.  We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

descriptionHtml:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team

Data Core is the storage abstraction layer behind Celonis' data pipelines. It sits between ETL workloads and the backends that run them, such as Databricks, Snowflake, StarRocks, Spark, and PostgreSQL. You will work mainly on three codebases:

  • Data Core, a Java / Spring Boot service with gRPC and message-queue APIs.
  • sqlglot, where we translate and optimize SQL across dialects.
  • StarRocks, the OLAP engine we use as a backend.

What You Will Do

  • Implement features and fix bugs in Data Core backend integrations.
  • Add and fix sqlglot dialect support: parsing, SQL generation, and transpilation correctness.
  • Investigate StarRocks behavior and compatibility issues, and contribute fixes or workarounds.
  • Debug slow or incorrect queries by following them from SQL text to query plan to results.
  • Write unit and integration tests, especially for SQL translation edge cases.
  • Take part in design discussions, write short design docs for your own work, and give and receive code reviews.
  • As a Senior: lead small to medium projects end to end and help onboard newer teammates.

What We Are Looking For

  • Solid Java, or strong Python with the willingness to work in Java daily.
  • Good SQL skills: joins, aggregations, window functions, and an understanding of how queries execute.
  • Familiarity with at least one analytical or distributed data system (for example Spark, Snowflake, Databricks, Trino, ClickHouse, or StarRocks).
  • Good testing and debugging habits.
  • Clear written and spoken communication, and a habit of asking questions early.

Strong Plus

  • Exposure to how SQL parsers, ASTs, or query planners work.
  • Contributions to open source projects, especially sqlglot or StarRocks.
  • Experience with gRPC, message queues, or Kubernetes.
  • Some C++ experience.
  • Interest in query optimization and database internals.

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

Your Privacy:

Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools

We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.

The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.

Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here.

title: Senior Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Senior Software Engineer

Office Location: Temple, London - hybrid working environment (3 days in office per week)

Experience Level: +5 years commercial software engineering experience

About Investa

Investa is building the UK’s first zero-commission Options and Stocks trading platform. Legacy platforms typically feature high fees and complex interfaces that cut out the majority of retail investors. We are building a streamlined alternative to fix that. Investa is the first FCA-regulated platform to offer completely free US share trading with no FX, no commission, and no other fees.

Our Traction So Far:

  • £3.5M+ raised in funding with 1,000+ shareholders backing our vision

  • FCA-regulated and multi-award winning in 2026: Best Options Trading App (Good Money Guide) & Best App for Options Trading (ADVFN)

  • Available on iOS and Android, scaling rapidly toward our next milestones of 10,000 and 100,000 active users

  • 8,000+ trades processed, 2,500+ early supporters rewarded, and 150+ 5-star reviews

Our Mission: To democratise options trading for UK investors

Our Vision: Think Options, Think Investa

We are a lean, agile team where every employee directly shapes the business. We don't have a corporate way of working. Instead, we look for people who want high autonomy, care about making a visible impact, and align with our core values of being Collaborative, Curious, and Creative.

We are growing and looking for ambitious talent to help us democratise retail investing across the UK.

The Role

The Investa app was installed over 1,000 times within the first 24 hours of our priority access launch and we’re now looking for a high-impact Senior Software Engineer to join our founding engineering team as we scale.

You will have extensive commercial experience designing, building and maintaining systems used in critical services or those handling significant volumes of activity.

 

You will play a crucial role in building key parts of our platform and apps, ensuring the robustness, scalability, and security of our systems.

 

If you’re passionate about building best-in-class products to tackle complex challenges and you excel in a collaborative, fast-paced environment, we want to hear from you.

 

What the role involves

  • Founding Team Ownership: Designing, building, and maintaining robust, scalable services by joining our founding team of 4 engineers. Working directly with the founders with zero middle-management red tape, you won’t just pull tickets from a backlog - you will actually own your work end-to-end, see your code ship, and see its immediate impact on users.

  • Building the Engineering Culture: Joining our founding engineering team means you are actively building our engineering culture, not just stepping into one. You will have a direct voice in shaping how we collaborate day-to-day, how we learn from each other, and how we preserve a friendly, agile, and tight-knit environment as we grow.

  • Full-Stack Versatility & Growth: Hands-on Building: Writing high-quality, secure code for our FCA-regulated platform. You’ll navigate our stack to ship features that delight users. Driven by our fast-paced environment, you will have the opportunity to step outside your comfort zone and get hands-on with the wider technical stack, levelling up your skills significantly faster than in a traditional, highly specialised role.

  • System Design & Architectural Influence: Partnering directly with the CEO and Principal Engineers to tackle complex systems design and actively shape our evolving architecture. Your technical perspective will give you a strong voice in our high-level design choices. You will have true design ownership over the specific services and systems you build, ensuring they remain robust, secure, and performant as we scale.

  • Technical Excellence: Maintaining a high bar for code quality, testing, and documentation. You’ll participate in (and drive) meaningful code reviews.

  • System Integrity: Monitoring and improving system reliability, ensuring our trading platform is always "always-on."

  • Production Support: Root-causing real-time production issues; we all take pride in the stability of what we ship.

Your Background

  • Coding: You are a "doer." You love shipping code, crave the responsibility that comes with joining a founding team, and are comfortable driving tricky engineering problems forward with high autonomy and support from the team.

  • Adaptable & Impact-Driven: Technical Depth: You have +5 years experience in software engineering, specifically building and maintaining production-grade distributed systems. You are a flexible engineer who is excited to jump in wherever the business actually needs you most to solve interesting problems across the board. You are proficient in at least one or two modern languages (Python, TypeScript, Java, Go, etc.) and have experience with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

  • Pragmatic Mindset: You balance structural integrity with contextual relevance, ensuring we don't just build the "perfect" system, but the right system for our current needs.

  • Collaborative Spirit: You enjoy working in a tight-knit team, giving/receiving candid feedback, and contributing to a culture of shared learning.

  • First-Principles Thinker: You don’t just follow patterns; you understand why they exist. You can pick up new technologies or domains (like complex options Greeks) quickly, and you welcome a setup that actively forces you to grow into a much more versatile engineer.

On-call

  • All engineers at Investa are involved in providing support for our products. This involves responding to events outside of working hours and is a core part of the role of all engineers.

What we offer:

Career Ownership & Impact: While we provide clear levels to grow into, you also have autonomy over your execution and your career trajectory. Your work impacts the business immediately without corporate red tape. You can choose whether you want to pave a path as a high-level individual contributor or step into management as we scale - you shape your career.

Collaboration & Proximity: You’ll work directly alongside our Co-Founders, Alec and Ross, and our founding engineers to co-author both the product roadmap and our engineering architecture. Because of our size, our culture is extremely personal. Everyone has firsthand insight into top-level strategy, cross-departmental exposure, and a direct voice in how we solve deep technical issues as we scale.

Creativity & Speed: We prioritise innovation through speed, agility, thinking outside the box, and resource-efficient solutions.

Shared Success & Equity: We are in this together. To ensure everyone benefits from our growth, every employee receives meaningful company EMI equity. Our success is your success.

The Package and Perks: Competitive base salaries, private medical insurance, team socials chosen by you, milestone celebrations, and hybrid flexibility.

Compensation and Benefits

Financial Growth 💸

  • Base Salary: £85,000 – £105,000 per annum, commensurate with experience.

  • Equity: Initial grant of 0.1% - 0.25% in stock options. We reward impact with additional performance-based grants and milestone-linked top-ups.

  • Annual Review: Structured salary and performance reviews conducted every year to ensure your growth stays on track.

Health & Wellbeing 🌴🦷

  • Annual Leave: 30 days (including bank holidays) + your birthday off.

  • Premium Coverage: Private medical and dental insurance via Bupa.

Office Environment & Lifestyle ☕

  • The Office: Work from a vibrant, spacious office featuring a private gym and a rooftop terrace for fresh-air breaks.

  • Fuel & Socials: Enjoy tea, coffee and snacks daily. Every last Wednesday of the month, we host a Team Lunch where the menu is chosen by you. We also run regular team socials, alongside company and individual milestone celebrations.

Tech 💻

  • Custom Setup: You’ll receive a high-spec MacBook Pro and £150 toward a mouse and keyboard of your choice.

Interview Process

  • Stage 1: Screening with Talent Lead

  • Stage 2: Technical & Architectural Deep Dive

  • Stage 3: Coding/Systems Design Interview

  • Stage 4: Final Behavioural interview

  • Offer

Looking at both our Senior and Mid-Level roles?

Please choose the single position that best matches your current experience and apply once. Our hiring team cross-reviews all engineering applications, so if the other level turns out to be a better fit, we’ll automatically switch your application.

Compensation: £85K – £105K • 0.1% – 0.25%

title: Senior Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Du willst Software bauen, die echte Menschen jeden Tag nutzen und nicht das zwölfte Ticket in einem Konzern abarbeiten?

Dann komm zu Matelify.

Wir sind ein Startup aus Rödental bei Coburg. Mit Matelify helfen wir Unternehmen, auf Social Media nicht nur zu posten, sondern es zu verstehen. Herzstück sind unsere Mates: fünf KI-Agenten: Cleo erstellt Content, Finn plant, Nova denkt Strategie, Alex analysiert, Max kümmert sich um die Community. Sie arbeiten im Chat live zusammen und beraten sich gegenseitig. Diese Zusammenarbeit ist das Produkt.

Jetzt suchen wir dich als Software Engineer in Vollzeit. Jemanden, der Features von der Idee bis in Produktion trägt.

Was du bei uns machst

  • Du baust Features end-to-end: Datenmodell, API, Oberfläche, Deployment, Messung. Kein Weiterreichen über drei Teams.

  • Du entwickelst unsere KI-Agenten weiter: von Tools und Prompts bis hin zu Orchestrierung und Evaluation. Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Mates immer smarter, zuverlässiger und besser im Zusammenspiel werden.

  • Du arbeitest in einer echten Cloud-Architektur: Go-Services auf AWS, serverless, Infrastruktur als Code.

  • Du schaust nach dem Release auf die Daten: Wird das Feature genutzt? Wo steigen Leute aus? Und baust danach weiter.

  • Du gestaltest nicht nur mit, wie wir etwas entwickeln, sondern auch, was wir bauen. Dabei bringst du eigene Ideen ein und tauschst dich direkt mit unseren Kunden aus, um ihre Bedürfnisse besser zu verstehen.

  • Du entwickelst unsere Plattform kontinuierlich weiter mit automatisierten Tests, CI/CD und Observability. Dabei sorgst du für sauberen Code, stabile Prozesse und eine Architektur, die mit uns wächst.

Kurz gesagt: Du bist kein Ressourcen-Slot im Sprint, sondern baust das Produkt mit.

Unser Stack

  • Frontend: TypeScript, React

  • Backend: Go-Microservices auf AWS, MongoDB, Python

  • Infra & Ops: Terraform, GitLab, CI/CD

Du musst nicht alles davon kennen. Aber du solltest Lust haben, dich in jeden Teil einzuarbeiten.

Wie wir arbeiten

KI ist bei uns Werkzeug, kein Buzzword. Wir entwickeln selbst mit KI-Coding-Agents im Alltag und erwarten, dass du damit souverän umgehst. Schnell sein ist gut. Verstehen, was da generiert wurde, ist Pflicht.

Ownership statt Zuständigkeit. Wer etwas baut, kümmert sich auch darum, dass es läuft.

Kurze Wege. Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Founder-Team. Entscheidungen dauern Minuten, nicht Wochen.

Shippen schlägt Perfektion, aber mit Tests, Code-Review und grüner Pipeline.

Hybrid & flexibel: Du entscheidest, wo du am produktivsten arbeitest, von zu Hause oder gemeinsam mit dem Team in Rödental.

Was du mitbringst

Studium, Ausbildung, Quereinstieg, egal was, es ist uns egal. Uns interessiert, ob du Software verstehst, Bock hast und zeigen kannst, was du draufhast. Wichtig ist uns:

  • Du hast mehrere Jahre echte Praxis in der Softwareentwicklung: ob im Job, in eigenen Projekten oder Open Source und hast Features eigenständig in Produktion gebracht und danach betreut.

  • Du bist sehr sicher in TypeScript und/oder Go und arbeitest dich schnell in den jeweils anderen Teil ein.

  • Du triffst Architekturentscheidungen selbst, kannst sie begründen und weißt, wann „gut genug“ wirklich gut genug ist.

  • Du verstehst, wie Web-Apps funktionieren: APIs, Datenbanken, Auth, Deployments.

  • Du hast mit LLMs oder Agenten schon mehr gemacht als einen Chatbot gefragt oder brennst darauf, genau das zu tun.

  • Du kommunizierst klar und sprichst sehr gut Deutsch und Englisch, mündlich wie schriftlich.

Ein Plus, kein Muss: AWS/Serverless, Terraform, MongoDB, Produktanalytics, Erfahrung in einem frühen Startup.

Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt? Bewirb dich trotzdem.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Echte Produktverantwortung in einem wachsenden KI-Produkt

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem Founder-/CEO-Team

  • Moderner Stack und Raum, ihn mitzuprägen

  • Ein kleines, motiviertes Team ohne Politik und Meeting-Marathons

  • Viel Raum für eigene Ideen: die beste Idee gewinnt, nicht die lauteste

  • Hybrides Arbeiten und flexible Arbeitszeiten

So bewirbst du dich

Schick uns:

  • deinen Lebenslauf oder ein gepflegtes LinkedIn-Profil

  • einen Link zu etwas, das du gebaut hast (GitHub, GitLab, Projekt, Demo)

Kein Anschreiben, keine Zeugnisse, kein Notenschnitt. Uns interessiert, wie du denkst und was du gebaut hast.

Unser Prozess: kurzes Kennenlernen → technisches Gespräch über echten Code statt Leetcode-Rätsel → persönliches Kennenlernen mit dem Team vor Ort in Rödental.

Wir freuen uns auf dich!

title: Senior Software Engineer
department: Maritime & Maneuver Dominance : Maneuver Dominance Engineering : Mission Software Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the Team

Anduril’s Maritime Division has assembled a diverse team of experts in software, robotics, artificial intelligence, sensor fusion, and data analysis to create software and hardware solutions that radically evolve the capabilities of our customers. We are fielding the next generation of autonomous systems to tackle the extremely challenging industry demands of maritime operations. Anduril has brought to market a unique, ultra-long-range, full-ocean-depth underwater vessel platform and a completely refreshed maritime vehicle and flexible manufacturing architecture that scales from "small" to "extra-large" vehicle sizes. Today, Anduril is executing on billion-dollar contracts while simultaneously performing Robot-as-a-Service (RaaS) AUV operations.

We are seeking to sustain our early successes with deep investment in an expanded product portfolio. These products, including Dive-XL, Dive-LD, Copperhead, Seabed Sentry, and other unannounced systems, will deliver a coherent system-of-systems, enabling the end-to-end conduct of a variety of autonomous missions in the maritime domain. If you are passionate about solving problems that have real impact and working on systems that directly contribute to achieving national strategic priorities, we want you to join Anduril’s Maritime Division and help us build the future of defence capability.

About the Job

Senior Software Engineers independently drive the delivery of a variety of software integrated in to our products. This includes autonomy, simulation, data processing, payload integration, and off-board command and control and decision support. We expect Senior Software Engineers to demonstrate end-to-end outcome ownership at the major subsystem or system level. Senior Software Engineers contribute as a technical lead to the rapid architecting, design, delivery, support, and evolution of next generation autonomous platforms through their entire product life-cycle.

What You’ll Do

  • Empathize with end-users and drive solutions that balance their needs with external constraints, restrictions and requirements in a multi-stakeholder environment
  • Own software enabled solutions that are deployed to customers, optimizing for the delivery of value to the end-user
  • Design and implement scalable software that rapidly delivers capability beyond the scope of current platforms, with a clear path for both architecture and capability evolution over time
  • Contribute to the design and development of existing software services across Anduril, with the aim of developing components that are re-usable across multiple Anduril product lines
  • Develop software that runs on- and off- robotic platforms, using a variety of technologies
  • Contribute to the design, implementation and execution of development processes for the initial delivery and subsequent iteration of vehicle and mission software, including full lifecycle testing, monitoring and operation
  • Create test and simulation fixtures that operate with both software- and hardware-in-the-loop
  • Support vehicle manufacturing and deployment
  • Work as a member of a multi-disciplinary engineering team, including as a mentor for Software Engineers from differing backgrounds
  • Travel to co-locate with end-users and/or other teams up to 20% of the time

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Engineering, a relevant field, or equivalent experience
  • Extensive professional experience working as a Software Engineer with one or more domains and/or technologies of expertise
  • Systems and/or application programming skills including algorithms, data structures, concurrency, scaling, testing, infrastructure, software design and system design
  • Experience troubleshooting and analyzing remotely deployed software systems
  • Capacity to work holistically on software enabled capabilities up and down the software stack and through lifecycle through design, implementation, operation and sustainment
  • Capacity to act as the technical owner for a software service, including stakeholder engagement, requirements definition, roadmap management, team co-ordination, design, implementation, sustainment and evolution
  • Capacity learn and grow individually, while mentoring junior team members effectively, building team cohesion and capacity
  • Ability to obtain and maintain an Australian Government Security Clearance

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a senior role for the delivery of a military mission system
  • Experience writing backend services or embedded software in C++, Rust and/or Go
  • Experience writing frontend applications using Typescript and React
  • Experience with the design, implementation and operation of horizontally scaled cloud technologies
  • Experience with the design, implementation and support of embedded software, particularly in the field of robotics
  • Experience with modeling and simulation
  • Experience with development of high assurance safety critical software
  • Experience within the product delivery lifecycle including manufacturing, system acceptance, deployment, and sustainment.
  • Familiarity with Systems Engineering concepts
  • Desire to learn and grow in to other roles that require experience as a Senior Software Engineer, such as Staff Software Engineer and/or Software Engineering Manager
  • Desire to grow in to a Tech-Lead-Manager role, with responsibility for line management of engineers, in addition to delivery

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an ----- address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to

    • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is ----- before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

    • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to 

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/. 

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.
