title: Team Lead, Partner Enablement
descriptionHtml:
Retire The ERP.

At Light, we’re on a mission to replace the ERP. Traditional systems are slow, painful to implement, and built for factories, not modern companies. Our Smart Financial Platform (SFP) is built for today’s global, service-based businesses, automating accounting, reporting and financial flows with speed and simplicity.

In just a short time, we’ve gone from idea to powering operations for leading companies like Lovable, Legora and Keyshot. We build with our customers, ship at high velocity, and obsess over making finance software that people actually love to use.

You’re joining an early-stage company defining a new software category, backed by top investors including Balderton, Atomico, Cherry Ventures, Seedcamp and Entrée Capital. Our advisory board includes the former CTO of Workday Financials, the Chief Architect of SAP S/4HANA, and SVPs from EY and Oracle. At Light, you’ll work with exceptional people, build category-defining products, and have the freedom to shape something transformative.

The Role

Light doesn’t implement Light alone anymore. Accounting and consulting firms, from Big 4 practices to regional champions, are building Light implementation practices, and a growing share of our new customers go live through a partner. Our Partner Solutions Architects make sure every one of those deliveries meets Light’s standard. You lead that team, and you own the system that makes partner delivery repeatable at scale.

  • Lead, hire and grow a team of Partner Solutions Architects: set priorities, assign partner portfolios, coach on hard deals, and hold a high bar for quality and pace.

  • Own partner delivery health across the whole ecosystem: one clear view of every partner-led implementation, which are on track, which are drifting, and what you’re doing about it.

  • Own Light’s delivery gates for partner deals and make sure every partner passes them on time and to the right standard.

  • Build and run the partner capacity and delivery forecast: who each partner has, who is certified, what they can take on next, and when. Sales should always be able to tell a customer yes, with a start date we can stand behind.

  • Own the partner enablement path end to end: AI Academy curriculum, instructor-led sessions, bootcamps, sandbox environments and certification. Decide what “Light-certified” means and hold that bar firm.

  • Use AI to scale enablement, so one architect can support many more partner consultants without the quality dropping.

  • Be the senior escalation point for partners and their clients: step in personally on the hardest consolidations, migrations and entity structures, and on partner relationships that need a reset.

  • Work with the Commercial Partnerships Lead on partner selection, tiering and onboarding, so the partners we sign are the partners who can deliver.

  • Feed what the team learns on live deals back into the curriculum, the implementation playbooks and the product roadmap.

  • Report to Light leadership on partner delivery health, capacity, certification and quality, using metrics such as certified consultants per partner, partner-led go-lives on time, and customer satisfaction on partner deals.

How You Fit Into The Team

As Team Lead, Partner Enablement, you sit between our partners, their clients and Light’s own implementation team, and you report directly to the Head of Services. You’ll work daily with the Commercial Partnerships Lead, Implementation, Sales, Data Migration Services and Product.

This is a player-coach role: you lead the team and run the system, and you still take a portfolio of your own and go hands-on when a deal needs it. Your mandate is simple to state and hard to do: every partner-led customer should have an experience as good as one delivered by Light directly.

Your Qualifications Could Be

  • You have been the accountable lead on at least one finance system go-live. This is a must.

  • 7+ years in finance transformation, ERP implementation or finance advisory: Big 4, a finance-focused boutique, or a vendor-side professional services team (NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Workday Financials or similar).

  • 2+ years leading consultants, whether as a line manager or as an engagement or practice lead with a team delivering under you.

  • You’ve managed a portfolio, not just a project: many moving deals, many stakeholders, one clear view of where everything stands.

  • You’re fluent in accounting and can hold your own with a Controller on multi-entity consolidation, intercompany eliminations, accruals, and statutory vs management reporting.

  • You’ve trained, coached or certified other consultants, and you know the difference between someone who has been trained and someone who can deliver.

  • You work well through people who don’t report to you, and build trust with partner leadership and client finance teams through clear communication and consistent follow-through.

  • You use AI tools daily, and have specific opinions on where they help in delivery and enablement work and where they don’t.

  • Highly organised and analytical. You like a good forecast, keep clean data, and spot the deal that’s quietly going wrong.

*If the core of the role sounds compelling but you don’t tick every box, we’d still love for you to reach out and convince us you’re the right person.

Bonus Points

  • Commercial instincts: experience in account management, client services, alliances or pre-sales alongside delivery.

  • Experience building a partner, channel or alliance enablement or certification programme from scratch.

  • Time at or with an implementation partner, so you know how partner practices staff, price and run their delivery.

  • Ex-Big 4 (advisory or audit) and a qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent).

  • Multi-jurisdiction experience (IFRS, US GAAP, UK GAAP and local GAAPs).

  • Additional European languages, German especially.

The Good Stuff

In addition to being part of a great team and working in a fun and innovative environment, we offer:

💸 A competitive salary plus equity.
🏝 A generous paid annual leave package, plus UK public holidays.
🥳 Regular socials and two company offsites a year. The last 2 were in Tuscany & Provence!
🚀 A huge opportunity for career growth as you help shape a market-defining motion.

Light is an equal opportunity employer.

Final Words

Working at Light means you’re embarking on an exciting journey to reshape the future of multinational financial operations. Our cheat code is that we’ve built something like this before, and now we’re doing it again, only better. Our goal is to make global finance effortless and empower companies to make informed decisions.

If you want to build the team that makes Light’s partners as good as Light, we’d love to hear from you at

Join the rocket ship while it’s taking off 🚀

title: Team Lead - Visual Localization
descriptionHtml:
Join SE3 Labs as Team Lead - Visual Localization

Build and lead the team that makes our autonomous systems know where they are.

About SE3

SE3 Labs builds spatial intelligence and autonomy software for unmanned systems. We combine 3D computer vision, state estimation and AI to help autonomous platforms perceive their surroundings, know where they are and operate when GPS and other sensors become unreliable. Defence is a core application of our work today.

We are growing to a team of 100+ people. Join at a stage where you can shape our localization technology, help build the team and grow your responsibilities as the company expands.

Our founding team’s research has received more than 90,000 citations. You will work closely with technical founders and engineers with deep experience in computer vision and autonomous systems, turning that research depth into systems that work in the field.

About the Role

You will hire and develop engineers, own the localization roadmap, set priorities and deliver a system that works on real sensors, within onboard compute limits and in difficult field conditions.

You will remain closely involved in architecture, core algorithms and debugging, with roughly 20–40% of your time spent coding. Work with senior individual contributors to set technical direction and with robotics software, embedded, hardware and field teams to turn it into a reliable deployed system.

What You’ll Work On

  • Build the Team: Hire excellent localization engineers, assess their technical work and help them develop. Give clear feedback, establish ownership and build a team that can solve difficult problems together.

  • Roadmap and Delivery: Own the roadmap and delivery of VIO, SLAM, sensor fusion, calibration, mapping and relocalization. Turn mission requirements and observed failures into specific engineering priorities.

  • Technical Direction: Guide architecture and core algorithm decisions with the team. Make the tradeoffs between accuracy, robustness, latency, memory and power explicit and test them against real data.

  • Evaluation and Replay: Build the evaluation and replay loop so the team can make most improvements from recorded data. Set measurable criteria for accuracy, robustness and runtime, and maintain regression tests that catch failures before deployment.

  • Hands-On Engineering: Stay involved in critical algorithms, production code and difficult debugging. Help resolve failures caused by timing, calibration, vibration, motion blur, poor lighting and degraded sensors.

  • Integration: Coordinate sensor and compute requirements, interfaces and integration with adjacent teams. Ensure localization outputs and uncertainty estimates work for planning, control and downstream autonomy.

  • Field Deployment: Take the system through live sensor testing and field deployment. Use mission logs and observed failures to decide what the team builds next.

Your Profile

  • You have personally built VIO or SLAM systems and taken substantial parts through deployment. You can explain your implementation, its limitations and measured improvements in accuracy, robustness or runtime.

  • You have led engineers through difficult technical work. You can point to systems your team delivered, people you helped develop and the decisions you were responsible for. This may be your first formal management role if you can demonstrate that experience.

  • You can assess an engineer’s technical work, give useful feedback and help them improve. You take an active role in recruiting and selecting the people who join your team.

  • You have strong foundations in 3D geometry, estimation, optimization and sensor fusion, and enough depth to examine algorithm and architecture decisions in detail.

  • You write production C++ and use Python for analysis, evaluation and tooling. You are comfortable working with Linux, real sensors, calibration, synchronization and constrained onboard compute. Rust experience is a plus.

  • You have used replay, evaluation datasets and automated tests to guide development. You can explain how your team measured progress, reproduced failures and decided when a system was ready to deploy.

  • You have a master’s degree, PhD or equivalent practical experience in a relevant technical field.

  • You speak fluent English; German is a plus. Given the nature of SE3’s work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to work on defence-related projects and, where required, obtain the relevant security clearance.

Especially Valued Bonus Skills

  • Experience deploying perception systems on Nvidia Jetson, embedded CPUs/GPUs, writing CUDA kernels, optimizing deep neural networks for edge deployment.

  • Experience with LWIR thermal cameras (for navigation), rolling shutter effects, visual-inertial calibration, multi-camera rigs, fisheye/wide-angle lenses or monocular depth.

  • Experience with GNSS-denied navigation in UAV context, terrain-relative navigation, map-based localization and re-localization.

  • Experience building evaluation datasets, replay systems, perception observability, log tooling, and automated regression pipelines.

  • Publications or open-source contributions in SLAM, VIO, 3D computer vision, state estimation, or robotics are welcome, but not required.

 

Perks & Benefits

  • Real Ownership: Participate in SE3’s growth through our employee participation programme

  • Work Environment to Excel at: Find a high-quality and modern toolset, flat hierarchy and a skilled, driven team which will push the limits together with you

  • AI-boosted workplace: We empower every employee with best-in-class AI tools and agents, giving you unlimited access to the latest advancements and a true productivity edge

  • 31 Paid Days Off: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off

  • Well-being Access: Free membership to gyms, yoga, and wellness through EGYM Wellpass

  • Team Offsites: We go on 2 company retreats per year, our last ones were in Italy and Greece

  • Mentorship: Work closely with experienced engineers and get paired with a professional mentor to support your growth

 

Our Process

  1. Intro Call (30 min): Let’s get to know each other

  2. Technical Conversation (45 Mins): High level discussion about your technical experience and what we are working on

  3. Coding / Algorithm Interview: We work through a practical perception, estimation, or robotics software problem together

  4. Technical Interview (90 mins): We dive into your experience with perception, state estimation, SLAM/VIO, robotics, and real-world debugging

  5. Team Dinner / Lunch: Meet the team and see whether it is a good fit on both sides

title: Technical Lead
descriptionHtml:
Technical Lead

Location: Bristol (hybrid, three days a week in the office)

Team: Engineering

Contract: Permanent

Reporting To: Software Engineering Manager

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

The role

You’ll join the Kaluza Technology community: a large team of product-focused and data-led Product and Platform Engineers working at serious scale. Our ecosystem is primarily based on TypeScript and React, utilising GraphQL and Kafka, backed by AWS and Terraform. Our work and responsibilities are diverse and wide-ranging, so you will need to have a product-minded problem solving attitude first and foremost. As a Senior Engineer you’ll own a slice of the product end-to-end, from the first design conversation to running it in production, and you’ll build it with AI coding agents as your default. We’re looking for someone whose judgement is worth more than their typing speed.

Engineers at Kaluza build with AI, and we mean that practically. From your first day you’ll have paid access to Claude Code, with a budget we don’t ration, and MCP access to the systems you need. Our tooling and conventions are evolving quickly, and you’ll have a heavy hand in defining how we build moving forward.

What you’ll do

  • Set the technical direction for your team: be accountable for the solution designs and architecture decisions, work with your team on technical strategy, and assist them through ambiguity over the longer term.

  • Work across the stack over time: depending on the team you’ll work across the interface people use, the services behind it, and the APIs between them, in whatever stack your team runs.

  • Build with AI coding agents as your default: break work down so agents can execute it, direct them, review what they produce as carefully as a colleague’s PR, and maintain the tests and guardrails that let agent-written code merge safely.

  • Own the health of your services: SLOs and SLAs, operational health reviews, post-mortems, and the in-hours support rota, with your turn on the on-call rota alongside the team.

  • Coach the engineers around you: technical guidance for a mix of junior and senior engineers, pairing, and code review that teaches as well as gates.

  • Connect your team to the rest of Kaluza: work with other Tech Leads and Principal Engineers on the wider architecture, and represent your team where platform decisions and engineering standards are made.

What you’ll bring

These are the practices and behaviours we see most in our best tech leads and value deeply, but we don’t expect everyone to tick every single box. If you’re excited by the role and can see yourself thriving here, we’d love to hear from you.

Ideally, you’ll have:

  • Experience with our tech stack: TypeScript and React, utilising GraphQL and Kafka, backed by AWS and Terraform.

  • Experience leading technical change: you’ve taken a new service or a major architecture change from idea through to running in production, and you can say what you’d do differently.

  • A daily agentic development practice: you build with tools like Claude Code or Cursor, you can walk us through work you’ve shipped this way, and you have views on where agents help a team and where they get in the way.

  • Operational ownership: comfortable deploying with shared tooling, well-versed in SRE fundamentals like SLOs, disaster recovery and platform health monitoring, and used to owning your software in production, including out-of-hours on-call.

  • A coach’s instincts: you’ve mentored and grown engineers at different levels, and you make the people around you better.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a bias to action: you can deliver against a technical strategy iteratively over months, and you’d rather ship a sound first step than wait for certainty.

  • Strong product sense: you ask why before building, and you can point to times when user feedback or metrics changed what you shipped.

  • Clear communication, especially in writing: designs, specs, PR descriptions and post-mortems that a teammate, a stakeholder or an agent can act on, and the stakeholder skills to work well with Product Managers, Principal Engineers and other Tech Leads.

Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app

Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.

title: Technical Program Manager
descriptionHtml:
About us

We are building a global leader in physical AI, anchored in Europe’s strongest robotics heritage. Founded by entrepreneurs with backgrounds in scaling digital products and advanced robotics, the team is bolstered by senior leadership from top-tier AI research labs and industrial tech companies.

Driven by a mission to create versatile and trustworthy embodied AI for physical labor, we fuse deep engineering mastery in AI and mechatronics with a rapid-execution culture. We are addressing the labor shortage by closing the gap to production-grade deployment. This means building the trusted alternative: robots that are safe, secure, and engineered to automotive standards of scale and durability.

We are well-capitalized and now assembling our team.

Our Locations: Vesoma has two main locations: Munich, Germany and Limassol, Cyprus. This pan-European setup represents our core ambition of building a European technology leader, gives us a great talent base and a strong corporate structure.

Your mission

As Technical Program Manager, you will own the end-to-end development program for our robotics platform(s), from concept through production readiness. You will work directly with founders, engineering leadership, and product leadership to drive delivery across AI, software, hardware, and robotics systems through a structured stage-gated product development process.

We are building a general-purpose humanoid robot designed to perform physical labour across a large range of environments. The engineering challenge is enormous and spans AI, software, mechanical, electrical, and controls systems, all converging into a single integrated product that needs to work reliably in the real world. 


Key responsibilities

  • Product Development Process & Gate Ownership: Own the NPI stage-gate development process (e.g. APQP/VDA or EVT/DVT/PVT, adapted to our context). Define gate criteria and build-readiness milestones, lead design reviews (PDR, CDR, ID/CMF), manage prototype build stages (A/B/C-sample or EVT/DVT/PVT) with defined quantities, test scope, and pass/fail criteria, and drive go/no-go decisions with leadership.

  • Cross-Functional Program Leadership: Act as the connective tissue between AI, software, controls, hardware, and industrial design teams. Maintain a holistic view of the system, from architecture down to integration points, ensuring that parallel workstreams converge into coherent, production-ready solutions.

  • Risk, Safety & Compliance: Identify technical, operational, and resource risks early. For safety-critical systems, drive structured hazard analysis and maintain the project risk register. Track regulatory certification (CE, FCC, Machinery Directive, relevant ISO standards) as critical path items and ensure compliance documentation is gate-ready.

  • Supply Chain & Production Readiness: Coordinate with suppliers and contract manufacturers on development timelines, DFM/DFA reviews, tooling stages (T0→T1→T2), and component qualification. Own the verification and validation plan spanning reliability, environmental, safety, and EMC testing. Manage the NPI-to-production transition including pilot runs, yield optimization, and ramp monitoring.

  • Cost, Change & Configuration Control: Own the project budget and BOM cost tracking. Drive target costing and cost-down initiatives. Enforce engineering change processes (ECO/ECN) and maintain configuration baselines across hardware, software, and firmware revisions.

  • Communication & Delivery Excellence: Provide clear, high-signal updates to leadership. Facilitate technical discussions, align priorities, and design scalable delivery processes that balance rigor with the agility required in an early-stage company.

Your profile

We are looking for a senior operator who is comfortable working deep within technical teams and confident engaging at leadership level.

  • Experience: 7+ years in Technical Program Management, Engineering Program Management, or equivalent roles. Proven track record delivering complex physical products through a full NPI type cycle, from concept to production, within robotics, consumer electronics, automotive, or deep-tech environments. You have shipped hardware, not just software.

  • NPI & Stage-Gate Fluency: Hands-on experience running a gated product development process, APQP/VDA from automotive or EVT/DVT/PVT from consumer electronics/robotics. Comfortable with BOM management, requirements traceability, and engineering change processes.

  • Technical Depth: Strong understanding of systems engineering principles across mechanical, electrical, and software domains. You don't need to code daily, but you must engage deeply with engineers on architecture, trade-offs, and technical constraints.

  • Supply Chain & Manufacturing: Experience working with suppliers, contract manufacturers, or internal manufacturing on DFM/DFA, tooling, and production ramp. You understand what it takes to get from a working prototype to a reliable production unit.

  • Mindset: Decisive, structured, and execution-driven. You thrive in ambiguity, take ownership, and bring clarity where none exists. You understand that building physical systems requires discipline, trust, and accountability.

  • Credentials: Degree in engineering, physics, or a related technical field. PMP, PRINCE2, or IPMA certification is a plus. Fluent English required, German is a plus.

Why us?

  • The Team: Work alongside leadership with a proven track record of building unicorn-scale companies and defining global robotics standards.

  • Smart Strategy: We operate as disciplined fast followers. Capital is timed to the deployment inflection point, avoiding early-mover dead ends to scale fast on proven foundations.

  • Resources: We are substantially internally funded and attract top-tier investors to avoid any capital constraints for our mission.

  • Historic Opportunity: Join at the dawn of a new industry comparable to the rise of the automobile. Help shape the European champion in this trillion-dollar market.

We are an equal opportunity employer.

title: Technical Support Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Join GLS/NXT as a Technical Support Engineer and help keep the future of out-of-home delivery running smoothly. We’re building the OOH Platform - a smart parcel locker platform that connects carriers, locker providers, and end customers across Europe.

As a Technical Support Engineer, you make sure every incident is thoroughly investigated and resolved. You handle incoming tickets, analyze logs and data to find the source of a failure, and follow each case through until it’s fully fixed. When an error keeps coming back, you push until its root cause is found and eliminated - and you build the processes, metrics, and reporting that make support predictable and transparent.

If you enjoy digging into complex problems, take ownership until things are truly fixed, and thrive in a collaborative and fast-moving environment, we’d love to have you on board. Let’s build the future of logistics - together.

Tasks

  • Own incoming support tickets from triage to resolution, prioritizing by business impact.

  • Analyze logs (e.g. Datadog) and production data (SQL) to find where an issue originates.

  • Escalate confirmed bugs to the right team with clear, reproducible reports.

  • Act as a technical point of contact for external partners on incidents and integration issues, requesting missing details and following up until each issue is properly resolved.

  • Identify recurring cases and drive them to a root-cause fix instead of closing each ticket as a one-off.

  • Build deep knowledge of the parcel lifecycle (drop-off, collection, returns, labelless flows, state transitions) and of how carrier and provider integrations behave, including edge cases.

  • Build and improve support processes, including triage rules, escalation paths, and follow-up routines.

  • Define and track support metrics such as ticket volume, resolution time, recurring issues, and response quality, and prepare regular reports on open issues and trends to push for long-term fixes.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in technical support, application support, or a similar engineering-facing role.

  • Hands-on experience analyzing logs and working with monitoring tools (e.g., Datadog).

  • Basic SQL skills for investigating production data.

  • Understanding of REST APIs and integrations, with the ability to read request and response payloads.

  • Experience with Postman or similar API tools.

  • Experience with ticketing and issue tracking tools (e.g., Jira, Zendesk).

  • Strong analytical thinking and a structured approach to troubleshooting.

  • Persistence and ownership in driving issues to resolution.

  • Experience using metrics and reports to drive process decisions.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to explain technical issues to partners and internal teams.

  • Nice to have: a background in logistics, parcel delivery, or e-commerce, and experience managing third-party vendors or carrier integrations.

Benefits

  • Dynamic workplace: A digital environment with international projects and space to learn and grow

  • Flexible work conditions: Hybrid working mode with a tailored remote policy

  • Focus on learning: A personal budget (1.000€) for learning and development initiatives

  • Physical space for ideas: A great office space in Berlin Mitte with top-tier equipment

  • Transparent and competitive compensation: A salary package that reflects your expertise and experience.

  • Active participation: A clear bonus system enabling participation in your and the team’s performance

  • Engaging team culture: Monthly team cooking, regular events and offsites

  • Vacation policy: 30 days of yearly holiday

  • Reward system: Rewards for the recommendation of additional team members

About GLS/NXT

GLS/NXT was founded with the mission to build the next generation of logistic experiences driven by technology - core, adjacent & beyond. More specifically, our sphere of interest is the Logistics and eCommerce sector. We are entrepreneurs and hence always start with the user's needs. We are located between Corporate and Startups and leverage the benefits from both (startup speed and corporate muscle). GLS/NXT inhabits different project teams, acting as startups with business responsibility and setting their own vision and mission. GLS/NXT is part of the GLS IT Services GmbH.

Commitment to Diversity

GLS/NXT is an equal opportunity employer, which means we do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Territory Account Executive

About Team & About Role

Rubrik helps organisations in every major industry stay resilient against cyberattacks, insider threats and operational disruption, protecting the data that hospitals, banks and public institutions depend on every day.   • Based in or near a major German city with convenient transport links, with willingness to travel regularly across your territory.

Preferred Qualifications

title: TUM Project Study – AI-Powered Learning Content Creator
descriptionHtml:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

Key Facts:
Design and build a generative-AI workflow that helps the Celonis Talent Development team create high-quality learning content — faster, more consistently, and tailored to the learner. Flexible start date. Applications are open!

Background:
In 2011, three students from TU Munich founded Celonis (www.celonis.com), today the global leader in Process Intelligence. Our mission: make Enterprise AI work. More than 1,400 companies — including ABB, Fujitsu, PepsiCo, and Uniper — use Celonis to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. At the core is the Celonis Context Model, combining process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to give people and AI agents the clarity to act reliably.

The Talent Development team enables Celonauts, customers, and partners with the learning experiences and leadership programs they need to be successful with Celonis.

The Role:
Learning content is one of the most powerful levers Celonis has to enable Celonauts, customers, and partners. But the volume, variety, and velocity of content needed keeps growing faster than it can be produced by hand. Also, as business needs change, it is important the content offered is relevant and tied to those needs. Generative AI  now makes it possible to rethink how learning content is designed, drafted, maintained, and personalized, while keeping instructional quality and human expertise at the center of the process.

Together with the Celonis Talent Development team, your project team owns the question end to end:
How can generative AI augment the learning content creation workflow to produce high-quality learning experiences faster, more consistently, and tailored to the different learner needs?

You'll get hands-on exposure to how a world-class enablement team works, and the chance to shape practical AI assisted workflows that could change how learning content is created across t Celonis.

Your Goals:

  • Research the current state of the art in generative AI for learning, instructional design, and content creation — including tools, techniques, and best practices
  • Map the current content creation process and identify opportunities where AI can add the most value while maintaining quality and consistency.
  • Identify and prioritize high-value use cases (e.g., turning source documents or materials into micro-learning, drafting scripts and storyboards, generating quizzes and assessment items, supporting localization and translation, refreshing outdated content, creating facilitator guides or other support resources)
  • Design and prototype an AI-assisted learning content creation workflow
  • Evaluate the results by considering content quality, relevance, instructional effectiveness, time and effort saved, usability for content creators and opportunities for personalization.
  • Define recommendations and guardrails for responsible AI adoption, including accuracy, human review, accessibility, brand voice, and governance.
  • Pilot the workflow on a real learning program and measure the impact

The qualifications you need:

  • You're genuinely curious about generative AI and excited to apply it to a real business challenge
  • You bring the bias-to-action of an entrepreneur and enjoy building new things from scratch, including the ambiguity of an unsolved problem
  • You're interested in learning, enablement, instructional design, user experience or knowledge management 
  • Experience with AI tools, prompt engineering, no-code automation, or basic scripting helpful but not required)
  • You are comfortable collaborating with different stakeholders and translating ideas into practical solutions
  • Your enthusiasm is contagious and you can win people over

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools

  • Operational Experience: Proven ability to work effectively in fast-paced environments (FMCG, Retail, Warehouse, or Last-mile delivery is a major plus).

  • Performance Driven: A track record of hitting goal targets, such as pick times or dispatch KPIs.

  • Natural Leadership: A "lead by example" mentality with a genuine passion for motivating and coaching junior team members.

  • Problem-Solving Mindset: A proactive approach to finding new ways to improve site operations and resolve challenges as they arise.

  • Adaptability: The ability to work autonomously while contributing to a high-energy, positive team environment.

Our Interview Process

  • Step 1: Apply – Apply for any role you’d like to be considered for. We’re looking forward to hearing from you.

  • Step 2: Online assessment – If your application is successful, you’ll receive an assessment from our AI hiring assistant, Maki People. Please note: this must be completed to continue.

  • Step 3: Initial conversation – One of our Recruitment team will get in touch to talk through your experience and what you’re looking for next.

  • Step 4: Final Onsite interview – You’ll be invited to an onsite interview with one of our Site Managers.

  • Step 5: Outcome – We’ll get back to you quickly after your interview to let you know the result!

Why Join Us?

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community organisers and more. All energised with an entrepreneurial, relentless spirit which helps us do big things as a team. In Operations, you’re at the heart of our marketplace — working directly with customers, riders and partners to keep Deliveroo moving.

  • 🔧 See the impact of your work in real time: Solve problems as they happen, turning challenges into positive experiences.

  • 🌱 Grow through doing: Develop leadership skills in a fast-paced environment with structured progression pathways.

  • 🤝 Be part of a tight-knit culture: Work collaboratively in an environment that values support, ownership, and resilience.

  • 🕒 Flexibility that works for you: Many roles offer flexible scheduling, including evening and weekend shifts.

What We Offer

  • Free monthly Friday lunch on Deliveroo

  • 25 days’ holiday (with increases based on service)

  • Career development and access to learning opportunities

  • Life assurance and wellbeing support

  • Access to great discounts and free Deliveroo Plus!

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support or reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application.

title: Web Designer, Growth at AIOS — Remote, $100k–$200k/yr inc equity
descriptionHtml:
About AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving 200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

Being a Web Designer, Growth at AIOS

We are building a world-class team.

As Web Designer, Growth at AIOS, your fundamental role is to turn cold clicks into customers, designing the pages that take a stranger from an ad to a purchase.

Visual polish matters, and for this role it comes second. Mastery here is conversion craft: knowing what goes on the first screen and in what order, turning a product into an offer, putting proof exactly where the doubt shows up, and removing risk at every step. You write and test your own headlines. You carry the ad’s promise and look all the way through to checkout.

You’ll own pre-conversion across our brands: landing pages, advertorials and listicles, quiz-to-plan flows and checkout, for our GLP-1 business and for the new non-Rx products we’re launching. You’ll ship your own pages to production with AI tools, without waiting on a developer, and you’ll live with each funnel through round after round of tests until you know exactly what moves the number.

You’ll:

  • Turn every growth bet into a live, high-converting page in days, not weeks

  • Close the gap between our funnels and best-in-class DTC, starting with the friction after our UK quiz

  • Launch new products with pages built to sell to cold traffic from day one

  • Keep us ahead of what’s new in DTC, and have our version live the same week

Great performance in this role means our pages win on persuasion, not just polish, and every new product and market launches with a funnel designed to convert.

This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you’ll work mostly async in the timezone of your choice, as long as you’re around until midday Pacific Time every weekday. This is an intense, hands-on IC role within the Growth team.

You’ll report directly to our Head of Growth (David Charles).

You’ll also work most closely with:

  • CRO Lead (Michael McCann)

  • Head of Design (Ryan Wu)

  • Growth (Jake)

  • CEO (Richie)

Key responsibilities

You’ll own pre-conversion end to end, from the ad click to the purchase.

  • First screen and page order: Decide what goes on the first screen and in what order, so a cold visitor knows what this is, why it’s for them and what to do next within seconds.

  • Offer design: Turn a product into an offer: the plan, the price anchor, the value stack, bonuses and the guarantee. Plan cards, best-value picks, struck prices and gifts inside the selected plan are your tools, not afterthoughts.

  • Proof and risk reversal: Put proof where the doubt shows up, not in a reviews block at the bottom, and remove risk at each step: what happens next, who the doctor is, cancel anytime, when it arrives.

  • Headlines and copy: Write and test your own headlines rather than laying out copy someone else handed over, and explain why one beats another.

  • Carrying the scent: Carry the ad’s promise and look through to the page, working with the growth team so the creative and the landing page feel like one journey.

  • Presells and quiz funnels: Design and iterate advertorials, numbered listicles, story pages and our quiz-to-plan flow, including the results moment and a plan page that feels built for one person.

  • Engaging pages: Use native-looking media, UGC, motion and before-and-afters where compliance allows, so the page holds attention the way the ad did.

  • Ship and iterate: Ship your own pages to production with AI tools, then live with the funnel through many rounds of tests, cut what loses and double down on what wins. Recent examples in motion: the UK post-quiz back end, the DE listicle, and Wave 1 non-Rx launches (skin, hair, ED, non-clinical).

  • Stay ahead of DTC: Track new formats across ecommerce as they appear (like RYZE’s Instagram-story listicles) and bring the best of them to our funnels fast.

Need to have

  • Live pages with real spend: Your best work is URLs that ran behind paid traffic. You can share live pages, the brand, rough monthly spend and the result.

  • Direct response ecom at scale: You’ve designed pages that sold a product to cold traffic with real spend behind them. Lead gen, info products, brand sites and app UI don’t count on their own.

  • Test history on one funnel: You’ve spent real time on one funnel at scale, on staff or in a long engagement, and can walk through a series of tests: what won, what lost, by how much and what you’d try next.

  • Direct response taste: You can name brands outside telehealth that do this well and explain why. Your acquisition references are DTC brands, not Apple, Airbnb or Whoop.

  • Offer thinking: You talk about the plan, price presentation, bundles, guarantees and gifts as naturally as you talk about layout.

  • Copy: You’re proficient in DTC and direct response copy and write your own pages. You may not be an S-tier copywriter, but you’re at least solid, and always hungry to improve.

  • CRO: Hands-on experience running or designing for A/B and multivariate tests, and using the results to decide what to try next.

  • Ownership: You own the results your pages generate. You’re a leader who gives a sh*t, not just an internal services function.

  • Ship it yourself, fast with AI: You ship your own pages to production with AI tools, without waiting on a developer, and can have a new format live the same week you spot it.

  • Visual craft at our bar: Required, and checked last. Your pages are clean, fast and on-brand within our design system.

‼️

NOT THE RIGHT FIT IF: you’re an agency designer with no test history, an app or product designer, or your work is all corporate ecom, brand sites or Dribbble-style concepts with no conversion numbers.

Nice to have

  • Quiz funnels: Experience designing long quizzes that build commitment and end on a personalised plan page.

  • Health and supplements: Experience on supplement, wellness or telehealth DTC pages, including compliant claims (FTC, ASA).

  • Analytics: Comfortable in behaviour and testing tools, and reading funnel data to find where people drop off.

  • Ad-to-funnel congruence: You understand carrying congruence from ad to funnel, and build accordingly. You think in awareness stages.

  • Motion and UGC: Able to cut native-looking video, motion and UGC assets for the page yourself.

  • Multi-market: Experience adapting funnels for different countries and languages.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2030 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come, it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

  5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully, in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

  9. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status. We ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

  10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.


🎯

"You just build a f*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."

Compensation & Benefits

You get paid above market salary and you get early stage equity, so you get really rich if we nail this.

  • Compensation: $100,000-$200,000/yr (inc equity)

Benefits

The stuff below is cool as well.

  • GLP-1s: free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s

  • Work coaching: free biweekly work coaching

  • Healthcare: comprehensive medical insurance (if appropriate)

  • Vacation: PTO with a yearly minimum (≥2wks/yr + local national holidays)

  • Remote: our team is fully distributed across the world and functions fully remotely

  • Personal development: budget for books, courses, coaching ($1200/yr)

  • Personal wellness: budget for gym, health apps ($1200/yr)

  • Coaching: free biweekly health coaching

  • Equipment: Macbook & work-from-home equipment provided as needed

  • What are we missing? We're still early so you get to shape our culture.

descriptionHtml:
Webmaster-Partner für Webdesign & digitale Lösungen

Starte deine eigene Internet-Agentur oder erweitere dein bestehendes digitales Angebot mit einem bewährten Webmaster-Konzept und persönlicher Unterstützung.

Du interessierst dich für Websites, Online-Marketing und digitale Lösungen? Du möchtest dir ein zweites Standbein aufbauen, dich selbstständig machen oder deine bestehenden Dienstleistungen erweitern?

Dann könnte unser Webmaster- und Agenturkonzept genau das Richtige für dich sein.

Unser Konzept richtet sich an motivierte Quereinsteiger sowie an erfahrene Fachpersonen aus Webdesign, Webentwicklung, Grafik, Marketing, IT, Verkauf und Beratung.

Seit über 25 Jahren begleiten wir Menschen auf ihrem Weg in die digitale Selbstständigkeit. Du profitierst von professionellen Werkzeugen, praxisnaher Ausbildung, bewährten Marketinglösungen und persönlicher Begleitung.

Als Webmaster-Partner unterstützt du Unternehmen, Selbstständige und KMU mit modernen Websites, digitaler Sichtbarkeit, Online-Marketing und digitalen Geschäftslösungen.

Du musst nicht bei null anfangen. Unser Gesamtkonzept bietet dir die Grundlage, um professionell am Markt aufzutreten, eigene Kunden zu gewinnen und langfristige Kundenbeziehungen aufzubauen.

Aufgaben

Als Webmaster-Partner begleitest du Unternehmen und Selbstständige bei der Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung ihrer digitalen Präsenz.

Je nach Erfahrung, persönlichen Stärken und Interessen übernimmst du folgende Aufgaben:

  • Webdesign: Konzeption, Erstellung, Optimierung und Betreuung moderner, responsiver Websites.

  • Individuelle Kundenlösungen: Anpassung von Design, Struktur und Inhalten an die geschäftlichen Ziele deiner Kunden.

  • Online-Marketing und SEO: Beratung zu Suchmaschinenoptimierung, digitaler Sichtbarkeit und Kundengewinnung.

  • Digitale Geschäftslösungen: Einsatz von CRM, E-Mail-Marketing, Formularen, Terminbuchungen und Marketing-Automationen.

Du entscheidest selbst, welche Dienstleistungen du anbieten und welche Schwerpunkte du setzen möchtest.

Dabei unterstützen dich ein erprobtes Gesamtkonzept, professionelle Werkzeuge und ein erfahrenes Partnernetzwerk.

Qualifikation

Für den Einstieg benötigst du keine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Webmaster oder Programmierer.

Wichtiger sind deine Motivation, Lernbereitschaft, Freude am Kundenkontakt sowie die Bereitschaft, eigenverantwortlich und unternehmerisch zu arbeiten.

Die notwendigen fachlichen Kenntnisse kannst du dir im Rahmen unserer praxisorientierten Aus- und Weiterbildung aneignen.

Du passt zu unserem Konzept, wenn du:

  • Interesse an Websites, Online-Marketing und Digitalisierung mitbringst.

  • gerne mit Menschen zusammenarbeitest und Kunden beraten möchtest.

  • zuverlässig, selbstständig und strukturiert arbeitest.

  • offen für neue Technologien und kontinuierliche Weiterbildung bist.

  • unternehmerisch denkst und Verantwortung übernehmen möchtest.

  • dir eine nebenberufliche oder hauptberufliche Selbstständigkeit aufbauen möchtest.

  • bereit bist, deine Kundengewinnung aktiv mitzugestalten.

  • professionelle Unterstützung und ein bewährtes Gesamtkonzept schätzt.

Quereinsteiger sind ausdrücklich willkommen

Ob du aus dem kaufmännischen, technischen, kreativen oder handwerklichen Bereich kommst: Entscheidend sind dein Engagement, deine persönlichen Stärken und dein Interesse an digitalen Lösungen.

Du bringst bereits Berufserfahrung mit?

Umso besser!

Kenntnisse in Webdesign, Webentwicklung, HTML/CSS, Programmierung, Grafikdesign, Social Media, SEO, Online-Marketing, Verkauf oder Beratung sind eine wertvolle Grundlage.

Du kannst deine bisherigen Erfahrungen gezielt einsetzen, zusätzliche Kompetenzen erwerben und dein Leistungsangebot erweitern.

Das Konzept eignet sich deshalb auch für Freelancer, bestehende Selbstständige und kleinere Agenturen, die neue Dienstleistungen anbieten und zusätzliche Geschäftsmöglichkeiten erschliessen möchten.

Benefits

Mit unserem Webmaster-Konzept erhältst du weit mehr als eine Ausbildung: eine umfassende Grundlage für den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung deiner eigenen digitalen Tätigkeit.

Deine Vorteile als Webmaster-Partner

  • Flexibler Einstieg: Starte nebenberuflich, baue dir ein zweites Standbein auf oder entwickle schrittweise deine eigene Internet-Agentur.

  • Starkes Partnernetzwerk: Tausche dich mit erfahrenen Partnern aus und profitiere von gemeinsamen Veranstaltungen und Weiterbildungen.

  • Selbstbestimmtes Arbeiten: Gestalte deine Arbeitszeit, dein Einsatzgebiet und deine geschäftlichen Schwerpunkte eigenständig.

Selbstständigkeit mit klaren Rahmenbedingungen

Die Tätigkeit als WORLDSOFT Webmaster-Partner erfolgt ausschliesslich auf selbstständiger Basis und ist keine Festanstellung.

Du gewinnst und betreust deine eigenen Kunden, entwickelst dein Dienstleistungsangebot und entscheidest selbst über den Umfang deiner geschäftlichen Tätigkeit.

Vielleicht möchtest du dich beruflich neu orientieren, dein Wissen erweitern oder dir eine zusätzliche Einkommensmöglichkeit aufbauen. Vielleicht bist du bereits selbstständig und suchst nach einer sinnvollen Erweiterung deines Angebots.

So wie Software zum Service geworden ist (SaaS), entwickelt sich heute auch das Dienstleistungsgeschäft hin zu Software. Unsere Dienstleistung eignet sich dafür besonders gut: Wir bearbeiten sehr viele gleichartige Fälle nach klar definierten Abläufen, und Software sorgt dafür, dass dabei nichts liegen bleibt und nichts übersehen wird. Bei uns ist das nicht neu: Wir haben schon softwaregetrieben gearbeitet, bevor KI zum Thema wurde – und genau das ermöglicht unser solides Wachstum.

Unser Ansatz: Wir entwickeln mit KI-Agenten – was dabei entsteht, ist aber deterministische, nachvollziehbare Software. In unseren Arbeitsabläufen setzen wir KI nur ein, wenn es nötig ist; die rechtliche Einschätzung bleibt in juristischer Hand. Wer jetzt dazukommt, lernt das System von Grund auf kennen und baut es Schritt für Schritt mit aus.

Warum wir dich suchen

Unser Kanzleiinhaber Matthias Prinz hat selbst Wirtschaftsinformatik (B. Sc.) an der TU München studiert. Wir wissen also ziemlich genau, was zu tun ist – Ideen, Konzepte und ein gut gefülltes Backlog haben wir. Derzeit setzen wir drei bis fünf Verbesserungen pro Tag um. Mit einer Entwicklerin oder einem Entwickler in Vollzeit wollen wir die Umsetzungsgeschwindigkeit erhöhen – durchdacht, getestet und passend zur bestehenden Architektur. Die fachliche Richtung ist klar – die technisch saubere Umsetzung liegt bei dir. Kein Beratungsgeschäft, keine wechselnden Kundenprojekte: Du entwickelst für dein eigenes Team und siehst jeden Tag, wie deine Software die Arbeit erleichtert.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Agentische Softwareentwicklung (dein Schwerpunkt): Du entwickelst unser Case-Management-System weiter (Python/FastAPI, React/TypeScript, Microsoft SQL Server, Azure) – mit KI-Agenten wie Claude Code: Du schreibst Spezifikationen, lässt die Agenten umsetzen, prüfst jedes Ergebnis kritisch und bringst es sicher in den Live-Betrieb.

  • Deterministisch statt KI im Ablauf: Was sich mit klassischer Software lösen lässt, setzt du ohne KI um – mit festen Regeln und prüfbarer Logik.

  • Schnittstellen & Automatisierung: Du bindest Systeme per API und Webhook an, etwa Microsoft 365, lexoffice und das besondere elektronische Anwaltspostfach (beA), und überführst bestehende Power-Automate-Flows in Azure Functions.

  • Anforderungen aufnehmen: Du hörst unseren Kolleginnen und Kollegen genau zu, verstehst ihre Abläufe und übersetzt ihre Anliegen in klare Lösungen. Die Prioritäten stimmst du mit Matthias Prinz ab.

  • Betrieb & Qualität: Du sicherst deine Arbeit mit automatisierten Tests ab, behältst Logs und Schnittstellen im Blick und findest bei Störungen systematisch die Ursache. Pflege und Fehlerbehebung gehören genauso dazu wie neue Funktionen.

  • Schulung: Du stellst neue Funktionen im Team vor und schulst deine Kolleginnen und Kollegen im Umgang damit.

Wir bieten:

  • Klare Rolle: Eine Fachposition ohne Personalverantwortung – du arbeitest direkt mit dem Kanzleiinhaber zusammen, der deine Sprache spricht. Kurze Wege, klare Absprachen.

  • Gepflegte Codebasis: Automatisierte Tests, Typprüfung und dokumentierte Architektur – kein Altsystem aus den 90ern.

  • Strukturierte Einarbeitung: Die Kanzleiprozesse lernst du über unsere Schulungsplattform mit Checklisten und Schritt-für-Schritt-Anleitungen kennen.

  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz: Unbefristete Anstellung von Anfang an.

  • Harmonisches Miteinander: Ein eingespieltes, derzeit überwiegend weibliches Team, in dem man sich aufeinander verlassen kann – in hellen, modernen Büros am Mainzer Rheinufer.

  • Gleitzeit und gutes Gehalt


  • Abgeschlossenes Studium der Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation – Quereinsteigerinnen und Quereinsteiger mit entsprechenden Fachkenntnissen sind ebenso willkommen

  • Erfahrung mit agentischer Softwareentwicklung (z. B. mit Claude Code) – für uns zentral: Du gibst KI-Agenten präzise Vorgaben, zerlegst Aufgaben in überschaubare Schritte und prüfst jedes Ergebnis kritisch

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit Python, SQL (idealerweise Microsoft SQL Server), React/TypeScript und REST-APIs – aus dem Beruf, einer Werkstudententätigkeit oder eigenen Projekten

  • Von Vorteil: Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365 (Graph API, Entra ID), Docker, Git und CI/CD

  • Verständnis für Geschäftsprozesse und Freude daran, Abläufe zu ordnen und Schritt für Schritt zu verbessern

  • Geduld und ein offenes Ohr: Du erklärst Technik so, dass sie auch Kolleginnen und Kollegen ohne IT-Hintergrund verstehen

  • Sensibilität für Datenschutz und Berufsgeheimnis: Wir setzen nur Datenverarbeiter ein, die den Anforderungen des § 203 StGB und der DSGVO genügen – das berücksichtigst du bei jeder Architektur- und Tool-Entscheidung

  • Zuverlässige, sorgfältige und selbstständige Arbeitsweise – was du zusagst, hältst du ein

  • Sicheres Deutsch in Wort und Schrift

  • Juristische Kenntnisse sind nicht nötig – die fachlichen Regeln bringen wir dir bei

Du arbeitest gern gründlich, baust lieber Software, die zuverlässig läuft, als Software, die nur beeindruckt – und freust dich, wenn dein Team damit leichter arbeitet? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:  

In a dynamic international trade environment, compliance is the key to sustainable success. As a Working Student (m/f/d) in Export Control/ International Trade Compliance, you will actively support our International Trade Compliance team in the operational implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of our global export control processes. You will apply your theoretical knowledge directly to complex cases involving German, European, and US export regulations (EAR/ITAR).
In this role, your work is the vanguard of our integrity. By rigorously enforcing export controls, managing licenses, and conducting thorough due diligence, you ensure that our advanced satellite technologies and sensitive data do not fall into the wrong hands. Your daily vigilance directly upholds Planet’s core values of global transparency, ethical business practices, and global security—allowing us to continue democratizing access to space while remaining a trusted, responsible partner on the global stage.

Because compliance touches every aspect of our global operations, this role acts as a central hub. On a day-to-day basis, you will collaborate closely with: Product Managers & Engineering, Sales & Go-to-Market Teams, Logistics & Supply Chain, Purchasing/ Procurement, Internal IT & Operations, Physical Security & Lab Management.

This is a temporary, part-time position and is expected to last 12 months. This hybrid position will require you to work from our Berlin office approx. 2 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

  • Classification & Screening: Assist in determining and assigning export control classification numbers (ECCN, national list numbers) as well as conducting systemic sanction list screenings, with Product Manager. 
  • Licensing Processes: Conduct preliminary checks of licensing requirements (BAFA, EU regulations) and US re-export regulations (EAR / ITAR) and support with preparation of license applications and license management, as needed.
  • Documentation: Ensure transparent and audit-proof documentation of decision-making processes and audit trails.
  • Contract Review: Review and evaluate export control-relevant clauses in customer and supplier agreements.
  • Legal Monitoring: Monitor legal changes in national and international foreign trade law and prepare their implications for day-to-day business operations.
  • Processes & IT: Support process modeling, identify optimization potential, and coordinate interfaces with internal IT systems (e.g., ERP/NetSuite/Oracle).
  • Communication: Act as a central link and point of contact for internal departments such as Sales, Purchasing, Logistics, and IT.
  • AccessControls Lab/ Visitor Requests: Evaluate and approve visitor requests and laboratory access permissions to mitigate deemed export risks, ensuring compliance with physical security protocols and technology transfer controls in sensitive areas.
  • Review international Shipments: Perform export compliance reviews and release holds on international outbound shipments, verifying end-use, licensing coverage, and documentation prior to dispatch.
  • Anti-Bribery/KYC/DueDiligence: Conduct risk-based third-party due diligence and Know-Your-Customer (KYC) assessments on business partners, evaluating red flags and enforcing adherence to anti-bribery and anti-corruption (ABAC) policies.

What You Bring:

  • Actively enrolled in an accredited university program in Business Law (LL.B.), International Trade, Logistics/Supply Chain Management with a focus on Customs, or a comparable degree program.
  • Fluent written and spoken German and English (essential for navigating legal references).
  • Interest in foreign trade issues, ideally paired with initial exposure to EU Dual Use Regulation or US export control regulations like Export Administration Regulation (EAR)/ International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR).
  • Detail-oriented with solid analytical capabilities; equipped with the ability to pragmatically translate complex legal texts into actionable corporate workflows.
  • Proficiency in Google Office Application; familiarity with ERP systems or process modeling tools is an advantage.

Application Deadline:

11:45p / 23:45 CET on the date stated below. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. This posting may be removed earlier than projected if a suitable pool of applications has been received. For this reason, we recommend applying as soon as you are able to.

Planet Labs Germany GmbH is authorized to receive U.S. export-controlled information at Planet under an export license issued by the Bureau of Industry and Security. This position requires access to U.S. and German/EU export-controlled information, and as such, employment (or hiring of a contractor) is contingent upon the candidate’s ability to access all applicable export-controlled information without additional export licensing being required by German, EU, or U.S. authorities.

  • Own meeting room management and keep our shared spaces working for everyone.

  • Keep the office looking good, whether that’s ordering office & Vrijmibo supplies, reporting a broken window, filing the printer with paper or tidying away coffee cups.

  • Test the AV and room set-up before important meetings, like Board meetings and company All Hands, so calls connect and screens that share first time.

  • Be the go-to person for daily office questions; working with People Specialist, Facilities Manager, the Building Manager to fix what needs fixing across locations.

  • Help the Facilities & People team plan and organise how we expand into neighbouring office spaces within the building.

Hospitality and first impressions

  • Welcome visitors, partners and investors to the building, and make their visit easy from arrival to departure.

  • Meet interview candidates at reception when the recruiter team is busy, put nervous interviewees at ease, and get them where they need to be on time.

  • Working with our People Partner in setting up new hire onboarding days.

What you'll bring

You'll need

  • 1+ years in an executive support, receptionist or office hospitality role.

  • A genuine hospitality mindset. You enjoy looking after people and it shows.

  • Meticulous attention to detail: you spot the double booking, the missing receipt and the wrong time zone.

  • Proactive in coming up with solutions, not just problems. You’re smart, pragmatic, hands on, and hard working.

  • Calm, confident organisation. You can juggle a board meeting, a visitor and a broken printer in the same hour, and still smile.

  • Discretion and sound judgement with confidential information.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

  • Comfortable with Google Workspace, calendar tools and Claude.

Nice to have

  • Experience coordinating board meetings or complex logistics.

  • Experience in a fast-growing start up or scale up.

  • BHV / first aid experience.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection.

What We Offer:

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage.

Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time

Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance

A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer

Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare

We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We know this helps us make better decisions, drives more innovation, and strengthens our culture.

As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening.

title: Zweiradmechatroniker (m/w/d) - Technical Customer Service
descriptionHtml:
Schreibe mit an der Erfolgsgeschichte von RAYMON und werde Teil unseres agilen Teams! Du glaubst, dass man das Rad jeden Tag neu erfinden kann? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig! Denn mit der R Raymon Bicycles GmbH gestalten wir schon heute die Mobilität von morgen. Wir entwickeln, designen und produzieren Fahrräder sowie E-Bikes für unterschiedliche Zielgruppen.

Zur Verstärkung unseres internationales Teams, suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine/n Zweiradmechatroniker (m/w/d) - Technical Customer Service in Vollzeit.

Aufgaben

  • Technik trifft Kundenservice: Du übernimmst die Aufnahme, Diagnose, Dokumentation und Beurteilung besonders kritischer und anspruchsvoller Reklamationen, die durch unsere Fachhändler nicht gelöst werden konnten – und findest eine passende Lösung.

  • Problemlöser:in mit Werkstattfokus: Du setzt komplexe Reklamationen fachgerecht instand und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Bikes schnell wieder auf die Straße bzw. auf den Trail kommen.

  • Schnittstelle zu unseren Fachhändlern: Du kommunizierst eng mit unseren Handelspartnern und arbeitest dabei eng mit dem Customer Service Team zusammen.

  • Ersatzteile im Griff: Du kontrollierst und verwaltest unser Ersatzteillager und stellst sicher, dass benötigte Komponenten verfügbar und richtig organisiert sind.

  • Wissen teilen: Du führst interne technische Schulungen durch und gibst dein Know-how verständlich an Kolleg:innen und Partner weiter.

  • Technik mit Weitblick: Du beobachtest unsere Produktpalette aus technischer Sicht, analysierst Fehler und Reklamationen und arbeitest Lösungen für wiederkehrende Serienprobleme aus – in enger Abstimmung mit dem Quality Management.

  • Bikes für besondere Einsätze: Du montierst und wartest unsere Eventfahrräder und sorgst dafür, dass sie für ihren Einsatz bestens vorbereitet sind.

  • Individualisierung: Du individualisierst Fahrräder für Brand Ambassadoren und setzt dafür notwendige Umbauten und Anpassungen um.

  • Ready for the spotlight: Du bereitest Fahrräder für Fotoshootings, Medientests und weitere Produktauftritte technisch und optisch auf.

  • Teamplayer on Tour: Du unterstützt unser Team bei Events auch direkt vor Ort und bringst deine technische Expertise dort ein, wo sie gebraucht wird.

Qualifikation

  • Technischer Background: Du kannst richtig gut schrauben und hast Spaß daran, auch die kniffligsten Fälle zu lösen. Wenn ein Fachhändler nicht mehr weiterkommt, findest du heraus, wo das Problem liegt, entwickelst eine passende Lösung und bekommst das Bike wieder auf die Straße.

  • System- & Diagnose-Know-how: Kenntnisse von Komponentenherstellern sowie deren Software und Diagnosesystemen sind ein echtes Plus.

  • Kundenorientiert & kommunikativ: Du kommunizierst klar, lösungsorientiert und auf Augenhöhe – intern wie extern.

  • Organisationstalent: Du behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Themen den Überblick und kannst Aufgaben zuverlässig koordinieren.

  • Digital unterwegs: Du hast Erfahrung im Umgang mit ERP- und CRM-Systemen und nutzt digitale Tools sicher im Arbeitsalltag.

  • Teamplayer: Du arbeitest gerne mit anderen Abteilungen zusammen und bringst dich aktiv in gemeinsame Lösungen ein.

  • Problemlöser:in: Du zeichnest dich durch hervorragende Problemlösungskompetenz und analytisches Denken aus.

Benefits

  • Familiäres Team, starke Marke: Bei R Raymon Bicycles erwartet dich ein herzliches, motiviertes Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und echter Hands-on-Kultur.

  • Bike-Benefit: Dein Bike, dein Ride: Leihe dir für bis zu ein Jahr ein Fahrrad oder E-Bike aus unserem aktuellen Sortiment – nahezu kostenfrei und mit flexiblen Optionen im Anschluss.

  • Dienstrad-Leasing: Dein Bike für den Alltag – langfristig nutzbar, inklusive 10 % Zuschuss zur monatlichen Leasingrate sowie steuerlichen Vorteilen.

  • Zeit für dich: Genieße 30 Tage Jahresurlaub für Erholung, Abenteuer und neue Energie.

  • Zukunft sichern: Profitiere von unserer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge inklusive 25 % Arbeitgeberzuschuss – für eine finanziell abgesicherte Zukunft.

  • Gesundheit zählt: Wir unterstützen dich mit einer privaten Zusatzabsicherung im Rahmen einer betrieblichen Krankenversicherung.

  • Energie tanken: Kalte und warme Getränke sowie frisches Obst stehen dir kostenlos zur Verfügung.

  • Gemeinschaft, die trägt: Freu dich auf regelmäßige Team-Events, gemeinsame Erlebnisse und echten Zusammenhalt.

  • Mitgestalten statt nur mitarbeiten: Bringe deine Ideen ein und gestalte aktiv unsere gemeinsame Zukunft.

  • Aus Fehlern lernen: Eine offene und positive Fehlerkultur sorgt für Vertrauen, Entwicklung und echtes Teamwork.

DU BIST EIN GUTER FIT?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine aussagekräftige Bewerbung mit Motivationsschreiben, Lebenslauf und Zeugnissen. Bitte gib deinen frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermin sowie eine konkrete Gehaltsvorstellung an.
